Investors buy preferred shares at $100 par value and earn a 13% annual dividend, paid daily on business days. Strive takes that capital and converts it into Bitcoin &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/strive-inc-to-buy-500-bitcoin-this-week-using-preferred-stock-sales#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. Warrant exercises during the same period added another $12.4 million, and including those proceeds, roughly 85% of the capital Strive has raised came from SATA &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://x.com/ColeMacro/status/2104541893300568088" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.techflowpost.com/zh-TW/newsletter/138076" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The structure has one big advantage: it doesn't dilute common shareholders. &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/vitalik-buterin-says-ethereum-is.html"&gt;Every Bitcoin Strive&lt;/a&gt; buys through SATA increases the amount of BTC per share without issuing new common stock &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/strive-inc-to-buy-500-bitcoin-this-week-using-preferred-stock-sales#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;But there's a trade-off. A 13% dividend is expensive capital. Whether the strategy works depends on Bitcoin appreciating faster than that 13% annual cost &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://in.tradingview.com/news/cryptobriefing:16112b4cd094b:0-strategy-and-strive-acquire-232m-in-bitcoin-adding-2-773-btc-to-corporate-treasuries/" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Strive's Bitcoin Strategy in Context&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Strive was co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, best known for his 2024 presidential campaign &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://bitcoinmagazine.com/news/strive-buys-more-bitcoin" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. The company went public through a reverse merger and has been accumulating Bitcoin at a rapid pace since early 2026 &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.edgen.tech/zh/news/post/strive-ceo-to-speak-at-bitcoin-treasuries-conference-as-firm-holds-19900-btc" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The pace has been aggressive. In January 2026, Strive completed an all-stock acquisition of Semler Scientific, adding roughly 5,048 BTC to its balance sheet in one transaction &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://in.tradingview.com/news/cryptobriefing:71928d51c094b:0-strive-buys-additional-469-bitcoin-pushing-total-holdings-to-25-000-btc/#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. Since then, it has made regular weekly purchases — 1,800 &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/thieves-steal-two-nvidia-trailers.html"&gt;BTC &lt;/a&gt;in late August, 1,375 BTC in early September, and now 1,107 BTC &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://in.tradingview.com/news/cryptobriefing:16112b4cd094b:0-strategy-and-strive-acquire-232m-in-bitcoin-adding-2-773-btc-to-corporate-treasuries/" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Strive now ranks as the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, trailing Strategy (MicroStrategy), Twenty One, Metaplanet, and MARA &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://bitcoinmagazine.com/news/strive-buys-more-bitcoin" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Why This Matters&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The corporate Bitcoin treasury trend has evolved significantly since MicroStrategy pioneered it in 2020. What started as an experimental strategy has become an asset class of its own.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Strive's approach is distinct because it avoids debt. The company has no bonds, no credit lines, and no leveraged positions that could trigger forced liquidation &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://bitcoinmagazine.com/news/strive-buys-more-bitcoin" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. CEO Matt Cole has described the company as "debt-free with zero margin requirements and zero encumbered bitcoin."&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;That's a different risk profile from Strategy, which has used convertible debt to fund purchases. Convertible notes have maturity dates and conversion mechanics that can create pressure at inconvenient moments. Perpetual preferred stock, by contrast, has no maturity date — Strive never has to repay the principal &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/strive-inc-to-buy-500-bitcoin-this-week-using-preferred-stock-sales#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;But the obligations don't disappear. With nearly $1 billion in SATA outstanding, Strive owes roughly $130 million per year in dividends &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/strive-inc-to-buy-500-bitcoin-this-week-using-preferred-stock-sales#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. That's a fixed cash cost that must be paid whether Bitcoin goes up or down.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What to Watch Next&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Strive's accumulation pace depends on its ability to keep selling SATA. As long as Bitcoin's long-term return exceeds the 13% dividend cost, the math works. If Bitcoin enters a prolonged downturn, the company would still owe those dividends while sitting on a depreciating asset &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://in.tradingview.com/news/cryptobriefing:996536d04094b:0-strive-reportedly-targets-500-bitcoin-purchase-this-week-funded-by-preferred-stock-sales/#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The company's "amplification ratio" — a measure of Bitcoin exposure relative to net asset value — was 53.5% as of mid-September &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://in.tradingview.com/news/cryptobriefing:71928d51c094b:0-strive-buys-additional-469-bitcoin-pushing-total-holdings-to-25-000-btc/#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. Whether that ratio continues to grow will depend on both Bitcoin's price and Strive's ability to raise capital.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Strive isn't alone in this race. New entrants like XXI, BSTR, and Metaplanet are accumulating at their own paces &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://miniapp.gate.com/zh/post/topic/Strive%E6%8C%81%E4%BB%93%E7%AA%81%E7%A0%B42.5%E4%B8%87%E6%9E%9A%E6%AF%94%E7%89%B9%E5%B8%81" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. The ranking of corporate Bitcoin holders could shift quickly.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;How much Bitcoin does Strive hold now?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;27,462 BTC, following the latest 1,107 BTC purchase &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.theblockbeats.info/flash/369381" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;How did Strive pay for the Bitcoin?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Through SATA, its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock, which pays a 13% annual dividend &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/strive-inc-to-buy-500-bitcoin-this-week-using-preferred-stock-sales#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Who founded Strive?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Vivek Ramaswamy, the former 2024 presidential candidate, co-founded the company &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://bitcoinmagazine.com/news/strive-buys-more-bitcoin" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What makes Strive different from Strategy?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Strive has no debt. It funds Bitcoin purchases through perpetual preferred stock rather than convertible notes &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://bitcoinmagazine.com/news/strive-buys-more-bitcoin" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Bottom line:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; Strive's latest purchase brings its Bitcoin treasury to 27,462 BTC. The company is funding its accumulation through a perpetual preferred stock that pays 13% — a bet that Bitcoin will outperform that cost over time. Whether the strategy pays off depends on both Bitcoin's price and Strive's continued access to capital markets.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</content>

    <title>Ripple Adds XRP and RLUSD Support to Stripe and Tempo’s AI Agent Payment Protocol</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiqaFqYtmx-spEVjT2Z49wBEG_uIqlYusFa8SysEzp7D3LbhgCfEdSD1BeVAxJHa7gRs2r4qD7jJWre5qChAtlv8s9OFyccpzv-gbIJFfJAgzSwT7OKm4GUoOXf4FzWUn0eBMFY_pspF2b4CJ36UrnmHGKnp3qXVgZ77rZrmkfgmc497b3yxfck-UCha3B2/s1733/ripple-xrp-rlusd-stripe-tempo-machine-payments-protocol.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Ripple logo beside the XRP and RLUSD token symbols, connected by arrows to the Stripe and Tempo logos, representing Machine Payments Protocol support on the XRP Ledger." border="0" data-original-height="907" data-original-width="1733" height="334" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiqaFqYtmx-spEVjT2Z49wBEG_uIqlYusFa8SysEzp7D3LbhgCfEdSD1BeVAxJHa7gRs2r4qD7jJWre5qChAtlv8s9OFyccpzv-gbIJFfJAgzSwT7OKm4GUoOXf4FzWUn0eBMFY_pspF2b4CJ36UrnmHGKnp3qXVgZ77rZrmkfgmc497b3yxfck-UCha3B2/w640-h334/ripple-xrp-rlusd-stripe-tempo-machine-payments-protocol.jpg.png" title="Ripple Adds XRP and RLUSD Support to Stripe and Tempo's Machine Payments Protocol" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Ripple is taking XRP and RLUSD deeper into the emerging AI-agent economy after updating its XRPL AI Starter Kit to support the Machine Payments Protocol, an open payment standard co-authored by Stripe and Tempo.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest update gives developers a way to build AI agents that can use XRP and RLUSD when paying for digital services, including APIs, computing resources and other machine-readable services.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The development is significant because AI agents are increasingly moving beyond generating text and answering questions. The next phase involves software that can independently perform tasks, access services and make payments on behalf of users or businesses.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple's latest developer tools are designed to give those agents access to blockchain-based payment infrastructure on the XRP Ledger.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Ripple Adds MPP Support to the XRPL AI Starter Kit&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple's updated &lt;strong&gt;XRPL AI Starter Kit&lt;/strong&gt; now supports the &lt;strong&gt;Machine Payments Protocol (MPP)&lt;/strong&gt; as well as the Open Wallet Standard.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MPP was introduced by Stripe and Tempo as an open, internet-native protocol designed specifically for payments initiated by software agents. The protocol allows an agent to request a digital resource, receive payment requirements, authorize the transaction and obtain the resource programmatically. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple's integration connects that payment architecture with the XRP Ledger.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to current reporting on Ripple's developer update, the toolkit supports payments in &lt;strong&gt;XRP and RLUSD&lt;/strong&gt;, giving developers both a native XRP Ledger asset and a dollar-denominated stablecoin option for agentic transactions. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In other words, an &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/bitcoin-apocalypse-15-years-ago-btc.html"&gt;AI agent &lt;/a&gt;can potentially pay for a service without a person having to manually complete a conventional checkout process.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Is the Machine Payments Protocol?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Machine Payments Protocol is designed around a simple idea: &lt;strong&gt;software agents should be able to pay for internet services as easily as they can request them.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Stripe and Tempo introduced MPP in March 2026, describing it as an open standard for agents and services to coordinate payments programmatically. The protocol is designed to support microtransactions, recurring payments and other machine-driven payment models. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A simplified MPP transaction can work like this:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol&gt;
&lt;li&gt;An AI agent requests a resource from a service.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The service returns the required payment information.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The agent authorizes the payment.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The payment is processed through the supported payment infrastructure.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The requested resource is delivered to the agent.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The resource could be an API call, data, computing power, AI inference or another digital service.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is different from traditional online commerce, where a human normally creates an account, enters payment information and confirms a purchase.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MPP is being designed for an internet in which software itself can become an economic participant.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why XRP Is Being Positioned for AI-Agent Payments&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The AI-agent economy creates a different set of requirements for payment systems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A human may make a few online payments every day. An autonomous software agent could potentially make many smaller payments while completing a larger task.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That makes factors such as settlement speed, transaction costs, wallet controls and programmability particularly important.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple's XRPL AI Starter Kit was originally introduced to help developers build AI-agent applications that can transact using the XRP Ledger. Ripple highlighted use cases including payments for APIs, computing and other digital services. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest MPP integration expands the number of payment standards developers can work with when building those applications.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;RLUSD Gives AI Agents a Dollar-Denominated Payment Option&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;XRP is only one part of the strategy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple is also bringing &lt;strong&gt;RLUSD&lt;/strong&gt;, its dollar-denominated stablecoin, into the AI-payment infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The difference matters for businesses that want blockchain settlement without exposing the price of a transaction to the volatility of XRP.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For example, an AI agent could theoretically request an API priced at a fixed dollar amount and settle that payment using a dollar-pegged digital asset.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That could make stablecoins particularly relevant for machine-to-machine commerce, where predictable pricing may be more important than exposure to a volatile asset.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple previously added XRP and RLUSD support for &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/circle-ceo-jeremy-allaire-says-crypto.html"&gt;AI-agent payments &lt;/a&gt;through the x402 payment standard when it launched the XRPL AI Starter Kit. The latest update adds MPP as another route for developers. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Ripple Is Supporting Multiple AI Payment Standards&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One of the more interesting aspects of the update is that Ripple is not relying on a single emerging AI-payment protocol.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The XRPL AI Starter Kit already supports &lt;strong&gt;x402&lt;/strong&gt;, while the new version adds support for MPP.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;thead&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;Protocol&lt;/th&gt;

&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;XRPL Connection&lt;/th&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;MPP&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Machine-to-service &lt;br /&gt;payments for AI agents&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Supported through the &lt;br /&gt;updated XRPL AI Starter &lt;br /&gt;Kit&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Previously supported using &lt;br /&gt;XRP and RLUSD&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This approach could give developers more flexibility as standards for machine payments continue to evolve.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Can AI Agents Pay For?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The technology is primarily aimed at digital services that can be delivered automatically.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;table style="border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;thead&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;Use case&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;Potential agent activity&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/thead&gt;
&lt;tbody&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;AI inference&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Pay for an AI model or inference &lt;br /&gt;request&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Computing&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Pay automatically for API access &lt;br /&gt;or individual calls&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Digital services&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Purchase other machine-readable &lt;br /&gt;online resources&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Stripe's own MPP examples include agents paying for browser infrastructure and other online services, demonstrating how the protocol is intended to support transactions where software rather than humans is the primary user. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Open Wallet Standard Is Also Important&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple's update is not limited to payments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The XRPL AI Starter Kit also adds support for the &lt;strong&gt;Open Wallet Standard&lt;/strong&gt;, which is intended to provide a common way for software to interact with blockchain wallets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That matters because autonomous agents need more than a payment protocol. They also need a secure way to manage transactions and interact with wallets without receiving unrestricted access to private keys.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wallet permissions, spending limits and transaction authorization can become critical safeguards when software is allowed to move money automatically.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For AI agents, the challenge is therefore not simply making &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-calls-ai.html"&gt;blockchain payments &lt;/a&gt;faster. The infrastructure also needs to determine &lt;strong&gt;what an agent is allowed to spend, where it can send funds and under what conditions a transaction can be approved.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Ripple's AI Payment Push Started Earlier This Year&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest MPP integration is part of a broader Ripple strategy rather than an isolated announcement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple launched its XRPL AI Starter Kit in June 2026, initially highlighting x402-powered payments using XRP and RLUSD. The company described the toolkit as a way for developers to build applications in which AI agents can transact for APIs, computing resources and other digital services. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company is now expanding that toolkit to another major machine-payment standard.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That progression reflects a larger change in how the cryptocurrency industry is approaching AI.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of treating AI simply as a tool for analyzing blockchain data or generating trading information, developers are increasingly exploring AI systems that can actually &lt;strong&gt;hold value, request services and execute transactions.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Machine-to-Machine Payments Could Become Important&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;AI agents could eventually operate continuously rather than only when a human opens an application.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;An autonomous agent might monitor markets, collect data, call specialized AI models, purchase additional computing capacity and send information to another service as part of one workflow.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Every one of those actions could potentially involve a payment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Traditional financial infrastructure was primarily designed around human users. Stripe itself argues that today's payment systems often require agents to navigate account creation, pricing pages, payment credentials and billing processes designed for people. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Machine-payment protocols attempt to remove those barriers by making payment instructions understandable and executable by software.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If that model scales, blockchain networks and stablecoins could become part of the underlying payment layer for autonomous software.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Ripple's XRP Ledger Is Targeting That Emerging Economy&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The XRP Ledger is now being positioned by Ripple as infrastructure for this potential machine economy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The appeal is not necessarily that AI agents need cryptocurrency for its own sake. Instead, the attraction is the ability to combine programmable software with blockchain-based settlement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;XRP can provide a native asset for transactions on XRPL, while RLUSD can provide a dollar-denominated alternative.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The result is a payment stack in which developers can choose the asset that best fits a particular application.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Technical Integration Does Not Equal Mass Adoption&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is an important distinction between what the new toolkit enables and what is already happening at commercial scale.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple's update gives developers the technical tools to build MPP-based AI payment applications. It does not mean that millions of AI agents are already using XRP or RLUSD to purchase services.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The MPP integration is an infrastructure and developer milestone. Actual adoption will depend on developers building applications, businesses accepting machine payments and users trusting autonomous agents with financial permissions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction is especially important for XRP investors and the wider crypto market. A new integration can expand the potential utility of an asset without guaranteeing future transaction volumes or token-price performance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What This Means for XRP and RLUSD&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The immediate significance for XRP and RLUSD is that both assets are being positioned for a new category of digital transactions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of focusing exclusively on human-to-human or human-to-business payments, Ripple is targeting &lt;strong&gt;machine-to-machine commerce.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If AI agents become regular economic participants, they will need infrastructure for purchasing data, computing resources, software tools and other services.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple is attempting to make XRP Ledger assets available within that emerging payment environment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, the success of that strategy will ultimately depend on real-world usage rather than the existence of the technical integration itself.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The next phase will likely be driven by developers experimenting with MPP, x402 and wallet standards across different AI-agent applications.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple's continued development of the XRPL AI Starter Kit will also determine how easily developers can build, test and deploy those applications.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Meanwhile, Stripe and Tempo are continuing to develop MPP as a broader standard for machine payments. Stripe says MPP is intended to support both microtransactions and recurring payments while allowing businesses to use existing payment infrastructure. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If AI agents become widespread users of internet services, the ability to pay automatically could become an important piece of the AI infrastructure stack.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ripple has added &lt;strong&gt;Machine Payments Protocol support to the XRPL AI Starter Kit&lt;/strong&gt;, giving developers another way to build AI-agent payment applications around XRP and RLUSD.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MPP was co-authored by Stripe and Tempo and is designed to let software agents coordinate payments with online services programmatically. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Ripple, the move expands its existing AI-payment strategy beyond x402 and strengthens the XRP Ledger's position in the developing machine-to-machine economy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The technology is still early, and technical support should not be confused with mass commercial adoption. But the direction is clear: Ripple wants XRP and RLUSD to be usable not only by people, but also by the autonomous software systems that may increasingly transact on the internet.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Editorial note:&lt;/strong&gt; This article distinguishes between technical capability and confirmed adoption. Ripple's latest update provides developers with MPP and wallet-standard support, but it does not establish a specific level of commercial usage or guarantee future XRP/RLUSD transaction volumes.&lt;/p&gt;
</content>

font-size: 16px; height: 1px; margin: 32px 0px;" /&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Tether has now frozen nearly $550 million in USDT tied to Iran’s central bank and sanctions networks this year alone, according to a company disclosure published Sunday &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://tether.io/news/tether-has-supported-nearly-550-million-in-iran-linked-usdt-freezes-as-u-s-expands-sanctions-campaign/" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. The freezes mark one of the largest crypto-focused sanctions enforcement actions to date.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The stablecoin issuer said the actions were taken in coordination with the U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) and American law enforcement.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;How the Freezes Happened&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The $550 million figure comes from two separate actions.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;In &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;April 2026&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, Tether froze more than &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;$344 million&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; in USDT across two addresses linked to the Central Bank of Iran &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-04-24-us-sanctions-iran-linked-crypto-wallets-addresses-344-million-frozen-tether-cnn-398847#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. The freeze came after OFAC provided information identifying the wallets. The next day, OFAC formally added those addresses to its sanctions list as digital currency identifiers for Iran’s central bank &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://tether.io/news/tether-has-supported-nearly-550-million-in-iran-linked-usdt-freezes-as-u-s-expands-sanctions-campaign/" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;In &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;July 2026&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, Tether froze another **$131 million** across four TRON addresses as the Treasury expanded its designation of the Central Bank of Iran &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://coinpaprika.com/news/us-freezes-130m-iranian-central-bank-crypto/#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;a href="https://cointelegraph.com/news/us-freezes-131m-in-iran-linked-crypto-as-middle-east-tensions-rise?utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound&amp;amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;amp;utm_source=rss_feed#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. Chainalysis reported that those four wallets had received roughly $165 million in &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/zuckerberg-says-superintelligence-will.html"&gt;stablecoins&lt;/a&gt;, though some funds had moved before the freeze took effect &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/07/16/u-s-adds-four-iran-central-bank-crypto-wallets-to-sanctions-tether-freezes-usd131-million-of-contents#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Together, the two actions amount to approximately $550 million in Iran-linked USDT frozen in 2026.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What “Freezing” Actually Means&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;This is important to understand. When Tether freezes USDT, it doesn’t seize the funds or move them anywhere. The tokens remain in the wallets.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;What happens is this: Tether updates its smart contract blacklist, which makes the tokens permanently immovable. The &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/bitmine-buys-another-17362-eth-total.html"&gt;wallet &lt;/a&gt;holder still controls the private keys, but they can’t transfer, spend, or redeem the USDT &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://coinmarketcap.com/community/el/articles/6a5918a383f6e67c15379696/#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;This is only possible because USDT is a centralized stablecoin. Tether, as the issuer, retains administrative control over the token contract. Decentralized assets like Bitcoin cannot be frozen this way.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Tether’s Broader Enforcement Record&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The Iran-linked freezes are part of a much larger picture. Tether said it has supported more than &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;2,900 investigations globally&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, including over 1,600 involving U.S. law enforcement &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://tether.io/news/tether-has-supported-nearly-550-million-in-iran-linked-usdt-freezes-as-u-s-expands-sanctions-campaign/" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. Across all actions, the company has frozen more than &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;$4.9 billion** in assets, with over **$2.4 billion&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; tied to U.S. authorities &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://foresightnews.pro/news/detail/114173" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Tether now cooperates with &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;340+ law enforcement agencies across 67 countries&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://foresightnews.pro/news/detail/114173" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Paolo Ardoino, Tether’s CEO, framed the freezes as a feature of public &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/vivek-ramaswamys-strive-buys-1107.html"&gt;blockchains&lt;/a&gt;, not a bug: “Public blockchains provide authorities with a level of visibility into the movement of funds that simply does not exist with cash, and Tether can act when credible information is provided by law enforcement” &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://tether.io/news/tether-has-supported-nearly-550-million-in-iran-linked-usdt-freezes-as-u-s-expands-sanctions-campaign/" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;The Operation Behind It&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The freezes are part of a broader U.S. campaign called &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Operation Economic Outcast&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, announced by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent last month. The operation targets financial networks supporting the Iranian regime and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://tether.io/news/tether-has-supported-nearly-550-million-in-iran-linked-usdt-freezes-as-u-s-expands-sanctions-campaign/" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Treasury specifically identified digital assets as one of five sectors at risk of expanded sanctions.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Bessent has been vocal about the strategy: “We will follow the money that Tehran is desperately attempting to move outside of the country and target all financial lifelines tied to the regime” &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-04-24-us-sanctions-iran-linked-crypto-wallets-addresses-344-million-frozen-tether-cnn-398847#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;A Legal Fight Is Brewing&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The frozen funds are now at the center of a legal battle. In May, a U.S. law firm filed a motion seeking to compel Tether to hand over the $344 million to victims of Iranian state-sponsored terrorism. The plaintiffs hold unpaid judgments totaling more than $2.4 billion &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://cointelegraph.com/news/us-law-firm-motion-redistribution-344m-usdt-iran#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-05-15-victims-of-iran-attacks-seek-court-order-for-turnover-of-344-million-in-usdt-frozen-by-tether-401443#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The motion argues that Tether has the technical capability to “zero out” the frozen addresses and reissue equivalent USDT to the plaintiffs, citing previous cases where Tether transferred frozen funds to law enforcement-controlled wallets &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-05-15-victims-of-iran-attacks-seek-court-order-for-turnover-of-344-million-in-usdt-frozen-by-tether-401443#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);     <title>Balancer Could Shut Down: $9M Treasury May Go to BAL Holders Who Burn Their Tokens</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhQD3IRoKbhMgQ8In0rkudx9MSeOzD5jTpDtytfNfCqGRmjTiHGMI0ExfVIFv6rvlehTMAKDE0mI1qWzwrFBR45gMX-FAFeD0cGHxGzdoeRJwHenaz5SGEI654B0Cs3O_3QqOE-lJO0Pr1jk1Ec0h9GL6BM4McYFEWVjEcBjlezf1XMhNr-vBHbzpDptmxd/s1734/balancer-wind-down-treasury-bal-holders.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="“Balancer wind-down proposal to distribute treasury assets to BAL holders”" border="0" data-original-height="907" data-original-width="1734" height="334" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhQD3IRoKbhMgQ8In0rkudx9MSeOzD5jTpDtytfNfCqGRmjTiHGMI0ExfVIFv6rvlehTMAKDE0mI1qWzwrFBR45gMX-FAFeD0cGHxGzdoeRJwHenaz5SGEI654B0Cs3O_3QqOE-lJO0Pr1jk1Ec0h9GL6BM4McYFEWVjEcBjlezf1XMhNr-vBHbzpDptmxd/w640-h334/balancer-wind-down-treasury-bal-holders.jpg.png" title="“Balancer Wind-Down Proposal and Treasury Distribution”" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;Balancer could be heading toward an orderly shutdown after a new governance proposal called for winding down the DeFi protocol and distributing its remaining treasury to eligible BAL holders.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal, published on Balancer's governance forum on September 14, 2026, would end new business development, gradually sunset the protocol, move eligible pools toward withdrawals-only operation and replace the planned BAL buyback with a treasury redemption mechanism.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Under the proposed plan, BAL holders would eventually burn their tokens and receive a pro-rata share of the treasury in the assets actually held by the DAO.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But Balancer has &lt;strong&gt;not shut down&lt;/strong&gt;. The proposal still needs approval from BAL holders through a Snapshot governance vote scheduled for &lt;strong&gt;September 25–29, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. The proposal states that wind-down actions will wait for the vote.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At current token prices, Balancer estimates that its managed treasury is worth &lt;strong&gt;at least $9 million&lt;/strong&gt;. That is not a guaranteed payout. The final distributable amount will be measured and audited when the first redemption round opens in May 2027, and it can change with token prices, expenses, recoveries and other treasury assets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Is Balancer Proposing?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The new governance proposal calls for a phased wind-down rather than an immediate shutdown.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The central plan is to stop pursuing new business development, gradually reduce the protocol's operating footprint, preserve users' ability to withdraw liquidity and eventually return the remaining treasury to BAL holders.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal includes several major changes:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Ending new business development.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Phasing out the protocol over a defined exit period.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Moving eligible pools to withdrawals-only operation on October 30, 2026.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Ending the current bug-bounty coverage on October 30, 2026.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Canceling the BIP-919 BAL buyback.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Consolidating DAO-owned treasury assets before the first distribution.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Distributing the treasury to eligible BAL holders on a pro-rata basis.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Opening the first redemption round at the end of May 2027.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Conducting a second distribution and a final treasury sweep afterward.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal also emphasizes that Balancer's contracts are non-custodial. Users' ability to withdraw funds does not depend on Balancer continuing to operate its frontend or business.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Is Balancer Considering a Wind-Down?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal says the main reason is the lack of sustained revenue growth despite attempts to restructure the protocol and improve its path toward profitability.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Earlier in 2026, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/bitcoin-apocalypse-15-years-ago-btc.html"&gt;BAL holders&lt;/a&gt; approved a restructuring plan designed to reduce costs, end emissions, simplify the token model, route protocol revenue to the DAO and rely on Balancer v3 for future growth.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to the new proposal, the team implemented that strategy, but the expected revenue growth did not materialize.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal says most of Balancer's protocol revenue still comes from v2, while v3 revenue has not grown enough to replace it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The figures cited in the proposal show the financial pressure:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;thead&gt;

&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal therefore argues that continuing to spend treasury funds without a convincing path to sustainable growth could ultimately leave BAL holders with less value.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Did the 2025 Balancer Exploit Cause the Shutdown?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The November 2025 exploit is part of Balancer's recent history, but the official proposal does not describe the exploit as the sole reason for the wind-down.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The incident affected legacy v2 pools. Balancer says v3 uses a different architecture, while acknowledging that the exploit made it harder for the protocol to rebuild traction and affected the effort to execute the restructuring plan.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal's broader argument is that Balancer tried to improve the &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ocean-protocol-launches-inference.html"&gt;business&lt;/a&gt; after the restructuring, but the required sustained revenue growth did not arrive.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This distinction is important because it would be inaccurate to describe the proposed shutdown simply as a direct consequence of the 2025 exploit.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal also makes clear that funds recovered from attacks belong to affected liquidity providers and are outside the treasury distribution described in the wind-down plan.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How Would the $9 Million Treasury Be Distributed?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposed mechanism is different from a conventional token buyback.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Eligible BAL holders would &lt;strong&gt;burn their BAL tokens and receive their proportional share of the treasury in kind&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means holders would receive the assets actually held by the treasury rather than necessarily receiving BAL or a single cash-denominated payment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal specifically cancels the previously approved &lt;strong&gt;BIP-919 BAL buyback&lt;/strong&gt; and replaces it with the treasury distribution mechanism.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Round One: BAL Redemption&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The first redemption round is scheduled to open at the &lt;strong&gt;end of May 2027&lt;/strong&gt;, assuming the wind-down proposal passes and the plan is implemented.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Before the round opens, Balancer plans to consolidate relevant DAO wallets, operational safes, fee-collection wallets, receivables and other DAO-owned positions into the treasury accounting process.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The opening snapshot will determine eligibility and the distribution denominator. The proposal says the treasury will be measured and audited at the block when round one opens.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The treasury is currently estimated at &lt;strong&gt;at least $9 million&lt;/strong&gt;, but that number can change before the distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The first redemption window would remain open for six months, ending at the &lt;strong&gt;end of November 2027&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When a holder redeems, the BAL is burned and the claim contract records the address and amount redeemed. That record becomes the basis for the second distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Round Two: Additional Treasury Assets&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A second distribution is planned within two months after the first redemption round closes.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Importantly, the second round would only go to addresses that participated in round one.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It would distribute assets including:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Any unspent portion of the wind-down budget.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Assets that arrive after the first snapshot.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Fees collected after the pause where applicable.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Revenue from pools that continue operating.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Recovered receivables.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Funds returned to the DAO.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The portion of the treasury that was not redeemed during round one.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The second distribution would be proportional to the amount of BAL each address redeemed in the first round.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Final Treasury Sweep&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A final sweep is proposed approximately six months after the second distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Any additional assets that arrive by that point would be distributed to the same addresses using the same proportional basis.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposed timeline places the final sweep around the &lt;strong&gt;end of July 2028&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens to veBAL, auraBAL, sdBAL and tetuBAL?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal includes specific rules for BAL held through different Balancer-related systems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;veBAL&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal expects all existing veBAL locks to have expired by the end of May 2027.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;veBAL positions unlock into an &lt;strong&gt;80/20 BAL/WETH BPT&lt;/strong&gt;. Holders can exit that position to BAL and then use the BAL in the treasury redemption process.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;auraBAL and sdBAL&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;These wrapper protocols have their own claim and unwind schedules.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Holders who want to participate in the BAL redemption would need to unwind their positions into BAL according to the applicable wrapper protocol's process before the relevant deadline.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal says a position that has not been unwound to BAL by the close of round one would not redeem through the standard process.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;tetuBAL&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;tetuBAL receives special treatment because it is an immutable permalock and does not simply convert back into BAL.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal fixes the relevant tetuBAL holder set and the BAL backing at the block when the proposal was posted.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When round one opens, tetuBAL holders would receive BAL equivalent to &lt;strong&gt;half of the measured BAL backing&lt;/strong&gt; from the treasury. That BAL can then be redeemed during the same window as other eligible holders.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;When Would Balancer Pools Become Withdrawals-Only?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the governance proposal passes, &lt;strong&gt;October 30, 2026&lt;/strong&gt; is the key operational transition date.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;On that date, pools that can be paused would be paused and moved to withdrawals-only operation. Where a pool's contracts require it, recovery mode would be enabled so &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/top-7-token-unlocks-this-week-zro-leads.html"&gt;withdrawals&lt;/a&gt; remain available.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Pools that cannot be paused would continue operating under their existing contract rules, with the protocol fee set to zero where the contracts permit it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal says the goal is to ensure that users can exit their positions without depending on Balancer continuing to operate its normal frontend, routing infrastructure or communications.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How Much Will the Wind-Down Cost?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposed wind-down has a defined budget rather than an unlimited operating allocation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The $220,000 reserve would only be drawn if needed.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Any part of the wind-down budget that is not spent would return to the treasury and ultimately become part of the distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens to Balancer's Code, Licenses and Other DAO Assets?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposed treasury distribution does not automatically transfer every asset associated with Balancer to one party.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Code, licenses, deployments and other DAO-owned assets outside the treasury would require separate governance decisions, with each transfer going through its own Snapshot vote.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal says nothing is handed to anyone by default.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If an asset is sold or otherwise generates value for the DAO, that value would flow back into the treasury where applicable.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is another reason why the &lt;strong&gt;$9 million figure should not be treated as the total economic value of everything connected to Balancer&lt;/strong&gt;. It is the current estimate of the managed treasury, while other DAO addresses and positions are still being inventoried.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens to Funds Recovered From Past Attacks?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Funds recovered from attacks are treated separately from the treasury distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to the proposal, those funds belong to liquidity providers affected by the relevant attacks and therefore remain outside the distribution to BAL holders.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Recovery efforts are expected to continue separately, and recovered funds are intended to go to affected LPs rather than becoming part of the general treasury distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Balancer Governance Vote: September 25–29, 2026&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The most important near-term event is the proposed &lt;strong&gt;Snapshot vote from September 25 through September 29, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal also specifies a &lt;strong&gt;5 million BAL quorum under BIP-924&lt;/strong&gt;. That means at least 5 million BAL of eligible voting power must participate for the governance vote to meet the stated quorum requirement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Voting power is based on eligible BAL held or delegated across supported chains, with specific treatment for the BAL underlying 80/20 BAL/WETH BPT on Ethereum and veBAL positions. Positions excluded under BIP-924 do not carry voting power.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What If BAL Holders Reject the Proposal?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A rejection would not automatically shut down Balancer.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal states that a “no” vote would leave the existing framework in place, including the BIP-918 mandate and budget, the BIP-919 buyback schedule, the BIP-687 bug-bounty earmark and the existing contracts.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That makes the September governance vote the critical decision point.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If approved, Balancer would move toward a controlled wind-down and treasury distribution. If rejected, the current framework would remain in place unless governance later approves another direction.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Balancer Proposal Matters for DeFi&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Balancer's proposed wind-down is significant beyond the BAL token because it highlights a difficult issue for mature decentralized protocols: what happens when a DAO still has a meaningful treasury but no longer has a convincing path to sustainable revenue growth?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of continuing to spend treasury funds indefinitely, the proposal argues that the remaining value should eventually be returned to the token holders who govern the protocol.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It also offers an example of how a DeFi protocol could wind down while preserving user access to funds through non-custodial smart contracts.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposed process separates liquidity withdrawals, treasury management, governance, asset transfers, contributor transition and legal-entity closure into different stages.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What BAL Holders Should Watch Next&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The first major catalyst is the &lt;strong&gt;September 25–29 governance vote&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Before voting, BAL holders should watch for any changes to the wind-down proposal, the final inventory of DAO-controlled assets and the implementation specification that is expected to be published for comment before the first redemption round.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The eventual treasury distribution will also depend on the assets actually held when round one opens in May 2027.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Therefore, the current &lt;strong&gt;$9 million estimate is not a guaranteed amount&lt;/strong&gt;. It is a snapshot of the managed treasury at current token prices. The proposal says the amount that counts will be measured and audited at the opening block for round one.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Balancer is considering an orderly wind-down that could return at least $9 million in treasury assets to eligible BAL holders, but the shutdown is not final.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the proposal passes, eligible BAL holders would eventually burn their tokens and receive a pro-rata share of the treasury in the assets actually held by the DAO. The first redemption round is planned for the end of May 2027, followed by a second distribution and a final sweep extending the proposed process into July 2028.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The plan also calls for eligible pools to move to withdrawals-only operation on October 30, 2026, a proposed $400,000 wind-down budget, cancellation of the BIP-919 buyback and separate governance votes for DAO assets outside the treasury.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The governance proposal requires a &lt;strong&gt;5 million BAL quorum under BIP-924&lt;/strong&gt;, making voter participation another key factor in the upcoming decision.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For now, the decisive event is the &lt;strong&gt;September 25–29, 2026 Snapshot vote&lt;/strong&gt;. Until BAL holders approve the proposal, Balancer's wind-down remains a governance plan rather than a completed shutdown.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Editorial fact-check note:&lt;/strong&gt; The article uses Balancer's official September 14 governance proposal as its primary source. The proposal's current forum title contains the temporary “BIP-XXX” identifier; this article intentionally refers to it as the “Balancer wind-down proposal” rather than presenting an unconfirmed BIP number as final.&lt;/p&gt;
