    &lt;/table&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 13px;"&gt;
    &lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;&lt;em&gt;Operational figures including transaction volume, wallets, enterprise customers and geographic reach are figures reported by Fasset.&lt;/em&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Fasset's $68 Million Series C
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The latest funding round gives Fasset a private valuation of &lt;strong&gt;$1 billion&lt;/strong&gt;. That places the company in the fintech unicorn category, a term generally used for privately held companies valued at $1 billion or more.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Japan's &lt;strong&gt;SBI Group&lt;/strong&gt; led the Series C round. The &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/strategy-pauses-bitcoin-buying-as-669b.html"&gt;investment&lt;/a&gt; also builds on an existing relationship between the two companies, including a strategic partnership involving &lt;strong&gt;SBI Remit&lt;/strong&gt; for international money-transfer infrastructure.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The new financing comes only months after Fasset raised $51 million in its Series B round. Combined with the latest financing, the company says it has raised &lt;strong&gt;$119 million during 2026&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    What Fasset Is Building
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Fasset describes itself as a stablecoin-powered neobanking and financial infrastructure platform. Its model is designed to connect users and businesses with financial services across multiple markets while using digital assets and stablecoins as part of the underlying settlement infrastructure.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    A major component of the company's strategy is &lt;strong&gt;Own Network&lt;/strong&gt;, which Fasset says connects banks, telecommunications companies, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/us-treasury-may-tap-nearly-1t-cash-pile.html"&gt;payment providers&lt;/a&gt; and liquidity providers across more than 100 international banking corridors.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Stablecoins can be used within this infrastructure as a settlement mechanism, while Fasset is also developing AI-powered systems designed to support corridor banking, transaction routing, stablecoin settlement and tokenized assets.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Why SBI Group's Investment Matters
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    SBI Group is one of Japan's major financial groups, with businesses spanning financial services, investment and digital assets.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    SBI Group has invested across the digital-asset sector, including companies such as &lt;strong&gt;Ripple, Circle and Morpho&lt;/strong&gt;, as well as crypto liquidity provider B2C2.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    For Fasset, the relationship could provide access to a broader financial network as the company attempts to expand its cross-border payment and settlement infrastructure across Asia, the Middle East and other emerging markets.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Fasset Reports More Than $40B in Annualized Volume
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Fasset says its platform has reached more than &lt;strong&gt;$40 billion in annualized transaction volume&lt;/strong&gt;. The company also reports more than &lt;strong&gt;3 million wallets&lt;/strong&gt;, over &lt;strong&gt;1,000 enterprise customers&lt;/strong&gt; and a presence spanning &lt;strong&gt;125 countries&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Those figures illustrate the scale of the network Fasset is building, although they are company-reported operating metrics rather than independently audited financial results.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The company says the Series C capital will help it expand this infrastructure and develop additional payment and financial corridors.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Where the New Capital Will Go
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Fasset says the fresh funding will support several areas of its expansion strategy.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;ul style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.9; padding-left: 25px;"&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;
      &lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own Network expansion:&lt;/strong&gt; Fasset plans to expand the infrastructure connecting banks, payment providers, liquidity providers and other financial institutions.
    &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li&gt;
      &lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;AI-powered financial systems:&lt;/strong&gt; The company plans to increase investment in systems supporting corridor banking, stablecoin settlement, transaction routing and tokenized assets.
    &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li&gt;
      &lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;International expansion:&lt;/strong&gt; Fasset aims to develop additional cross-border financial corridors using strategic partnerships and its growing international network.
    &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Stablecoins Move Beyond Crypto Trading
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The Fasset funding round comes at a time when stablecoins are increasingly being explored for uses beyond cryptocurrency trading.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Financial institutions, fintech companies and payment providers are examining stablecoins for cross-border transfers, settlement and other forms of digital money movement.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    That broader infrastructure opportunity is where Fasset is attempting to position itself. Rather than treating stablecoins only as crypto assets, the company is building services around their potential use as settlement rails.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The involvement of a major Japanese financial group such as SBI also highlights the increasing overlap between traditional finance and digital-asset infrastructure.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The Road Ahead
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Reaching a $1 billion private valuation is a major milestone, but the next stage will be about execution.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Fasset now has additional capital to expand its network, build AI-enabled financial systems and develop more international payment corridors. The challenge will be turning those investments into sustainable growth while operating across different regulatory and financial environments.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    SBI Group's involvement could become particularly important as Fasset expands its presence in Asia and other emerging markets.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The company's ability to maintain growth, expand its network and convert transaction activity into durable revenue will ultimately determine whether the latest valuation can be supported over the long term.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The Bottom Line
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Fasset has raised &lt;strong&gt;$68 million in Series C funding led by Japan's SBI Group&lt;/strong&gt;, taking its private valuation to &lt;strong&gt;$1 billion&lt;/strong&gt; and moving the company into unicorn territory.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    The round follows Fasset's $51 million Series B and brings its total 2026 fundraising to $119 million. The company plans to use the capital to expand Own Network and develop AI-enabled systems for cross-border banking, stablecoin settlement and tokenized assets.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    But the bigger story may be the growing institutional interest in the infrastructure surrounding stablecoins.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;
    Stablecoins are increasingly being explored as rails for moving money across borders, and Fasset is positioning its platform around that opportunity. With SBI Group leading the latest funding round, the company now has additional financial and strategic backing to pursue that expansion.
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;"&gt;
    &lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The next question is whether Fasset can turn that growing network into sustainable long-term growth.&lt;/strong&gt;
  &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr style="border-color: rgb(221, 221, 221) currentcolor currentcolor; border-image: none; border-style: solid none none; border-top: 1px solid #ddd; border-width: 1px 0px 0px; border: 0px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; margin: 35px 0px 20px;" /&gt;

    <title>Hunter Biden Says “I Don’t Want Anybody to Buy My Coin” as $LAPTOP Crashes After Launch</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;h1&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhHXIdKnOZwDRoCtTd-Ms99s12GpCNYxu-s18U1LmuBOffagbRIc0Yic-1i1pqwDebaDBeaJN7WeHkp6YU3SZBPhyphenhyphenqzB8saezJleOZm62uVKshvlS99V89Cg6tQQK1Np0YCvN4MOwCX0buxBZGBYEMfjdwCCqDQHPxbc5UUNsPX4U5yd9n8OxjRZTGvw1Ec/s1733/hunter-biden-laptop-crypto-coin-crash.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Hunter Biden discusses his $LAPTOP crypto coin after its sharp price crash" border="0" data-original-height="907" data-original-width="1733" height="334" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhHXIdKnOZwDRoCtTd-Ms99s12GpCNYxu-s18U1LmuBOffagbRIc0Yic-1i1pqwDebaDBeaJN7WeHkp6YU3SZBPhyphenhyphenqzB8saezJleOZm62uVKshvlS99V89Cg6tQQK1Np0YCvN4MOwCX0buxBZGBYEMfjdwCCqDQHPxbc5UUNsPX4U5yd9n8OxjRZTGvw1Ec/w640-h334/hunter-biden-laptop-crypto-coin-crash.webp.png" title="Hunter Biden $LAPTOP Crypto Coin Crash" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Hunter Biden says his crypto project isn't about getting people to buy a token.&lt;/strong&gt; In a recent appearance on Bradley Martyn's &lt;em&gt;RawTalk&lt;/em&gt;, Biden said, “I don't want anybody to buy my coin,” explaining that he sees the project as a way to reach the cryptocurrency community and talk directly to its audience.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The comment comes only days after the launch of &lt;strong&gt;$LAPTOP&lt;/strong&gt;, a politically themed memecoin built around the controversy surrounding Biden's laptop. The token experienced an extraordinary launch, briefly trading above $190 and, according to some market trackers, above $300, before losing almost all of its value. The Financial Times reported that the token lost about 98% of its value within minutes. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The collapse has raised questions about liquidity, automated trading, token distribution and the risks associated with celebrity and political memecoins.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Hunter Biden Says the Coin Is a Way to Reach the Crypto Crowd&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Biden's explanation is notable because he is not presenting $LAPTOP as a conventional investment opportunity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead, he described the token as a way to reach people already involved in cryptocurrency. His stated goal is to communicate with a community that has become increasingly influential across finance, technology, online culture and U.S. politics.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;CoinMarketCap highlighted Biden's comments in an X post on September 12, 2026, quoting his appearance on Bradley Martyn's &lt;em&gt;RawTalk&lt;/em&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;blockquote&gt;
&lt;p&gt;“I don’t want anybody to buy my coin.”&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/blockquote&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The timing is striking because $LAPTOP has already experienced extreme price volatility since its launch.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Is Hunter Biden's $LAPTOP Coin?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;$LAPTOP&lt;/strong&gt; is a memecoin launched on the &lt;strong&gt;Base blockchain&lt;/strong&gt;, Coinbase's Ethereum layer-2 network.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The token's name refers to the laptop that became a major political controversy during the 2020 U.S. presidential election. Biden has attempted to reclaim the symbolism surrounding that episode by turning it into the basis for a cryptocurrency project.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Before the launch, Biden described $LAPTOP as a symbol of &lt;strong&gt;“resilience, redemption, and recovery.”&lt;/strong&gt; He also positioned the project as an alternative to politically connected memecoins such as Donald Trump's $TRUMP token. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The token was launched with a total supply of &lt;strong&gt;1 billion tokens&lt;/strong&gt;. Reporting from The Wall Street Journal said 30% was allocated to founders, including Biden, with those tokens subject to lock-up and vesting conditions. Another allocation was intended for people who lost money on $TRUMP and followers of Biden's media platforms, while other tokens were designated for liquidity, charity and administrative purposes. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;$LAPTOP Surged Above $190 Before Collapsing&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The exact peak price varies depending on the exchange and market-data provider because trading was extremely volatile during the first hours of the launch.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Wall Street Journal reported that $LAPTOP launched at approximately &lt;strong&gt;$0.05&lt;/strong&gt; and briefly reached &lt;strong&gt;$199.51&lt;/strong&gt; before falling more than 95%. Other trackers recorded temporary prices above $300 during the extreme launch volatility. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The exact peak matters less than what happened next. &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ai-insider-trading-new-market-abuse.html"&gt;The token&lt;/a&gt; rapidly lost almost all of the value it had gained during the initial buying frenzy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Financial Times reported that $LAPTOP lost approximately &lt;strong&gt;98% of its value within minutes&lt;/strong&gt; of its debut. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Is $LAPTOP Worth Now?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;$LAPTOP remains highly volatile, and prices differ between liquidity pools.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;CoinMarketCap's latest available data shows Hunter Biden's Laptop at approximately &lt;strong&gt;₹37.42 per token&lt;/strong&gt;, while its conversion data indicates a dollar value of roughly &lt;strong&gt;$0.43&lt;/strong&gt;. CoinMarketCap also shows that the token has fallen approximately &lt;strong&gt;98.95%&lt;/strong&gt; over the past 30 days. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;DEX prices can differ substantially because $LAPTOP trades across multiple pools with different liquidity levels. For that reason, readers should check the live market price before trading rather than relying on a static figure published in a news article. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); margin: 20px 0px; padding: 15px;"&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Price snapshot:&lt;/strong&gt; CoinMarketCap's latest available data showed approximately ₹37.42 per $LAPTOP, equivalent to roughly $0.43 at the time of the data capture. Prices can vary between exchanges and liquidity pools.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Did $LAPTOP Crash?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The explanation is still being debated, but the project's own team has pointed to &lt;strong&gt;thin initial liquidity and sniper bots&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to The Block, the project said the initial liquidity pool launched the token at approximately $0.05 and encountered much stronger demand than expected. The team said the market maker's initial liquidity was insufficient to absorb that demand, creating an extreme price spike before the liquidity could catch up. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The project said it planned to add incentives to increase liquidity on trading pools. It also announced that 4 million LAPTOP tokens, equal to 0.4% of the total supply, would be deployed to incentivize liquidity on Aerodrome pools. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The launch structure also made the token vulnerable to automated traders. Because $LAPTOP initially traded on decentralized exchanges rather than major centralized exchanges, there was no broad external price benchmark during the first minutes of trading. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Roughly 80% of Buyers Lost Money&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The scale of the losses helps explain the backlash.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to &lt;strong&gt;Bubblemaps&lt;/strong&gt;, more than 80% of wallets that bought $LAPTOP were in the red after the launch. The Block reported that the affected group represented more than 11,500 wallets, while later reporting put the number of wallets with losses above 15,000. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Block also reported that Bubblemaps identified significant losses among individual traders, including some traders who lost between $100,000 and $1 million. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The numbers illustrate the difference between a token's headline market valuation and the actual amount of liquidity available for traders trying to exit positions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Was $LAPTOP a Rug Pull?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;No regulator, court or blockchain-forensics firm has established that $LAPTOP was a rug pull.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The term has been used by critics and commentators because of the token's rapid rise and collapse, while blockchain analysts have highlighted the unusually profitable trades made by some early participants.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, a price collapse by itself does not prove an intention to defraud.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The project team has attributed the crash to insufficient initial liquidity and aggressive activity from sniper bots. Biden has also denied profiting from the collapse and said the project's founders were subject to lock-up arrangements. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That does not remove the legitimate questions surrounding the launch, but it is important to distinguish between &lt;strong&gt;documented market losses&lt;/strong&gt; and &lt;strong&gt;unproven allegations of deliberate fraud&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How the $LAPTOP Tokenomics Work&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The token's distribution structure was another major point of discussion before and after launch.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Wall Street Journal reported that 30% of the one-&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/can-ai-autonomously-own-and-manage.html"&gt;billion-token&lt;/a&gt; supply was allocated to founders, including Biden, with the tokens locked for six months and then vested over a longer period. Another 20% was allocated for community-related distributions, while other allocations were connected to liquidity, charity and administrative expenses. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The project also linked another 30% of the supply to real-world predictions. Depending on the outcome of those events, the associated tokens could either be burned or donated to charity. The Block reported that two predictions had already resolved “Yes,” resulting in 10 million tokens being scheduled for burning. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The project has also said there was no presale or allocation to influencers before public trading began. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Biden's “Don't Buy My Coin” Comment Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Biden's statement is unusual in a market where attention is often the main driver of a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/bitcoin-faces-80k-supply-wall-as-long.html"&gt;memecoin's&lt;/a&gt; early price.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A celebrity or political name can attract buyers even when the project has little established utility. In the case of $LAPTOP, the combination of Biden's name, the laptop controversy and extensive social-media coverage created a powerful speculative narrative.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Biden, however, says that is not the purpose of the project.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;His stated objective is to use the token as a way to reach cryptocurrency users and communicate with them. That makes $LAPTOP less of a traditional investment pitch and more of a political and cultural experiment built around a digital asset.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next for $LAPTOP?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The project has not disappeared.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The team has said it intends to improve liquidity on trading pools, while Biden has publicly indicated that he remains committed to the project. The project has also continued discussing token burns and other mechanisms connected to its tokenomics. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, whether $LAPTOP can rebuild its market and community after such a severe launch collapse remains uncertain.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Its future will likely depend on liquidity, trading activity, community interest and whether the project can maintain attention after the initial political controversy fades.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The token's current market price should therefore not be interpreted as evidence that a recovery is underway. It simply reflects the price at which current market participants are trading the asset.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What the $LAPTOP Crash Says About Political Memecoins&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The episode highlights a wider problem facing political and celebrity-linked cryptocurrencies.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;First, &lt;strong&gt;market capitalization can be misleading&lt;/strong&gt; when a token has limited liquidity. A small amount of trading can create an enormous implied valuation without providing enough liquidity for all holders to sell at that price.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Second, &lt;strong&gt;attention is not the same as utility&lt;/strong&gt;. A token can become globally visible within minutes without having a sustainable business model behind it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Third, &lt;strong&gt;early trading conditions matter&lt;/strong&gt;. Automated traders and highly experienced market participants can react to a new liquidity pool faster than ordinary users.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Finally, political branding can amplify both gains and losses. A recognizable name may bring millions of dollars of attention, but it can also make a crash far more controversial.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hunter Biden's statement that &lt;strong&gt;“I don't want anybody to buy my coin”&lt;/strong&gt; comes at a particularly important moment for $LAPTOP.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The token launched on Base on September 9, 2026, surged from an initial price of around $0.05 to triple-digit levels and then collapsed by more than 95%, with the Financial Times reporting a roughly 98% loss within minutes. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bubblemaps reported that more than 80% of buyers were left in losses, while the project team blamed thin initial liquidity and sniper bots for the extreme price movement. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Claims that the launch was a rug pull remain allegations rather than established fact.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For now, Biden says the point of $LAPTOP is not to convince people to buy a token. He says it is a way to reach the crypto community and have a conversation with an audience he wants to understand and engage with.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Whether that strategy works politically or culturally remains to be seen. Financially, however, the launch has already demonstrated just how quickly a politically connected memecoin can move from viral attention to enormous losses.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Disclaimer: This article is for news and informational purposes only and is not financial, investment or trading advice. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile, and prices can change rapidly.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Why did Hunter Biden launch $LAPTOP?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Biden has said the project is intended to reach and communicate with the cryptocurrency community. He has specifically said, “I don't want anybody to buy my coin.”&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;How much did $LAPTOP crash?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;The token lost more than 95% from its early peak, while the Financial Times reported an approximately 98% loss within minutes of its debut. Different exchanges and data providers recorded different peak prices because of the extreme volatility. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is $LAPTOP worth now?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;CoinMarketCap's latest available data showed approximately ₹37.42 per token, or roughly $0.43, although prices can vary between liquidity pools. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Was $LAPTOP a rug pull?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;There is currently no established finding from a court, regulator or blockchain-forensics firm that proves $LAPTOP was a rug pull. The project team has attributed the crash to thin initial liquidity and sniper-bot activity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is Hunter Biden still supporting $LAPTOP?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Yes. The project has said it plans to improve liquidity, and Biden has publicly indicated that he remains committed to the project. &lt;/p&gt;

    <title>OpenAI Makes Progress on Another Millennium Prize Problem, but Won’t Say Which One</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEi4XqNTDgbY-qqFyUdZo7uNpSnr3P2XDfbHRZzAraM1dBJ3FbnIAEXu17hbf5iei0-HA-xgWf6KWtuh93fEanrttjd8BJZ9RJZs79LQIUTiMx4oz51B_CtEhgetpHW4wAly2WQgCN4K-jTj1hfjssMawAYDwGe0IL-L3rLZNQhrg2jmHV-8jgUtQq8sxXvb/s1672/openai-millennium-prize-problem-navier-stokes-ai-research.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="OpenAI AI system researching a Millennium Prize Problem and Navier-Stokes mathematics" border="0" data-original-height="940" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEi4XqNTDgbY-qqFyUdZo7uNpSnr3P2XDfbHRZzAraM1dBJ3FbnIAEXu17hbf5iei0-HA-xgWf6KWtuh93fEanrttjd8BJZ9RJZs79LQIUTiMx4oz51B_CtEhgetpHW4wAly2WQgCN4K-jTj1hfjssMawAYDwGe0IL-L3rLZNQhrg2jmHV-8jgUtQq8sxXvb/w640-h360/openai-millennium-prize-problem-navier-stokes-ai-research.webp.png" title="OpenAI AI Research on Millennium Prize Problems and Navier-Stokes" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;OpenAI says it has made substantial progress on another Millennium Prize Problem, just days after publishing an AI-generated proposed solution to a &lt;strong&gt;forced variant of the Navier–Stokes problem&lt;/strong&gt;. The company has not revealed which Millennium Prize Problem it is working on, saying it is still deciding how to share the results.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The disclosure adds another chapter to the growing discussion around artificial intelligence and advanced mathematical research. It also comes shortly after OpenAI published its September 8, 2026 research on Navier–Stokes, a result that has attracted attention from mathematicians because of both its technical claims and the circumstances surrounding its development.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;OpenAI Confirms Progress but Keeps the Problem Secret&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI made the latest disclosure in a statement provided to &lt;em&gt;The New York Times&lt;/em&gt;. The company said that, since completing its Navier–Stokes work, it has made &lt;strong&gt;“substantial progress”&lt;/strong&gt; on another Millennium Prize Problem and is working through how to share the results thoughtfully. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That wording is important. OpenAI has &lt;strong&gt;not said that it has solved another Millennium Prize Problem&lt;/strong&gt;. The company has also not identified the problem, published the underlying research or provided enough technical information for the mathematical result to be independently evaluated.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For now, the confirmed information is limited to OpenAI's statement that it has made substantial progress on another Millennium Prize challenge.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Is OpenAI Working on the Hodge Conjecture?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One of the biggest questions circulating online is whether OpenAI's undisclosed project involves the &lt;strong&gt;Hodge Conjecture&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Hodge Conjecture is one of the seven original Millennium Prize Problems and concerns deep questions in algebraic geometry. It remains an unresolved mathematical problem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Hodge Conjecture has attracted attention in online speculation because advanced AI systems are increasingly being used for mathematical reasoning, symbolic work and formal verification. However, there is currently &lt;strong&gt;no confirmation from &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/revolut-data-breach-hacker-launches.html"&gt;OpenAI&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/strong&gt; that its latest progress concerns Hodge.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Until OpenAI identifies the problem or publishes the underlying research, any connection between the company's latest announcement and the Hodge Conjecture should be treated as speculation rather than established fact.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); margin: 20px 0px; padding: 16px;"&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Editor's note:&lt;/strong&gt; OpenAI has not identified the second Millennium Prize Problem. References to the Hodge Conjecture are therefore speculation unless and until OpenAI confirms the connection.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Are the Millennium Prize Problems?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Millennium Prize Problems were announced by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000. Seven exceptionally difficult mathematical problems were selected, with a $1 million prize associated with each successful solution that satisfies the institute's requirements.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The problems span several areas of mathematics, including number theory, computer science, algebraic geometry, mathematical physics, topology and fluid dynamics.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Announcement Comes After OpenAI's Navier–Stokes Research&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest statement follows OpenAI's &lt;strong&gt;September 8, 2026 research publication&lt;/strong&gt; concerning the Navier–Stokes problem. OpenAI published a write-up of its proposed result together with a formalization in Lean and related research materials. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Navier–Stokes equations are fundamental to the mathematical description of fluid motion. They are used in areas including aircraft design, weather forecasting and the study of fluid flows. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI said its internal system produced an analytical proof concerning a &lt;strong&gt;forced version of the Navier–Stokes problem&lt;/strong&gt;. In the result described by OpenAI, a smooth external force is applied to the fluid, and the system's proof establishes finite-time singularity formation under that setup. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This distinction matters. The Clay &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ripple-adds-xrp-and-rlusd-support-to.html"&gt;Mathematics&lt;/a&gt; Institute's Millennium Prize problem concerns the existence and smoothness of Navier–Stokes solutions in three-dimensional Euclidean space. OpenAI's published work includes an externally forced setup, so it should not be presented as an unqualified statement that the entire original Millennium Prize problem has been independently settled. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI also said the system produced a formalization of the proof in &lt;strong&gt;Lean&lt;/strong&gt;. According to the company's account, the Lean formalization and verification took an additional &lt;strong&gt;17 hours&lt;/strong&gt; using GPT-6 Astra. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The research used a system of coordinating AI agents. OpenAI said the group that produced the Navier–Stokes result involved &lt;strong&gt;on the order of 10,000 concurrent agents&lt;/strong&gt;. The company said the agents reached their resolution on &lt;strong&gt;September 5, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;, about &lt;strong&gt;88 hours after the first agents were launched&lt;/strong&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI has also said that it &lt;strong&gt;does not intend to claim the $1 million Millennium Prize&lt;/strong&gt; for this result. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Navier–Stokes Result Has Drawn Scrutiny&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The OpenAI result has generated discussion among mathematicians over how the work was produced, how AI systems interacted with the research process and whether outside research could have influenced the result.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;NYU mathematician &lt;strong&gt;Tristan Buckmaster&lt;/strong&gt; and Anthropic mathematician &lt;strong&gt;Levent Alpöge&lt;/strong&gt; had been working on related mathematical research. The New York Times reported on the dispute surrounding OpenAI's effort and Buckmaster's concerns about the company's approach and the question of research credit. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI said that its researchers and agents did not see Buckmaster and Alpöge's work before it was publicly released. The company also said that, following an investigation, Buckmaster's Codex prompts from the preceding two months could not have influenced the internal system, including through training. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI's published account also says the two groups' mathematical results differed: Alpöge and Buckmaster had produced a result involving external forcing for the Euler equations, while OpenAI's reported Navier–Stokes result involved a different setup. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;These questions are separate from the mathematical question of whether OpenAI's published proof meets the exact requirements of the original Millennium Prize problem. Independent mathematical examination remains important.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Clay Institute Says Its Review Process Is Deliberately Unhurried&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Clay Mathematics Institute acknowledged OpenAI's Navier–Stokes announcement in a statement published on &lt;strong&gt;September 11, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. CMI said its rules govern how proposed solutions are evaluated and how credit is assigned, and described the process as &lt;strong&gt;“deliberately unhurried.”&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;CMI's formal rules are even more specific. Before the institute will consider a proposed solution for a Millennium Prize, three conditions must be satisfied: the solution must be published in a qualifying outlet, at least &lt;strong&gt;two years&lt;/strong&gt; must have passed since publication, and the solution must have received general acceptance in the global mathematics community. CMI also says it does not accept direct submissions of proposed solutions. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means a mathematical claim involving a Millennium Prize Problem is not transformed into an official Clay-certified solution immediately after publication. The institute's process is designed to allow substantial time for publication, scrutiny and broader mathematical acceptance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Second Announcement Is Important&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest disclosure is notable because OpenAI is not simply presenting AI as a tool for routine mathematical calculations. The company is increasingly using advanced &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/circle-ceo-jeremy-allaire-says-crypto.html"&gt;AI systems&lt;/a&gt; to investigate problems that have challenged mathematicians for decades.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A verified breakthrough on another Millennium Prize Problem would provide another important case study in how AI systems contribute to mathematical research.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At the same time, &lt;strong&gt;“substantial progress”&lt;/strong&gt; can describe different stages of research. It could refer to a new theorem, an important partial result, a promising proof strategy or work that still requires significant mathematical verification.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Without seeing the underlying research, it is not possible to determine which of those possibilities applies to OpenAI's latest claim.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Independent Verification Will Matter&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Any eventual Millennium Prize submission would need to withstand detailed mathematical examination.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A result generated with the help of AI is not automatically accepted simply because an AI system produces a convincing argument or a machine-checked component. Researchers still need to establish that the argument addresses the exact mathematical problem and that its assumptions and logical steps are valid.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This distinction is particularly important in the current situation because OpenAI's latest statement about another Millennium Prize Problem provides no technical details about that second project.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company has said it is deciding how to share the results, so additional technical information could emerge later.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;AI Research Is Entering a New Phase&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI's latest announcement comes amid a broader acceleration in AI-assisted mathematical research.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Advanced AI systems are increasingly being used for theorem proving, symbolic reasoning, formal verification, mathematical experimentation and research assistance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The emergence of multi-agent systems adds another dimension. Instead of asking a single model to solve a problem in one attempt, researchers can deploy multiple AI agents to explore different approaches, test ideas, write code and verify intermediate results.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI said its Navier–Stokes effort involved millions of agent messages and hundreds of billions of output tokens across its broader experiments. The company reported approximately 2.7 million messages and 130 billion output tokens specifically during the Navier–Stokes effort. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If OpenAI's second Millennium Prize project eventually produces a publicly verifiable mathematical result, researchers will have an opportunity to study not only the mathematics but also the process through which an AI system generated and verified the work.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What We Know So Far&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;OpenAI says&lt;/strong&gt; it has made substantial progress on another Millennium Prize Problem.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The company has not named&lt;/strong&gt; the problem.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;OpenAI has not announced&lt;/strong&gt; a second confirmed solution.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Hodge Conjecture&lt;/strong&gt; is being discussed online, but OpenAI has not confirmed that speculation.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;OpenAI says&lt;/strong&gt; it is deciding how to share the results.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Navier–Stokes work&lt;/strong&gt; published on September 8 concerns a forced variant and should not be described without that qualification as a completed solution to the original Clay prize criteria.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Further technical details and independent review&lt;/strong&gt; will be needed before the significance of the second claim can be assessed.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The next major development will &lt;strong&gt;likely come when&lt;/strong&gt; OpenAI identifies the problem and publishes or otherwise shares details of its work.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Until then, the most accurate description is that OpenAI has reported &lt;strong&gt;substantial progress&lt;/strong&gt;, not that it has solved a second Millennium Prize Problem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For the AI industry, the announcement is another indication that advanced models are being tested against some of mathematics' deepest unanswered questions. For the scientific community, the next stage will be examining the evidence, understanding the methods and determining how much of the claimed progress can be independently verified.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI says it has made substantial progress on another Millennium Prize Problem after its recent Navier–Stokes research, but the company has not yet revealed which problem it is or published the underlying results. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Hodge Conjecture is among the possibilities being discussed online, but there is currently no confirmation from OpenAI linking its latest work to that problem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI's September 8 Navier–Stokes publication should also be described carefully: its reported proof concerns a &lt;strong&gt;forced variant&lt;/strong&gt; of the equations, while the Clay Mathematics Institute has its own formal requirements for recognizing a Millennium Prize solution. OpenAI has said it does not intend to claim the $1 million prize for its published result. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Until the company releases more information about the second project, the announcement should be viewed as a report of significant mathematical progress rather than a confirmed second Millennium Prize solution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;CoinAINews will update this report when OpenAI identifies the problem or publishes further technical details.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;/article&gt;

    <title>Bitcoin in 2011: How $300K Could Move BTC From $9 to $13</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjwww5B1302f70tezLKu5FU4lvLDvTmEwI2ytttnxACabbLRX20uYLiGZAgDR_EF-F-dMOMC3K2TDU687Sit_Qs3BmtpozMS8mXwnzft3_ghcZNIq3t3l-nZCc1s_oG_X-rtnguVQZfHQPmLBhY50bLo60C7tBzL6pPWfOnBUeRgVJCBzEroSHVpMiB1cjw/s1672/bitcoin-2011-300k-btc-9-13-market-liquidity.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Bitcoin in 2011 with $300K buying moving BTC toward $13 and $800K selling toward $9" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjwww5B1302f70tezLKu5FU4lvLDvTmEwI2ytttnxACabbLRX20uYLiGZAgDR_EF-F-dMOMC3K2TDU687Sit_Qs3BmtpozMS8mXwnzft3_ghcZNIq3t3l-nZCc1s_oG_X-rtnguVQZfHQPmLBhY50bLo60C7tBzL6pPWfOnBUeRgVJCBzEroSHVpMiB1cjw/w400-h225/bitcoin-2011-300k-btc-9-13-market-liquidity.jpg.png" title="Bitcoin in 2011: $300K Could Move BTC From $9 to $13" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;By CoinAINews Staff | &lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;In Bitcoin’s early market, a trader estimated that
roughly $300,000 in buying could move BTC toward $13, while about $800,000 in
selling could push it toward $9.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The observation came from a BitcoinTalk discussion dated &lt;b&gt;August
22, 2011&lt;/b&gt;, where a user going by “tacotime” discussed the amount of buying
and selling that could potentially move Bitcoin’s price on Mt. Gox, one of the
most important Bitcoin trading venues at the time.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;“There are too many buyers for bitcoin for it right now to
crash... to get to 9weneed800,000 of BTC sold on Mtgox, but only 300,000$
bought to get to 13.”&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The figures are striking by today’s standards. More
importantly, they offer a glimpse into how Bitcoin’s early market worked: &lt;b&gt;relatively
modest amounts of capital could have an outsized effect on price when liquidity
was extremely thin.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;How Thin Bitcoin’s Early Market Was&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The forum discussion was not a modern market-depth report.
It was an observation from an early Bitcoin trader looking at the liquidity
available on Mt. Gox.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The trader estimated that moving &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/term-labs-governance-exploit-drains.html"&gt;BTC &lt;/a&gt;toward $9 would have
required about &lt;b&gt;$800,000 in selling&lt;/b&gt;, while roughly &lt;b&gt;$300,000 in buying&lt;/b&gt;
could move it toward $13.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Those figures should be viewed as the trader’s historical
estimate rather than a standardized measurement of market depth. Even so, they
illustrate how different Bitcoin’s trading environment was in 2011.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;At the time, Bitcoin was still a relatively young asset with
a small number of exchanges and participants. Large orders could therefore have
a much greater impact on price than they would in a deeper market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What the 2011 Discussion Revealed&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The discussion also shows how early Bitcoin traders were
trying to understand the market’s supply and demand.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;One participant wrote:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;“~$72,000 worth of BTC is mined every single day. Where does
it all go?”&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Another raised concerns about large holdings and the
possibility of a sharp move on Mt. Gox:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;“Perhaps it is being horded so that it may cause a giant
crash on Mtgox... Bitcoin is too volatile to really know what’s going on from
one moment to the next.”&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The comments provide a snapshot of a market where
participants had limited information and were attempting to interpret price
movements in real time.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That uncertainty was part of Bitcoin’s early trading
environment.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;From a Thin Market to a Global Market&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin’s market structure has changed dramatically since
then.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;In 2011, hundreds of thousands of dollars could represent a
meaningful amount of liquidity on a Bitcoin exchange. Today, Bitcoin trades
across a much larger global ecosystem of exchanges and financial venues, with
institutional investors, market makers, funds and other participants involved.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That growth has made the market substantially deeper and
more sophisticated.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It has not, however, eliminated volatility. Bitcoin can
still experience sharp moves when market liquidity falls, large orders hit the
market or traders move aggressively in the same direction.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The difference is the scale and breadth of the market
absorbing that activity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why Liquidity Matters&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Liquidity is often overlooked when markets are functioning
normally. It becomes much more important when trading conditions deteriorate.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;In a liquid market, a large buy or sell order can often be
absorbed by other participants without causing a dramatic change in price. In a
thin market, a large order can consume available bids or offers across several
price levels.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That means the amount of money required to move an asset can
be very different from its overall market value.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The 2011 Bitcoin discussion is a simple historical example
of that principle.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The trader was not saying that Bitcoin itself was worth only
$300,000 or $800,000. The observation concerned the estimated capital needed to
move through available liquidity at particular price levels.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That distinction is important.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Has Changed Since 2011?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin’s market today is fundamentally different from the
market described in the old forum discussion.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;There are more exchanges, more trading venues, more
professional market makers and significantly more participants. Price discovery
also takes place across a much broader global market rather than being
concentrated around a small number of early trading platforms.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The result is a market that can absorb substantially larger
amounts of trading activity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But liquidity remains an important part of price discovery.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;When liquidity becomes concentrated or disappears during
periods of stress, even large markets can experience rapid price movements. The
lesson from Bitcoin’s early years therefore remains relevant despite the
enormous growth of the asset.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bigger Lesson for Bitcoin Traders&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The old discussion offers a straightforward lesson: &lt;b&gt;price
is determined not only by demand, but also by the liquidity available to absorb
that demand.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A market can have strong buying interest and still move
sharply if available liquidity is limited. Likewise, selling pressure can
produce an outsized move when there are not enough buyers across the order
book.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin’s evolution from a thin early market to a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/elliptic-says-irans-nobitex-was-hit-in.html"&gt;globaldigital asset&lt;/a&gt; makes the 2011 observation particularly interesting.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What once could be discussed in terms of hundreds of
thousands of dollars now takes place within a vastly larger financial
ecosystem.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A BitcoinTalk discussion from August 2011 provides a rare
glimpse into the conditions surrounding Bitcoin’s early price discovery.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The post claimed that around &lt;b&gt;$800,000 of selling could
have been required to push BTC toward $9, while roughly $300,000 of buying
could move it toward $13.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Those numbers should be understood as an individual trader’s
observation from the period, not as a modern standardized measurement of
Bitcoin market depth.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Still, the historical snapshot illustrates how dramatically
Bitcoin’s trading environment has changed.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;In 2011, relatively small amounts of capital could
potentially have a major effect on Bitcoin’s price. Today, the market is far
deeper, broader and more sophisticated.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The basic principle, however, has not changed: &lt;b&gt;when
liquidity is thin, price can move much faster than investors expect.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;Source: Historical BitcoinTalk discussion referenced in
Cointelegraph’s August 23, 2026 X post.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

cryptocurrency, technology, finance and digital-asset markets. This article is
for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>About CoinAINews</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;h1&gt;About CoinAINews&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;CoinAINews is a crypto and AI news publication built for people who want to understand what's actually happening in digital assets — without the hype, jargon, or noise.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;We started this site because crypto news had become either too technical for regular readers or too sensational to be useful. There was a gap: coverage that treats you like an intelligent adult, explains things clearly, and doesn't try to sell you anything.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That's what we try to do every day.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What We Cover&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;We publish daily coverage of:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Bitcoin, Ethereum, and major altcoins&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Blockchain technology and infrastructure&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Artificial intelligence and its intersection with crypto&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;DeFi, stablecoins, and Web3&lt;/li&gt;

&lt;li&gt;Exchange updates, security incidents, and market trends&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;NFTs and emerging technologies&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Whether you're an investor, a developer, a trader, or just someone curious about where this technology is going — we write for you.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How We Work&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Our editorial team is small and based in India. We publish stories based on publicly available information, official announcements, on-chain data, industry reports, and credible news sources.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Ex-CFTC Commissioner Quintenz: US Regulatory Framework for Prediction Markets Is 'Gold Standard'</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEj6DMragzLOEnOTvg1IGzmC49zCjx3VgQ-_1EM3VzGMB2bZwqIeNeYOHOJfo_A1W_eIkIn0QSSOsH1VHbWRjdzhy-4EQIbW7yVYZVCcoDkOthLvg4JteBIeppIfq9Ss7egV_X3Tx0CRUu8cC6h7n1S-DCqEls1lPzyQuE7WDPF9b961zYONQSZUIfyL6th6/s1672/us-prediction-market-regulation-cftc-quintenz.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="U.S. prediction market regulation and CFTC oversight illustrated with financial charts and regulatory symbols" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEj6DMragzLOEnOTvg1IGzmC49zCjx3VgQ-_1EM3VzGMB2bZwqIeNeYOHOJfo_A1W_eIkIn0QSSOsH1VHbWRjdzhy-4EQIbW7yVYZVCcoDkOthLvg4JteBIeppIfq9Ss7egV_X3Tx0CRUu8cC6h7n1S-DCqEls1lPzyQuE7WDPF9b961zYONQSZUIfyL6th6/w400-h225/us-prediction-market-regulation-cftc-quintenz.jpg.png" title="US Prediction Market Regulatory Framework" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/i&gt;&amp;nbsp;|&amp;nbsp;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Brian Quintenz, the former Commodity Futures Trading
Commission commissioner and current Kalshi board member, has called the U.S.
federal regulatory regime for prediction markets the global "gold
standard," arguing that no other jurisdiction offers the same breadth of
framework.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The remarks come at a pivotal moment for the prediction
markets industry. Once a niche corner of financial markets, prediction
platforms like Kalshi and &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/ai-trading-agents-are-already-here-but.html"&gt;Polymarket&lt;/a&gt; have exploded in popularity, drawing
billions in trading volume and intense scrutiny from regulators at both the
federal and state levels.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Quintenz Actually Said&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Quintenz, who served as a CFTC commissioner from 2017 to
2021 and now advises the Coalition for Prediction Markets, argued that the U.S.
Commodity Exchange Act (CEA) provides a comprehensive framework that other
countries lack. According to him, no other jurisdiction has "the same
breadth of framework" when it comes to regulating event contracts and
derivatives tied to real-world outcomes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;His stance aligns with a long-held position. Quintenz has
consistently argued that prediction markets are legitimate financial
instruments—not gambling. In a 2021 dissent, he famously wrote that events like
elections, sporting outcomes, and even whether the Olympics would occur were
"commodities" under the CEA.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bigger Picture: A Market at a Crossroads&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Quintenz's praise for the U.S. regulatory system arrives
amid a fierce battle over who should oversee the rapidly expanding prediction
market sector. The industry has reached a critical juncture as &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/new-crypto-token-and-coin-launches.html"&gt;federal&lt;/a&gt;
regulators and state officials clash over jurisdiction.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The CFTC's Position:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Chair Michael Selig has
asserted the agency has "exclusive jurisdiction" over prediction
markets, including sports-related contracts, and has sued several states
challenging that authority.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;State Pushback:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;State officials across the
country have increasingly raised concerns about prediction markets, arguing
that contracts tied to sports events amount to gambling and violate state
gaming laws. New York sued Kalshi in July, prompting the CFTC to respond on
Aug. 11, issuing emergency authority and ordering Kalshi to continue providing
its event contracts in the state.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Key Concerns in the Debate&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Self-Certification Under Fire:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;CME Group CEO
Terry Duffy raised concerns about the sheer volume of self-certified contracts
hitting the market. He noted that roughly&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;2,500 self-certifications&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;have
been filed since January 2025, with&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;none opposed&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;by the
agency. Under the Commodity Exchange Act, platforms can propose and certify
event contracts without prior CFTC approval, a process Duffy argued can leave
markets vulnerable to manipulation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Mention Markets &amp;amp; Insider Trading:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Duffy
also warned about "mention markets"—contracts where traders speculate
on specific words being used in a speech or earnings call. He cited
high-profile insider trading cases, including:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The
     April arrest of a U.S. soldier who allegedly used classified intelligence
     to bet on Nicolás Maduro's capture on Polymarket&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A
     teleprompter operator facing federal investigation for bets tied to
     President Trump's State of the Union Address on Kalshi&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The CFTC's Three-Part Roadmap:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;During the
meeting, Selig detailed a regulatory roadmap for prediction markets:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Amending
     rules on what event contracts the CFTC could prohibit&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Modernizing
     the reporting framework for fully collateralized event contracts&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Proposing
     stronger consumer protection requirements&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;A Structural Gap:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;The CFTC currently has only
one sitting commissioner—Michael Selig—despite the agency being structured for
five commissioners, making it difficult to challenge the flood of
self-certifications.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Quintenz's "gold standard" framing is a defense of
the U.S. regulatory approach at a moment when it is under intense pressure. The
CFTC is moving forward with new rules on event contracts, modernized reporting,
and stronger consumer protections.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For now, the debate remains unresolved—but Quintenz's
message is clear: he believes the U.S. framework is already the best in the
world and should be preserved rather than weakened.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

not constitute investment advice. Regulatory frameworks and policies are
subject to change and may vary by jurisdiction.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
