    <title>Tether's KPMG Audit Is Done. But Its Biggest Questions Remain.</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhlTCi-oOowq-qv_H90Gv6i3WAY8grDopZFCaRBpWXcUr3XjZ5iignCE9vRZHXwekpI6IDLPv3uGxMtH6MyPgXlEeMne3FqycsXgcm2rJGTZaNeYOnYZMaKOIpw65ZsMkbP6UT6tVUws9xSEeio7Kj_TSr4tubGBzSvd1Rt0UhqHI63lvvN9yDHFQzfeg1A/s1536/Tether%20KPMG%20Audit%20Biggest%20Questions%20Remain.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Tether KPMG audit showing $6.814 billion in excess reserves, transparency concerns, GENIUS Act compliance challenges, and illicit-finance risks." border="0" data-original-height="1024" data-original-width="1536" height="213" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhlTCi-oOowq-qv_H90Gv6i3WAY8grDopZFCaRBpWXcUr3XjZ5iignCE9vRZHXwekpI6IDLPv3uGxMtH6MyPgXlEeMne3FqycsXgcm2rJGTZaNeYOnYZMaKOIpw65ZsMkbP6UT6tVUws9xSEeio7Kj_TSr4tubGBzSvd1Rt0UhqHI63lvvN9yDHFQzfeg1A/w320-h213/Tether%20KPMG%20Audit%20Biggest%20Questions%20Remain.png" title="Tether's KPMG audit is complete, but questions surrounding transparency, regulation and USDT compliance remain." width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For years, the question hung over crypto markets like a
shadow:&amp;nbsp;&lt;i&gt;Where are Tether's reserves?&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Last week, that question got an answer — at least a partial
one. Tether announced that KPMG U.S. had completed its first full financial
audit, issuing an unqualified opinion on Tether International's 2025 financial
statements. The company reported reserves exceeding liabilities by&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;$6.814
billion&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;as of December 31, 2025. Auditors physically counted every
gold bar, tested transactions, and examined systems.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;"For years, some detractors said an audit of Tether
could not be completed," CEO Paolo Ardoino said.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But if you think this closes the chapter on Tether's
transparency issues, you haven't been paying attention.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The audit answers one question and opens several more.
Here's what comes next.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;1. The Audit That Didn't Publish the Books&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The biggest issue right now is structural. Tether announced
the audit, but&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;did not release the actual financial statements or the
full KPMG report&lt;/b&gt;. Its transparency page still lists only BDO assurance
reports, with nothing from KPMG, and the announcement links to no opinion
letter or set of statements.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A source told The Block that &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/what-is-slippage-in-crypto-trading-and.html"&gt;Tether &lt;/a&gt;doesn't publish the
documents because it's a private company, pointing to Bloomberg as another
private firm that doesn't share audited financials.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But in crypto, where trust is often the only collateral,
that explanation doesn't land the same way. The gap between "Big Four
signed off" and "here are the books" is exactly the kind of
structural ambiguity that keeps controversy alive.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Additionally, the audit covered&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Tether
International, S.A. de C.V.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— one legal entity — not the full
consolidated Tether Group. KPMG examined one subsidiary for one fiscal year
under U.S. GAAP. When asked if Tether International is&amp;nbsp;&lt;i&gt;the&lt;/i&gt;&amp;nbsp;issuer
or&amp;nbsp;&lt;i&gt;an&lt;/i&gt;&amp;nbsp;issuer, Ardoino clarified: "TIL [Tether
International] is the only entity issuing USDT. To be clear."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The distinction may seem narrow, but the legal entity
covered by an audit matters when investors and regulators assess exactly what
the audit does — and does not — cover.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;2. The $476 Million Difference in Reported Figures&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This is the detail that demands attention.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The audited figure — $6.814 billion in excess reserves —
sits $476 million above what Tether reported for the same date in its quarterly
attestation. The BDO Italia attestation for December 31, 2025, gave total
assets of $192.88 billion against liabilities of $186.54 billion, or $6.338
billion in equity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The two figures rest on different accounting frameworks. The
reserves report applies IFRS recognition and measurement principles, while KPMG
audited to U.S. GAAP. The difference does not by itself indicate an error or
misconduct. Still, the gap is notable and deserves explanation, particularly if
similar differences appear in future reporting.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;3. The GENIUS Act Compliance Challenge&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The bigger storm is still approaching.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The GENIUS Act, signed into law in July 2025, creates a
phased regulatory framework for stablecoin issuers, with implementation and
compliance deadlines depending on the specific provision and issuer. For
Tether, the treatment of USDT as a foreign-issued stablecoin remains an
important regulatory issue as U.S. agencies finalize the framework.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Key context:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;U.S. regulators missed the GENIUS
Act's July 18, 2026 deadline for issuing final implementing regulations.
Several major rulemakings remained at the proposal stage as agencies continued
the implementation process.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tether's challenge:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Some analyses have argued
that a meaningful portion of Tether's reserve portfolio may not fit the GENIUS
Act's permitted-reserve framework, particularly holdings such as gold and
Bitcoin. Tether's own published figures show significant precious-metal and
Bitcoin holdings — $17.45 billion in gold and $8.43 billion in Bitcoin as of
the audit date.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The political dimension:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;A &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/are-there-legit-crypto-recovery.html"&gt;Bloomberg&lt;/a&gt;investigation alleged that Trump administration insiders helped shape the
GENIUS Act in ways that benefited Tether. The report detailed three provisions
Tether reportedly secured:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol start="1" style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="1"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A
     "regulatory equivalence loophole" allowing the Treasury
     secretary to deem El Salvador's oversight sufficient for USDT to operate
     in U.S. markets&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A
     three-year compliance grace period for foreign issuers&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Exemption
     from liability for token misuse in secondary DeFi markets&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Tether denied any improper conduct, stating it engaged in
"legal and transparent communication with regulators, lawmakers, and law
enforcement."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;4. Illicit Finance Concerns&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Despite Tether's stated cooperation with law enforcement,
blockchain analytics and reporting cited by Bloomberg have identified
significant USDT activity involving sanctioned entities and networks linked to
sanctions evasion. Data shows $507 million in USDT was purchased by Iran's
sanctioned central bank, and $2.5 billion flowed to wallets linked to Russian
sanctions-evasion networks in July 2025 alone.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Since July 2025, federal prosecutors have filed lawsuits
seeking to seize at least $172 million in USDT tied to criminal activity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Timothy Massad, former CFTC chairman, warned that the
regulatory equivalence provision creates unfair competition: "If we want
the dollar to maintain its central global reserve currency status, we cannot
allow terrorists, sanctioned individuals, and criminals to anonymously transfer
dollar funds."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Comes Next&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The KPMG audit is a milestone, not a conclusion.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The most likely next flashpoints are:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol start="1" style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="1"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Continued
     calls to release the full financial statements&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— transparency
     advocates won't stop asking&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The
     GENIUS Act implementation&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— Tether's treatment as a foreign
     issuer remains an important issue as U.S. agencies finalize the framework&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Quarterly
     attestation scrutiny&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— the gap between audited and attestation
     figures will be watched closely&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Political
     oversight&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— the Bloomberg investigation will keep lawmakers
     asking questions&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Ardoino's response to critics after the audit:
"Honestly, I don't care." He noted Tether's resilience — in 2022, the
company redeemed $7 billion in 48 hours without pausing withdrawals. He also
said he's comfortable being viewed as a "villain" if Tether can
continue serving the millions of users who rely on USDT.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But as the GENIUS Act framework takes shape, the question
isn't whether Tether can survive criticism. It's whether it can survive
compliance.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

    <title>Binance bStocks Overtakes xStocks to Become Second-Largest Tokenized Stock Issuer</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh834BxxDwHEbIwZrutDHHxeaRySl_YbKLHjD5yepZkYvf-QIQ7NNsXB3Q6gHncd-EvnKzebRtgIKAPONYzgc_W7RTrXTkZxZ9eXVtq60HuEKh0AKPmVZFPUGFQ3kbhifNX0FGGh1KKr2HNFiZtyng_AhQz3OgJmSagBSrZWiUrKXYEUs7lB4Zk9lq_LmtS/s1672/Tokenized%20Markets%20bStocks%20Rising.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Binance bStocks overtakes xStocks in the rapidly growing tokenized stock market" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="180" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh834BxxDwHEbIwZrutDHHxeaRySl_YbKLHjD5yepZkYvf-QIQ7NNsXB3Q6gHncd-EvnKzebRtgIKAPONYzgc_W7RTrXTkZxZ9eXVtq60HuEKh0AKPmVZFPUGFQ3kbhifNX0FGGh1KKr2HNFiZtyng_AhQz3OgJmSagBSrZWiUrKXYEUs7lB4Zk9lq_LmtS/w320-h180/Tokenized%20Markets%20bStocks%20Rising.png" title="Tokenized Markets bStocks Rising" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Aug 13, 2026&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;– Binance's tokenized stock product
bStocks has overtaken Backed's xStocks to become the second-largest issuer of
tokenized equities by market value, less than two months after its June
launch&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;According to data from Token Terminal, bStocks now holds a
market capitalization of&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;$610.6 million**, representing 22.1% of the
total tokenized stock market&amp;nbsp;. Backed's xStocks sits just behind at
**$601.2 million&lt;/b&gt;, while Ondo Finance remains the market leader at&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;$951.8
million&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;with a 34.4% share&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The tokenized stock market has grown dramatically in 2026.
The sector's total market capitalization has surged from&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;$569.76
million** at the start of the year to approximately **$2.8 billion&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— a
year-to-date growth rate of about&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;391%&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;. A year earlier,
xStocks led with $40.7 million, followed by Robinhood at $37.2 million, while
Ondo held about $65,000&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Rapid Growth Driven by New Buyers, Not Competition&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Interestingly, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/miden-to-launch-usdcx-privacy-first.html"&gt;Binance's rise &lt;/a&gt;hasn't come at the expense of
existing competitors. While bStocks captured most of the new demand, xStocks
actually grew by&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;228%&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;during the same period&amp;nbsp;. The market
expanded so quickly that even with its own growth, xStocks' overall share
shrank because the pie grew larger.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Binance's internal data confirms that the growth in bStocks
has not come at the expense of xStocks&amp;nbsp;. This suggests the exchange is
reaching entirely new buyers who were not exposed to tokenized stocks a few
months ago.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Why bStocks Is Growing So Fast&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Binance launched bStocks on&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;June 11&lt;/b&gt;, allowing
investors to gain exposure to U.S. stocks through blockchain-based tokens
without directly owning the underlying shares&amp;nbsp;. The product has been
structured for maximum accessibility:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Seamless
     integration:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;bStocks trades in Binance's spot market directly
     against USDT. Users can buy tokenized stocks like Nvidia the same way they
     would purchase SOL — all within the Binance platform, with no bridging or
     separate onboarding required&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Zero-fee
     conversion:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Anyone holding shares through Nest Trading, Binance's
     affiliated broker-dealer, can convert them to bStocks at a 1:1 ratio with
     no fees. The process is fully reversible, making holding bStocks a
     flexible decision rather than a long-term commitment&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Largest
     user base:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Changpeng Zhao, Binance's co-founder and former CEO,
     attributed bStocks' rapid growth to Binance's existing large user
     base&amp;nbsp;. The venue had the accounts before it had the product, and the
     product inherited them&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;How the Issuers Compare&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/white-house-fully-committed-to-passing.html"&gt;Ondo Finance&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;leads the market despite not
operating its own trading venue. It mints tokens through other platforms'
interfaces, including Binance&amp;nbsp;. The company has maintained its position
through early entry and fast expansion&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Binance bStocks&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;controls both issuance and
distribution, giving it the same model as Kraken — which owns Backed and runs
its own exchange. However, Binance's user base is significantly larger&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;xStocks&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;held the second position for nearly a
year before bStocks surpassed it. It remains structurally similar to bStocks
but with a smaller footprint.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Important Distinction: Market Cap Measures Minting, Not
Trading&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Market capitalization by issuer counts how many tokens have
been created, not how actively they trade&amp;nbsp;. A token sitting idle in a
wallet weighs the same as one that trades daily. Whether higher issuance levels
will translate into increased trading activity remains an open question&amp;nbsp;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Binance's bStocks has rewritten the tokenized stock
leaderboard in record time — not by stealing customers, but by putting the buy
button where users already were. The sector's nearly 400% growth this year
suggests tokenized equities are moving from a niche experiment to mainstream
adoption, driven by the same playbook that made crypto exchanges dominant:
distribution beats everything.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

    <title>Strategy Is Back: Saylor's Company Buys 4,603 Bitcoin for $370 Million</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjxa23w-jMGVTiUaf861jTMkILSQs3DSAhOs3xCmvT8sGSdOsn_TcK5Bh5PHiLy3tXNhPo36zgsZI0jXRbJdHFbWrhMurrwGX7_VSKSHjrMp0FZFPed46ToalpGm2sUkFoe1nE3HrY_Cqe9TKlW_5GJ3al_BgnT2BW9BLX5wYtGH-nCgqvklvR12A12Vqm4/s1672/strategy-buys-4603-bitcoin-370-million-saylor-2026.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Strategy CEO Michael Saylor and Bitcoin representing Strategy's 4,603 BTC purchase worth $369.7 million" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjxa23w-jMGVTiUaf861jTMkILSQs3DSAhOs3xCmvT8sGSdOsn_TcK5Bh5PHiLy3tXNhPo36zgsZI0jXRbJdHFbWrhMurrwGX7_VSKSHjrMp0FZFPed46ToalpGm2sUkFoe1nE3HrY_Cqe9TKlW_5GJ3al_BgnT2BW9BLX5wYtGH-nCgqvklvR12A12Vqm4/w400-h225/strategy-buys-4603-bitcoin-370-million-saylor-2026.jpg.png" title="Strategy Buys 4,603 Bitcoin for $370 Million" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Michael Saylor's Strategy is buying Bitcoin again.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;After roughly ten weeks without a fresh Bitcoin purchase, the company has returned to the market with a &lt;strong&gt;4,603 BTC acquisition worth $369.7 million&lt;/strong&gt;. The purchase is Strategy's first reported Bitcoin buy since late June and brings the company's total Bitcoin holdings to &lt;strong&gt;845,050 BTC&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The move also gives investors a clearer look at how Strategy is managing its balance sheet after a summer in which the company sold Bitcoin, raised capital through its equity program and repurchased preferred shares.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Saylor previewed the move with a short message on social media: &lt;strong&gt;"We're back."&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;And this time, the numbers behind that statement are substantial.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Strategy Buys 4,603 BTC After a Long Pause&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to Strategy's latest disclosure, the company acquired &lt;strong&gt;4,603 Bitcoin between August 24 and August 30, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;, spending approximately &lt;strong&gt;$369.7 million&lt;/strong&gt;, including fees and expenses.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The average purchase price was approximately &lt;strong&gt;$80,318 per Bitcoin&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Following the transaction, Strategy's Bitcoin treasury reached &lt;strong&gt;845,050 BTC&lt;/strong&gt;. The company says those holdings were acquired for a cumulative cost of approximately &lt;strong&gt;$63.73 billion&lt;/strong&gt;, representing an average acquisition price of about &lt;strong&gt;$75,412 per BTC&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy maintains a detailed transaction history through its official Bitcoin Ledger, allowing investors to track the company's disclosed Bitcoin acquisitions over time.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;
&lt;a href="https://www.strategy.com/ledger" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;
View Strategy's official Bitcoin Ledger
&lt;/a&gt;
&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Where Did the $369.7 Million Come From?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest purchase is particularly interesting because Strategy did not simply use cash sitting on its balance sheet to fund the entire transaction.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company sold &lt;strong&gt;4,531,421 shares of MSTR common stock&lt;/strong&gt; through its at-the-market, or ATM, equity offering program between August 24 and August 30.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The stock sales generated approximately &lt;strong&gt;$602.8 million in net proceeds&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A significant portion of that capital was then allocated across several corporate purposes.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Funding Structure Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At first glance, the headline is simply another Bitcoin purchase. But the financing tells a more interesting story.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy raised substantially more money through its MSTR share sales than it spent on Bitcoin during the period. The company then divided the proceeds between &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/russias-sberbank-plans-to-accept-ether.html"&gt;Bitcoin&lt;/a&gt; purchases, preferred-stock repurchases, dividend obligations and its cash position.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means the latest transaction is not simply a bet on Bitcoin's short-term price. It is also part of Strategy's broader capital-management strategy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company has increasingly used different layers of its capital structure to maintain its Bitcoin treasury while also managing preferred securities and liquidity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;845,050 BTC: Strategy's Treasury Gets Bigger Again&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The new purchase pushes Strategy's Bitcoin holdings back above the 845,000 BTC level.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is an extraordinary concentration of Bitcoin in the hands of a single publicly traded company.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Strategy Had Been Selling Bitcoin This Summer&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest purchase is notable partly because it comes after an unusual period for Strategy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company sold Bitcoin during the summer to help fund obligations and preferred-stock repurchases. In early August, for example, Strategy disclosed the sale of another &lt;strong&gt;1,690 BTC for approximately $108.6 million&lt;/strong&gt;, with the proceeds used to repurchase STRC preferred shares.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That transaction temporarily reduced the company's Bitcoin holdings to 840,447 BTC.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest purchase therefore represents a meaningful change in direction: Strategy has moved from selling Bitcoin during the summer back toward accumulation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;
&lt;a href="https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/08/10/strategy-sells-1-690-bitcoin-raises-usd653-million-from-mstr-shares" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;
Read the earlier Bitcoin-sale report
&lt;/a&gt;
&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The June Peak Is Still an Important Part of the Story&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy's current 845,050 BTC position is enormous, but it is worth looking at the number in context.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company's Bitcoin holdings had previously reached a reported peak of approximately &lt;strong&gt;847,363 BTC on June 21&lt;/strong&gt;, before the summer sales reduced the treasury.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest purchase therefore brings Strategy much closer to its previous high-water mark.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction matters because the headline "845,050 BTC" should not be interpreted as an all-time record for the company. It is the latest post-purchase holding figure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Strategy Also Bought Back $151.8 Million of STRC&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin was not the only asset involved in Strategy's latest capital allocation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company also used approximately &lt;strong&gt;$151.8 million&lt;/strong&gt; to repurchase STRC preferred shares.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;STRC is Strategy's variable-rate preferred stock, and the repurchases form part of the company's broader effort to manage its preferred securities alongside its Bitcoin treasury.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This makes the latest announcement more than a simple "Saylor bought Bitcoin" story.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It is a snapshot of how Strategy is simultaneously managing:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;Bitcoin accumulation&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;MSTR equity issuance&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;Preferred-stock repurchases&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;Dividend obligations&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;USD liquidity&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;$6.71 Billion in USD Assets Adds Another Layer&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy also reported approximately &lt;strong&gt;$6.71 billion in USD assets&lt;/strong&gt; across its disclosed cash and reserve pools.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That liquidity gives the company another tool besides selling Bitcoin or issuing additional securities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It is especially relevant because Strategy's Bitcoin strategy has historically operated through multiple sources of &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/japan-fsa-seeks-tax-filing-exemption.html"&gt;capital&lt;/a&gt; rather than relying exclusively on the company's operating business.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reuters recently reported that Strategy had allocated approximately &lt;strong&gt;$1.6 billion to a USD Cash pool&lt;/strong&gt; intended for flexible treasury purposes, including potential Bitcoin purchases, share repurchases and other corporate needs.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;
&lt;a href="https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactional/strategy-earmarks-16-billion-cash-pool-treasury-operations-buybacks-2026-08-24/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;
Read Reuters' report on Strategy's USD Cash pool
&lt;/a&gt;
&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Does This Mean for MSTR Investors?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy's Bitcoin purchases can have a significant effect on the investment case for MSTR, but the relationship is not as simple as "Bitcoin goes up, MSTR goes up."&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MSTR shareholders are exposed to several factors at the same time:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;Bitcoin's market price&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;The company's Bitcoin holdings per share&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;Debt and preferred-stock obligations&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;Future equity issuance&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;The market valuation assigned to Strategy's Bitcoin treasury&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;The company's ability to raise capital on favorable terms&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When Strategy issues new shares to purchase Bitcoin, existing shareholders can experience dilution. However, the company argues that its capital strategy can increase the amount of Bitcoin exposure associated with its equity over time.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That dynamic is one reason MSTR often trades differently from Bitcoin itself.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bigger Question: Is Strategy Back to Accumulation?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest purchase certainly points in that direction, but one transaction does not establish a permanent change in policy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy has demonstrated that it is willing to buy Bitcoin aggressively when capital markets are favorable, while also using Bitcoin sales, equity issuance, preferred securities and cash reserves when circumstances require it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For investors, the more important question may therefore be whether this purchase marks the beginning of another sustained accumulation phase.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If Strategy continues buying Bitcoin in the coming weeks, the market may view the August transaction as the restart of its familiar treasury strategy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If purchases remain sporadic, the move may instead represent opportunistic capital allocation following a period of balance-sheet adjustments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Saylor's "We're Back" Message Carries Weight&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Michael Saylor's short "We're back" message attracted attention because Strategy's Bitcoin purchases have become a closely watched signal for crypto markets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company is now one of the most significant corporate holders of Bitcoin anywhere in the world, meaning every major treasury move can influence the conversation around institutional Bitcoin adoption.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But investors should separate the company's &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/imf-warns-stablecoins-could-cut-payment.html"&gt;Bitcoin strategy &lt;/a&gt;from a prediction about Bitcoin's next price move.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy buying 4,603 BTC does not guarantee that Bitcoin will rise, nor does it eliminate the risks associated with leverage, dilution or cryptocurrency volatility.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The immediate question is whether Strategy will continue adding Bitcoin after this purchase.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company still has access to capital markets, a large Bitcoin treasury and substantial USD assets. At the same time, its financing strategy remains dependent on market conditions and investor demand for its securities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That creates an unusual feedback loop.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strong Bitcoin performance can increase the value of Strategy's holdings and potentially improve market access. Favorable equity-market conditions can then provide additional capital for Bitcoin purchases. But the reverse can also happen when Bitcoin falls sharply or the company's securities trade under pressure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For that reason, Strategy's next filings may be just as important as the latest purchase itself.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy has officially returned to Bitcoin accumulation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company bought &lt;strong&gt;4,603 BTC for $369.7 million&lt;/strong&gt;, taking its total holdings to &lt;strong&gt;845,050 BTC&lt;/strong&gt;. The purchase was funded primarily through MSTR equity sales that generated approximately &lt;strong&gt;$602.8 million&lt;/strong&gt;, while another &lt;strong&gt;$151.8 million&lt;/strong&gt; went toward STRC repurchases.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The numbers show that Strategy's Bitcoin strategy is no longer simply about buying and holding BTC. It is increasingly a complex capital-management operation involving common equity, preferred securities, cash reserves and Bitcoin.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Bitcoin investors, the purchase is another sign that Strategy remains committed to its long-term treasury strategy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For MSTR investors, however, the bigger story is the financing mechanism behind the purchase — and whether the company can continue expanding its Bitcoin exposure without creating unfavorable dilution or balance-sheet pressure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One thing is clear: after a summer of selling, &lt;strong&gt;Strategy is buying Bitcoin again.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

He didn't announce a specific catalyst, timeline, or price target. But that hasn't stopped the crypto community from reading into it.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The context matters. In August, CZ posted a message suggesting that if you want your future self to thank you for today's decision, you need to act immediately. Bitcoin was trading around $60,000 at the time.     <title>China's Data Strategy Could Give It an Edge in AI Race, US Advisory Body Warns</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjRBy-pblKY-oqsAqP3Hxemxy2c5bzghHbBFKzdXOHhpSutuSdyf0-c-TXSt9RRgWG6-vwJKyC09fAh754LbUCyp6O6h9BavJWLdcIMkc8iX9ut08ke-kNVkg-48opBBt3lEeLwL1n0r6Zdsu3eGYao2kLDlC5DA2gFoLSPc_1SuUFKRg99FmMVZujdo9Fo/s1672/china-data-strategy-ai-race-advantage.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="China's data strategy and AI technology illustrating its potential advantage in the global artificial intelligence race." border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="180" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjRBy-pblKY-oqsAqP3Hxemxy2c5bzghHbBFKzdXOHhpSutuSdyf0-c-TXSt9RRgWG6-vwJKyC09fAh754LbUCyp6O6h9BavJWLdcIMkc8iX9ut08ke-kNVkg-48opBBt3lEeLwL1n0r6Zdsu3eGYao2kLDlC5DA2gFoLSPc_1SuUFKRg99FmMVZujdo9Fo/w320-h180/china-data-strategy-ai-race-advantage.jpg.png" title="China's Data Strategy Could Give It an Edge in AI Race" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/i&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A U.S. congressional advisory body has warned that China's
systematic approach to collecting and commercializing data could give it a
strategic advantage over the United States in the global artificial
intelligence race.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission
(USCC), an independent panel that advises Congress on national security
implications of the U.S.-China relationship, released a report on Tuesday
highlighting Beijing's strategy of treating data as a strategic national asset.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Data Gap That Matters&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;As major U.S. AI companies increasingly face limits in
sourcing additional high-quality training data from the open internet, China is
systematically collecting domestic "enterprise, operational and
physical-world data that cannot be scraped"—data that is crucial for
training AI tools designed for business use, autonomous vehicles and humanoid
robots.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;"Over the last half decade, China has been able to
consolidate data, find ways to label it and refine it, and hoover up new data
and make sure it's quickly made available to entities," said Mike Kuiken,
the commission's vice chair.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The report identifies China's advanced manufacturing and
industrial robotics ecosystems as potential sources of a data advantage. These
sectors provide a vast pool of high-quality data for "embodied AI"
applications—&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/gen-z-on-binance-is-quietly-rewriting.html"&gt;AI systems&lt;/a&gt; that operate in the physical world, such as
robots—giving China a potential edge in developing robotics software for both
commercial and military uses.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Beijing's Top-Down Data Strategy&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;China formally designated data as a core "factor of
production" in 2020, elevating it alongside land, labor, capital and
technology. The country established the National Data Administration in 2023 to
oversee nationwide data standardization and classification, with a mandate to
build a unified national market for data trading.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The report describes Beijing's approach as the same
"top-down" industrial policy that has made China a leader in advanced
manufacturing. Rather than leaving the development of a data economy to market
forces, China is building infrastructure where participants can exchange
data—fostering third-party services like data valuation, analytics and
financing.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Chinese firms have already begun listing proprietary
datasets on regional data exchanges in cities including Shanghai, Shenzhen and
Beijing, while accounting rules allow companies to record qualifying data
resources as assets on their balance sheets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Risk of Falling Behind&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The USCC warned that the United States risks ceding global
leadership in setting international data standards to China, which would give
Chinese firms a lasting advantage in industries where data is a central pillar
of development.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;"Standards are difficult to revise once adopted,"
the report said. "Engaging now would be more effective than seeking to
unwind an established standard later."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The report also highlighted risks for U.S. firms operating
in China, who increasingly "risk running afoul of China's strict data and
cyber governance regimes" as Beijing tightens regulatory oversight of
cross-border data transfer.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A Call for U.S. Action&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The USCC's top recommendation was straightforward: Congress
should consider developing a national data strategy that treats data as an
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/ripples-ipo-stance-shifts-to-more.html"&gt;economic&lt;/a&gt; asset—similar to what China has already implemented.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;"We recommend that U.S. Congress think about a national
data strategy and how the U.S. government could treat data as an economic asset
as our number one recommendation," Kuiken said.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The commission's report underscores a growing concern in
Washington: that the AI race is no longer just about chips and computing power,
but about who can best harness the vast, messy world of real-world data.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;China has been building an institutional framework to
collect, standardize and facilitate the commercialization of data across its
economy. Whether the U.S. responds with a similar strategy—or leaves it to
market forces—could shape the next decade of AI competition.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

not constitute investment advice.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Zcash Surges Above $1,000 as ETF Demand and Short Squeeze Fuel Rally</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

  &lt;div style="margin: 0px 0px 24px;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgUj1HDOYSdcwa2JjwCbc94HghwfvRvkAB4uOW5HZsF5wwhc1oc6zwqVTVi8SDlfQgLNK5YdB2fH1qMfb55t99Yffa32lUZQ4u6zVm7czaHrrLjgi531OrE0BtM29LoAql6otXUoTEEA8N_41onWVsDSSFQLopOyuYaMy5V9ygpWLgkV8VBiuinz0Fy-1My/s1672/Zcash%20Surges%20Above%20$1,000%20as%20ETF%20Demand%20Fuels%20Rally.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Zcash ZEC surges above $1,000 as ETF demand and short liquidations fuel rally" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgUj1HDOYSdcwa2JjwCbc94HghwfvRvkAB4uOW5HZsF5wwhc1oc6zwqVTVi8SDlfQgLNK5YdB2fH1qMfb55t99Yffa32lUZQ4u6zVm7czaHrrLjgi531OrE0BtM29LoAql6otXUoTEEA8N_41onWVsDSSFQLopOyuYaMy5V9ygpWLgkV8VBiuinz0Fy-1My/w640-h360/Zcash%20Surges%20Above%20$1,000%20as%20ETF%20Demand%20Fuels%20Rally.png" title="Zcash Surges Above $1,000 as ETF Demand Fuels Rally" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;
    September 5, 2026
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Zcash (ZEC) has surged above the $1,000 mark, putting the privacy-focused cryptocurrency back at the center of the crypto market's attention. The move accelerated on September 4 as strong trading activity, growing institutional interest and a wave of short-position liquidations pushed ZEC into four-digit territory.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    ZEC traded above $1,000 and reached roughly the $1,020-$1,045 area during the rally, depending on the market-data snapshot. Its market capitalization approached $17 billion, while trading volume climbed sharply as traders reacted to the breakout.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The move was accompanied by approximately $36.6 million in leveraged ZEC liquidations over a 24-hour period, including about $34.5 million in short positions, according to CoinDesk. The forced closing of bearish positions added another layer of buying pressure to an already powerful rally.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The breakout also comes shortly after the launch of Grayscale's Zcash ETF, trading under the ticker &lt;strong&gt;ZCSH&lt;/strong&gt;. The exchange-traded product began trading on NYSE Arca on August 25, giving investors a traditional-market route to gain exposure to ZEC.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Zcash Crosses $1,000 After a Powerful Rally&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Crossing $1,000 is a major psychological milestone for Zcash. The cryptocurrency had already been climbing rapidly through August before accelerating toward the four-digit level in early September.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    CoinDesk reported that ZEC gained about 20% over a 24-hour period during the strongest phase of the September 4 move. Other market reports placed the intraday peak between approximately $1,020 and $1,045.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The current move is particularly significant because Zcash had not traded at these levels for years. Recent coverage has described the breakout as the token's strongest price level in roughly a decade.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    It is important, however, not to confuse the $1,000 milestone with Zcash's absolute historical all-time high. Early trading history from 2016 contains extreme price prints that are difficult to compare with today's market because the circulating supply and &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/sam-altman-says-ai-industry-did.html"&gt;market structure&lt;/a&gt; were very different.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;$34.5 Million in Short Liquidations Amplified the Move&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    One of the clearest immediate catalysts behind the breakout was the liquidation of traders betting against Zcash.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    CoinDesk reported approximately &lt;strong&gt;$36.6 million&lt;/strong&gt; in leveraged ZEC positions liquidated over 24 hours, with approximately &lt;strong&gt;$34.5 million&lt;/strong&gt; coming from short positions.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    When a short position is liquidated during a sharp price increase, the position may have to be closed by buying the asset. When many traders are forced to buy at the same time, that activity can intensify an existing rally.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The liquidation data therefore helps explain why ZEC's move became so rapid after it crossed the psychological $1,000 level.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    However, the short squeeze should not be treated as the only reason for the rally. Zcash had already gained substantially before the September breakout, with ETF-related demand, renewed interest in privacy technology and derivatives activity contributing to the broader trend.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Futures Open Interest Reaches Billions&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Zcash's derivatives market has also expanded significantly during the rally.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Recent market reports placed ZEC futures open interest around &lt;strong&gt;$2.3 billion&lt;/strong&gt;, with some September 5 updates putting the figure closer to $2.4 billion.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Rising open interest means a larger amount of capital is tied to outstanding derivatives positions. That can support momentum during a strong trend, but it can also increase the size of potential liquidations if the market suddenly moves in the opposite direction.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    For ZEC, the combination of elevated open interest and recent short liquidations shows that derivatives markets are playing an important role in the latest price action.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Grayscale's ZCSH ETF Adds a New Source of Demand&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Another major development behind the renewed interest in Zcash is the launch of Grayscale's spot Zcash ETF.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The fund, trading under the ticker &lt;strong&gt;ZCSH&lt;/strong&gt;, began trading on NYSE Arca on &lt;strong&gt;August 25, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. Grayscale described the product as an exchange-traded vehicle providing spot exposure to ZEC through a traditional investment account.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The launch matters because investors can now obtain Zcash exposure through the conventional brokerage and exchange-traded-product structure rather than needing to purchase and custody ZEC directly.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    According to Grayscale's reported fund data, ZCSH had approximately &lt;strong&gt;$414.7 million in assets under management as of September 3, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. The fund's AUM can change as ZEC's market price and fund flows change.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    &lt;strong&gt;Source:&lt;/strong&gt;
    &lt;a href="https://www.thezcashetf.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;
      Grayscale Zcash ETF — Official Fund Information
    &lt;/a&gt;
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why Financial Privacy Is Back in the Conversation&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The Zcash rally is not only a market story. It also reflects renewed interest in financial privacy as digital surveillance and artificial-intelligence-based monitoring become more sophisticated.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Zcash was built around privacy-preserving cryptocurrency transactions using zero-knowledge cryptography. Its shielded transaction system is designed to protect transaction information while allowing the network to verify transactions without exposing all underlying details.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Grayscale has highlighted growing demand for &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/poland-crypto-bill-veto-parliament.html"&gt;financial privacy&lt;/a&gt; as one of the broader factors behind renewed interest in Zcash. The argument is that increasingly powerful data analysis and AI-driven monitoring could make financial privacy more valuable to individuals and businesses.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    That does not mean privacy-coin adoption is guaranteed to increase. Privacy-focused cryptocurrencies continue to face regulatory, compliance and exchange-access challenges. But the renewed institutional availability of ZEC gives investors a new way to express a view on the sector.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Zcash's Rally Was Building Before the $1,000 Breakout&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The September move did not happen overnight. Zcash had already posted a substantial rally during August.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    ZEC moved through several major psychological levels during the month as traders anticipated the launch of Grayscale's exchange-traded product. The ETF eventually began trading on August 25, adding another catalyst to the existing momentum.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    By early September, Zcash had moved decisively above $800 before breaking through $1,000.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    CoinDesk reported that ZEC had gained approximately 94% over 30 days and more than 2,300% over the previous year at the time of its September 4 report. Such gains help explain why Zcash has suddenly attracted much greater attention across the broader cryptocurrency market.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Technical Indicators Show the Rally Is Becoming Stretched&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    While momentum remains strong, technical indicators are also warning that ZEC has become increasingly stretched.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Recent technical analysis put the daily Relative Strength Index, or RSI, near &lt;strong&gt;80&lt;/strong&gt;. An RSI around or above 70 is commonly considered an overbought reading, meaning the asset has experienced unusually strong recent momentum.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    A high RSI does not automatically mean that a cryptocurrency must fall. Strong assets can remain overbought for extended periods during powerful rallies. However, it does indicate that traders should expect a greater possibility of sharp pullbacks and increased volatility.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Because RSI changes with every new price movement, the exact reading should be treated as a market snapshot rather than a permanent condition.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Could Happen After the $1,000 Breakout?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The key question for the market is whether Zcash can maintain demand after the initial breakout.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    A sustained move would require more than short liquidations. Traders will likely watch spot-market volume, ETF flows, futures open interest and the amount of leverage remaining in the market.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    If ETF demand continues and spot buyers remain active, the $1,000 level could become an important reference point for the market. If speculative leverage begins to unwind, however, ZEC could experience a sharp correction even if the longer-term privacy narrative remains intact.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The distinction is important because a short squeeze can create rapid upside without necessarily establishing long-term fundamental demand.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why the $1,000 Level Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The $1,000 level is important primarily because of its psychological significance and the amount of attention it attracts from traders and investors.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    For Zcash, the milestone also highlights how dramatically market expectations have changed in a relatively short period. The token has moved from being heavily pressured earlier in the year to becoming one of the strongest-performing large cryptocurrencies during the latest rally.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The combination of an established privacy narrative, a newly launched U.S.-listed ETF and significant derivatives activity has created a very different market environment from previous Zcash rallies.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Risks Behind the Rally&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Despite the bullish momentum, Zcash remains a highly volatile cryptocurrency.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The first risk is leverage. With billions of dollars in futures open interest, a sudden reversal could trigger another wave of liquidations.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The second risk is the elevated technical momentum. A daily RSI near 80 indicates that the market has moved rapidly and could become vulnerable to profit-taking.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The third risk is ETF-flow uncertainty. The launch of ZCSH creates a new source of potential demand, but fund flows can change over time and should not automatically be assumed to remain positive.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Finally, privacy-focused cryptocurrencies remain exposed to regulatory and exchange-access risks. The long-term investment case therefore depends on more than the recent price rally.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Zcash's move above $1,000 is a genuine and significant &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/bis-researchers-test-xrp-ledger-official-statistics.html"&gt;market event&lt;/a&gt;. The rally has been supported by several factors rather than a single catalyst: the launch of Grayscale's ZCSH ETF, renewed attention to financial privacy, strong derivatives activity and a major wave of short liquidations.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The ETF's reported assets of roughly $414.7 million by September 3 add another important dimension to the story, while the recent daily RSI near 80 shows just how quickly momentum has accelerated.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The bigger question now is whether Zcash can turn the $1,000 breakout into sustained demand or whether the market will see a period of consolidation after an exceptionally strong move.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    For now, Zcash has firmly returned to the center of the cryptocurrency market's privacy debate—and its next move will be closely watched by both spot investors and derivatives traders.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Did Zcash really cross $1,000?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Yes. ZEC crossed the $1,000 level on September 4, 2026, with market-data reports showing the cryptocurrency moving above $1,020 and briefly reaching the $1,040-plus area.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Why did Zcash rise above $1,000?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The rally was supported by several factors, including the launch of Grayscale's ZCSH ETF, renewed interest in financial privacy, increased derivatives activity and significant short-position liquidations.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;How much ZEC short-position liquidation occurred?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    CoinDesk reported approximately $34.5 million in ZEC short liquidations within a broader $36.6 million in leveraged ZEC liquidations over a 24-hour period.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What is Grayscale's Zcash ETF ticker?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Grayscale's Zcash ETF trades under the ticker &lt;strong&gt;ZCSH&lt;/strong&gt; on NYSE Arca. It began trading on August 25, 2026.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;How much money does the Zcash ETF manage?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Grayscale's reported fund data showed approximately &lt;strong&gt;$414.7 million in assets under management as of September 3, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. AUM can change as ZEC's market price and fund flows change.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Is Zcash overbought after the rally?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Recent technical reports placed ZEC's daily RSI near 80, which is commonly considered an overbought or highly stretched level. However, RSI is a dynamic indicator and can remain elevated during strong trends.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Does crossing $1,000 mean Zcash will keep rising?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    No. The breakout is significant, but it does not guarantee further gains. High leverage, elevated momentum and changing ETF flows could produce substantial volatility in either direction.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Is this article giving a Zcash price prediction?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    No. This report covers verified market developments and the factors surrounding the rally. It does not guarantee a future price target or provide investment advice.
  &lt;/p&gt;

    <title>CFTC Warns Prediction Markets Against American-Style Moneyline Odds</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEimj5R4FpIvvL_RrWqB_nmpoAlbdsgfI4B-QxleBihk4qCL9IDafgjDFHr9zNH1SlWEDhizNFsKAun0D8rYVPw36kkMYOv1oSDp1ncBhPbIL8jgduluFB1ryMCbJ78q0ILeila5tqNhGyZVKQyGqqL9jgUOyZVTFrgGDfFxlRJXQ-jSrHYvhm5tvxosqTIP/s1408/CFTC.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="CFTC warning prediction markets moneyline odds Kalshi Polymarket regulation 2026" border="0" data-original-height="768" data-original-width="1408" height="175" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEimj5R4FpIvvL_RrWqB_nmpoAlbdsgfI4B-QxleBihk4qCL9IDafgjDFHr9zNH1SlWEDhizNFsKAun0D8rYVPw36kkMYOv1oSDp1ncBhPbIL8jgduluFB1ryMCbJ78q0ILeila5tqNhGyZVKQyGqqL9jgUOyZVTFrgGDfFxlRJXQ-jSrHYvhm5tvxosqTIP/w320-h175/CFTC.png" title="Commodity Futures Trading Commission seal prediction market regulatory action 2026" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Aug 8, 2026 – The &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=Commodity+Futures+Trading+Commission&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;Commodity Futures Trading Commission&lt;/a&gt; has issued a warning to regulated &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=what+are+prediction+market+platforms&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;prediction market platforms&lt;/a&gt;, instructing them to stop displaying &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=explain+American-style+moneyline+betting+odds&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;American-style moneyline betting odds&lt;/a&gt; – a move that underscores the agency's broader push to assert exclusive jurisdiction over the rapidly expanding sector .&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The CFTC sent letters to regulated entities reminding them to comply with federal law and avoid "deceptive" practices when listing, advertising, or soliciting &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=what+are+event+contracts+in+finance&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;event contracts&lt;/a&gt;, according to correspondence viewed by Bloomberg&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3 style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Why the Odds Format Matters&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;div&gt;American-style moneyline odds – the familiar plus-and-minus format used in sportsbooks – show how much a bettor would win on a $100 wager. Prediction markets, by contrast, typically display prices in cents that directly correspond to implied probability .&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;The agency cited research in its letter finding that moneyline-style wagers lead to increased risk-taking behaviour in sports betting . The CFTC argues that presenting event contracts with casino-style odds encourages users to think like gamblers rather than &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=derivatives+traders&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;derivatives traders&lt;/a&gt; – a distinction that is central to its legal argument for federal oversight .&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;h3 style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Jurisdictional Battle Intensifies&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;div&gt;The warning lands amid a broader regulatory conflict over which level of government has authority over prediction markets . CFTC Chair Michael Selig has repeatedly argued that the agency holds "exclusive jurisdiction" because event contracts are financial instruments regulated under the &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=Commodity+Exchange+Act&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;Commodity Exchange Act&lt;/a&gt;, not wagers subject to state gaming laws .&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;That position is being vigorously contested. A coalition of 38 state attorneys general has formally opposed &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=define+federal+preemption&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;federal preemption&lt;/a&gt;, while several states have pursued legal action against platforms like &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=Kalshi&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;Kalshi&lt;/a&gt; on allegations of illegal sports gambling . The dispute could ultimately reach the &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=U.S.+Supreme+Court&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;U.S. Supreme Court&lt;/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;h3 style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Industry Response&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;div&gt;Kalshi, a federally registered exchange that commands approximately 89% of U.S. prediction market trading volume, said it would comply with the agency's guidance .&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;"As a federally regulated exchange, Kalshi follows CFTC guidance and will comply with the letter by its deadline," a spokesperson said in an emailed statement .&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=Polymarket&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;Polymarket&lt;/a&gt; did not respond to requests for comment&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;h3 style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Broader Regulatory Push&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;div&gt;The warning is the latest in a series of enforcement actions against the industry, which has experienced extraordinary growth. Combined monthly trading volume on Polymarket and Kalshi climbed by $22 billion to $24 billion between August 2025 and April 2026 .&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;On July 24, the CFTC issued a separate advisory warning platforms against using broad, template-style self-certifications for event contracts – its second such notice in four months . The agency said many platforms continue to certify contracts "without supplying the terms and conditions of each proposed permutation and a concise explanation and analysis" of compliance with the Commodity Exchange Act&amp;nbsp;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;h3 style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Legislative Dimension&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;div&gt;The regulatory conflict has also reached Congress. Senators and tribal gaming regulators have pushed to preserve state and tribal authority over sports betting through amendments to the &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=Clarity+Act&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;Clarity Act&lt;/a&gt;, as lawmakers weigh &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=federal+crypto+market+legislation&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;federal crypto market legislation&lt;/a&gt; . Tribal gaming operations generated $43.9 billion in 2024 revenues, and tribal nations view prediction markets as an existential threat to their compacting authority under the &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=Indian+Gaming+Regulatory+Act&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=3820594944027714783" target="_blank"&gt;Indian Gaming Regulatory Act&lt;/a&gt; .&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;Without explicit carve-out language, gaming associations argue the legislation could entrench an arrangement where platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket operate outside state gambling law .&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;CoinaiNews.COM provides independent market analysis and coverage of cryptocurrency, technology, and financial markets. The information presented does not constitute financial advice.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</content>
