    <title>Vitalik Buterin Says Ethereum Is Becoming a 'Cryptographic World Computer' After Hegota</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhmZa4oS_H2xm1cPzTMNt90J_HRmQRDph0yK8IQMIAjYXjx2bz36DM7rN5n30wwuRqTqX70p4RnxwaHFVabV6Pr5f4Jimi-iKlpXMKfJCFqRGaFHmcyfMye3CTLPCwBlHeUQ_v75UyxGn_pTRvgwjHJevqg5USUyBJy5tQcT3jNsbNEMWZBj0OqHGxDOyTd/s1672/vitalik-buterin-ethereum-cryptographic-world-computer.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Vitalik Buterin Says Ethereum Is Becoming a 'Cryptographic World Computer' After Hegota" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhmZa4oS_H2xm1cPzTMNt90J_HRmQRDph0yK8IQMIAjYXjx2bz36DM7rN5n30wwuRqTqX70p4RnxwaHFVabV6Pr5f4Jimi-iKlpXMKfJCFqRGaFHmcyfMye3CTLPCwBlHeUQ_v75UyxGn_pTRvgwjHJevqg5USUyBJy5tQcT3jNsbNEMWZBj0OqHGxDOyTd/s1600/vitalik-buterin-ethereum-cryptographic-world-computer.jpg.png" title="Vitalik Buterin's essay describes Ethereum's post-Hegota architecture as a &amp;quot;cryptographic world computer&amp;quot; combining blockchain with zero-knowledge proofs." /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Key Takeaways:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0in;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;Vitalik
     Buterin published a new essay calling Ethereum a "cryptographic world
     computer."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;Hegota,
     planned for late 2026 or 2027, is expected to be Ethereum's last
     "normal" fork.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;FOCIL
     (Fork-Choice Enforced Inclusion Lists) is the headline upgrade, designed
     to force validators to include valid transactions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;After
     Hegota, Ethereum will shift toward recursive STARKs, quantum-resistant
     cryptography, and a redesigned consensus.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;Block
     times could drop from 12 seconds to 4-8 seconds, with finality dropping
     from minutes to seconds.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin says &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/thieves-steal-two-nvidia-trailers.html"&gt;Ethereum&lt;/a&gt; is no
longer "just a blockchain." In a new essay published on September 27,
he described the network as a "cryptographic world computer" — a
hybrid system that combines blockchain consensus with modern cryptography,
zero-knowledge proofs, and decentralized computation .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The essay, titled "The Cryptographic World
Computer," outlines how Ethereum will change after the Hegota upgrade,
which is expected in late 2026 or 2027.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Buterin wrote on X that Ethereum is "really not just a
blockchain anymore" — it's "a hybrid architecture that combines
blockchains and modern cryptography, to enable much more powerful
properties" .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What Hegota Changes&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Buterin described Hegota as Ethereum's last
"normal" fork — meaning it will still include features that would
look familiar to someone working on the network in 2015. After Hegota,
everything changes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The headline feature of Hegota is &lt;b&gt;FOCIL (Fork-Choice
Enforced Inclusion Lists)&lt;/b&gt;. This is a censorship-resistance mechanism that
forces validators to include valid transactions in blocks. Under FOCIL, a
committee of 17 randomly selected validators creates a list of transactions
that must be included. If a block builder ignores that list, the network
rejects the block .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Why does this matter? In the past, large validators have
excluded transactions tied to sanctioned protocols like Tornado Cash. FOCIL
makes that kind of censorship much harder, because an attacker would need to
control both the builder and the committee — an extremely difficult and costly
task .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Buterin said FOCIL, combined with EIP-8141 (account
abstraction), gives "guaranteed rapid inclusion" for almost any valid
transaction, including smart wallet transactions and privacy protocol
transactions, within one to two slots .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What Comes After Hegota&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;After Hegota, Ethereum's roadmap shifts toward what Buterin
calls "cryptographic" infrastructure:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0in;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Recursive
     STARKs&lt;/b&gt; — Instead of every node downloading and re-executing every
     block, a single computer would generate a concise cryptographic proof that
     it followed the rules. Other nodes would verify that proof, which is
     orders of magnitude faster than re-executing the computation .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;PeerDAS
     data sampling&lt;/b&gt; — Nodes would verify data availability by sampling parts
     of the dataset instead of downloading everything .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Quantum-resistant
     cryptography&lt;/b&gt; — The &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/bitcoin-needs-95300-to-flip-meta-and-re.html"&gt;Ethereum Foundation&lt;/a&gt; has set a December 2029 target
     for making Ethereum's execution, consensus, and data layers
     quantum-resistant .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list .5in;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Lean
     consensus&lt;/b&gt; — A redesigned consensus mechanism aiming for faster
     finality and simpler architecture .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Buterin also named concrete performance targets for 2030:
block time falling from about 12 seconds today to &lt;b&gt;4 to 8 seconds&lt;/b&gt;, and
finality from several minutes to &lt;b&gt;8 to 32 seconds&lt;/b&gt; .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Why This Matters&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Ethereum's shift from "download and re-execute" to
"verify proofs" is a fundamental change in how blockchains work. It
could reduce hardware requirements for validators while increasing throughput.
Buterin said nodes should still obtain consensus and validity guarantees while
storing less history and performing less redundant computation .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The change also has implications for Layer 2 networks. FOCIL
is designed to strengthen Layer 2 settlement guarantees, making it harder for a
single actor to censor transactions that need to settle on Ethereum .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Buterin acknowledged that making proof systems efficient
enough for widespread use remains difficult. But he said &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/uk-banks-complete-first-interbank.html"&gt;AI tools&lt;/a&gt; are helping
progress, and the 2030 vision is a technical direction rather than a locked
schedule .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What is FOCIL?&lt;/b&gt;&lt;br /&gt;
FOCIL stands for Fork-Choice Enforced Inclusion Lists. It's a mechanism that
forces validators to include valid transactions in blocks, making censorship
harder .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;When is Hegota happening?&lt;/b&gt;&lt;br /&gt;
Hegota is planned for late 2026 or 2027, following the Glamsterdam upgrade .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What is a "cryptographic world computer"?&lt;/b&gt;&lt;br /&gt;
It's Buterin's term for Ethereum's future architecture — a system that combines
blockchain consensus with zero-knowledge proofs, data sampling, and
decentralized computation .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Will Ethereum become quantum-resistant?&lt;/b&gt;&lt;br /&gt;
The Ethereum Foundation has set a December 2029 target for quantum resistance
across execution, consensus, and data layers .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Bottom line:&lt;/b&gt; Buterin says Ethereum is no longer just
a blockchain. After Hegota, it becomes a cryptographic world computer — with
FOCIL forcing transaction inclusion, recursive STARKs replacing re-execution,
and quantum resistance on the horizon. The shift is technical, but it changes
what Ethereum is at its core.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</content>

    <title>MARA Sold 23,093 BTC for $1.6B in H1 2026 — Here's Why</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjcprhtlAB-szxXljM07-OTVwOGxX4RnLtO_sCvP0tO2kNjPf2qraBgV9NnMHsVTbfq0jbLaLaIXQCRLA3ybn0NFIRZ14-5LiZuxzJWjEtZ-O1bbwIhM3y5cr8na0ReErP8PpPQbjJXLn83kQQvykAwVkMHxndY_L_sTMZL0tMoAo2GC6rbtbVCsGGUZLai/s1536/large%20Bitcoin%20mining%20facility%20with%20rows%20of%20ASIC%20miners.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="MARA sold 23093 BTC for 1.6 billion H1 2026 Bitcoin miner holdings 35577 BTC" border="0" data-original-height="1024" data-original-width="1536" height="213" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjcprhtlAB-szxXljM07-OTVwOGxX4RnLtO_sCvP0tO2kNjPf2qraBgV9NnMHsVTbfq0jbLaLaIXQCRLA3ybn0NFIRZ14-5LiZuxzJWjEtZ-O1bbwIhM3y5cr8na0ReErP8PpPQbjJXLn83kQQvykAwVkMHxndY_L_sTMZL0tMoAo2GC6rbtbVCsGGUZLai/w320-h213/large%20Bitcoin%20mining%20facility%20with%20rows%20of%20ASIC%20miners.png" title="MARA Sold 23,093 BTC for $1.6B in H1 2026 — Here's Why | CoinaiNews" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Aug 10, 2026&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;– MARA Holdings, one of the largest
publicly traded Bitcoin miners, sold 23,093 BTC for approximately $1.6 billion
during the first half of 2026.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The company still holds 35,577 BTC worth roughly $2.3
billion at current market prices, but the scale of the sale has raised
questions about whether miners are capitulating or strategically repositioning.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The Numbers That Matter&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Bitcoin
     Sold (H1 2026):&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;23,093 BTC&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Sale
     Proceeds:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;~$1.6 billion&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Remaining
     Holdings (June 30):&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;35,577 BTC — worth roughly $2.3 billion&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Reserve
     Decline:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;29% drop from 49,951 BTC a year earlier&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;MARA mined 4,669 BTC during H1 2026, meaning it sold nearly
five times more Bitcoin than it produced during the period.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Why MARA Really Sold&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;A major portion of the proceeds was used to reduce
convertible debt and strengthen MARA's balance sheet.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;During Q1 2026, MARA sold approximately 20,880 BTC for about
$1.5 billion. The company said the proceeds helped fund the repurchase of more
than $1 billion face value of its 2030 and 2031 convertible notes and reduce
its line of credit by $200 million.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;In Q2 2026, the company sold an additional 2,213 BTC at an
average price of $73,078.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The broader picture looks like this:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;The
     company retired approximately 30% of its outstanding convertible debt&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;Total
     debt was reduced from $3.3 billion to $2.3 billion — a 30% cut&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;The
     company also eliminated potential future shareholder dilution by retiring
     convertible notes at a discount&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;This was not a panic sale. It was a treasurer's playbook
executed under margin pressure.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The Financial Reality&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;MARA's Q2 results were ugly, largely due to Bitcoin's price
decline during the quarter:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Revenue:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;$174.9
     million, down 27% year-over-year&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Net
     Loss:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;$611.3 million (compared to a $808.2 million profit a year
     earlier)&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Adjusted
     EBITDA:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Negative $360.9 million&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Unrealized
     Loss:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;$343 million fair-value loss on digital assets as Bitcoin
     fell about 28% from the same period last year&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Bitcoin's price drop was the primary culprit. Revenue would
have benefited from higher production, but a 28% year-over-year decline in
Bitcoin's average price reduced revenue by approximately $65.9 million.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;MARA Is Still a Bitcoin Believer — But Not a Pure Play&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;MARA remains the fourth-largest corporate Bitcoin holder —
but its strategy has evolved.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;CEO Fred Thiel has made it clear: MARA is increasingly
expanding beyond Bitcoin mining into energy and AI/HPC infrastructure.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"Bitcoin mining provided the foundation. We believe
digital Infrastructure, along with our Exaion and technology initiatives, will
expand the value we create from that foundation. Together, they position MARA
to participate across multiple layers of the AI infrastructure value chain
while remaining disciplined in how we allocate capital."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;—&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Fred Thiel&lt;/b&gt;, Chairman and CEO of MARA Holdings&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The company has agreed to acquire Long Ridge Energy &amp;amp;
Power, a 505 MW combined-cycle natural gas power plant in Hannibal, Ohio, for
approximately $1.5 billion. Management projects Long Ridge will contribute
roughly $144 million in annualized adjusted EBITDA.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The campus supports more than one gigawatt of total
potential power capacity, with a clear path to up to 600 gross MW of AI and
critical IT load over time.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The Pivot to Bitcoin-Backed Loans&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Rather than selling more Bitcoin, MARA is using its
remaining stack as collateral to fund its infrastructure ambitions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;After the quarter ended, MARA secured Bitcoin-backed loan
facilities from Coinbase Credit and Two Prime Lending, pledging a portion of
its June 30 holdings as collateral. The company has already used substantial
Bitcoin-sale proceeds for debt reduction, while its new financing gives it
another source of liquidity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The risk:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;A significant portion of MARA's
Bitcoin holdings are now pledged. Deeper price weakness could trigger forced
selling, though the company has not disclosed exact margin-call thresholds.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What This Means for Bitcoin Markets&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The selling pressure from MARA is real — but it may be
behind us. The company has already used substantial Bitcoin-sale proceeds for
debt reduction, while its new financing gives it another source of liquidity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;That said, MARA's pivot to AI infrastructure reflects a
broader structural challenge facing the mining industry. As block rewards
shrink and mining difficulty rises, industrial-scale miners are increasingly
looking for higher-margin revenue streams.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Whether that weakens Bitcoin's proof-of-work network in the
long run remains an open question.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;MARA sold a substantial amount of Bitcoin as part of a
broader capital-allocation strategy that included debt reduction, liquidity
management and investment in infrastructure.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;MARA's Bitcoin sales in 2026 mark a significant shift in how
the company manages its reserves. Rather than treating Bitcoin solely as a
long-term holding, MARA is using its digital assets as a source of liquidity
while reducing debt and investing in energy and infrastructure opportunities.
The strategy could strengthen the company's balance sheet, but it also means
shareholders are exposed to the trade-off between holding Bitcoin and deploying
it for corporate growth.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Bitfinex Securities Lists Five Tokenized Notes Tied to Bitcoin Treasury Stocks</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article style="box-sizing: border-box; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; line-height: 1.75; margin: 0px auto; max-width: 900px; padding: 10px 0px;"&gt;

  &lt;h1 style="font-size: 34px; line-height: 1.25; margin: 0px 0px 14px;"&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEj3NMYcPTjPntpZyoYS6bFdkdQ0JUV1Vn-b0dvws725VsHbLVFqGD6vfGXvxzVRHDwkuOn8WemdXF66kv7-_4unaTNfQhESdHlRPmKBIHO8FjeDZ9Nt86O8xF9N1G5GEiBTqE890Ue5X6nXu2c2HZxzTKVuorARRejthpb9nJVfxVDkMLeMoQIyIk195Z5H/s1672/bitfinex-securities-tokenized-notes-strategy-metaplanet.jpg.png" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Bitfinex Securities lists tokenized notes tracking Strategy and Metaplanet" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEj3NMYcPTjPntpZyoYS6bFdkdQ0JUV1Vn-b0dvws725VsHbLVFqGD6vfGXvxzVRHDwkuOn8WemdXF66kv7-_4unaTNfQhESdHlRPmKBIHO8FjeDZ9Nt86O8xF9N1G5GEiBTqE890Ue5X6nXu2c2HZxzTKVuorARRejthpb9nJVfxVDkMLeMoQIyIk195Z5H/w400-h225/bitfinex-securities-tokenized-notes-strategy-metaplanet.jpg.png" title="Bitfinex Securities Tokenized Notes for Strategy and Metaplanet" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: 14px;"&gt;&lt;h1 style="font-size: 34px; line-height: 1.25; margin: 0px 0px 14px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: 14px;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;Bitfinex Securities has expanded its tokenized securities market with five new notes linked to companies that have become closely associated with Bitcoin treasury strategies.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The newly listed products track the economic performance of
    &lt;strong&gt;Strategy, Strategy's STRC preferred stock, Metaplanet, Sweden's H100 Group and France's Capital B&lt;/strong&gt;.
    Eligible investors can trade the notes against &lt;strong&gt;U.S. dollars, USDT and Bitcoin&lt;/strong&gt;, with fractional exposure starting at approximately $1.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The move gives eligible non-U.S. investors another way to gain exposure to Bitcoin-focused public companies through blockchain-based securities infrastructure.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    However, there is an important distinction: &lt;strong&gt;these products are tokenized notes, not direct tokenized shares.&lt;/strong&gt;
    Investors do not receive direct ownership of the underlying company shares simply by holding the notes.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Five Bitcoin-Linked Public-Market Exposures
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The five products cover a mixture of common-equity and preferred-security exposure. Their structures are designed to provide economic exposure to the referenced securities through tokenized notes.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    These Are Tokenized Notes, Not Direct Shares
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    This is arguably the most important detail of the announcement.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The products should not be described as blockchain versions of the actual company shares. Instead, they are structured as &lt;strong&gt;tokenized, securities-backed notes&lt;/strong&gt; whose value is linked to the underlying securities.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The notes were issued through &lt;strong&gt;ORO (II), a Luxembourg umbrella securitization fund managed by SICOS Securities&lt;/strong&gt;.
    The underlying securities are held with regulated financial institutions supporting the securitization structure.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    This means &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/does-blockchain-ever-actually-delete.html"&gt;investors&lt;/a&gt; receive exposure through the note rather than becoming direct shareholders of Strategy, Metaplanet, H100 Group or Capital B.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    As a result, holding one of these notes should not automatically be treated as equivalent to holding the company's stock directly. Shareholder rights such as &lt;strong&gt;voting rights&lt;/strong&gt; may not apply in the same way because the investor holds the note rather than the underlying equity security itself.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Fractional Exposure Starts at About $1
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    One of the more notable features is the ability to obtain fractional exposure.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Bitfinex Securities says the products can be accessed from approximately &lt;strong&gt;$1&lt;/strong&gt;, depending on the relevant instrument and applicable trading conditions.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The notes can be traded against three major currencies or digital assets:
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;ul style="padding-left: 25px;"&gt;
    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;USD&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;USDT&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bitcoin (BTC)&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    That combination is significant because it places traditional equity-linked exposure alongside crypto-native trading assets.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    An eligible investor holding Bitcoin, for example, can potentially use BTC as the trading pair for a securities-backed instrument whose economic performance is connected to a Bitcoin treasury company.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    U.S. Investors Are Excluded
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The products are &lt;strong&gt;not available to U.S. persons&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Bitfinex Securities states that its securities trading services are not offered to prohibited persons, including U.S. persons and people present in the United States, subject to applicable terms and jurisdictional restrictions.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Therefore, this announcement should not be interpreted as a new route for U.S. retail investors to directly access Strategy or Metaplanet through Bitfinex Securities.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The products are intended for &lt;strong&gt;eligible investors in permitted jurisdictions&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Why Bitcoin Treasury Companies Are a Natural Fit for Tokenization
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The timing of the launch is notable.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Bitcoin treasury companies sit at the intersection of traditional capital markets and the digital-asset economy. Their shares trade through conventional financial markets, while their corporate strategies can be strongly influenced by Bitcoin prices, financing conditions and crypto-market sentiment.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tokenization adds another layer to that relationship.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Instead of requiring an investor to use a traditional stock brokerage to obtain exposure to these companies, a securities-backed &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/michael-saylor-calls-msci-crypto.html"&gt;tokenized&lt;/a&gt; note can bring that exposure into blockchain-based market infrastructure.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    This could make the products particularly interesting to investors who already operate within digital-asset markets.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Volatility Remains a Major Risk
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tokenization does not make the underlying investment less volatile.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Because the notes are linked to publicly traded securities, investors remain exposed to the price movements of those underlying assets. Strategy, Metaplanet and other Bitcoin-focused companies can experience substantial price swings when Bitcoin moves sharply or when investor sentiment toward their treasury strategies changes.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The note structure may also introduce differences between the market price of the tokenized instrument and the price of the referenced security.
    Therefore, investors should not assume that blockchain-based trading eliminates equity-market volatility or guarantees a perfect one-to-one price relationship at every moment.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Liquidity Is Another Factor to Watch
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Liquidity is another important consideration.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Major public equities can benefit from deep liquidity across established stock exchanges. A tokenized note trading on a specialized securities platform may have a smaller pool of buyers and sellers.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    That means investors could potentially face wider spreads, fewer counterparties or greater difficulty executing larger trades, particularly during periods of market stress.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    In simple terms, &lt;strong&gt;tokenization can improve accessibility without automatically creating the same level of liquidity as a major traditional stock exchange.&lt;/strong&gt;
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Custody and Securitization Structure Matter
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Another important part of the structure is custody.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The underlying securities supporting the notes are held with regulated financial institutions involved in the securitization arrangement. This is different from simply holding the actual shares directly in an investor's conventional brokerage account.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Investors therefore need to understand not only the underlying company's financial and market risks, but also the legal and structural characteristics of the note, its issuer and the institutions involved in holding the underlying securities.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Bitfinex Securities Is Expanding Its Tokenized Securities Business
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The five listings also show how &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/how-supporters-turned-marmot-project.html"&gt;Bitfinex&lt;/a&gt; Securities is expanding beyond conventional cryptocurrency trading.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The platform has previously supported different types of tokenized financial products, including debt and other investment structures. Its broader objective is to provide blockchain-based infrastructure for issuing and trading securities.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The latest listings extend that model into public companies with significant exposure to the Bitcoin ecosystem.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    The $50 Million Alkemya Raise
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The timing of the announcement also follows another major development for Bitfinex Securities.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    In &lt;strong&gt;August 2026&lt;/strong&gt;, the platform completed a &lt;strong&gt;$50 million tokenized capital raise for Alkemya&lt;/strong&gt;, a metals company. The transaction demonstrated that tokenization on the platform is being used not only for investment exposure but also as a mechanism for companies to access capital through blockchain-based securities infrastructure.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Against that backdrop, the latest five listings represent another expansion of the platform's tokenized securities offering—this time focusing on companies whose equity stories are closely connected with Bitcoin.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    What the Launch Could Mean for Investors
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    For investors who already understand Bitcoin treasury companies, the new products provide another potential route to market exposure.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    But the structure also introduces risks that are different from simply buying a company's common stock.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;ul style="padding-left: 25px;"&gt;
    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"&gt;
      &lt;strong&gt;Underlying asset risk:&lt;/strong&gt; The value of the note can be affected by the referenced security.
    &lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"&gt;
      &lt;strong&gt;Volatility risk:&lt;/strong&gt; Bitcoin treasury stocks can experience significant price movements.
    &lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"&gt;
      &lt;strong&gt;Liquidity risk:&lt;/strong&gt; Tokenized markets may have fewer buyers and sellers than established stock exchanges.
    &lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"&gt;
      &lt;strong&gt;Issuer and structural risk:&lt;/strong&gt; The investor holds a note rather than the underlying share itself.
    &lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"&gt;
      &lt;strong&gt;Custody risk:&lt;/strong&gt; The structure depends on institutions responsible for holding and supporting the underlying securities.
    &lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"&gt;
      &lt;strong&gt;Regulatory risk:&lt;/strong&gt; Availability depends on jurisdiction and investor eligibility.
    &lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"&gt;
      &lt;strong&gt;Crypto-market risk:&lt;/strong&gt; Trading against BTC or USDT adds a digital-asset dimension to the investment.
    &lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"&gt;
      &lt;strong&gt;Price-tracking risk:&lt;/strong&gt; The note's market price may not perfectly match the underlying security at every point in time.
    &lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    A Bridge Between Stocks and Crypto Markets
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The bigger story behind Bitfinex Securities' latest listings may therefore be less about the five individual products and more about the convergence of traditional securities and digital-asset infrastructure.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Strategy and Metaplanet are already examples of companies whose market narratives are closely connected to Bitcoin. By putting securities-backed notes linked to these companies alongside Bitcoin and USDT trading pairs, Bitfinex Securities is bringing traditional equity exposure closer to the crypto trading environment.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    For eligible non-U.S. investors, that creates another potential route between fiat currencies, stablecoins, Bitcoin and tokenized securities within a regulated-market framework.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Whether this model becomes a major part of global capital markets will depend on liquidity, regulatory adoption, market infrastructure and investor demand.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    For now, the five new listings represent another step in the development of &lt;strong&gt;tokenized securities as a bridge between traditional financial assets and blockchain-based markets.&lt;/strong&gt;
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;!--KEY TAKEAWAYS--&gt;
  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Key Takeaways
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;div style="background: rgb(245, 245, 245); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); margin: 20px 0px; padding: 18px 20px;"&gt;

    &lt;ul style="margin: 0px; padding-left: 22px;"&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        Bitfinex Securities has listed &lt;strong&gt;five tokenized notes&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        The products track &lt;strong&gt;Strategy, STRC, Metaplanet, H100 Group and Capital B&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        Trading is available against &lt;strong&gt;USD, USDT and Bitcoin&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        Fractional exposure starts at approximately &lt;strong&gt;$1&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        The products are intended for &lt;strong&gt;eligible non-U.S. investors&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;
        &lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;U.S. persons are excluded&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        The products are &lt;strong&gt;tokenized notes, not direct ownership of the underlying company shares&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        Underlying securities are held with regulated financial institutions supporting the securitization structure.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 8px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        Investors remain exposed to &lt;strong&gt;equity volatility and liquidity risk&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

      &lt;li style="margin-bottom: 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: red;"&gt;
        The launch follows Bitfinex Securities' &lt;strong&gt;$50 million Alkemya tokenized capital raise completed in August 2026&lt;/strong&gt;.
      &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

    &lt;/ul&gt;

    <title>Trump-Linked Real Trump Coins Promoted GOLD — Then a Wallet Dump Sent It Crashing 99%</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

  &lt;h1&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEguUoN5odlQljnJpHA3iFupG-A68g8qgi0AJi8DqRguKYDM2K28Rmi2eaiE05fhyphenhyphenEusSxTsSROC1I70FgSlXh7PVic9kimQMbFvqCX4oSJjku6f8QZHvC2kG6Nxayh4QTftpjBSb_xn6Qbs5hrq3cRNezfjAkL0Ki30G0FMqoqgfQUEpTtzTPZ8h0ktEvV2/s1672/trump-linked-gold-token-wallet-dump-99-percent-crash.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Trump-linked GOLD crypto token plunging after large wallet sell-off and concentrated token holdings" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEguUoN5odlQljnJpHA3iFupG-A68g8qgi0AJi8DqRguKYDM2K28Rmi2eaiE05fhyphenhyphenEusSxTsSROC1I70FgSlXh7PVic9kimQMbFvqCX4oSJjku6f8QZHvC2kG6Nxayh4QTftpjBSb_xn6Qbs5hrq3cRNezfjAkL0Ki30G0FMqoqgfQUEpTtzTPZ8h0ktEvV2/w400-h225/trump-linked-gold-token-wallet-dump-99-percent-crash.webp.png" title="Trump-Linked GOLD Token Crashes After Large Wallet Sell-Off" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: small;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff &lt;/span&gt;|&amp;nbsp;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;A new Solana token promoted through the Real Trump Coins brand went from a rapid early surge to an almost complete collapse within hours — and the on-chain data tells a story of extreme concentration.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The token, &lt;strong&gt;Trump Digital GOLD (GOLD)&lt;/strong&gt;, surged to a market capitalization of more than $50 million shortly after launch before collapsing by roughly 98% to 99%, depending on the point of measurement used. Recent reports put its post-crash valuation in the hundreds of thousands of dollars.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The dramatic reversal followed the sale of a large GOLD position by a group of wallets that blockchain analytics firm &lt;strong&gt;Lookonchain&lt;/strong&gt; linked to the project.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But there is more to the story than a 99% price collapse.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The key questions are how the token was distributed, who controlled the wallets, why such a large portion of the supply was concentrated, and whether the social-media account promoting GOLD was operating normally.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Those questions matter because blockchain data can show where tokens moved and when they were sold. It cannot, by itself, establish the real-world identity or intent of every wallet holder.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;GOLD Went From Hype to Collapse&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;GOLD appeared on Solana on August 29 and was promoted through the Real Trump Coins ecosystem.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The &lt;strong&gt;@realtrumpcoins1&lt;/strong&gt; X account promoted “Trump Digital GOLD” before related promotional posts were deleted. The account is followed by Donald Trump's official X account and has been associated with the Trump-linked merchandise brand, adding an appearance of legitimacy to the promotion.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That association is important, but it should not be confused with proof that Donald Trump personally launched or endorsed GOLD.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The token quickly attracted speculative buying.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Its market capitalization climbed above &lt;strong&gt;$50 million&lt;/strong&gt;, with some reports placing the peak closer to $60 million depending on the market-data snapshot.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Then the wallet activity became the focus.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;According to Lookonchain, the developer wallet held approximately &lt;strong&gt;600 million GOLD&lt;/strong&gt;, while 15 newly created wallets spent around &lt;strong&gt;$18,657&lt;/strong&gt; to acquire another &lt;strong&gt;224.5 million GOLD&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Lookonchain estimated that the developer and those wallets collectively controlled approximately &lt;strong&gt;82.45% of the total supply&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That level of concentration created an obvious vulnerability.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A small number of wallets had enough tokens to create enormous selling pressure if they decided to exit.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And eventually, those wallets sold.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The $330,000 Sale&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Lookonchain reported that the 15 wallets sold their entire &lt;strong&gt;224.5 million GOLD&lt;/strong&gt; position.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The tokens were sold for approximately &lt;strong&gt;3,178 SOL&lt;/strong&gt;, worth around &lt;strong&gt;$330,000&lt;/strong&gt; at the time.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;According to Lookonchain's calculation, the wallets had spent approximately $18,657 acquiring the tokens and realized a profit of roughly &lt;strong&gt;$312,000&lt;/strong&gt;, representing about a 17-fold return on the initial outlay.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The timing was crucial.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;GOLD was still a very young token, and the market did not have enough depth to absorb such a large concentrated sale without a major price reaction.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;As selling pressure increased, the token's price collapsed.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Recent reports showed the token falling from a valuation above $50 million to well below $1 million. The exact percentage depends on the market-cap snapshot, but the decline was clearly in the high-90% range.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why a $330,000 Sale Could Trigger a Massive Collapse&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;This is one of the most misunderstood parts of low-liquidity crypto markets.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;When a token is said to have a $50 million market &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/new-york-warns-ai-is-making-investment.html"&gt;capitalization&lt;/a&gt;, it does not mean there is $50 million sitting in a liquidity pool waiting to be withdrawn.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Market capitalization is calculated using the token's price and supply.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If the price falls sharply, the implied value of the entire remaining supply falls with it.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That means a relatively small amount of actual selling can sometimes erase tens of millions of dollars in paper market capitalization.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;GOLD's situation was particularly vulnerable because so much of its supply was reportedly concentrated among a small group of wallets.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Once those wallets started selling, the market had to absorb a huge amount of supply relative to the available liquidity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The process can become self-reinforcing.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A large holder sells.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The price falls.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Other traders see the collapse and begin selling.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Liquidity becomes thinner.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The next sell order pushes the price down even further.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Within a short period, a token that appeared to be worth tens of millions of dollars can be trading at a tiny fraction of its previous valuation.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The 82.45% Concentration Was the Real Warning Sign&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The most important number in the entire episode may not be 99%.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It may be &lt;strong&gt;82.45%&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;According to Lookonchain's analysis, the developer and associated wallets controlled approximately four-fifths of GOLD's total supply.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For a newly launched token, that is an extremely concentrated distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It means ordinary market participants may have had relatively little control over the available supply.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It also means that large holders could dramatically influence the price simply by moving their tokens.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;This is why experienced crypto traders often look beyond market capitalization.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They check the holder distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They examine liquidity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They follow large wallet transfers.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And they look for clusters of newly created wallets receiving or purchasing unusually large amounts of a token.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;GOLD illustrates why those checks can matter.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The token's market capitalization suggested rapid growth.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The wallet distribution suggested significant concentration risk.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Was It a Rug Pull?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;This is where the story requires careful wording.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Several crypto outlets and commentators have described the event as an apparent &lt;strong&gt;rug pull&lt;/strong&gt;, while Lookonchain itself used the phrase &lt;strong&gt;“GOLD just rugged”&lt;/strong&gt; after the wallet sales.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But a definitive statement that the operators committed fraud would go beyond the evidence currently available.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;What can be established from the reported on-chain activity is more specific:&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;The developer reportedly held about &lt;strong&gt;600 million GOLD&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Fifteen newly created wallets acquired approximately &lt;strong&gt;224.5 million GOLD&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Lookonchain linked those wallets to the project team.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Those wallets subsequently sold the entire 224.5 million GOLD position.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;The sale generated approximately &lt;strong&gt;$330,000&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;The token's market capitalization then collapsed from tens of millions of dollars to well below $1 million.&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Those transactions can be examined on the blockchain.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;What remains less certain is who ultimately controlled every wallet and what their intentions were.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That distinction matters.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Calling the event an “apparent rug pull” describes how many observers interpreted the sudden collapse. It does not, by itself, establish a legally proven case of fraud.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The X Account Raises More Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The situation became even more unusual because the Real Trump &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/could-state-actor-use-ai-to-51-attack.html"&gt;Coins X&lt;/a&gt; account reportedly promoted GOLD before the related posts were deleted.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That immediately raised questions about what was happening behind the account.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Was the token deliberately launched and promoted?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Was the account compromised?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Was someone operating the account without authorization?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Or was the launch simply badly managed?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Recent reports have raised the possibility that the account was compromised, while other reporting has described the incident as an apparent hack. However, the available reporting does not provide enough independent confirmation to treat that explanation as definitively established.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The distinction is important because the blockchain evidence and the identity of the people behind the wallets are two different issues.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The transactions are visible.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The intent is not.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Is the Connection to Trump?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The Trump connection is real in terms of the broader Real Trump Coins brand, but it needs to be described carefully.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Donald Trump has publicly promoted Trump-themed physical coins and collectibles through the broader Trump brand ecosystem. The Real Trump Coins account involved in the GOLD promotion is also followed by Trump's official X account.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;However, that does &lt;strong&gt;not automatically mean that GOLD was personally launched or endorsed by Donald Trump&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That distinction is particularly important with a newly launched cryptocurrency.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A token can use Trump-related branding or appear through an account associated with a Trump-linked merchandise business without establishing that Trump himself created, controlled or officially endorsed the token.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For investors, brand association should therefore never replace independent verification.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why the Branding Mattered&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Crypto markets are driven heavily by attention and narrative.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A new token with no recognizable identity can struggle to attract buyers.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A token connected to a recognizable political brand can generate attention much faster.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That attention can bring traders.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Traders bring volume.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Rising prices create more social-media attention.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And the cycle can continue until something breaks the narrative.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;In GOLD's case, the token reportedly reached a market capitalization above $50 million while still having a highly concentrated supply structure.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That combination can be dangerous.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The market may focus on the story while overlooking the underlying &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/hong-kong-sfc-flags-star-bridge-capital.html"&gt;token economics&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Then, when large holders sell, the narrative can disappear almost as quickly as it appeared.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Buyback Promise&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Another detail surrounding GOLD deserves attention.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Reporting on the token's promotion said the Real Trump Coins website advertised a &lt;strong&gt;4% trading fee&lt;/strong&gt; and claimed that &lt;strong&gt;99% of trading fees would be used to buy back GOLD&lt;/strong&gt;. The website also promoted an ambitious goal of pushing the token toward the top 10 cryptocurrencies by market capitalization.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Those statements are marketing claims.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They should not be treated as guarantees of future performance.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A buyback plan does not automatically protect a token from a liquidity shock.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It does not prevent a major holder from selling.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And it does not guarantee that a token will retain its market value.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The subsequent collapse demonstrates why investors should separate a project's stated plans from independently verifiable results.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Blockchain Tells Part of the Story&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;One of the biggest advantages of public blockchains is transparency.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Anyone can potentially inspect wallet activity and see when tokens move.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That makes on-chain analysis particularly useful when a newly launched token experiences a sudden collapse.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;In a case like GOLD, traders can examine:&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;The largest holders&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Wallet creation dates&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Token acquisition patterns&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Transfers between related wallets&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Liquidity levels&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Large selling transactions&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Changes in token ownership over time&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But blockchain transparency has limits.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A wallet address does not automatically reveal the real-world identity of the person controlling it.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Several wallets may be controlled by one entity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Or multiple wallets may belong to unrelated individuals.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is why wallet clustering and attribution from analytics firms should be described as analysis or identification, rather than automatically treated as definitive proof of ownership.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why Market Capitalization Can Be Misleading&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The fall from more than $50 million to below $1 million sounds like tens of millions of dollars vanished from the market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But that does &lt;strong&gt;not&lt;/strong&gt; mean an equivalent amount of cash was withdrawn.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The difference is important.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Market capitalization reflects the value implied by the current token price.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If the token trades sharply lower, the value assigned to every remaining token falls as well.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;This is why a thinly traded token can experience a massive market-cap collapse without an equivalent amount of cash leaving the market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The &lt;strong&gt;$330,000 sale reported by Lookonchain&lt;/strong&gt; is a transaction figure.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The collapse in market capitalization is a change in implied valuation.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Those figures should never be treated as interchangeable.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Investors Can Learn From the GOLD Collapse&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The incident offers a useful checklist for anyone considering a newly launched token.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Check Holder Concentration&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If the developer and a handful of wallets control most of the supply, the risk is significantly higher.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Look at Liquidity&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A large market capitalization does not necessarily mean that enough liquidity exists to support large trades.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Examine Wallet Activity&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Fresh wallets receiving or purchasing enormous amounts of supply deserve closer scrutiny.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Verify the Promoter&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A recognizable brand or social-media account does not automatically prove official authorization.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Read the Tokenomics&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Look beyond promises about buybacks, fees or future rankings. Understand who owns the supply and what mechanisms could affect the market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Don't Chase the First Price Surge&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Rapid price increases can attract more buyers, but they can also create the perfect exit environment for early holders.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The immediate question is whether GOLD has any realistic path forward after losing almost all of its reported market value.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That will depend largely on transparency.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The project would need to explain the wallet activity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The status of the Real Trump Coins social-media account would need to become clearer.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And investors would need credible information about who controls the token and the infrastructure surrounding it.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Without that clarity, rebuilding confidence could be difficult.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the larger lesson extends beyond GOLD.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The episode shows how quickly a newly launched token can move from hype to collapse when recognizable branding, social-media attention, concentrated ownership and thin liquidity come together.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Trump Digital GOLD did not simply experience an ordinary market correction.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The token surged shortly after launch, reached a reported market capitalization above &lt;strong&gt;$50 million&lt;/strong&gt;, and then collapsed by roughly 98% to 99% after wallets identified by Lookonchain sold approximately &lt;strong&gt;224.5 million GOLD for around $330,000&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The reported wallet structure was a critical warning sign.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The developer and associated wallets were estimated to control approximately &lt;strong&gt;82.45% of the token supply&lt;/strong&gt;, leaving an unusually large share of GOLD concentrated among a small number of wallets.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;When those wallets sold, the market had little ability to absorb the selling without a dramatic price reaction.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Whether the episode ultimately proves to be a deliberate rug pull, a compromised online presence or something more complicated remains unresolved.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the on-chain lesson is already clear.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;A famous name can attract buyers. A rising market cap can create excitement. But neither can compensate for dangerously concentrated token ownership.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For anyone trading newly launched crypto assets, the most important question may not be who is promoting the token.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;It may be who can sell it — and how much of the supply they control — because in crypto, concentration is often the real risk behind the hype.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Disclaimer:&lt;/strong&gt; This article is for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment or financial advice. Wallet holdings, wallet attribution and transaction figures discussed above are based on blockchain analytics and current secondary reporting. Claims concerning wallet ownership, account compromise or deliberate wrongdoing should not be treated as independently proven unless confirmed by additional evidence. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile, and newly launched tokens can carry an extreme risk of loss.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Coldcard Hack Losses Remain Unclear as Estimates Range From 1,432 to 1,730+ BTC</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiR64kHA1xBFN7zOAg34XGON_bAArxi8YD2wEGS4VJsJGTLislq1lMVqFUrHjg0sh1K0_TpDenxGQCLeXEqpOGDP9PctfkLZFsUh2QMoR0pDIpnn_2Rw-z314L7s-el26ZGFVAhv1hf0ur_puC7NO4S00UwsKUG6rmUAo9SK2VbAPq4eWpAzfddGFG6BNRO/s1536/Coldcard%20Wallet%20Amid%20Crypto%20Vulnerabilities.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Coldcard hack losses unclear 1432 to 1730 Bitcoin stolen CryptoQuant Galaxy TRM estimates" border="0" data-original-height="1024" data-original-width="1536" height="213" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiR64kHA1xBFN7zOAg34XGON_bAArxi8YD2wEGS4VJsJGTLislq1lMVqFUrHjg0sh1K0_TpDenxGQCLeXEqpOGDP9PctfkLZFsUh2QMoR0pDIpnn_2Rw-z314L7s-el26ZGFVAhv1hf0ur_puC7NO4S00UwsKUG6rmUAo9SK2VbAPq4eWpAzfddGFG6BNRO/w320-h213/Coldcard%20Wallet%20Amid%20Crypto%20Vulnerabilities.png" title="Coldcard Hack Losses Remain Unclear: 1,432 to 1,730+ BTC Stolen | CoinaiNews" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Aug 11, 2026&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;– More than a week after the
Coldcard hardware wallet vulnerability was disclosed, the total scale of stolen
Bitcoin remains uncertain. Blockchain analytics firms have arrived at different
figures, reflecting the difficulty of measuring losses from self-custody
wallets where there is no complete list of affected accounts.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Blockchain analytics platform&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;CryptoQuant&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;currently
puts confirmed losses at&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;1,432 BTC&lt;/b&gt;. The firm takes a conservative
approach, starting with public reports from victims — including wallet
addresses or transaction IDs — and verifying those against known on-chain
attack patterns before confirming them.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"Because the stolen Bitcoin belonged to individuals
and not to a centralized entity, like an exchange, we can only confirm what
each victim publicly discloses."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br /&gt;
—&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Julio Moreno&lt;/b&gt;, Head of Research at CryptoQuant&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Galaxy Research and TRM Labs Point to Higher Numbers&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Galaxy Research&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;and blockchain intelligence
firm&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;TRM Labs&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;both say their analysis points to a higher toll,
while distinguishing between losses directly confirmed by victims and funds
attributed to the attack through on-chain patterns.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;As of Tuesday, Galaxy put its high-confidence minimum
at&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;1,730 BTC&lt;/b&gt;, with Galaxy's Alex Thorn saying the figure could
still increase as more victim reports corroborate attack patterns. The firm's
earlier potential estimate of 1,816 BTC, which appeared in some reports, was a
potential figure rather than a confirmed loss total.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"We have directly confirmed 450+ BTC directly from
victim reports, but their reports have helped identify other, as-yet-unknown
victims in more than 730 total BTC. We are still withholding many more BTC we
suspect but for which we lack sufficient corroboration."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br /&gt;
—&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Alex Thorn&lt;/b&gt;, Galaxy Research&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;TRM Labs said its independent tracing lands in the same
range as Galaxy, estimating that attackers drained about&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;1,816 BTC&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;from
more than 5,200 addresses across four waves. TRM's global head of policy Ari
Redbord said that the estimate should be expected to keep moving upward before
it stabilizes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Why the Numbers Differ&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The discrepancy comes down to methodology. CryptoQuant only
counts losses that victims have publicly disclosed and that the firm can verify
through on-chain patterns. Galaxy and TRM cast a wider net, using victim
reports to identify attack patterns and then tracing additional addresses that
match those patterns, even if the owners haven't come forward.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Moreno emphasized that the total will remain an estimate
because investigators can only confirm what victims disclose:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"Knowing the total BTC stolen is difficult, and it
will always be an estimation."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br /&gt;
—&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Julio Moreno&lt;/b&gt;, CryptoQuant&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The Exploit and Its Aftermath&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The vulnerability stems from a March 2021 firmware
integration error that, on affected devices, caused seed generation to use a
deterministic software pseudorandom number generator instead of the hardware
random number generator of the STM32 chip. On affected Mk3 seeds, effective
entropy could fall to roughly 40 bits instead of the expected 128 bits, making
private keys potentially brute-forceable.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The vulnerability affected seeds generated under specific
firmware conditions across Coldcard models, with the Mk3 facing the most severe
entropy reduction. Mk4, Mk5 and Q devices were also later identified as
affected under certain pre-fix firmware conditions, although their affected
seeds had higher effective entropy.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/coinbase-expands-uk-derivatives-access.html"&gt;Coinkite&lt;/a&gt; released fixed firmware for the affected models —
Mk3 version 4.2.0 or later, Mk4/Mk5 version 5.6.0 or later, and Coldcard Q
version 1.5.0Q or later. Updating the firmware does not repair a seed that was
already generated under vulnerable conditions, so affected users should follow
Coinkite's migration guidance and generate a new seed after installing the
fixed firmware.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;As of now, the confirmed loss figure remains contested.
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/standard-chartered-says-chainlink-could.html"&gt;CryptoQuant's&amp;nbsp;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;b&gt;1,432 BTC&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;represents a floor based on
victim-disclosed losses, while Galaxy's&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;1,730 BTC&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;high-confidence
minimum includes additional funds identified through on-chain pattern analysis.
The figures could rise as more victims come forward and investigators gain
additional evidence linking addresses to the attack.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;For affected users, the message is clear: if a wallet seed
was generated on a vulnerable Coldcard device, the funds should be moved to a
new seed generated on patched firmware — regardless of the exact loss figures.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

    <id>tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-1063445581464181190.post-4282134920937323958</id>
    <blogger:type>POST</blogger:type>
