&lt;h2&gt;How Wirero's Distribution Model Works&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero takes a different approach from a traditional newsroom or journalist-pitching service.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company describes its product as infrastructure for distributing content through a network of independent publishing domains. Its &lt;a href="https://wirero.com/network/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;network section&lt;/a&gt; provides more detail about the different publishing categories available through the platform.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That makes the service potentially interesting to companies that care about distribution scale and repeatable publishing workflows.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It also explains why the service should not be evaluated in exactly the same way as a traditional newswire.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A traditional wire may be chosen because of its established media relationships or journalist-facing distribution. A network-based platform is more focused on the publishing infrastructure itself.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Neither approach automatically guarantees editorial coverage. The value depends on what a company is trying to accomplish with the announcement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Wirero Pricing in 2026&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Cost is another area where the two models can look quite different.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to the current &lt;a href="https://wirero.com/pricing/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;Wirero pricing page&lt;/a&gt;, the platform lists two main monthly plans.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Starter — $250 per month:&lt;/strong&gt; The plan currently includes 100 total placements per month, selected niche networks, standard reporting and CSV export.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Unlimited — $500 per month:&lt;/strong&gt; The plan currently includes unlimited distributions, all 10 industry networks and publishing across up to 1,000 domains, together with expanded reporting.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company also lists network-wide banner, email and widget placement options separately.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;These figures are based on the pricing displayed at the time of publication. Companies considering the service should check the &lt;a href="https://wirero.com/pricing/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;official pricing page&lt;/a&gt; for the latest plans, limits and features before purchasing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why This Could Matter to Crypto Startups&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For a company that publishes one announcement every few months, a large distribution infrastructure may not be particularly important.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The calculation changes for businesses that are constantly launching products, announcing partnerships or expanding into new markets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Imagine a blockchain startup preparing a mainnet launch. A few weeks later it announces a major integration. Then comes a funding announcement, followed by a new geographic expansion.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Those are separate stories, but the communications team still needs a repeatable way to distribute them.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is where a recurring distribution platform can become useful. Instead of approaching each announcement as a completely separate operational task, a company can have an established distribution workflow in place.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Of course, the announcement still needs to be worth distributing. More publishing destinations do not make weak news stronger.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Agencies May Be Interested&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The agency use case is slightly different.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A PR or digital marketing agency may have several clients that need press release distribution. Managing those campaigns individually can become time-consuming, particularly when the agency wants to build its own service packages.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero has a dedicated &lt;a href="https://wirero.com/agency/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;agency offering&lt;/a&gt; aimed at this type of workflow.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The idea is that an agency can incorporate distribution into its own client services while using Wirero's underlying infrastructure to handle the publishing side.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is commonly referred to as a &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=define+white-label+or+reseller+model&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4324214788202780066" target="_blank"&gt;white-label or reseller model&lt;/a&gt;. The agency remains responsible for its client relationship and commercial offering, while the infrastructure provider handles the distribution operation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For agencies working with crypto and Web3 companies, that can make the model particularly relevant because clients often need recurring announcements rather than a single campaign.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Can Crypto PR Distribution Help With SEO?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is probably the question most companies ask before paying for distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The answer needs some context.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A distributed press release can create additional publicly accessible pages containing information about a company, product or announcement. Those pages can give people more opportunities to discover the company online.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But that does not mean that every placement becomes a valuable &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=define+SEO+backlink&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4324214788202780066" target="_blank"&gt;SEO backlink&lt;/a&gt;, or that distributing a release across many domains automatically produces higher search rankings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Search engines evaluate pages and links in context. Google's guidance also warns against using scaled content and links primarily to manipulate search rankings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For that reason, companies should look at PR distribution as part of a broader communications strategy rather than treating it as a shortcut to search rankings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A stronger approach combines press releases with useful first-party content, genuine media relationships, original research, product documentation and independent editorial coverage where it is available.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What About Google AI Overviews and AI Search?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=AI-powered+search+impact+current+state&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4324214788202780066" target="_blank"&gt;AI-powered search&lt;/a&gt; has changed another part of the equation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;People are increasingly asking systems such as &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=define+Google+AI+Overviews&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4324214788202780066" target="_blank"&gt;Google AI Overviews&lt;/a&gt;, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity questions about companies, products and current events. Those systems can draw information from publicly available sources, but no PR platform can guarantee that a particular press release will be cited.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For a crypto company, the more useful goal is to make its public information clear, accurate and consistent.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That includes using the same company name across official properties, providing specific dates, clearly describing products and linking important announcements back to authoritative first-party sources.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Distribution can contribute to that broader online footprint, but it should not be sold as a guaranteed route into AI answers.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;When a Traditional Newswire Still Makes Sense&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There are plenty of situations where a traditional newswire can remain the appropriate choice.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A company may specifically need established journalist databases, financial-media distribution, geographic targeting or services built around large corporate announcements.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Large public companies, for example, can have very different communications requirements from a small Web3 startup.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is why comparing the two models purely on price or number of publishing domains can be misleading. The more useful comparison is whether the service matches the company's actual communications objective.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;When a Multi-Domain Model May Be Worth Considering&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A multi-domain platform may be worth examining when a company or agency is primarily interested in recurring distribution and publishing infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Some of the reasons include:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Regular press release campaigns&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Industry-focused distribution networks&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Subscription-based pricing&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Scalable publishing workflows&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Agency or white-label use&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Distribution reporting&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Before signing up, however, businesses should review the actual network, publishing policies, reporting options, pricing and terms rather than relying solely on headline distribution numbers.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What PR Distribution Cannot Guarantee&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is where expectations matter.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Publishing a press release on multiple websites does not mean that every website has independently reported the story. It also does not guarantee Google rankings, Google News inclusion, Discover traffic or citations from AI search engines.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Likewise, a large distribution number should not automatically be interpreted as an equivalent number of high-value backlinks or independent media mentions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The announcement itself still matters most.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A genuinely useful product update, credible partnership or meaningful business announcement gives journalists, readers and search systems something substantive to work with. Distribution simply helps put that information in more places.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;FAQ: Crypto PR Distribution in 2026&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is crypto PR distribution?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Crypto PR distribution is the process of distributing announcements from cryptocurrency, blockchain and Web3 companies through newswire services, publishing networks, industry websites and other media channels.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is multi-domain press release distribution?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It is a distribution model in which a press release can be published across a network of publishing domains instead of relying entirely on one traditional newswire.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does press release distribution guarantee Google rankings?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. Distribution can increase the number of places where information about a company is publicly available, but it does not guarantee higher Google rankings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can a press release appear in AI search results?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A press release may become part of the publicly available information that search and AI systems process, but no distribution provider can guarantee that an AI system will cite a particular release.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does Wirero offer an agency solution?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. Wirero has a dedicated &lt;a href="https://wirero.com/agency/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;agency page&lt;/a&gt; describing its offering for agencies and businesses using its distribution infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Where can I check Wirero's current pricing?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The current plans and features are listed on the &lt;a href="https://wirero.com/pricing/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;Wirero pricing page&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Where can I learn about Wirero's network?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company's &lt;a href="https://wirero.com/network/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;network page&lt;/a&gt; provides information about its publishing network and industry categories.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Where can I find answers to common questions?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero maintains an &lt;a href="https://wirero.com/faqs/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;official FAQ section&lt;/a&gt; covering common questions about its service.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Crypto PR distribution is becoming less about one standard distribution route and more about choosing an infrastructure that fits the company's actual needs.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Traditional newswires continue to serve companies looking for established media distribution and journalist-facing services. Multi-domain platforms represent another option, particularly for startups and agencies that need recurring publishing infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero sits in that second category, with industry networks, subscription plans and an agency-focused offering.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For crypto companies, the important thing is not simply how many domains appear in a distribution package. The bigger questions are whether the audience is relevant, whether the publishing network is transparent, whether reporting is useful and whether the announcement itself provides something worth reading.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Used with realistic expectations, PR distribution can be one part of a broader communications strategy. It should complement—not replace—original content, genuine media relationships and independent editorial coverage.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;/article&gt;

font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Key Takeaways:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px; padding-left: 18px;"&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The Netherlands has proposed a new Box 3 system based on actual investment returns, with a 36% tax rate.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Under the proposal, self-held crypto could be subject to annual taxation on changes in value, even without selling.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The House of Representatives passed the bill in February 2026, but the Senate still has to consider it.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The government is examining possible changes to the system, and the final form remains uncertain.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The planned start date is January 1, 2028.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;hr style="background: none 0% 0% / auto repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-style: none; border-width: medium; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; height: 1px; margin: 32px 0px;" /&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;A proposed tax overhaul in the Netherlands is drawing intense scrutiny from crypto investors. The plan, part of the &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Actual Return in Box 3 Act&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; (Wet werkelijk rendement box 3), would shift the Dutch tax system toward taxing &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;actual investment returns&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; rather than assumed returns. Under the proposal, a &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;36% tax rate&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; would apply to the taxable Box 3 result — which, for crypto, could include annual changes in value even if the investor never sells.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What the New Box 3 System Proposes&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The Netherlands uses a "box" system for personal income tax. Box 3 covers income from savings and investments. The current system, which taxes an assumed return rather than actual returns, has been repeatedly struck down by the Dutch Supreme Court for violating property rights when the assumed return diverges from reality &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.eerstekamer.nl/nonav/brief_in/20260208/schrap_de_wet_werkelijk_rendement/f=/vmuxfcmggn9q.pdf#1#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.sectie5.nl/fondsen/fondsenfile/21351/Hoekstede%20BV%20IM.pdf#18%2312" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The new system is designed to tax &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;actual returns&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. The general rule under the proposal is a &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;capital growth tax&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; (vermogensaanwasbelasting, or VAB). This means both income (like dividends and interest) and &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;annual changes in value&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; would be taxable, regardless of whether the investor sells &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://open.overheid.nl/documenten/4d0b291f-6d9d-44a5-b7d4-46ffb0f5be3d/file#1#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/nl/box-3/content/wat-is-mijn-werkelijk-rendement" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. However, the proposal also includes a &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;realization-based regime&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; (vermogenswinstbelasting, or VWB) for certain asset categories — primarily real estate and shares/interests in startups and scale-ups &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl/kst-36748-3.xml#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;For crypto investors, this means that if Bitcoin rises in value over the course of a year, the holder could owe tax on that increase — even without cashing out. Loss settlement would be &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;subject to the proposal's loss-settlement rules&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, which are still being finalized in the legislative process. The proposal also includes a &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;€1,800 tax-free result&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; allowance.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Important Context on the 36% Rate&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The proposed 36% rate applies to the &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;taxable Box 3 result&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; after the applicable calculation and allowances. It should not be described simply as "36% of every unrealized &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/cz-hints-crypto-pump-is-coming-soon.html"&gt;Bitcoin gain&lt;/a&gt;." The exact tax base depends on how the final legislation defines actual returns and how losses and allowances are applied.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What About Crypto ETFs and Gold/Silver?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The current proposal includes a separate &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;realization-based regime&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; (VWB) for certain assets. According to the official proposal, this regime is primarily intended for &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;real estate and shares/interests in startups and scale-ups&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl/kst-36748-3.xml#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; — not automatically for crypto ETFs.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Crypto ETFs should &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;not&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; be assumed to fall under the realization-based exception without a specific applicable rule. Similarly, the treatment of physical gold and silver under the proposal is not the same as the &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/trader-turns-105m-aster-long-into-65.html"&gt;ETF &lt;/a&gt;exception. The article does not claim a specific treatment for gold and silver beyond what the statutory source establishes.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Current Legislative Status&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The bill passed the &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Tweede Kamer (House of Representatives)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; on February 12, 2026. The &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Eerste Kamer (Senate)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; still has to consider the bill and has not yet given final approval &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://odb.belastingdienst.nl/documentatie/bank-en-beleggingsproducten-2028-v01/" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.eerstekamer.nl/nonav/commissievergadering/20260512_fin#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The government's current target for implementation is &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;January 1, 2028&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. However, following a &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;June 19, 2026 update&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, the government is examining possible changes to the VAB system and is also investigating alternative wealth-gains-tax approaches &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/dutch-government-to-revise-controversial-crypto-unrealized-gains-tax-bill" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.heraldsun.com.au/business/dutch-government-forced-to-backflip-on-taxing-unrealised-capital-gains/news-story/36523ff537e11695a81059e03d7086bb#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Dutch Finance Minister &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Eelco Heinen&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; said in February 2026 that the proposal would need to be amended &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/dutch-government-to-revise-controversial-crypto-unrealized-gains-tax-bill" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.btcc.com/en-IN/amp/square/Global%20Cryptocurrency/1541869" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. According to reports, he stated the law "cannot stand as it is" and that he would discuss changes with both houses of parliament &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.heraldsun.com.au/business/dutch-government-forced-to-backflip-on-taxing-unrealised-capital-gains/news-story/36523ff537e11695a81059e03d7086bb#1" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What This Means for Crypto Investors&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The proposal would represent a major change toward taxing actual investment returns. For crypto holders in the Netherlands, the key implication is that &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;annual value changes&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; could become taxable events, even without a sale.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;However, the legislation is &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;not yet final&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. The Senate has not voted, and the government is actively considering changes to the system. The final form — including how &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/the-business-is-gradually-back-to-usual.html"&gt;crypto &lt;/a&gt;is treated and whether the realization-based regime is expanded or narrowed — remains subject to the legislative process and possible amendments.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What is the Netherlands Box 3 tax plan?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The Box 3 Actual Return Act would tax actual returns on investments, including annual changes in value for crypto, at a proposed 36% rate. The planned start date is January 1, 2028.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Will crypto ETFs automatically be taxed only when sold?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Not necessarily. The current proposal's realization-based regime specifically covers certain real-estate assets and qualifying startup/scale-up interests. Crypto ETFs should not automatically be treated as part of that exception without a specific applicable rule.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Is the 36% rate a 36% tax on every crypto gain?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;No. The proposed 36% rate applies to the taxable Box 3 result after the applicable calculation and allowances. It should not be described simply as 36% of every unrealized Bitcoin gain.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Has the law been finalized?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;No. The House of Representatives passed the bill in February 2026, but the Senate still has to consider it. The government is also examining possible changes to the system.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What should Dutch crypto investors do?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Keep detailed records of asset values at the start and end of each tax year. Consult a tax advisor for personalized guidance. The final rules are not yet set.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Bottom line:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; The Netherlands is preparing a new Box 3 system based on actual returns, with a proposed 36% tax rate. Under the current proposal, crypto can be subject to annual taxation on changes in value even when gains have not been realized through a sale. However, the legislation is not yet final, and the government is considering changes to the wealth-accrual system and examining a wealth-gains approach. The planned start date remains January 1, 2028.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</content>

    <title>Hanwha Builds Tokenized Securities Platform on Avalanche in South Korea</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhuBlnw0Vt5w2yXcQ6TtPp_RMBnhbHdFL2D-dfkGfpVJDcDt91voPgNWUDpjTZIFC70SCeEpp0MPbxAlJTxtm_Fb0rEWzTfJfbQCX8RlWaP2HRyJOjB5qoL3NibqDurzsbNXao2G3E2cWM3Mkim4sABWlxkUv7FafKPWHB27GDLL1gwn1Ka6G6NQACc4S5o/s1672/hanwha-tokenized-securities-avalanche-south-korea.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Hanwha Investment and Securities builds tokenized securities platform on Avalanche" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhuBlnw0Vt5w2yXcQ6TtPp_RMBnhbHdFL2D-dfkGfpVJDcDt91voPgNWUDpjTZIFC70SCeEpp0MPbxAlJTxtm_Fb0rEWzTfJfbQCX8RlWaP2HRyJOjB5qoL3NibqDurzsbNXao2G3E2cWM3Mkim4sABWlxkUv7FafKPWHB27GDLL1gwn1Ka6G6NQACc4S5o/w640-h360/hanwha-tokenized-securities-avalanche-south-korea.jpg.png" title="Hanwha Tokenized Securities Platform on Avalanche" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;
&lt;strong&gt;September 7, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;South Korean financial giant &lt;strong&gt;Hanwha&lt;/strong&gt; is moving deeper into blockchain-based finance, with &lt;strong&gt;Hanwha Investment &amp;amp; Securities&lt;/strong&gt; completing a tokenized-securities platform that supports the &lt;strong&gt;Avalanche blockchain&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The development comes as South Korea prepares to formally integrate tokenized securities into its regulated capital markets. The platform was developed with blockchain technology company &lt;strong&gt;FairSquare Lab&lt;/strong&gt; and is designed to support multiple blockchain environments, including Avalanche and &lt;strong&gt;Hyperledger Besu&lt;/strong&gt;, according to Seoul Economic Daily. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The move gives Avalanche another institutional use case in South Korea, while also highlighting how traditional financial firms are preparing for the country's upcoming tokenized-securities market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Hanwha Is Building&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hanwha Investment &amp;amp; Securities' project is focused on &lt;strong&gt;tokenized securities&lt;/strong&gt;, rather than launching a new cryptocurrency.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Tokenized securities use blockchain or distributed-ledger technology to represent ownership or rights connected to traditional financial assets. Depending on the regulatory framework, those assets can include funds, bonds, stocks and fractional investment products.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hanwha began developing the platform in 2025 with FairSquare Lab. The completed infrastructure can operate across different blockchain networks, with Avalanche and Hyperledger Besu among the supported environments. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Avalanche Is Part of the Platform&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The use of Avalanche is notable because the project is being developed for a regulated financial application rather than a conventional crypto trading product.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Avalanche can support customizable blockchain environments, including networks designed for specific institutional requirements. That makes the technology potentially useful for financial applications where participants, access rules and transaction processes need to be controlled.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hanwha's decision to support both Avalanche and Hyperledger Besu also shows that institutional blockchain strategies do not necessarily revolve around one network.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The development should therefore not be interpreted as South Korea choosing Avalanche as its national blockchain for securities. It is one platform being developed by a financial institution within a broader multi-network market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;South Korea Is Preparing for Tokenized Securities&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The timing of Hanwha's platform is particularly important.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;South Korea is preparing a regulatory framework that will bring tokenized securities into its existing capital-market system. The new rules are scheduled to take effect in &lt;strong&gt;February 2027&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Financial Services Commission has outlined a phased approach for tokenization, with the scope expected to expand beyond fractional investment products to conventional securities such as &lt;strong&gt;stocks, bonds and funds&lt;/strong&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Under the first stage, certain &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/hina-gold-reserves-650000-ounces-august-2026.html"&gt;tokenized&lt;/a&gt; products will be introduced through regulated structures, while later phases are expected to expand the range of securities that can be tokenized and potentially introduce on-chain settlement using payment instruments such as stablecoins.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This regulatory shift gives Korean financial institutions a reason to build the necessary infrastructure before the market officially expands.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Hanwha's Platform Arrives Ahead of the 2027 Market&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Hanwha Investment &amp;amp; Securities, completing the platform ahead of the regulatory transition could allow the company to test and develop its blockchain infrastructure before tokenized securities become a larger part of South Korea's financial market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Korea Securities Depository is also developing tokenized-securities infrastructure capable of connecting with multiple &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/kalshi-ceo-says-nba-prediction-market.html"&gt;blockchain technologies&lt;/a&gt;, including Avalanche. Seoul Economic Daily described this as evidence that demand from private financial firms is beginning to influence regulated market infrastructure. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That connection could eventually become important for issuance, trading, ownership records and settlement of tokenized financial products.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Hanwha Has Been Expanding Its Blockchain Exposure&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Avalanche platform is part of a wider blockchain strategy at Hanwha Investment &amp;amp; Securities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Earlier in 2026, the securities firm invested approximately &lt;strong&gt;$13 million in Kresus Labs&lt;/strong&gt;, a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/china-unveils-45-billion-bank-and.html"&gt;blockchain &lt;/a&gt;company focused on digital-asset infrastructure. The investment was linked to areas including enterprise wallet infrastructure and real-world asset tokenization.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hanwha has also expanded its exposure to the broader tokenization sector through investments and partnerships involving companies such as &lt;strong&gt;Securitize&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Taken together, these developments suggest that Hanwha is exploring blockchain as financial infrastructure rather than simply treating digital assets as a speculative investment theme.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Tokenization Could Change&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Tokenization could change how financial assets are issued, transferred and recorded.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Traditional securities rely on multiple systems and intermediaries to maintain ownership records, process transactions and complete settlement. Blockchain-based infrastructure can potentially bring some of those functions onto a shared digital ledger.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Potential advantages include:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Faster settlement&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Programmable financial products&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;More transparent transaction records&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Potentially more efficient asset administration&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Fractional ownership for certain assets&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, tokenization does not eliminate financial regulation. Tokenized securities still need to comply with rules covering investor protection, ownership rights, issuance, trading and settlement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Hanwha Is Not Moving South Korea's Entire Market to Avalanche&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One distinction is important when interpreting the announcement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hanwha Investment &amp;amp; Securities has built a platform supporting Avalanche, but there is no indication that South Korea has selected Avalanche as the country's exclusive blockchain for tokenized securities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;South Korea's market infrastructure is being developed around multiple technologies. The Korea Securities Depository's work and the government's phased tokenization roadmap show that the country's approach is broader than any single blockchain network. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That makes Hanwha's development significant as an institutional adoption story, but not as a national blockchain-selection announcement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why This Matters for Avalanche&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Avalanche, the project adds another example of its infrastructure being considered for institutional financial applications.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The larger opportunity is the growing market for &lt;strong&gt;real-world asset tokenization&lt;/strong&gt;. Banks, brokerages, asset managers and other financial institutions are increasingly exploring whether blockchain can be used for funds, bonds, private assets and other securities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But infrastructure development alone does not guarantee large-scale adoption. The success of tokenized securities will depend on regulation, liquidity, investor demand, custody, interoperability and the ability of blockchain systems to integrate with existing financial infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The next major milestone will be South Korea's implementation of its tokenized-securities framework in &lt;strong&gt;February 2027&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That transition should provide a clearer picture of how &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/china-unveils-45-billion-bank-and.html"&gt;financial institutions&lt;/a&gt; such as Hanwha can use blockchain infrastructure in regulated securities markets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Avalanche, the important question will be whether institutional projects move beyond technical platforms and into actual issuance, trading and settlement of tokenized assets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For now, the development is clear: &lt;strong&gt;Hanwha Investment &amp;amp; Securities has completed a tokenized-securities platform supporting Avalanche and Hyperledger Besu as South Korea prepares for a regulated tokenization market.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is Hanwha building on Avalanche?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hanwha Investment &amp;amp; Securities has completed a tokenized-securities platform that supports Avalanche and Hyperledger Besu.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is Hanwha launching a new cryptocurrency?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. The reported project is focused on tokenized securities and financial infrastructure. It is not a new Hanwha cryptocurrency launch.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is South Korea choosing Avalanche for its entire securities market?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. Hanwha's platform is a private-sector project. South Korea's broader tokenized-securities infrastructure is being developed through regulators and market institutions using a multi-network approach.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;When will South Korea's tokenized-securities rules take effect?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The new framework is scheduled to take effect in &lt;strong&gt;February 2027&lt;/strong&gt;. South Korea is preparing to expand tokenization from fractional investment products toward conventional financial securities such as stocks, bonds and funds. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What are tokenized securities?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Tokenized securities are financial securities represented using blockchain or distributed-ledger technology. Depending on the regulatory framework, they can include funds, bonds, stocks and fractional investment products.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Why is Avalanche relevant to institutional finance?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Avalanche can support customizable blockchain environments and institutional applications. Its inclusion in Hanwha's platform shows that the network is being considered for regulated financial infrastructure beyond conventional cryptocurrency use cases.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>US Senators Could Unveil Bipartisan AI Safety Bill as Early as Next Week</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;h1&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/a/AVvXsEgndSBoiDjeSaDbMnB0fTiQ1_yNca1--On7LriEf5NbABKIV2bgiS8jnwYculYZ2WHA-9H51VVxCWrTYekaZ72UMbI-rKgWp2EZYDulviRSDsMf5H7v7c5n02xFSjSSXG5DW-hEuJ_FgQV4LzX4f3JWIksCT8tGsH4MhPE9IoB7hFhQ8tVGZUVTFpIcMW5M" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="US senators consider bipartisan AI safety bill amid growing AI regulation debate" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1671" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/a/AVvXsEgndSBoiDjeSaDbMnB0fTiQ1_yNca1--On7LriEf5NbABKIV2bgiS8jnwYculYZ2WHA-9H51VVxCWrTYekaZ72UMbI-rKgWp2EZYDulviRSDsMf5H7v7c5n02xFSjSSXG5DW-hEuJ_FgQV4LzX4f3JWIksCT8tGsH4MhPE9IoB7hFhQ8tVGZUVTFpIcMW5M=w640-h360" title="US Senators Consider Bipartisan AI Safety Bill" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;
September 10, 2026&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;U.S. senators could unveil a new bipartisan artificial intelligence safety bill as early as next week, according to &lt;strong&gt;Semafor&lt;/strong&gt;, potentially giving Washington its latest attempt to establish federal guardrails for increasingly capable AI systems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The reported Senate effort comes at a critical moment for the AI industry. Advanced models are becoming more autonomous, AI agents are gaining the ability to interact with external systems, and lawmakers are facing growing pressure to establish safety standards without slowing U.S. technological development.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Importantly, the Senate bill has not yet been formally released.&lt;/strong&gt; The timing and provisions described here are based on reporting about a potential upcoming legislative proposal, not on final congressional text.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Source:&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;a href="https://www.semafor.com/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Semafor&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What We Know About the Reported Senate AI Safety Bill&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to Semafor's reporting, senators could introduce the bipartisan legislation as soon as next week. A formal announcement would mark the beginning of the legislative process rather than the creation of a new federal AI law.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The actual bill text will be important because it will determine which AI developers and systems are covered, what safety obligations would apply and which federal agencies could be responsible for enforcement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Until lawmakers publish the legislation, it would be premature to describe specific provisions as confirmed requirements.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why AI Safety Is Moving Higher on the U.S. Agenda&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The potential Senate legislation arrives as concerns about increasingly autonomous AI systems intensify.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Recent reports have highlighted cases in which AI agents accessed or interacted with external systems in unexpected ways during testing. Reuters reported that the rapid improvement of &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/italy-crypto-sanctions-screening-banca-ditalia.html"&gt;AI capabilities&lt;/a&gt; is raising new questions about monitoring, autonomy and the ability of developers to control increasingly sophisticated systems. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That has changed the policy debate. Instead of focusing only on AI-generated content and traditional software risks, lawmakers are increasingly examining what happens when AI systems can independently perform tasks, access digital infrastructure or potentially discover and exploit vulnerabilities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;OpenAI Is Calling for Mandatory Federal AI Safety Rules&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Senate discussion also comes as OpenAI is pushing Congress toward mandatory national AI safety requirements.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to Reuters, OpenAI has called for binding, capability-based federal rules covering areas such as testing standards, independent assessments, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/us-bank-usbdc-stablecoin-stellar-cross-border-payments.html"&gt;cybersecurity &lt;/a&gt;protections and incident reporting for advanced AI systems. The company has argued that voluntary commitments are not enough as AI capabilities advance. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI has also endorsed four California AI-safety bills, including proposals involving third-party assessments, protections related to AI-enabled biological threats and safeguards for children. Reuters reported that the company is supporting state-level legislation while also calling for a national framework. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The distinction is important: these California measures are separate from the reported bipartisan Senate bill and should not be treated as part of the federal proposal unless lawmakers explicitly incorporate similar provisions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;California, Colorado and Texas Are Already Moving Ahead&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The United States does not have one comprehensive federal AI safety law covering every major AI system. As a result, individual states have been developing their own rules.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;California&lt;/strong&gt; has become one of the most important centers of &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/hunter-biden-laptop-memecoin-crash-86-5-percent.html"&gt;AI regulation&lt;/a&gt;. The state has adopted multiple AI-related measures, including rules covering frontier AI transparency, training-data disclosures and other targeted AI risks. California Governor Gavin Newsom signed the Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act, known as SB 53, in 2025. The law is part of the state's broader attempt to address the risks associated with highly capable AI systems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Colorado&lt;/strong&gt; has also taken a major role in AI regulation. The state's original Colorado AI Act established requirements around high-risk AI and algorithmic discrimination. Colorado subsequently revised that framework through SB 26-189 in 2026, narrowing and changing important aspects of the law. The revised framework is scheduled to take effect in 2027. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Texas&lt;/strong&gt; is another significant example. The Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act, commonly known as TRAIGA, took effect on January 1, 2026. The law establishes restrictions around certain uses of AI and creates a state-level governance framework. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The growing state-by-state patchwork is one reason technology companies have pushed for clearer federal standards. Different requirements across jurisdictions can increase compliance costs and create uncertainty for developers operating nationwide.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;AI Agent Security Is Becoming a Separate Policy Issue&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One of the clearest signs of the changing debate is the attention being given to AI agents.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;On September 3, bipartisan House lawmakers Josh Gottheimer and Mike Lawler introduced the &lt;strong&gt;Stop Rogue AI Act&lt;/strong&gt;. The proposal would direct the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) to develop standards and best practices for secure AI-agent deployment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The legislation reflects a concern that traditional software security approaches may not be sufficient for systems capable of making decisions and taking actions across external digital environments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The House proposal is separate from the reported Senate legislation, but both developments point toward a broader congressional focus on AI safety and agent security.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Bipartisan Support Could Be Important&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A bipartisan Senate AI safety bill could have greater political momentum than legislation backed primarily by one party.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;AI policy has become unusually complicated because lawmakers are trying to balance several competing objectives: protecting the public, maintaining national security, supporting innovation and ensuring that U.S. companies remain competitive with China and other AI-producing countries.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A bipartisan proposal could potentially provide a foundation for negotiations over those competing priorities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, bipartisan introduction does not guarantee passage. Differences could still emerge over enforcement authority, liability, federal preemption of state laws, compliance costs and the definition of an advanced or high-risk AI system.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;U.S.-China AI Safety Talks Are Also Coming&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The domestic legislative debate is taking place alongside an emerging international AI-safety dialogue between Washington and Beijing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reuters reported that the United States and China are preparing for their first official bilateral talks focused specifically on AI safety, with discussions tentatively scheduled for &lt;strong&gt;mid-September 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. The talks are expected to address risks associated with advanced AI, including AI-directed cyberattacks and mechanisms for sharing information about emerging threats. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The timing is notable because the talks are expected ahead of a planned September 24 meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reuters reported that Washington wants to encourage cooperation between AI laboratories in both countries on issues such as self-monitoring and information sharing, although expectations for immediate concrete agreements remain limited. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means the Senate's potential legislation would arrive as AI safety is being discussed simultaneously at the domestic and international levels.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Could a Federal AI Safety Bill Cover?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Until the Senate proposal is officially released, its specific requirements cannot be confirmed. However, several policy areas are already central to the broader U.S. AI-safety debate.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="margin: 20px 0px; overflow-x: auto; width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;table style="border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 720px; width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;thead&gt;

&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;Potential Area&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;Possible Focus&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/thead&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 10px;"&gt;Creating processes for reporting serious AI-related safety or security incidents.&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 10px;"&gt;Addressing systems capable of taking autonomous actions across external environments.&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;/table&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p&gt;These areas reflect the wider policy discussion and recent proposals. They should not be interpreted as confirmed provisions of the Senate bill until its legislative text is published.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Federal-State Divide Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The growing number of state AI laws creates another issue for Congress: whether federal legislation should establish a national baseline or preempt some state requirements.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Technology companies generally benefit from consistent rules because they can design products around one regulatory framework rather than dozens of state-specific requirements.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;States, however, have argued that they need the ability to respond to emerging risks within their own jurisdictions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A federal AI safety bill could therefore face an additional political fight over how much authority Washington should have compared with individual states.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens If Senators Introduce the Bill Next Week?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If senators formally unveil the legislation, the first major development will be the publication of its actual text.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That document will reveal which AI systems are covered, whether obligations apply to developers or deployers, what testing requirements may exist, which agencies would enforce the rules and whether the proposal would affect existing state AI laws.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;After introduction, the legislation would still need to go through the congressional process, which could include committee consideration, negotiations and Senate floor action.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;In other words, introducing the bill would be an important policy signal, but it would not mean that a new federal AI safety law is immediately taking effect.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What It Could Mean for AI Companies&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For AI developers, the biggest potential change would come if Congress moves from voluntary guidelines toward mandatory federal requirements.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Companies developing advanced models or autonomous AI agents could eventually face additional testing, documentation, cybersecurity and incident-reporting obligations.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For smaller companies, compliance costs could become an important concern. Congress would need to decide whether requirements should apply equally across the industry or scale according to the capabilities and risks of individual AI systems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What It Could Mean for AI Investors&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Federal AI regulation could become another factor for investors evaluating technology companies.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Clear national standards could reduce regulatory uncertainty and potentially make compliance requirements more predictable. At the same time, stricter rules could increase costs for companies developing advanced models.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The eventual market impact will depend heavily on the legislation's details, rather than the mere announcement of a Senate proposal.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Could U.S. senators introduce an AI safety bill next week?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to Semafor, senators could unveil a bipartisan AI safety bill as early as next week. The exact timing and final provisions have not yet been confirmed through released legislative text.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is the reported AI safety bill already law?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. Even if senators introduce the bill, it would still need to pass the congressional legislative process and receive presidential approval before becoming federal law.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is driving the push for AI safety legislation?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Lawmakers and technology companies are increasingly concerned about advanced AI systems, autonomous agents, cybersecurity risks, dangerous capabilities and AI systems interacting with external digital infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Has Congress already introduced AI safety legislation?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. The bipartisan Stop Rogue AI Act was introduced in the House earlier this month and would direct NIST to develop standards and best practices for secure AI-agent deployment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does the U.S. already have state AI laws?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. California, Colorado and Texas are among the states that have enacted significant AI-related legislation, although their approaches and requirements differ.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What AI safety rules does OpenAI support?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI has called for mandatory national requirements involving testing, independent assessments, cybersecurity protections and incident reporting for advanced AI systems. It has also supported several California AI-safety bills. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;When are U.S.-China AI safety talks expected?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reuters reported that the first official bilateral U.S.-China AI safety discussions are tentatively planned for mid-September 2026, ahead of a planned September 24 meeting between President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The possibility of a bipartisan Senate AI safety bill being unveiled as early as next week would be another important development in Washington's rapidly changing approach to artificial intelligence.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the distinction between a reported upcoming bill and enacted legislation is crucial. Until senators release the actual text, specific requirements should not be presented as settled policy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;What is clear is that the U.S. AI debate is moving toward concrete safety rules. Federal lawmakers are considering new approaches to AI-agent security, OpenAI is calling for mandatory national standards, and states including California, Colorado and Texas are developing their own frameworks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At the same time, Washington and Beijing are preparing for their first official bilateral AI-safety discussions. Together, these developments suggest that AI safety is becoming not only a technology issue, but also a major regulatory, economic and national-security priority.&lt;/p&gt;
