    <title>Standard Chartered Becomes First Bank to Distribute Hong Kong’s Regulated HKDAP Stablecoin</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgKlQ0i5pjI2DZma64bMVMatUfTbuUiIfKj6thZrPUSNSiLxtfWmeiq0b5blKV46LZnHlrw9LQp23_9KxpP7fMZlQlrputpM_y2HsSFH87VUMljlgxlVLQShLqLCymn4_kGkfZJy7w3b0NRCu1s6M3iQcPRX8N-44uMszpeZESmEybotnFrmzLBBR3T00iC/s1672/standard-chartered-hkdap-hong-kong-stablecoin.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Standard Chartered distributes HKDAP, Hong Kong's regulated Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgKlQ0i5pjI2DZma64bMVMatUfTbuUiIfKj6thZrPUSNSiLxtfWmeiq0b5blKV46LZnHlrw9LQp23_9KxpP7fMZlQlrputpM_y2HsSFH87VUMljlgxlVLQShLqLCymn4_kGkfZJy7w3b0NRCu1s6M3iQcPRX8N-44uMszpeZESmEybotnFrmzLBBR3T00iC/w400-h225/standard-chartered-hkdap-hong-kong-stablecoin.jpg.png" title="Standard Chartered Becomes First Bank to Distribute HKDAP Stablecoin" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;By CoinAINews Staff |&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) has become the first
bank authorized to distribute HKDAP, a regulated Hong Kong dollar-backed
stablecoin — marking another step in Hong Kong’s push to connect traditional
banking with blockchain-based payments. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;HKDAP, short for &lt;b&gt;HKD At Par&lt;/b&gt;, is issued by Anchorpoint
Financial Limited and is designed to maintain a one-to-one value with the Hong
Kong dollar. Anchorpoint is licensed by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA)
to issue stablecoins in Hong Kong. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The development is significant because Standard Chartered is
not simply providing banking infrastructure around the stablecoin. It is
becoming part of the &lt;b&gt;distribution layer&lt;/b&gt;, giving eligible institutional
clients and partners a regulated banking channel through which they can explore
HKDAP-based financial applications. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered Becomes HKDAP’s First Bank Distributor&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) announced on August 24
that it had become an authorized distributor of HKDAP.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The bank said it is engaging with eligible institutional
clients and partners to explore commercial applications for the stablecoin,
including &lt;b&gt;fund settlement, treasury management and cross-border trade
payments&lt;/b&gt;. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The initial rollout is focused on institutional use rather
than immediate mass-market adoption.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That distinction matters. HKDAP is being positioned as
financial infrastructure that can potentially help businesses move and settle
value through blockchain-based rails while remaining connected to regulated
financial institutions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered also plans to introduce additional
commercial applications as HKDAP moves through its phased rollout. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Is HKDAP?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;HKDAP stands for &lt;b&gt;HKD At Par&lt;/b&gt; and is a Hong Kong
dollar-backed stablecoin issued by &lt;b&gt;Anchorpoint Financial Limited&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Anchorpoint is a joint venture established by Standard
Chartered Bank (Hong Kong), HKT and Animoca Brands. The company received a
stablecoin issuer licence from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority in April 2026. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;According to Anchorpoint’s HKDAP documentation, each token
has a par value of &lt;b&gt;HKD 1.00&lt;/b&gt; and HKDAP in circulation is backed by
reserve assets with a market value at least equal to the value of the tokens
outstanding. The reserve assets are held on trust for HKDAP holders. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;HKDAP entered its &lt;b&gt;Beta Access phase on August 12, 2026&lt;/b&gt;,
with access initially limited to selected authorized distributors and their
institutional or corporate users. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why Bank Distribution Matters&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Stablecoins have traditionally been closely associated with
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/coinmarketcap-clarifies-dex-trading.html"&gt;cryptocurrency&lt;/a&gt; exchanges and digital-asset companies.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;HKDAP is being developed around a broader set of financial
applications, including payments, settlement and treasury operations.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered’s role gives the project a direct
connection to established banking infrastructure and institutional clients.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The bank said its initial use cases include tokenized
money-market fund subscriptions and settlements, intragroup settlement for
treasury and liquidity management, and cross-border payments. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That could make HKDAP relevant beyond cryptocurrency
trading.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cross-Border Payments Could Be a Major Use Case&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;One of the strongest potential applications for HKDAP is
international payments.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Traditional cross-border transactions can involve multiple
banks, payment networks, currencies and settlement processes. A regulated
stablecoin could potentially reduce some of those steps by allowing value to
move digitally while remaining linked to a fiat currency.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered specifically highlighted &lt;b&gt;cross-border
trade payments&lt;/b&gt; as one of the areas it intends to explore with HKDAP. The
bank said tokenized money could reduce operational friction while improving
capital mobility and transaction predictability. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The opportunity is particularly relevant to Hong Kong
because of its position as a major financial and trade center connecting
mainland China, Asia and international markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If businesses can eventually use regulated stablecoins to
move money across borders with fewer settlement steps, the technology could
become part of a much wider financial infrastructure rather than remaining a
niche crypto product.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Hong Kong’s Regulated Stablecoin Push&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The launch comes as Hong Kong builds a formal regulatory
framework for stablecoins.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The city’s &lt;b&gt;Stablecoins Ordinance&lt;/b&gt; came into effect on
August 1, 2025, establishing a licensing regime for issuers of fiat-referenced
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/fasset-hits-1b-valuation-after-68m-sbi.html"&gt;stablecoins&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;In April 2026, Anchorpoint was among the first entities to
receive a stablecoin issuer licence from the HKMA. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The regulatory framework is intended to establish
requirements around areas such as reserves, governance and redemption
arrangements.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For financial institutions, that creates a clearer
regulatory environment in which blockchain-based money can be tested for
real-world financial applications.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;HKDAP’s Institutional Rollout&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;HKDAP is currently in its &lt;b&gt;Beta Access phase&lt;/b&gt;, meaning
availability remains limited.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Anchorpoint says selected authorized distributors can
provide access to institutional and corporate users that complete the required
account-opening and KYC processes. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered’s participation expands that distribution
network from the banking side.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The bank said it plans to launch tokenized money-market fund
subscription and settlement use cases with international and local asset
managers in the fourth quarter. It also intends to use HKDAP for intragroup
settlement across its network. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Those initiatives could provide an early test of whether
regulated stablecoins can deliver measurable efficiency improvements for
traditional financial institutions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Stablecoins Meet Tokenized Finance&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Another important part of the story is the connection
between stablecoins and tokenized assets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Tokenized funds, bonds and other financial instruments
require reliable ways to transfer value when transactions settle.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A regulated Hong Kong dollar stablecoin could potentially
serve as the settlement instrument for some of these transactions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Anchorpoint has said it wants HKDAP to support the
settlement and distribution of tokenized real-world assets, while Standard
Chartered has identified tokenized money-market fund transactions as one of its
initial use cases. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This creates a link between two rapidly developing areas of
digital finance: &lt;b&gt;tokenized assets and regulated digital money&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered’s Wider Digital-Asset Strategy&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The HKDAP initiative also fits into Standard Chartered’s
broader work with blockchain and digital-asset infrastructure.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Just days before announcing its HKDAP distribution role,
Standard Chartered said it had completed a live cross-border tokenized-deposit
transaction with HSBC using Swift’s blockchain-based ledger. The transaction
was designed to demonstrate interoperability between regulated bank-issued
tokenized deposits. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;HKDAP is a different model because it is a regulated
stablecoin issued by Anchorpoint rather than a tokenized commercial-bank
deposit.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Still, the developments point toward a similar trend: major
banks are increasingly experimenting with blockchain-based systems for &lt;b&gt;payments,
settlement and the movement of financial value&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The next test for HKDAP will be real-world adoption.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Regulatory approval and banking support provide an important
foundation, but businesses will ultimately determine whether the stablecoin
becomes useful at scale.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered’s distribution role could help by
connecting HKDAP with institutional customers that already operate within the
traditional financial system.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If adoption grows, HKDAP could eventually be used across a
wider ecosystem involving banks, payment providers, asset managers, businesses
and tokenized-asset platforms.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For now, however, the rollout remains focused on controlled
institutional and corporate use.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) has become the &lt;b&gt;first
bank authorized to distribute HKDAP&lt;/b&gt;, the regulated Hong Kong dollar-backed
stablecoin issued by Anchorpoint Financial. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The move gives HKDAP a major connection to traditional
banking infrastructure at a time when Hong Kong is building a regulated market
for stablecoins.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For now, the focus is on &lt;b&gt;fund settlement, treasury
management and cross-border payments&lt;/b&gt;, with additional commercial
applications expected as the rollout progresses. &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The bigger story is the growing connection between regulated
banks and blockchain-based money.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;If HKDAP can move from a controlled institutional rollout
into real-world payments and settlement at scale, Hong Kong could be laying the
groundwork for a new generation of bank-connected digital money — and Standard
Chartered is helping build the rails.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;Sources: Standard Chartered and Anchorpoint Financial.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

cryptocurrency, technology, finance and digital-asset markets. This article is

margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The transfers were first flagged by on-chain investigator ZachXBT.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Ironwood conceals transaction participants and amounts, making the stolen funds significantly harder to trace.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Bitget's CEO has previously said she is "not very optimistic" about fully recovering the stolen funds.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;hr style="background: none 0% 0% / auto repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-style: none; border-width: medium; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; height: 1px; margin: 32px 0px;" /&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Attackers linked to the September 24 Bitget exploit have begun moving stolen funds into Zcash's shielded transaction system, according to on-chain investigator ZachXBT. Approximately &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;2,746 ZEC&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, worth around &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;$3.9 million&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, were reportedly moved into Zcash's &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Ironwood shielded pool&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; in three separate transfers between 08:15 and 08:46 UTC on Wednesday.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The Bitget breach involved multiple asset types, with approximately $387.5 million worth of assets transferred to attacker-controlled addresses, according to Bitget's revised estimate. A wallet identified by Bitget as belonging to the attacker received &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;nearly 18,917 ZEC&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; during the September 24 breach, according to CoinDesk's review of transaction records. The three transfers represent about 15% of the ZEC stolen in the September 24 breach.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What Is Ironwood?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Ironwood is Zcash's newest shielded pool, activated on &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;July 28, 2026&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, as part of the &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;NU6.3 network upgrade&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. It is designed to keep transaction participants and amounts private from public blockchain observers.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The key privacy feature is straightforward: &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;shielded transactions conceal transaction participants and amounts from public &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/netherlands-box-3-tax-plan-how-proposed.html"&gt;blockchain &lt;/a&gt;observers.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; Investigators can observe funds entering the pool, but once ZEC is shielded, the direct on-chain link between the sender and recipient becomes much harder to establish. If funds are later withdrawn to a transparent public address, the timing, amount and surrounding transaction activity may still provide investigators with clues, even though the direct transaction link is obscured.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Why This Matters for Recovery Efforts&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The movement of funds into a shielded pool could complicate Bitget's efforts to trace and recover the assets. Bitget CEO &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Gracy Chen&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; has said she is "not very optimistic" about fully recovering the stolen funds, pointing to the limited percentage of funds frozen after the 2025 Bybit hack as a reference point.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Funds linked to the attack have also moved through other routes that can make tracing more complex. CoinDesk previously reported that a wallet linked to the Bitget attacker swapped about &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;$6.3 million&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; worth of ether into bitcoin through &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/cz-hints-crypto-pump-is-coming-soon.html"&gt;THORChain&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. CoinDesk's analysis identified 27 completed swaps involving about 2,390 ETH and 75.2 BTC. Those swaps remained visible on public blockchains because the incoming ether and outgoing bitcoin transactions could be observed. Moving funds into &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/trader-turns-105m-aster-long-into-65.html"&gt;Zcash's&lt;/a&gt; shielded pool provides substantially less transaction-level visibility.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;The North Korea Connection&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Blockchain analytics firm &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Elliptic&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; assessed the Bitget exploit as highly likely to be linked to the &lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;, citing infrastructure overlaps, laundering patterns and connections with previous DPRK-attributed attacks. The assessment remains an attribution by a blockchain analytics firm rather than a publicly confirmed determination by law enforcement.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What Happens Next&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The funds entering Ironwood are not necessarily unrecoverable. If the attackers later move the funds to a centralized exchange or another identifiable service, investigators and exchanges may have additional opportunities to trace the funds and, where possible, seek their freezing or recovery.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Bitget has published attacker addresses and a recovery-tracking process, while exchanges, blockchain analytics firms and law enforcement can continue monitoring publicly visible addresses and transaction activity.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What is the Ironwood shielded pool?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Ironwood is Zcash's newest shielded pool, activated on July 28, 2026, as part of the NU6.3 network upgrade. It is designed to keep transaction participants and amounts private from public blockchain observers.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;How much was moved?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Approximately 2,746 ZEC, worth around $3.9 million, entered Ironwood in three transfers between 08:15 and 08:46 UTC on Wednesday, according to CoinDesk's review of transaction records.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Why does this make funds harder to trace?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Once ZEC enters a shielded pool, the direct public on-chain link between the sender and recipient becomes obscured. Investigators can observe relevant entry and exit activity, but the shielded transactions themselves do not expose the same transaction details available on a transparent address.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Is North Korea behind the attack?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic has assessed the exploit as highly likely to be linked to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). That remains an attributed analytical assessment rather than a publicly confirmed law-enforcement determination.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Bottom line:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; Attackers linked to the Bitget exploit have reportedly moved approximately 2,746 ZEC, worth about $3.9 million, into Zcash's Ironwood shielded pool. The amount represents roughly 15% of the ZEC stolen in the September 24 breach, while the shielded pool makes direct transaction tracing substantially more difficult. The development adds another layer of complexity to efforts to track and potentially recover the assets.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-1063445581464181190.post-4788887498254074942</id>
    <blogger:type>POST</blogger:type>
    <blogger:status>LIVE</blogger:status>
    <author>
      <name>Top Crypto News</name>
      <blogger:type>BLOGGER</blogger:type>
    </author>
    <title>New York Warns AI Is Making Investment Scams Harder to Spot as Losses Top $8 Billion</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

  &lt;div style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhfhE9HWDCx-nASAaA8SON04ZAsi1TKOm2ZO_npnGsy_QSh1nmqoZrH-5heOpCR6Vmy0iC4L8HCxhBU3HaxBUBzX1KGCXvjkjMv4Vq7NYrjwJ9TgjElE_9B23ViKaWfBrmo-NjXhueujUo33wx52Sb8cqF7l-cKnTT9BkomaMUoqeWuwcviwbuTBHTTolTC/s1672/new-york-ai-investment-scam-warning-8-billion-losses.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="AI-powered investment scam warning as reported investment losses top $8 billion" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhfhE9HWDCx-nASAaA8SON04ZAsi1TKOm2ZO_npnGsy_QSh1nmqoZrH-5heOpCR6Vmy0iC4L8HCxhBU3HaxBUBzX1KGCXvjkjMv4Vq7NYrjwJ9TgjElE_9B23ViKaWfBrmo-NjXhueujUo33wx52Sb8cqF7l-cKnTT9BkomaMUoqeWuwcviwbuTBHTTolTC/w400-h225/new-york-ai-investment-scam-warning-8-billion-losses.webp.png" title="New York Warns About AI-Powered Investment Scams" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;By CoinAINews Staff |&amp;nbsp;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Artificial intelligence is giving investment scammers a powerful new tool: the ability to make fake opportunities look remarkably real.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;New York officials are warning consumers to be especially careful as fraudsters increasingly use AI-generated voices, faces, videos and messages to make investment pitches appear legitimate.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The warning comes as reported investment-scam losses continue to climb. According to the New York Department of State’s Division of Consumer Protection, &lt;strong&gt;144,041 consumers reported losing more than $8 billion to investment scams in 2025&lt;/strong&gt;, a 38% increase from the previous year. The median reported loss was &lt;strong&gt;$10,560&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But there is an important distinction behind that headline number.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The $8 billion figure is not the amount lost specifically to AI investment scams.&lt;/strong&gt; It represents reported investment-scam losses overall. New York’s warning highlights AI as a technology that scammers are increasingly using to make those schemes more convincing.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That difference matters — particularly when reporting on a fast-moving problem where AI and financial fraud are increasingly overlapping.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;AI Is Giving Old Investment Scams a New Face&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Investment scams are hardly new.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For years, fraudsters have relied on fake trading platforms, unrealistic returns, celebrity endorsements, unsolicited messages and promises of easy money.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;AI does not change the basic objective.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It changes how convincing the story can look.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A scammer can use artificial intelligence to create realistic-looking promotional material, generate messages, produce fake images or imitate voices. A fraudulent investment opportunity that once looked obviously suspicious can now be wrapped in a much more professional presentation.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;New York officials specifically warned consumers about increasingly sophisticated investment scams involving AI-generated content and deceptive investment opportunities.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For someone encountering an investment promotion on social media, that creates a difficult problem.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The advertisement may look professional.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The video may look genuine.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The voice may sound familiar.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And the website may appear to show a functioning trading account.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;None of those things, by themselves, prove that the investment is legitimate.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The $8 Billion Figure Needs Context&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The numbers behind the warning are significant, but they need to be presented accurately.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;New York officials cited Federal Trade Commission data showing that &lt;strong&gt;144,041 consumers reported more than $8 billion in investment-scam losses during 2025&lt;/strong&gt;. The figure was 38% higher than the previous year, while the median reported loss reached $10,560.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Those are reported losses across investment scams generally.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They are &lt;strong&gt;not an official tally of losses caused by AI&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That distinction is important because there is currently no basis for saying that AI itself was responsible for all, or even most, of the $8 billion figure.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The better way to understand the warning is that investment fraud is already generating enormous losses, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/could-state-actor-use-ai-to-51-attack.html"&gt;while AI&lt;/a&gt; is giving scammers additional tools to make those schemes easier to create and harder for victims to recognize.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The FBI is separately tracking AI-related fraud. Its 2025 Internet Crime Report recorded &lt;strong&gt;22,364 complaints containing an AI-related component and nearly $893 million in reported losses&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is a separate figure from the broader investment-scam total.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Keeping those numbers separate is essential.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;How AI Can Make a Fake Investment Look Real&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;One of AI's biggest advantages for scammers is speed.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Creating convincing content used to require more time, money and technical skill.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Generative AI can reduce that barrier.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Fraudsters can potentially produce personalized messages, advertisements, fake identities and other promotional material at scale.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Voice cloning creates another layer of deception.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A scammer can potentially imitate a recognizable voice and use it to make an investment opportunity sound as though it has been endorsed by someone the victim trusts.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Deepfake videos can take the idea even further.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A public figure may appear to promote an investment opportunity even though the person never made the endorsement.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The FBI has warned that criminals are using generative AI to create fake social profiles, synthetic content and other material that can support fraudulent schemes.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That makes one traditional assumption increasingly unreliable:&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;If it looks professional, it must be legitimate.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That assumption is exactly what scammers want victims to make.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Fake Trading Platforms Add Another Layer&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;AI-generated advertising is only part of the problem.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Some investment scams direct victims toward websites that resemble legitimate brokerage or cryptocurrency platforms.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Once a victim creates an account, the website may display what appears to be a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/hong-kong-sfc-flags-star-bridge-capital.html"&gt;real portfolio&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The numbers can go up.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The account can show trading activity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The platform may even appear to generate profits.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the displayed balance may have nothing to do with real investments.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The victim may initially be allowed to withdraw a small amount. That can create confidence in the platform and encourage a much larger deposit.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;When the victim later tries to withdraw the larger balance, the problems begin.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The platform may demand additional taxes, processing fees or verification payments before the money can supposedly be released.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Those demands can continue until the victim realizes that the investment account was never what it appeared to be.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Social Media Is a Major Entry Point&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Investment scams can reach potential victims through many of the platforms people use every day.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That includes social media, text messages, email, online advertisements and dating applications.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A scam may begin with something that does not look like an investment pitch at all.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It could be a message about cryptocurrency.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A financial tip.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A supposed trading opportunity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Or simply a conversation with someone who claims to have discovered a reliable way to make money.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The investment pitch can come later.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That gradual approach can be more effective because the scammer is not immediately asking for a large payment.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Instead, the goal is to build trust first.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Once trust has been established, the victim may be more willing to accept financial advice from the person behind the account.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Relationship Investment Trap&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Some investment fraud schemes combine financial deception with relationship-building.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A scammer may spend weeks communicating with a target before introducing an investment opportunity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The person might claim to have experience trading cryptocurrency, stocks or foreign exchange.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They may show screenshots of supposed profits.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They may recommend a particular platform.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Eventually, the victim is encouraged to make a deposit.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;AI can potentially make these interactions more convincing by helping criminals create realistic profiles and generate personalized messages.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the underlying warning sign remains the same:&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An investment opportunity introduced through an unexpected online relationship should be independently verified before any money is sent.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Trusting the person is not enough.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The investment itself needs to be verified.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why Guaranteed Returns Should Raise Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Some of the most effective scam pitches are also some of the simplest.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They promise unusually high returns with little or no risk.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That combination should immediately raise questions.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Legitimate investments involve risk.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Even professional investors cannot guarantee that a market will move in a particular direction.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Scammers often present the opposite picture.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They describe large profits as predictable.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They may claim that an opportunity is almost risk-free.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They may also create a sense of urgency by telling victims that they must invest immediately before the opportunity disappears.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That pressure is another warning sign.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A legitimate investment decision generally does not need to be made because someone on social media says the clock is running out.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Investors Should Verify Before Sending Money&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The best response to a suspicious investment opportunity is to slow down.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Before transferring money, investors should independently verify the company and the person promoting it.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Start with the regulator.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If an investment firm claims to be licensed, search for the company through the regulator's official website rather than clicking the verification link provided by the promoter.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Check the exact legal entity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Check the licence number.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Check the jurisdiction.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And check whether the licence actually covers the service being offered.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A company may be legitimately registered somewhere while still not being authorized to provide a particular service in another jurisdiction.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That distinction can matter enormously if something goes wrong.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Don't Trust a Celebrity Video Just Because It Looks Real&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;AI has created another problem for investors: fake endorsements.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A video can show a recognizable person apparently discussing an investment.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The voice can sound right.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The face can look right.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The words can even match the person's usual speaking style.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But none of that proves the video is authentic.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Investors should verify endorsements through the public figure's official channels or through independent reporting.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The same rule applies to screenshots of news stories, investment returns and account balances.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A screenshot is evidence of what someone wants you to see.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It is not independent verification.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;AI Changes the Presentation, Not the Core Warning Signs&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Despite all the new technology, many of the most important warning signs have remained unchanged.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Promises of guaranteed returns are suspicious.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Pressure to invest immediately is suspicious.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Requests to move a conversation into private messaging deserve caution.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Unusual payment methods are another warning sign.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And a platform that cannot clearly explain which legal entity operates it and which regulator oversees it should raise questions.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;AI may make the presentation more sophisticated.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the underlying objective remains simple:&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Convince the victim to trust the opportunity and send money.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That means consumers do not necessarily need to become experts in artificial intelligence to protect themselves.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They need to become better at &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/bitcoin-knocks-on-50-week-moving.html"&gt;verification&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why the Problem Goes Beyond New York&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The latest warning comes from New York, but the underlying problem is much larger.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Online investment promotions can cross borders almost instantly.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A scammer operating in one country can target consumers in another through a social-media advertisement or messaging platform.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The same AI tools can be used to produce content for different languages, markets and audiences.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That makes AI-assisted investment fraud an international concern.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Cryptocurrency can add another layer of risk because transactions can move quickly and may be difficult to reverse once funds reach a scammer-controlled wallet.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That does not mean cryptocurrency itself is a scam.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It means investors need to be particularly careful when an online investment opportunity combines cryptocurrency payments with anonymous promoters, guaranteed returns or pressure to act quickly.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Second Scam Can Come After the First&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;There is another risk that victims should know about.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;After losing money, a victim may be contacted by someone claiming to be able to recover it.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The person may present themselves as a lawyer, investigator, regulator or recovery specialist.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;They may promise to retrieve the lost funds in exchange for an upfront payment.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That can become another scam.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Anyone who has already lost money should be extremely cautious about unsolicited offers promising guaranteed recovery.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Instead, victims should contact their financial institution, preserve transaction records and report the original fraud to the appropriate authorities.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Sending additional money to an unknown recovery service can make the situation worse.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Bigger Picture&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The rise of AI does not mean every sophisticated investment advertisement is fake.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Nor does the existence of AI-generated scams mean consumers should ignore legitimate digital investment opportunities.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The lesson is simpler.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The quality of the presentation is no longer enough to establish credibility.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A polished website can be fake.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A professional-looking advertisement can be fake.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A convincing video can be fake.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A familiar voice can be fake.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And a trading dashboard showing profits can be completely fabricated.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Independent verification therefore becomes more important as AI tools become more accessible.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;New York officials are warning consumers that artificial intelligence is helping scammers make investment fraud more sophisticated and convincing.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;At the same time, reported investment-scam losses topped &lt;strong&gt;$8 billion in 2025&lt;/strong&gt;, according to data cited by New York officials. That figure represents investment scams broadly — &lt;strong&gt;not AI-specific losses&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Separately, the FBI reported nearly &lt;strong&gt;$893 million in losses from complaints containing an AI-related component&lt;/strong&gt; in 2025, showing that AI-assisted fraud is already a measurable problem of its own.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For investors, the message is straightforward.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Don't trust an investment because a video looks real.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Don't trust a platform because its dashboard shows profits.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Don't trust a promoter because the person sounds familiar.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And don't send money simply because someone says the opportunity will disappear tomorrow.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;AI may be changing the face of investment fraud, but independent verification remains one of the strongest defenses investors have.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Disclaimer:&lt;/strong&gt; This article is for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment or financial advice. The more-than-$8 billion figure refers to reported investment-scam losses in 2025 cited by New York officials and is not an AI-specific loss figure. AI-related fraud figures from the FBI are reported separately. Readers should independently verify investment opportunities, companies and regulatory information before sending money.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;/article&gt;</content>

Let's break it down.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What Is Superintelligence?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Superintelligence is AI that outperforms the smartest humans in virtually every field — scientific creativity, general wisdom, social skills, everything &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.technologyreview.com/2016/09/20/70131/no-the-experts-dont-think-superintelligent-ai-is-a-threat-to-humanity/?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;There are three stages:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;1. Narrow AI (ANI):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; AI that's excellent at one task. Siri, YouTube recommendations, spam filters. It can't do anything outside its lane.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;2. General AI (AGI):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; AI that's as smart as a human. It can learn, reason, and adapt across different tasks. This doesn't exist yet.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;3. A Personal Agent for Everyone&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Zuckerberg's vision is simple: everyone gets an &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/vivek-ramaswamys-strive-buys-1107.html"&gt;AI assistant&lt;/a&gt; that understands their goals and works for them 24/7. Not a chatbot. An agent. Something that can actually &lt;/span&gt;&lt;em&gt;do&lt;/em&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; things.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Meta's Muse agent is the first step. Since launching on September 8, it's crossed 2.5 million downloads and hit No. 1 on the US App Store &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://enterpriseai.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry/metas-muse-tops-the-charts-on-us-app-store-on-partnership-expansion/134461446?utm_source=Mailer&amp;amp;utm_medium=ET_batch&amp;amp;utm_campaign=etenterpriseai_news_2026-09-25&amp;amp;dt=2026-09-25" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. It can shop on your behalf, book travel, manage emails, and even make phone calls.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Muse integrates with Shopify, PayPal, Expedia, Instacart, Walmart, Best Buy, and more &lt;/span&gt;&lt;a href="https://enterpriseai.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry/metas-muse-tops-the-charts-on-us-app-store-on-partnership-expansion/134461446?utm_source=Mailer&amp;amp;utm_medium=ET_batch&amp;amp;utm_campaign=etenterpriseai_news_2026-09-25&amp;amp;dt=2026-09-25" rel="noreferrer" style="border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); border-image: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px 3px; color: #3964fe; cursor: default; margin-left: -3px; margin-right: -3px; position: relative; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);" target="_blank"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;. You tell it what you need. It handles the rest.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;2. Tools for Businesses of All Sizes&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Meta Enterprise Platform gives businesses access to the same AI infrastructure Meta uses internally.
