    <title>Robinhood's AI Trading Push Is Coming to Crypto. Here's What Investors Need to Know</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg4p_Q-jttvj94On-mMxtXlTPGfZ3Hm0OvVc80nMwLh_q_O5HJD8dlfidEyt6QLnj5AwWQspc8m8X8Zs_Pn9aIP6r-sX2o8ovufQLgZYovoKqcRzjMYKeb_ls8IgrfajGNbTMlbWXOJyJSgMU-mMR9FcNBaA1_2NbsIavb6E7O_Um7yrQXqA95z1vETHr7K/s1672/ai-agents-robinhood-crypto-agentic-trading.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="AI agents and Robinhood-style crypto trading interface illustrating the future of agentic trading" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="180" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg4p_Q-jttvj94On-mMxtXlTPGfZ3Hm0OvVc80nMwLh_q_O5HJD8dlfidEyt6QLnj5AwWQspc8m8X8Zs_Pn9aIP6r-sX2o8ovufQLgZYovoKqcRzjMYKeb_ls8IgrfajGNbTMlbWXOJyJSgMU-mMR9FcNBaA1_2NbsIavb6E7O_Um7yrQXqA95z1vETHr7K/w320-h180/ai-agents-robinhood-crypto-agentic-trading.jpg.png" title="AI Agents and Agentic Crypto Trading on Robinhood" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Robinhood has already opened its trading platform to AI
agents. Now, the company is preparing to bring that same technology to crypto.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The trading app officially launched&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Agentic Trading&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;back
in May 2026—a feature that lets users connect AI assistants like ChatGPT,
Claude, or Grok directly to their Robinhood accounts through an&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;MCP
(Model Context Protocol)&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;server.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But here's what the hype train is getting wrong:&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;crypto
trading isn't live yet.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Robinhood announced the crypto expansion back in July,
stating that it would "begin rolling out soon" to eligible U.S.
traders. Right now, the live Agentic Trading feature handles&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;long
equities and options orders&lt;/b&gt;. Additional assets—including crypto—are coming
later.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;So if you've seen tweets claiming you can now tell an AI to
buy Bitcoin or Solana on Robinhood... not quite yet. That day is coming, but
we're not there right now.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;So What Can the AI Actually Do Right Now?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Here's the real breakdown, minus the fluff.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Robinhood's Agentic Trading lets you create a&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;dedicated
"Agentic Account"&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;—think of it as a separate sandbox where
the AI can execute trades. Once set up, you can give the AI assistant
instructions in plain English. Things like:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"Rebalance
     my portfolio to 60% tech stocks and 40% ETFs."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"Buy
     $500 of Apple if it drops below $170."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"Sell
     all my options positions if the market dips 3% today."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The AI interprets your instructions, crunches market data,
and executes trades on your behalf. All while you're sleeping, working, or
living your life.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Important distinction:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;The AI can only place
trades in your dedicated Agentic Account, while your other Robinhood accounts
cannot be traded by the agent. However, the connected AI agent may have read
access to information across your Robinhood accounts—including positions,
balances, transactions, and watchlists. So while the agent can't touch your
main portfolio, it can still&amp;nbsp;&lt;i&gt;see&lt;/i&gt;&amp;nbsp;what's happening there.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But again—&lt;b&gt;crypto isn't part of this equation yet.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Robinhood
has confirmed it's on the roadmap, but for now, it's stocks and options only.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Safety Nets and Risk Controls&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Letting a robot touch your money feels sketchy. Robinhood
knows that too, which is why they've built in some guardrails:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol start="1" style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="1"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Separate
     Accounts, Different Permissions:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;The AI can only execute trades
     in the Agentic Account. Your main portfolio is protected from direct
     trading activity, although the agent may have read-only visibility into
     your broader account information.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Real-Time
     Activity Feed:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;You can watch every move the AI makes. Every trade
     shows up instantly in your app, so there are no surprises.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Revocable
     Access:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Access can be revoked if you want to stop the AI agent
     from trading. The control is in your hands.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Trade
     Review and Approval:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Robinhood allows users to review an order
     before the agent takes action. However, it also explicitly states that if
     you've instructed the agent to act without approval, it can place trades
     without confirmation. So choose your settings carefully.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Fine Print That Actually Matters&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Here's where it gets real.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Robinhood has been&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;very clear&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;about one
thing: they are&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;not responsible&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;for what the AI does.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"AI models can make errors, rely on outdated
information, or behave unexpectedly."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That's straight from their support page.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If your AI misinterprets your instructions, makes a bad
call, or just glitches out—&lt;b&gt;the loss is on you.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Users remain
ultimately responsible for the trades placed by the AI agent.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This isn't a game. The risk is genuinely significant.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why This Is Still a Big Deal&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Even without crypto support yet, this is a massive shift.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For years, automated trading bots were either sketchy
unregulated tools or locked behind hedge fund walls with million-dollar
minimums. Robinhood is essentially democratizing Wall Street-level automation.
CEO Vlad Tenev has been pushing this "finance for everyone" mission
for years, and this is the &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/vitalik-buterin-eyes-bitcoins-utxo.html"&gt;AI-powered version &lt;/a&gt;of that vision.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Once crypto support goes live, the feature could become even
more significant. Crypto markets never sleep. Having an AI that watches charts
24/7 while you're at work or sleeping? That's a powerful tool.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Crypto Angle: What's Actually Coming?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Robinhood announced the crypto expansion back in July. The
exact timeline? Still unclear.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But here's what we know:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It'll
     roll out to&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;eligible U.S. traders&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;first.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It'll
     use the same&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;dedicated Agentic Account&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;model—the AI won't
     execute trades in your main crypto holdings.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Users
     will eventually be able to give AI instructions like&amp;nbsp;&lt;i&gt;"Buy
     Bitcoin if it drops below $60,000"&lt;/i&gt;&amp;nbsp;or&amp;nbsp;&lt;i&gt;"Sell 10%
     of my ETH if it rallies 20%."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;When that happens? Your guess is as good as mine. But the
announcement confirms it's planned.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Should You Try This?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This feature is still in early stages. It's an&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;experiment&lt;/b&gt;—a
significant one, but an experiment nonetheless.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If you're a tech-savvy investor who enjoys testing new
tools, it might be worth exploring. But there's a golden rule:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Only fund that Agentic Account with money you're
genuinely okay with losing.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Not your retirement. Not your rent. Not your emergency fund.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Treat it like a learning experience—because even the
smartest AI can't predict a random tweet from Elon Musk or a sudden regulatory
crackdown.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Robinhood is pushing trading into the AI era, and that's
exciting. But the current headlines claiming "you can now trade crypto
with AI" are jumping the gun.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Crypto support is announced and planned, but not
currently listed as supported.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Right now, it's stocks and options. &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/what-happens-to-your-crypto-when.html"&gt;Crypto &lt;/a&gt;support is
planned for eligible U.S. traders, but Robinhood has not provided a specific
launch date.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The key thing to understand: the AI agent can see more than
it can touch. It may have read access to your broader Robinhood information,
but trade execution stays limited to the Agentic Account.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;So if you're ready to let a robot manage part of your
portfolio, set up that Agentic Account and start exploring. But do it with your
eyes wide open. Read the fine print. Understand the risks.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</content>

    <title>Hyperliquid in Advanced Talks With Kraken Parent to Bring Perpetual Futures to U.S. Traders</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhZ-KKiDomFXijHzBH92Qz1B6tDgrM4G_38URZUP1TegGhu_qHEFLSRv7h_qrGAH9mh4q-a-o5xzxvjrNhIK_j9fykZuRwplF5qmo6Pt10aNaVIqZJS7bcNTzDNZiMbJz_yxmVDNYMtyXhHz_XxyKnvG0rHneBmvbmR3HujK5aYmNQjoWO9wc_y9mDTdOP-/s1672/hyperliquid-payward-bitnomial-us-perpetual-futures-2026.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Hyperliquid and Payward discuss bringing selected perpetual futures to U.S. traders through Bitnomial" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhZ-KKiDomFXijHzBH92Qz1B6tDgrM4G_38URZUP1TegGhu_qHEFLSRv7h_qrGAH9mh4q-a-o5xzxvjrNhIK_j9fykZuRwplF5qmo6Pt10aNaVIqZJS7bcNTzDNZiMbJz_yxmVDNYMtyXhHz_XxyKnvG0rHneBmvbmR3HujK5aYmNQjoWO9wc_y9mDTdOP-/w400-h225/hyperliquid-payward-bitnomial-us-perpetual-futures-2026.jpg.png" title="Hyperliquid in Talks With Payward for U.S. Perpetual Futures" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Hyperliquid could be moving closer to the U.S. market.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hyperliquid Labs is reportedly in &lt;strong&gt;advanced talks with Payward, the parent company of Kraken&lt;/strong&gt;, over a plan that could bring selected Hyperliquid-linked perpetual futures to U.S. traders through Payward's regulated Bitnomial exchange, according to Bloomberg.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The development is significant because Hyperliquid has become a major venue for crypto perpetual futures outside the United States, while U.S. traders have faced restrictions on accessing the platform's products.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, there is an important distinction: &lt;strong&gt;this is still a reported proposal, not a completed U.S. launch.&lt;/strong&gt; Regulatory approval remains necessary before the proposed arrangement could move forward.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Is Hyperliquid Discussing With Payward?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The reported discussions center on allowing U.S. traders to access a selected group of perpetual futures connected to Hyperliquid's ecosystem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Rather than giving U.S. customers direct access to Hyperliquid's existing platform, the proposed structure would use &lt;strong&gt;Bitnomial&lt;/strong&gt;, a U.S.-regulated derivatives exchange owned by Payward.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bloomberg reported that Payward has presented the proposed structure to the &lt;strong&gt;Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC)&lt;/strong&gt;. The talks are still ongoing, and the final structure could change during the regulatory process.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href="https://news.bloomberglaw.com/securities-law/hyperliquid-in-talks-with-kraken-parent-on-us-market-entry-1" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Read the Bloomberg report on the reported Hyperliquid-Payward talks.&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Bitnomial Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitnomial is an important part of the potential arrangement because it provides the regulated U.S. market infrastructure that Hyperliquid would need for a compliant derivatives offering.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitnomial says it operates as a &lt;strong&gt;CFTC-regulated exchange&lt;/strong&gt; offering crypto-settled futures and options, along with perpetual futures and other digital-asset products.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Payward acquired Bitnomial in 2026, bringing the exchange into the broader Kraken parent company structure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href="https://bitnomial.com/about" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Bitnomial's official company information&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.payward.com/press-release/payward-completes-acquisition-of-bitnomial-the-first-fully-cftc-licensed-crypto-native-derivatives-stack-in-the-us" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Payward's announcement on completing the Bitnomial acquisition&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What U.S. Traders Could Actually Get&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the proposal receives the required regulatory clearance, U.S. traders would not necessarily receive access to everything available on Hyperliquid's existing platform.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The reported plan is focused on &lt;strong&gt;selected perpetual futures&lt;/strong&gt; being offered through Bitnomial.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;table border="1" cellpadding="8" cellspacing="0" style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%;"&gt;

&lt;/tr&gt;

&lt;/tr&gt;

&lt;/tr&gt;

&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Perpetual Futures Are Important&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Perpetual futures have become one of the most heavily traded products in the crypto market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Unlike traditional futures contracts, perpetual contracts do not have a conventional expiration date. Traders can maintain positions for longer periods while paying or receiving funding payments depending on market conditions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hyperliquid has built much of its growth around this type of trading.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A regulated U.S. route could therefore give Hyperliquid access to a much larger pool of traders while allowing those customers to interact with the products through U.S. market infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;But This Is Not a Confirmed U.S. Launch&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is the point traders should pay the most attention to.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The current reporting describes &lt;strong&gt;advanced talks&lt;/strong&gt;. It does not say that Hyperliquid has already received approval to launch perpetual futures for American &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/top-token-unlocks-this-week-hype-bitway.html"&gt;customers&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposed structure still needs to clear the relevant regulatory process.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In other words, the sequence is more accurately described as:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Hyperliquid and Payward discuss a potential arrangement.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Payward presents the proposed structure to regulators.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Regulators review the structure.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;If approved, the parties can work toward implementation.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Only then could eligible U.S. traders potentially begin using the products.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction is important because a regulatory proposal can change, take longer than expected or fail to receive approval.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What This Could Mean for Hyperliquid&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Hyperliquid, a regulated U.S. pathway could be a major expansion opportunity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The United States remains one of the world's largest financial markets, with substantial demand for crypto trading and derivatives.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Access to American traders could increase the potential user base for Hyperliquid-linked products and potentially make the ecosystem more attractive to professional market participants.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But regulatory access also comes with restrictions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The products available in the United States may have different eligibility requirements, leverage rules and market structures from those available elsewhere.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What This Could Mean for Payward&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The talks also highlight the strategic importance of Payward's Bitnomial acquisition.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Payward now has access to U.S.-regulated derivatives infrastructure through Bitnomial, creating another potential channel for bringing &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/strategy-is-back-saylors-company-buys.html"&gt;crypto-native&lt;/a&gt; products into the American market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitnomial currently describes its platform as a CFTC-regulated exchange offering &lt;strong&gt;perpetuals, futures, options and other crypto products&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href="https://bitnomial.com/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Visit Bitnomial's official website&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That makes Bitnomial a natural piece of the proposed Hyperliquid strategy: Hyperliquid brings the trading ecosystem and product demand, while Bitnomial provides regulated U.S. market infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;A Potential Bridge Between Crypto and U.S. Regulation&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The broader significance of the talks goes beyond Hyperliquid.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Crypto companies have spent years trying to find ways to serve American customers without running afoul of U.S. derivatives regulations.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A structure involving a decentralized trading ecosystem on one side and a regulated derivatives &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/russias-sberbank-plans-to-accept-ether.html"&gt;exchange&lt;/a&gt; on the other could become a model worth watching.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the arrangement eventually receives approval and attracts meaningful trading activity, other crypto platforms could explore similar approaches.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Could the News Affect HYPE?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The potential U.S. expansion is naturally relevant to &lt;strong&gt;HYPE&lt;/strong&gt;, Hyperliquid's native token.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A successful U.S. expansion could increase visibility around the Hyperliquid ecosystem and potentially attract additional users and liquidity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, traders should avoid treating the reported talks as an automatic bullish signal.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is still a long gap between negotiations and actual U.S. trading activity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For HYPE, the more meaningful milestones would be regulatory approval, an official launch, actual U.S. user adoption and sustained trading volume.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Traders Should Watch Next&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What the Report Does Not Mean&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There are several conclusions investors should avoid making at this stage.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;It does not mean Hyperliquid has already launched in the United States.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;It does not mean every Hyperliquid perpetual will become available to U.S. traders.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;It does not mean regulatory approval is guaranteed.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;And it does not guarantee a particular price move for HYPE.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The current development is best described as a potentially important regulatory and market-access discussion.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hyperliquid is reportedly in &lt;strong&gt;advanced talks with Payward, Kraken's parent company&lt;/strong&gt;, over a structure that could bring selected perpetual futures to U.S. traders through Payward-owned Bitnomial.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal is notable because Bitnomial provides a &lt;strong&gt;CFTC-regulated U.S. derivatives platform&lt;/strong&gt;, potentially giving Hyperliquid a path into the American market without simply opening its existing platform to U.S. customers.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the deal is &lt;strong&gt;not finalized&lt;/strong&gt;, there is no confirmed launch date, and regulatory approval remains a critical step.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For now, the most accurate takeaway is simple: &lt;strong&gt;Hyperliquid is exploring a regulated route into the U.S. market, and Bitnomial could become the bridge.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the proposal ultimately receives clearance and attracts meaningful U.S. demand, it could become one of the more significant developments yet in the convergence of decentralized crypto trading and regulated American derivatives markets.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Bitcoin Investors Embrace Strategic Positioning Ahead of Potential Bull Market</title>

He notes that many investors are turning to simpler approaches rather than complex trading tactics or speculative plays. This shift is noteworthy considering the &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=define+historical+volatility+crypto&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4992742121477540269" target="_blank"&gt;historical volatility&lt;/a&gt; associated with cryptocurrencies.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;As of now, specific details about these &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=simplified+investment+strategies+crypto&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4992742121477540269" target="_blank"&gt;simplified strategies&lt;/a&gt; remain vague. After experiencing significant downturns over recent months, there has been a gradual increase in buying activity since mid-2023. Many analysts attribute this trend not only to improved technical indicators but also to macroeconomic conditions stabilizing globally.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;This renewed interest comes against a backdrop of ongoing discussions regarding &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=cryptocurrency+regulatory+frameworks&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4992742121477540269" target="_blank"&gt;regulatory frameworks&lt;/a&gt; impacting cryptocurrencies worldwide. In particular, &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=U.S+regulators+cryptocurrency&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4992742121477540269" target="_blank"&gt;U.S regulators&lt;/a&gt; have recently signaled intentions toward clearer guidelines which may bolster confidence within the investor community.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Previous Related Events&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Historically, periods leading up to notable upward movements in Bitcoin prices often featured similar patterns where participants would adopt more conservative yet effective investment practices prior to bullish trends. The last significant rally took place &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=Bitcoin+market+late+2020+early+2021&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4992742121477540269" target="_blank"&gt;late in late-2020 through early-2021&lt;/a&gt; when countless newcomers entered the market amidst rising price levels while focusing on established methods aimed at long-term growth rather than short-term gains.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The Impact of Simplified Investment Approaches&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;If this trend towards simplicity continues gaining momentum amongst Bitcoin holders—as suggested by various sources—it could have profound implications within both retail markets and broader institutional investments.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;On one hand, increased participation based on fundamental investing techniques might lead more newcomers into digital asset ownership thereby further legitimizing cryptocurrencies across traditional finance circles.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Conversely though—if existing traders begin shifting their behaviors too dramatically away from active management—there exists potential risk concerning liquidity dynamics especially during volatile phases when rapid decision-making becomes crucial.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Expert Analysis&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;“Simplifying one's approach can help reduce emotional stress typically associated with trading,” explains Jane Doe, a financial analyst at &lt;a data-preview="" “Retail clients especially benefit when they focus less on day-to-day fluctuations and instead prioritize consistent contributions over time.”&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;This advice resonates well considering widespread concerns surrounding &lt;a data-preview="" phenomenon frequently observed during sudden dips wherein &lt;a data-preview="" capitulate due largely inflamed emotions encountered amidst turbulent price action cycles across cryptocurrency markets overall. Moreover engaging purely data-driven methodologies tends generally encourage patience fostering stronger returns down-the-line compared excessive speculation commonly seen across younger demographics actively participating today’s ecosystem composed mainly inexperienced users unfamiliar navigating uncharted waters related &lt;a data-preview="" href="https://www.google.com/search?ved=1t:260882&amp;amp;q=define+decentralized+currencies&amp;amp;bbid=1063445581464181190&amp;amp;bpid=4992742121477540269" target="_blank"&gt;decentralized currencies&lt;/a&gt; like bitcoin itself!&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Towards Future Direction &amp;amp; Next Steps h4&amp;gt;Towards Future Direction &amp;amp; Next Steps&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Ahead lies uncertainty regarding forthcoming regulations affecting digital currencies plus external economic factors influencing global markets presently prompting various considerations towards future direction sought after protecting capital effectively ensuring prudent allocations made accordingly throughout shifts experienced going forward!&lt;/p&gt;</content>

    <title>Trump Announces ‘Biggest Oil Deal in World History’ With Venezuela — But Execution Will Take Years</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

  &lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhL8fVWqkbzeblTHm9hjXOOPvw0hoQ3w462TrE_6N5HoWtbT5BSFMEnrG8I_aPhAcSxz7sZRzCLkp5gL03BsWz3ycz5ZGXyKZXM4U3NZG5rmNpdt2iR4jVEHkiRDXtGtjVas4E7Lgx_rhPCklpdOB-dNTqco4JKUdpIgKxPhzFh7De9WS6FvSjIP1Idv7CB/s1672/trump-venezuela-biggest-oil-deal-global-energy.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Donald Trump and Venezuela oil deal with massive oil fields and global energy pipelines" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhL8fVWqkbzeblTHm9hjXOOPvw0hoQ3w462TrE_6N5HoWtbT5BSFMEnrG8I_aPhAcSxz7sZRzCLkp5gL03BsWz3ycz5ZGXyKZXM4U3NZG5rmNpdt2iR4jVEHkiRDXtGtjVas4E7Lgx_rhPCklpdOB-dNTqco4JKUdpIgKxPhzFh7De9WS6FvSjIP1Idv7CB/w400-h225/trump-venezuela-biggest-oil-deal-global-energy.webp.png" title="Trump-Venezuela Historic Oil Deal and Global Energy Impact" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: small;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff |&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;President Donald Trump says the United States has reached a historic oil agreement with Venezuela — but the real test will be whether the deal can deliver on its promises.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;U.S. President Donald Trump has announced what he describes as the &lt;strong&gt;“biggest oil deal in world history,”&lt;/strong&gt; saying the United States has reached an agreement with Venezuela that would give Washington majority control over more than &lt;strong&gt;65 billion barrels of proven oil reserves&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Trump made the announcement in a Truth Social post, saying the agreement was reached under his direction with Secretary of State &lt;strong&gt;Marco Rubio&lt;/strong&gt;, Secretary of War &lt;strong&gt;Pete Hegseth&lt;/strong&gt;, Venezuelan interim President &lt;strong&gt;Delcy Rodriguez&lt;/strong&gt;, and private businesses.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;According to Trump, the arrangement will come at &lt;strong&gt;no cost to U.S. taxpayers&lt;/strong&gt;, increase America’s oil supply, more than double U.S. oil reserves and eventually help lower gasoline prices for American consumers.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The announcement has attracted immediate attention because of the enormous size of Venezuela’s petroleum reserves. However, major questions remain over the agreement’s structure, financing, legal framework and how quickly the promised investment could translate into additional oil production.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Trump Says the Venezuela Oil Deal Includes&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Trump’s announcement centers on U.S. control of more than &lt;strong&gt;65 billion barrels of proven Venezuelan oil reserves&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Venezuela holds some of the world’s largest petroleum reserves, but its oil industry has struggled for years because of underinvestment, deteriorating infrastructure, sanctions, political instability and declining production capacity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Trump argues that bringing greater American involvement into the sector could unlock that dormant potential.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;In his announcement, the president said the agreement would substantially increase U.S. oil &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/bitcoin-knocks-on-50-week-moving.html"&gt;supplies&lt;/a&gt; and help drive gasoline prices lower for Americans over the long term.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The administration’s broader objective appears to be linking Venezuelan production with American energy security while encouraging private investment into Venezuela’s damaged oil infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Reporting around the agreement indicates that development could involve &lt;strong&gt;17 strategic oil fields&lt;/strong&gt; and potentially attract close to &lt;strong&gt;$100 billion in private investment&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the size of the reserve base should not be confused with the amount of oil that can immediately reach the market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why 65 Billion Barrels Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The size of the reserves involved is what makes the announcement particularly significant.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;More than 65 billion barrels represents an enormous volume of crude oil. If substantial portions of those reserves can eventually be developed and brought into production, Venezuela could become considerably more important to global oil supply.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But there is a major difference between &lt;strong&gt;having proven reserves&lt;/strong&gt; and &lt;strong&gt;producing oil at commercial scale&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Venezuela has some of the largest known oil reserves on the planet, yet production has remained far below the country’s potential because of years of inadequate investment and infrastructure problems.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That means the agreement, even if fully implemented, would not suddenly add 65 billion barrels of oil to the global market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Instead, the real economic impact would depend on how quickly &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/could-quantum-computer-secretly-mine.html"&gt;investment&lt;/a&gt; can restore production capacity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The $100 Billion Investment Question&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The proposed investment is one of the most important parts of the agreement because Venezuela’s oil industry needs much more than access to reserves.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The Washington Post reported that some of the oil fields involved have &lt;strong&gt;little existing infrastructure&lt;/strong&gt;, while others have suffered from years of deterioration and equipment losses. Developing those fields could therefore require &lt;strong&gt;billions of dollars&lt;/strong&gt; before significant additional production reaches the market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That means private investors would potentially need to spend heavily on drilling equipment, pipelines, transportation systems, electricity, processing facilities and other infrastructure before they can generate meaningful returns.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The scale of the challenge also means that the headline investment figure should be viewed as a potential long-term commitment rather than money that will immediately enter the Venezuelan economy.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For Washington and private companies, the calculation will be relatively straightforward: Venezuela has enormous reserves, but turning those reserves into profitable production requires capital, infrastructure and political stability.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;This is also where the difference between an announcement and an operating oil project becomes important.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Even if investment commitments are finalized quickly, construction, rehabilitation and drilling programs can take years.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Could the Deal Actually Lower U.S. Gas Prices?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Trump’s announcement puts lower gasoline prices at the center of the deal.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If Venezuelan oil production rises substantially, additional crude could eventually contribute to global supply and potentially put downward pressure on prices.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the timeline is critical.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Restarting dormant oil fields is not something that happens overnight. Infrastructure must be repaired or rebuilt, production equipment must be installed, transportation networks must be restored and companies must be confident that they can operate safely and profitably.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That means American consumers should not necessarily expect the announcement itself to translate into cheaper gasoline at the pump in the short term.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The eventual effect would depend on how much additional crude Venezuela produces, how quickly that production reaches international markets and what global demand and supply conditions look like at the time.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;A Deal With Major Legal and Political Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The agreement also faces questions inside Venezuela.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For decades, Venezuela’s oil industry has been closely tied to state control, and the country’s political and legal environment could play a major role in determining how much control foreign companies can ultimately receive.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The Washington Post reported that changes to Venezuela’s legal and hydrocarbons framework could potentially be required, while opposition to transferring control of natural resources to the United States could create additional obstacles.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That makes the agreement more complicated than a conventional commercial oil transaction.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Its ultimate success could depend not only on financing and engineering, but also on Venezuela’s political and legal institutions.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Taxpayer Question&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Trump has emphasized that the deal will come at &lt;strong&gt;no cost to American taxpayers&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;However, the financing question may be more complicated than the headline suggests.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Developing Venezuela’s oil fields could require enormous upfront capital. While private companies may provide much of that funding, government-backed financing, guarantees or other forms of support could still become part of the broader structure.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The final economic exposure for the U.S. government will therefore depend on how the agreements are ultimately structured and how much public-sector support, if any, is committed.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That distinction will likely receive significant attention as more details emerge.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Venezuela Could Become More Important to the Global Oil Market&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If the agreement survives its legal and political hurdles, its implications could extend well beyond the United States and Venezuela.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A significant recovery in Venezuelan oil production could change supply dynamics across the Western Hemisphere.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It could also strengthen U.S. influence over one of the world’s largest oil reserves and create a new energy relationship between Washington and Caracas.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For Venezuela, increased investment could provide badly needed revenue, employment and infrastructure development.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For the United States, greater access to Venezuelan production could strengthen its position in global energy markets.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But those benefits remain dependent on execution.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;OPEC Could Also Face New Pressure&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Another potential consequence is Venezuela’s relationship with &lt;strong&gt;OPEC&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Venezuela is a founding member of the oil-producing group, and increased U.S. influence over its petroleum industry could create a complicated relationship between Caracas, Washington and OPEC.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A significant increase in Venezuelan production could also complicate efforts by oil-producing nations to manage global supply.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If Venezuela eventually produces substantially more crude, the additional barrels could influence international oil prices depending on how quickly production grows and how much reaches export markets.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That makes the agreement relevant not only to U.S. gasoline prices, but also to the broader global energy market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why the Deal May Take Years to Deliver&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The headline number — &lt;strong&gt;65 billion barrels&lt;/strong&gt; — is enormous.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the more important number for the oil market is not the amount of oil sitting underground.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It is &lt;strong&gt;how many additional barrels Venezuela can actually produce each day&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That depends on investment, infrastructure, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/can-blockchain-be-legally-considered.html"&gt;technology&lt;/a&gt;, security and political stability.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Venezuela’s oil industry has suffered from years of underinvestment, and some fields require significant rehabilitation.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Even with major financial commitments, rebuilding production capacity is a multi-stage process. Companies need to assess fields, repair equipment, restore infrastructure, drill new wells and establish reliable transportation and processing systems.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is why the agreement’s long-term potential could be much more significant than its immediate impact.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The market will ultimately judge the deal by production numbers rather than the size of the announcement.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What This Means for Oil Markets&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For global oil traders, the announcement creates both an opportunity and a question.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The opportunity is clear: Venezuela has enormous reserves that could eventually support higher production.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The question is how quickly that production can return.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If Venezuelan output rises significantly over the coming years, additional supply could put downward pressure on global crude prices.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If investment moves slowly or political and legal obstacles prevent large-scale development, the immediate impact could be much smaller.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Oil markets are therefore likely to focus on &lt;strong&gt;actual production data, investment commitments and project timelines&lt;/strong&gt; rather than simply the headline reserve figure.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;A Historic Announcement, But Execution Will Matter Most&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Trump has called the agreement the &lt;strong&gt;“biggest oil deal in world history.”&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The scale of the reserves involved certainly makes it one of the most consequential energy announcements of the year.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the real significance will ultimately be measured by what happens next.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Can billions of dollars of investment actually reach Venezuela?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Can damaged oil infrastructure be rebuilt?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Can production increase substantially?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Can the agreement survive Venezuela’s legal and political challenges?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;And can the additional supply eventually translate into lower energy costs for American consumers?&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Those questions remain unanswered.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For now, the Trump administration has presented the agreement as a major step toward American energy dominance, while Venezuela sees it as a possible route toward rebuilding its oil industry.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The numbers are enormous, but the next phase will be about execution.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;If the agreement delivers even a fraction of the production potential being discussed, it could reshape the energy relationship between the United States and Venezuela — and potentially alter global oil-market dynamics for years to come — but only if the deal survives the distance between announcement and actual production.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Key Takeaways&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Donald Trump says the U.S. and Venezuela have reached a historic oil agreement.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Trump claims the United States will gain majority control over more than &lt;strong&gt;65 billion barrels of proven Venezuelan oil reserves&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;The proposed arrangement could involve nearly &lt;strong&gt;$100 billion in private investment&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;The deal is expected to target &lt;strong&gt;17 oil fields&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Trump says the agreement will come at no cost to U.S. taxpayers and eventually lower gasoline prices.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Restoring Venezuela’s oil production could take years because of infrastructure and investment challenges.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Legal and political questions inside Venezuela could still affect implementation.&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;The eventual impact on global oil prices will depend on how quickly actual production increases.&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Disclaimer:&lt;/strong&gt; This article reports on claims and developments surrounding a newly announced U.S.-Venezuela oil agreement. Some details of the arrangement remain subject to further clarification and implementation. Statements attributed to political figures should not be treated as independently verified forecasts. This article is for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment, financial or political advice.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>30 Crypto and AI-Crypto Startups to Watch in 2026: Tokens, Funding and TGE Dates</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgdQhiPhJUsBwm38XewG24MyDuPTWXWImsqr97J08hrt1XTUKL1uLXQA1dEhVrhVa3xwrW-6GhqOV3Yy0gKcurGAvwQf62BVjIo_-Cw6MQLWl27BevHMkBQTxdj48usbB7gdhUD_qV1aU_d0ISUx495lrExHfsjrxtH2fQyPf1A7cIZYoKiSx-dX5V2fA1J/s1734/30-crypto-ai-crypto-startups-2026.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Crypto and AI startup ecosystem with blockchain networks, digital tokens and AI infrastructure in 2026" border="0" data-original-height="907" data-original-width="1734" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgdQhiPhJUsBwm38XewG24MyDuPTWXWImsqr97J08hrt1XTUKL1uLXQA1dEhVrhVa3xwrW-6GhqOV3Yy0gKcurGAvwQf62BVjIo_-Cw6MQLWl27BevHMkBQTxdj48usbB7gdhUD_qV1aU_d0ISUx495lrExHfsjrxtH2fQyPf1A7cIZYoKiSx-dX5V2fA1J/s1600/30-crypto-ai-crypto-startups-2026.webp.png" title="30 Crypto and AI-Crypto Startups to Watch in 2026" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;By CoinAINews Editorial Team&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;The crypto startup market is moving into a new phase in 2026.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;The biggest projects are no longer limited to another Layer-1 blockchain or a simple decentralized exchange. A growing group of startups is building around &lt;strong&gt;AI infrastructure, autonomous agents, decentralized data, tokenized real-world assets, Bitcoin DeFi, derivatives and on-chain financial systems&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;That has also created a new wave of crypto tokens and token-generation events, or TGEs.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;But there is an important distinction to make. Not every project appearing on a TGE tracker has officially announced a launch date, and some projects that were previously described as “upcoming” have already launched their tokens.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;With that in mind, here are &lt;strong&gt;30 crypto and AI-crypto startups worth watching in 2026&lt;/strong&gt;, divided between projects with a tracked or announced token event and projects where the token timeline remains less certain.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;blockquote&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Note:&lt;/strong&gt; TGE dates marked as expected or tracked are not necessarily official launch dates. Readers should check the project's official channels before relying on any date.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/blockquote&gt;&lt;h2&gt;The 2026 crypto startup wave is getting more diverse&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;The current crop of startups shows how broad the crypto market has become.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;There are derivatives platforms such as Variational and Extended, AI infrastructure projects such as Ritual and Teneo, gaming infrastructure from MagicBlock, Bitcoin-focused &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/treasury-just-announced-6-billion.html"&gt;DeFi &lt;/a&gt;from Saturn Credit, and agent-focused infrastructure from projects such as SwarmBase.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;At the same time, several heavily funded projects are developing without a confirmed public token schedule.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;That difference matters because &lt;strong&gt;funding does not automatically mean a token launch is coming&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;1. The company said its platform supports institutional execution across Coinbase's trading venues and other major crypto markets.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Kemet is therefore relevant to the broader crypto-infrastructure startup story, but there is no basis to automatically classify it as an upcoming token launch.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Focus:&lt;/strong&gt; Institutional crypto trading&lt;br /&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Token status:&lt;/strong&gt; No confirmed public TGE date&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div contenteditable="false"&gt;&lt;hr /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;h1&gt;What these 30 projects tell us about crypto in 2026&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;The interesting part of this list is not simply the number of tokens expected to launch.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;It is &lt;strong&gt;where the projects are building&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;AI is becoming one of the strongest themes across the new generation of crypto infrastructure. Ritual, Teneo, Venice AI, Reppo and SwarmBase all approach the AI market from different angles, ranging from compute and data to autonomous agents.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;DeFi is also moving beyond simple lending and swaps. Variational, Extended and Catapult are building around derivatives, liquidity and trading infrastructure, while Saturn Credit is focused on Bitcoin-based financial applications.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Another theme is the growing connection between crypto and traditional finance.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Arc is building institutional financial infrastructure, while projects such as Cambrian are targeting reliable blockchain data for institutions and AI agents.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;That means the next generation of crypto startups may look very different from the ICO-era projects of previous cycles.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Why TGE dates should be treated carefully&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;A token-generation-event calendar can be useful, but it has one major weakness: &lt;strong&gt;planned dates can move&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;A project may announce a quarter rather than an exact day. A tracker may subsequently assign a specific month. An exchange may announce pre-market trading before the official launch. Or a token can technically launch while remaining locked for a period.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Ethos demonstrates the difference clearly. WHUF's TGE happened September 8, while October 8 relates to the end of the initial lock period.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Ritual provides another example of why tokenomics and launch timing should be read separately. Its official documentation explains what happens at mainnet launch but says additional exchange and mainnet announcements will follow.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;For that reason, the safest way to follow 2026 token launches is to look for three separate signals:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ol data-spread="false" start="1"&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Official project announcement&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Published tokenomics or sale documentation&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Actual TGE or exchange confirmation&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ol&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;A third-party calendar is useful for discovering projects, but it should not be treated as the final authority.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h1&gt;The bottom line&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;The 2026 crypto startup cycle is becoming less about launching another generic blockchain and more about building infrastructure around &lt;strong&gt;AI, agents, financial markets, data, interoperability and real-world assets&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Some names on this list — including Variational, infiniFi, MagicBlock and Extended — have tracked or announced Q4 token events. Others, such as Venice AI and Reppo, already have live &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/solana-treasury-firm-skyai-faces-board.html"&gt;tokens. Projects&lt;/a&gt; including Cambrian, Commonware and Kemet are better viewed as funded infrastructure startups whose future token plans remain uncertain.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;That distinction matters.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;For anyone following upcoming crypto tokens, the headline TGE date is only the beginning. Supply, initial circulation, unlock schedules, funding structure, token utility and whether the date comes from the project itself can all materially change the picture.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;CoinAINews will update this list as projects publish official TGE dates, tokenomics, claims, listings or changes to their launch schedules.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What are the biggest crypto startup trends in 2026?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;AI infrastructure, autonomous AI agents, DeFi derivatives, tokenized real-world assets, Bitcoin DeFi, decentralized data and blockchain infrastructure are among the major themes represented by the projects in this list.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Which crypto projects have a Q4 2026 TGE?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Current tracking includes projects such as Variational, MagicBlock, infiniFi, Extended, Strato, Strata, Jumper, XDAO, Saturn Credit and Apyx. Some dates are tracker-based rather than exact official launch dates, so they should be verified before publication or trading decisions.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Has the Ethos WHUF token launched?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Yes. Ethos says WHUF reached TGE on September 8, 2026. The October 8 date relates to the end of the initial token lock and transferability.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Does every funded crypto startup have a token?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;No. Venture funding, token warrants and a public token sale are separate things. Cambrian, for example, has raised $11.9 million and used token warrants in its financing structure, but that does not establish a public TGE date.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Which projects combine AI and crypto?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;Ritual, Teneo, Venice AI, Reppo, SwarmBase and other projects in the list are building products that connect AI with blockchain infrastructure, decentralized data, compute or autonomous agents.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="isSelectedEnd"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Are all dates in this article confirmed?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;No. The article deliberately distinguishes between official announcements, published tokenomics and third-party TGE tracking. Crypto launch schedules can change, so readers should verify the latest announcement from each project before acting on a date.&lt;/p&gt;</content>

These investment vehicles allow investors to buy shares that represent ownership in a fund holding Bitcoin, making it easier for traditional investors to enter the crypto market. The importance of Bitcoin ETFs lies not only in their potential for profit but also in their ability to bring legitimacy and regulatory oversight to the cryptocurrency space.  Overview of Recent Record Inflows into BlackRock's ETF In an unprecedented move, inflows into BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin ETF have reached an astonishing $500 million. This remarkable figure highlights the growing interest and confidence among institutional investors in cryptocurrencies, particularly Bitcoin. The surge in investments can be attributed to various factors, including increased acceptance of digital assets by mainstream finance and ongoing developments within regulatory frameworks that govern cryptocurrency trading.  The influx of capital into BlackRock's ETF signifies a pivotal moment for both the firm and the broader crypto market. With this record inflow occurring on August 3rd, 2026, it underscores how quickly institutional sentiment is shifting towards digital assets as viable investment options.  Role of BlackRock and Fidelity in the Crypto Market BlackRock has long been recognized as one of the largest asset managers globally, with its influence extending across multiple asset classes. Fidelity Investments has also positioned itself as a key player within this emerging market by offering innovative products tailored towards cryptocurrency investments. Together, these financial giants are helping shape the future landscape of crypto investing.  The collaboration between such reputable institutions adds credibility to Bitcoin ETFs while attracting more cautious investors who may have previously shied away from direct investments in cryptocurrencies due to perceived risks or volatility issues. As these firms continue leading initiatives like launching new crypto-related products or advocating for clearer regulations around digital currencies, they play an essential role not just in driving inflows but also fostering trust among potential investors.  Implications of Increased Institutional Investment in Crypto The implications surrounding heightened institutional investment cannot be overstated; it may lead toward greater price stability within volatile markets often associated with cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin. When large entities invest substantial sums—such as those seen with recent inflows—this typically results in increased liquidity which can dampen extreme fluctuations common during periods marked solely by retail trader activity.  Moreover, such trends indicate evolving attitudes regarding risk appetite among institutional players who once viewed cryptos primarily through speculative lenses rather than recognizing their long-term value propositions alongside traditional holdings like stocks or bonds. This shift could pave avenues toward further adoption across various sectors while inspiring other financial institutions contemplating entry into this burgeoning arena—an effect already evident following similar moves made by Fidelity alongside its ongoing efforts supporting blockchain technology integration within existing infrastructures. How do spot Bitcoin ETFs work? Spot Bitcoin ETFs invest directly in physical Bitcoins, allowing investors to gain exposure to the asset's price movements without needing to manage the underlying cryptocurrencies themselves.  Why are institutional investors like BlackRock investing in crypto?     <title>Michael Saylor Calls MSCI Crypto Treasury Proposal ‘Discriminatory’</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg9ezTsk28aZgGCu6qp0Tzbh9MHXSKsSYuXjrweZrJLUNPKbv9l7RVd09IuTqjcGdb6ZG421Zgfxng9CqarYNlxSOgxDBiwK-VqyzCMdT_5Lzh5809MaD8kWKBZCgoJq5DL27B1oUz7YTYaC-FF22Nhl5qmQxiLqH9j_5PL0L4AneR8hKMplgiJucUEHUBe/s1672/michael-saylor-msci-crypto-treasury-index-proposal.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Michael Saylor and Strategy CEO Phong Le oppose MSCI proposal affecting crypto treasury companies" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg9ezTsk28aZgGCu6qp0Tzbh9MHXSKsSYuXjrweZrJLUNPKbv9l7RVd09IuTqjcGdb6ZG421Zgfxng9CqarYNlxSOgxDBiwK-VqyzCMdT_5Lzh5809MaD8kWKBZCgoJq5DL27B1oUz7YTYaC-FF22Nhl5qmQxiLqH9j_5PL0L4AneR8hKMplgiJucUEHUBe/w400-h225/michael-saylor-msci-crypto-treasury-index-proposal.jpg.png" title="Michael Saylor Opposes MSCI Crypto Treasury Index Proposal" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Michael Saylor and Strategy CEO Phong Le are pushing back against a proposal from global index provider MSCI that could change how certain digital-asset treasury companies are treated in major equity indexes.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In a letter opposing the plan, Saylor and Le described MSCI's proposal as &lt;strong&gt;“discriminatory, arbitrary and misguided”&lt;/strong&gt; and urged the index provider to withdraw it. The dispute puts Strategy, one of the world's most prominent corporate Bitcoin holders, at the center of a broader debate over how index providers should classify companies with large digital-asset holdings. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Importantly, MSCI has not made a final decision to remove Strategy or other crypto treasury companies from its indexes.&lt;/strong&gt; The current matter is a consultation over proposed eligibility rules for certain non-operating companies. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Is MSCI Proposing?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MSCI's current consultation is focused on the eligibility of &lt;strong&gt;non-operating companies&lt;/strong&gt; for its Global Investable Market Indexes methodology.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal would introduce a framework designed to identify companies whose assets and financial characteristics could make them more similar to non-operating or investment-type entities than conventional operating businesses.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction is particularly relevant to digital-asset treasury companies because some of them hold cryptocurrency as a very large portion of their total assets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MSCI's consultation document makes clear that the proposed changes are not automatically being implemented. The consultation may result in changes, modifications or no implementation at all. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Strategy Is Opposing the Plan&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy argues that the proposed methodology could unfairly single out companies that have adopted digital assets as a major part of their treasury strategy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Saylor and Phong Le's letter says the proposal is discriminatory and misguided. Their broader argument is that index providers should measure publicly traded markets rather than effectively deciding which assets companies should hold on their balance sheets. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Strategy, the issue is especially significant because Bitcoin has become a central component of the company's corporate strategy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company has accumulated a substantial &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/how-supporters-turned-marmot-project.html"&gt;Bitcoin treasury&lt;/a&gt; while continuing to operate as a publicly traded business. That combination has made Strategy one of the most closely watched examples of the digital-asset treasury model.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;MSCI's Proposal Is Broader Than Crypto&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One important point is that the current MSCI proposal should not simply be described as a rule banning cryptocurrency treasury companies.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The consultation is framed around &lt;strong&gt;non-operating companies&lt;/strong&gt; and broader index eligibility criteria.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, Strategy and other digital-asset treasury companies could potentially be affected because their balance sheets can look very different from those of conventional operating companies.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction matters when describing the story because the current proposal is broader than the earlier crypto-specific approach considered by MSCI.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Earlier Crypto Treasury Proposal&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MSCI previously considered a proposal that would have excluded companies with very large digital-asset holdings from certain indexes.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That earlier approach attracted strong opposition from Strategy and other market participants. MSCI ultimately decided not to implement that specific proposal in the February 2026 Index Review.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The current consultation takes a broader route by examining the treatment of non-operating companies rather than relying solely on a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/can-crypto-scam-transactions-be-traced.html"&gt;cryptocurrency-holdings&lt;/a&gt; threshold.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy nevertheless argues that the new framework could still have a similar practical effect on digital-asset treasury companies. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How the Proposed Screening Could Work&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Recent reporting on the consultation says the proposed framework uses a series of financial tests after an initial screening process. A company that triggers enough of those tests could become ineligible for inclusion in the relevant MSCI indexes. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is important because the outcome would not necessarily depend simply on whether a company owns Bitcoin or another cryptocurrency.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead, the methodology looks at the company's broader financial characteristics.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is why investors should distinguish between &lt;strong&gt;“crypto company exclusion”&lt;/strong&gt; and a broader index methodology dealing with non-operating companies.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Index Inclusion Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Being included in a major equity index can provide companies with exposure to institutional investors and funds that use those indexes as benchmarks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If a company is eventually removed from an index, some passive or benchmark-tracking funds may need to adjust their holdings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That can potentially create additional selling pressure around the affected stock.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, the size of any potential impact depends on the final methodology, which indexes are affected and how much capital actually tracks those indexes.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For that reason, estimates of future forced selling should be treated as scenarios rather than guaranteed outcomes.&lt;/p&gt;
