&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MSCI's consultation is now the key next step.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to MSCI's official announcement, market participants can submit feedback through &lt;strong&gt;September 30, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. MSCI expects to announce the results of the consultation on or before &lt;strong&gt;October 16, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. Any resulting changes are proposed to be implemented as part of the November 2026 Index Review. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That timeline means the current headlines should not be interpreted as an immediate index removal.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is still time for the methodology to be changed following feedback from Strategy and other market participants.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Debate Matters Beyond Strategy&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The dispute could have implications for the wider &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/binance-launches-physically-settled.html"&gt;digital-asset&lt;/a&gt; treasury industry.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Over the past few years, more publicly traded companies have adopted Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies as part of their treasury strategies.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;These companies are creating a new category of public-market exposure: investors can buy shares in an operating company while also gaining exposure to a balance sheet heavily influenced by digital assets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If index providers begin applying stricter rules to such companies, the consequences could extend beyond a single stock.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Institutional investors may have to reconsider how these businesses fit into traditional equity benchmarks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Strategy's Argument About Index Neutrality&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At the heart of Strategy's opposition is the question of index neutrality.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company argues that an index provider should reflect the market rather than determine which corporate treasury strategies are acceptable.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy's position is that digital assets should be treated as legitimate corporate assets and that companies should not lose index eligibility simply because they have chosen to allocate a large portion of their balance sheet to them.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MSCI's framework, meanwhile, is based on its assessment of whether certain companies fit the characteristics required for inclusion in its investable-market indexes.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The disagreement therefore involves both cryptocurrency and a much broader question about how modern public companies should be classified.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Investors Should Watch&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For investors following MSTR and other digital-asset treasury stocks, several developments are worth watching over the coming weeks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;MSCI consultation feedback:&lt;/strong&gt; Whether Strategy's objections lead to changes in the proposed methodology.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Final MSCI decision:&lt;/strong&gt; Whether the proposed framework is adopted, modified or rejected.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Index eligibility:&lt;/strong&gt; Which companies, if any, would actually be affected.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Institutional exposure:&lt;/strong&gt; Whether passive and benchmark-linked funds would need to adjust their positions.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Market reaction:&lt;/strong&gt; How MSTR and other affected treasury stocks respond to further MSCI developments.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Could This Affect MSTR?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Potentially, but the impact cannot be known with certainty at this stage.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If Strategy were eventually removed from relevant indexes, funds tracking those indexes could have to reduce their exposure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That could create additional demand or supply effects around MSTR depending on the size of the affected funds.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But because MSCI has not finalized the proposal, investors should not treat potential index-related selling as a confirmed event.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The more immediate development is the consultation itself and Strategy's attempt to persuade MSCI to change course.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bigger Picture for Bitcoin Treasury Companies&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The MSCI dispute highlights how quickly the relationship between cryptocurrency and traditional capital markets has changed.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin was once largely outside the conventional equity-index ecosystem. Today, publicly traded companies can build enormous digital-asset treasuries and become important vehicles for institutional investors seeking indirect crypto exposure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That evolution creates questions that traditional financial infrastructure was not originally designed to answer.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Should a company with a large Bitcoin treasury be treated like a conventional operating company?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Or should its balance-sheet structure result in different index treatment?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Strategy and MSCI currently have very different answers to that question.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What did Michael Saylor and Phong Le say about MSCI?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Saylor and Le opposed MSCI's proposal and characterized it as discriminatory, arbitrary and misguided. They urged MSCI to withdraw the proposed approach. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is MSCI removing Strategy from its indexes?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Not yet. MSCI is currently consulting on proposed eligibility changes. No final exclusion decision has been announced. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;When will MSCI make a decision?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MSCI says it will accept feedback through September 30, 2026 and expects to announce consultation results on or before October 16, 2026. Proposed changes could then be implemented as part of the November 2026 Index Review. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does the MSCI proposal target only crypto companies?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. The current consultation is framed around the eligibility of non-operating companies more broadly. However, Strategy argues that digital-asset treasury companies could be disproportionately affected.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Why does index inclusion matter to Strategy?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Major indexes are used as benchmarks by institutional and passive investment funds. If a company were eventually removed, some funds tracking affected indexes could need to adjust their holdings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Has MSCI considered crypto-specific exclusion rules before?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. MSCI previously considered a more direct approach involving companies with substantial digital-asset holdings. That earlier proposal was not implemented in the February 2026 Index Review. The current consultation uses a broader non-operating-company framework. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Michael Saylor and Phong Le have drawn a clear line in the sand against MSCI's latest index proposal, calling it &lt;strong&gt;“discriminatory” and “misguided.”&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the current situation is still a consultation, not a finalized exclusion.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;MSCI is considering broader rules for non-operating companies, and the outcome could determine how Strategy and other digital-asset treasury businesses are treated in major global equity indexes.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For investors, the next major dates are &lt;strong&gt;September 30&lt;/strong&gt;, when consultation feedback closes, and &lt;strong&gt;October 16&lt;/strong&gt;, when MSCI expects to announce its results. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Until then, the most accurate description is simple: &lt;strong&gt;Strategy is fighting a proposed MSCI methodology change, but no final index exclusion has been decided.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Disclaimer: This article is for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment or financial advice. MSCI's consultation and methodology may change, and investors should review official company and index-provider disclosures before making investment decisions.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Revolut Data Breach: Hacker Launches Website to Advertise Stolen Customer Data and Demands $3 Million Ransom</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;h1&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEitGfocDz-pXmGHCdA_IkYMUX6yGZD6tFw7uwjbW5mpQwDIXZS5tZsqlVSP71Ey9R-ygog1fJohjoFhTpGYN9w0AmbN8e68HlwcUSu53QvWyuaG9FwS94u63Po4uI5xG0fZn7grlEmdg5uTKHSRumS0hWm3gDvvCXs1-bSQU8kAwN60kCB9bMBZDCVwEsRY/s1672/revolut-data-breach-hacker-ransom-stolen-customer-data.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Revolut data breach hacker ransom demand and stolen customer data" border="0" data-original-height="940" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEitGfocDz-pXmGHCdA_IkYMUX6yGZD6tFw7uwjbW5mpQwDIXZS5tZsqlVSP71Ey9R-ygog1fJohjoFhTpGYN9w0AmbN8e68HlwcUSu53QvWyuaG9FwS94u63Po4uI5xG0fZn7grlEmdg5uTKHSRumS0hWm3gDvvCXs1-bSQU8kAwN60kCB9bMBZDCVwEsRY/w640-h360/revolut-data-breach-hacker-ransom-stolen-customer-data.webp.png" title="Revolut Data Breach: Hacker Claims Stolen Customer Data" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;The Revolut data breach has taken a more serious turn after a hacker claiming responsibility for the incident reportedly launched a website advertising stolen customer information and demanding a ransom.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;The latest development has raised fresh concerns for customers whose personal and financial information may have been exposed. According to reports, the group behind the claim is threatening to sell or release additional information unless Revolut pays the demanded ransom.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The alleged attackers have also reportedly contacted or attempted to pressure people whose information was included in the stolen material, adding a potential blackmail element to an already serious data-security incident.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;However, one important detail remains unresolved: &lt;strong&gt;Revolut says it has not received a direct ransom demand from the alleged attackers.&lt;/strong&gt; Reuters reported on September 16 that the company had no direct contact with the individuals or group claiming responsibility, despite reports of a public ransom threat.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;What is happening with the Revolut data breach?&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Revolut confirmed earlier in September that an unauthorized party had obtained sensitive customer information after fraudulent requests were sent using a legitimate government email domain.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Rather than breaking directly into Revolut's core systems, the attackers allegedly exploited a trusted communication process. The fraudulent requests were presented as legitimate government or law-enforcement requests for customer information.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Revolut said it detected the activity, blocked the relevant address and notified the appropriate government agency, law-enforcement authorities, data-protection bodies and financial regulators. The company has also said that its systems and customer funds were not affected.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;That makes the incident particularly notable from a cybersecurity perspective. The reported attack relied on &lt;strong&gt;social engineering and impersonation&lt;/strong&gt;, rather than a conventional intrusion into Revolut's banking infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Hacker reportedly demands $3 million&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;The latest escalation involves an online group identifying itself as &lt;strong&gt;"I Am Not A Villain"&lt;/strong&gt;, according to the Financial Times.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The group has reportedly demanded approximately &lt;strong&gt;$3 million in Monero (XMR)&lt;/strong&gt; and threatened to sell the stolen information to other criminals if the demand is not met.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The reported website allegedly contains a countdown and claims that the information will be sold if the ransom is not paid. The Financial Times reported that the group said the demand amounted to &lt;strong&gt;6,000 XMR&lt;/strong&gt;, equivalent to around $3 million at the time of the report.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The use of Monero is notable because the &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ripple-adds-xrp-and-rlusd-support-to.html"&gt;cryptocurrency &lt;/a&gt;is designed to provide greater transaction privacy than Bitcoin, making it a cryptocurrency frequently associated with privacy-focused transactions.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Still, the ransom demand remains a claim made by the alleged attackers. Revolut has said it has &lt;strong&gt;not been directly contacted by the group&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Around 680 Revolut customers reportedly affected&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;The scale of the breach has also become clearer.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The Financial Times reported that approximately &lt;strong&gt;680 customers&lt;/strong&gt; were affected. The compromised information reportedly included highly sensitive personal and financial records.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Potentially exposed information includes identity documents, account information and transaction histories. Earlier reporting on the incident also indicated that customer notices could include information such as dates of birth, addresses, phone numbers, passports, driving licences, verification selfies, account statements and transaction records.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For some customers, transaction information could include cryptocurrency activity.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;That is especially sensitive because transaction histories can potentially provide criminals with information about a person's financial activity and, in some cases, their involvement with digital assets.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Why crypto users may face additional risks&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;The incident has attracted particular attention from the cryptocurrency community because some of the affected customers were reportedly selected based on their financial activity.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The Financial Times reported that the alleged attackers claimed to have targeted customers with significant cryptocurrency holdings.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;If accurate, this could make the incident more concerning than a conventional identity-data leak.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;A stolen passport or address can potentially be used for identity fraud. But when that information is combined with transaction history, account details and knowledge of &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/circle-ceo-jeremy-allaire-says-crypto.html"&gt;cryptocurrency holdings&lt;/a&gt;, criminals may have a much clearer picture of a potential target.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;That information could potentially be used for phishing, impersonation, financial fraud or highly targeted social-engineering attacks.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;The blackmail claims add another layer&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;The latest reports suggest that the alleged attackers are not simply trying to sell a database.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;People whose information was allegedly included in the stolen records may also face direct pressure.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;This is where the reported incident moves into potential extortion and blackmail. If criminals possess identity documents, contact details or financial records, they may attempt to convince victims that paying money is the only way to prevent the information from being published.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Customers should be cautious about such threats.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The appearance of personal information in material published by an alleged hacker does not automatically prove that every piece of information is genuine. Cybercriminals can mix authentic, outdated or fabricated information into claims designed to increase pressure on victims.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Was Revolut's banking system hacked?&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Based on Revolut's public statements, the incident was &lt;strong&gt;not described as a compromise of its core banking systems&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The company said an unauthorized third party obtained customer information through fraudulent requests originating from a legitimate government agency email domain. Reuters reported that Revolut characterized the event as an external impersonation scam.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;This distinction is important.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;A traditional cyberattack might involve criminals stealing credentials and directly accessing a company's database. In this case, the reported method involved convincing the company to provide information through a process that was supposed to be used for legitimate government requests.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;In other words, the attackers allegedly abused trust rather than simply breaking through a technical firewall.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;What information may have been exposed?&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Reports about the incident indicate that affected customer information could include several categories of sensitive data.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;These may include:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Names and dates of birth&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Postal and email addresses&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Telephone numbers&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Passport and driving-licence information&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Verification selfies&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Account statements&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;IBAN and account information&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Withdrawal records&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Transaction histories&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Cryptocurrency transaction information&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;The exact information exposed may vary from customer to customer. Revolut has reportedly been contacting affected individuals directly with information about the data associated with their particular case.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;What Revolut customers should do now&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Customers who receive an official notification from Revolut should take it seriously, but they should also be careful about follow-up messages.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;A data breach can create an opportunity for criminals to launch convincing phishing campaigns.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For example, a scammer who knows a customer's name, phone number and recent financial activity may be able to make a fraudulent message appear much more credible.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Customers should therefore avoid sharing:&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Passwords&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;One-time authentication codes&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Recovery phrases&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Private keys&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Card security information&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;Anyone claiming to be from Revolut or law enforcement should not be trusted solely because they know information about the customer.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For cryptocurrency users, the most important rule remains unchanged: &lt;strong&gt;never share a wallet seed phrase or private key with anyone.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;The investigation is still developing&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Italian authorities are investigating aspects of the incident, while Revolut has said it is cooperating with law enforcement, regulators and relevant authorities.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The investigation will need to establish how the attackers were able to use a legitimate government communication channel, how the fraudulent requests passed through Revolut's verification process and exactly how much &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-calls-ai.html"&gt;customer information&lt;/a&gt; was disclosed.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;There is also a separate question surrounding the latest ransom website.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Authorities and cybersecurity researchers will need to determine whether the individuals behind the website actually possess all of the information they claim to have obtained and whether any of the material being advertised is genuine.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;What happens next for Revolut?&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;The reported ransom campaign could put additional pressure on Revolut as it works with affected customers and authorities.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The company has already said that it blocked the fraudulent source after detecting the activity and took steps to notify the relevant organizations.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;But the emergence of a public extortion website creates a new challenge.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;If the alleged attackers begin releasing additional customer records, affected individuals could face increased risks of identity theft, phishing and targeted fraud.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For Revolut, the incident also highlights a broader cybersecurity problem facing financial institutions: protecting customer information is not only about defending internal networks. Companies must also ensure that sensitive data cannot be released simply because a request appears to originate from a trusted organization.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;A warning for the wider crypto industry&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;The Revolut incident could have implications beyond one fintech company.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Cryptocurrency platforms, exchanges and financial institutions routinely hold a combination of identity documents, contact information and transaction records.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;That makes them attractive targets for criminals who want to build detailed profiles of potential victims.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The reported Revolut attack shows why organizations need to independently verify sensitive information requests, even when those requests appear to originate from legitimate government or law-enforcement domains.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For customers, the lesson is equally important: a data breach does not necessarily end when the company blocks the original attacker.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The information obtained during an incident can potentially be used later for impersonation, phishing and financial fraud.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Bottom line&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;The latest Revolut development is a significant escalation of an already serious data-security incident.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;A group claiming responsibility has reportedly launched a website advertising stolen customer information and demanded a &lt;strong&gt;$3 million ransom&lt;/strong&gt;, while reports indicate that affected individuals may also be facing direct threats.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;At the same time, Revolut has said it &lt;strong&gt;has not received a direct ransom demand&lt;/strong&gt; from the alleged attackers, meaning the public extortion claims should remain clearly attributed until independently confirmed.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The investigation remains ongoing, and the full scope of the incident has yet to be established.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;For affected customers, the immediate priority is to watch for suspicious communications, verify unexpected requests through official channels and never disclose passwords, authentication codes, private keys or cryptocurrency recovery phrases.&lt;/p&gt;</content>

    <title>How Crypto Agencies Can Offer White-Label PR Distribution Without Building a Publisher Network</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhAZN-04z1hxCigmcSAgUEmOoX6Di01ozn3XfwGfO3OgREk6yyp2FxNsgALHVidr8NrRrdVcUAtKJW1IN93N0aOt8OoM1VkXZaNtfCl39mFpR29jY1RSX3uhs6Ix0vSju13MstuNG2hefUv623B42XaqlNAYBDJz4vUd5nu0czAteiQd_6WJkrSP6IR6g-m/s1734/white-label-pr-distribution-crypto-agencies-2026.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="White-label PR distribution infrastructure for crypto marketing agencies" border="0" data-original-height="907" data-original-width="1734" height="334" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhAZN-04z1hxCigmcSAgUEmOoX6Di01ozn3XfwGfO3OgREk6yyp2FxNsgALHVidr8NrRrdVcUAtKJW1IN93N0aOt8OoM1VkXZaNtfCl39mFpR29jY1RSX3uhs6Ix0vSju13MstuNG2hefUv623B42XaqlNAYBDJz4vUd5nu0czAteiQd_6WJkrSP6IR6g-m/w640-h334/white-label-pr-distribution-crypto-agencies-2026.webp.png" title="White-Label PR Distribution for Crypto Agencies" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Editorial Team&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;“Can you handle the PR distribution too?”&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For a crypto marketing agency, that sounds like a simple client request. In practice, it can open up an entirely different operational problem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;An agency may already handle content, SEO, social media, paid campaigns and community growth. But PR distribution requires something different: access to publishers and a system for getting announcements distributed efficiently.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Building that infrastructure internally is possible, but it takes time. There are domains to identify, publishing relationships to manage, submissions to coordinate and campaigns to track.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is why some agencies are looking at another option: &lt;strong&gt;white-label PR distribution infrastructure&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The basic idea is straightforward. Instead of building and maintaining a publishing network yourself, you use an existing distribution platform in the background while keeping the client relationship, packaging and commercial side of the service within your agency.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href="https://wirero.com/agency/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"&gt;Wirero&lt;/a&gt; is one example of this model. The company positions its platform as backend infrastructure for agencies, reseller platforms and high-volume campaigns rather than as a traditional PR newswire.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Problem Crypto Agencies Run Into With PR Distribution&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Crypto agencies already have plenty on their plates.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A typical client might want help with website content, social media, influencer campaigns, search visibility and community management. Then comes a product launch or &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/crypto-pr-distribution-in-2026-why.html"&gt;partnership &lt;/a&gt;announcement, and the client wants that news distributed beyond its own channels.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is where things become more complicated.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the agency does not have its own publishing network, it has a few choices. It can manually contact websites, negotiate individual placements, work with an external newswire or simply tell the client that distribution is outside its service offering.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;None of those options is necessarily wrong. The problem is that they can create additional work and make the agency dependent on another provider's workflow.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For an agency trying to build a recurring PR service, having access to distribution infrastructure can therefore be useful.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What White-Label PR Distribution Actually Means&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;“White label” sounds more complicated than it is.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In this context, it generally means that the agency sells the distribution service as part of its own offering while another company provides the underlying infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The agency can decide how the service is packaged for clients, what it charges and what distribution scope is included. The infrastructure provider handles the operational side of getting the content distributed.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction is important.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The agency does not necessarily need to own hundreds of publishing websites. It needs a reliable way to access distribution infrastructure without taking on the cost and management burden of building that network itself.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero's agency offering is built around this idea. The company says agencies can use its infrastructure as a backend execution layer while controlling client pricing, packaging and distribution scope. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How the Wirero Model Works for Agencies&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero describes its platform as a multi-domain publishing infrastructure rather than a traditional newswire.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Its current network information says the system contains &lt;strong&gt;1,000 independent domains&lt;/strong&gt; divided into &lt;strong&gt;10 industry-specific networks&lt;/strong&gt;. One of those categories is Blockchain &amp;amp; Cryptocurrency, alongside areas such as fintech, technology, real estate, healthcare and travel. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For an agency, the workflow can be relatively simple:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Access the distribution infrastructure.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Prepare the client's announcement.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Select the relevant industry network or distribution scope.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Launch the campaign through the platform.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Use the available reporting to document distribution for the client.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero says its system supports manual publishing, RSS automation and bulk distribution. Its agency page also says campaigns can be managed from a centralized dashboard. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company currently advertises an average publishing time of under one hour. That is a platform claim rather than a guarantee that every individual campaign will always publish within exactly that timeframe. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Agencies May Prefer Infrastructure Over Building a Network&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Building a publisher network sounds attractive until the operational work becomes clear.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;An agency would need to find suitable websites, establish relationships, understand publishing requirements, keep track of contact points and coordinate campaigns across those properties.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;And the work does not stop after the first campaign. Publisher relationships have to be maintained.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;An infrastructure model moves much of that operational burden away from the agency.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of spending its time asking individual websites whether they can publish a client's announcement, the agency can work through an existing distribution system.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That can be particularly relevant for agencies handling several recurring crypto clients.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Makes the Model Different From Reselling a Traditional Newswire?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is a subtle but important difference between reselling a newswire service and using backend distribution infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;With a traditional newswire, the agency may essentially be purchasing the provider's distribution product and passing it on to the client.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;With a white-label infrastructure model, the agency can build its own service package around the underlying distribution system.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That gives the agency more control over how the service is positioned and priced.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="overflow-x: auto;"&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;Designed for recurring and &lt;br /&gt;higher-volume campaigns&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;

&lt;/table&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Where Wirero Fits Into the Picture&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero's current positioning is quite specific.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company says it is &lt;strong&gt;“distribution infrastructure, not a traditional newswire.”&lt;/strong&gt; Its network page describes a controlled network of 1,000 independent domains organized into industry categories. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means an agency considering the platform should evaluate it as distribution infrastructure rather than assuming it provides the same service as a conventional journalist-focused newswire.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The distinction matters because a distributed press release is not automatically independent media coverage.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A website publishing a distributed announcement does not necessarily mean that its editorial team independently researched or reported the story. Agencies should be transparent with clients about that difference.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How Much Does the Infrastructure Cost?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero currently offers subscription-based access rather than requiring agencies to negotiate every placement individually.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Its current pricing information lists a &lt;strong&gt;Starter plan at $250 per month&lt;/strong&gt; with 100 total placements per month and an &lt;strong&gt;Unlimited plan at $500 per month&lt;/strong&gt; with unlimited distributions and access to all 10 industry networks. The Unlimited plan also advertises publishing across up to 1,000 domains. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For an agency, the significance is less about the headline price and more about the business model.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If an agency already has clients asking for distribution, a predictable infrastructure cost can make it easier to design recurring service packages.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, agencies still need to account for their own staff, content production, client acquisition, taxes, payment processing and other operating costs. A subscription does not automatically translate into profit.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How Agencies Can Package the Service&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is no single pricing model that works for every agency.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One agency might sell individual distribution campaigns. Another may include PR distribution in a monthly marketing retainer. A larger agency could bundle distribution with content creation, SEO, social media and reporting.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For example, an agency could structure its service around:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Per-release campaigns&lt;/strong&gt; for clients with occasional announcements.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Monthly PR packages&lt;/strong&gt; for startups publishing regularly.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Premium communications packages&lt;/strong&gt; combining content creation, distribution and reporting.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;White-label services&lt;/strong&gt; for other agencies that do not have their own distribution infrastructure.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The important point is that the agency should sell a genuine service rather than simply adding a markup to an identical third-party product.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What About Crypto-Specific Distribution?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is where industry targeting becomes useful.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A crypto announcement is not necessarily relevant to every publishing category. A blockchain infrastructure launch, for example, may have a natural connection to technology, fintech and cryptocurrency audiences.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero's network includes a dedicated Blockchain &amp;amp; Cryptocurrency category, alongside other industry networks. Its network page says each category contains 100 independent domains. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For an agency, that makes category selection an important part of campaign planning.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The goal should not simply be to maximize the number of placements. The better question is whether the distribution destinations make sense for the announcement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Agencies Should Check Before Choosing a White-Label Provider&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The white-label label itself should not be enough to make a purchasing decision.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Agencies should ask practical questions before committing to a platform.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;1. How large is the actual network?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Look for clear information about the number of domains and how they are categorized. Wirero currently publishes details about its 1,000-domain network and its 10 industry categories. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;2. How are campaigns distributed?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Understand whether distribution is manual, automated, RSS-driven or a combination of methods.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;3. What reporting is available?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Client reporting matters. Agencies should know whether they can export campaign data and provide clients with a clear record of distribution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;4. What control does the agency have?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Pricing, packaging, distribution scope and campaign management are particularly important for agencies building recurring services.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;5. Is the provider transparent about what it actually offers?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This may be the most important question.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Distribution infrastructure should not be marketed as guaranteed traffic, guaranteed rankings or guaranteed independent media coverage.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;PR Distribution Is Not the Same as SEO&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Agencies should also be careful about how they position this service to clients.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A press release can increase the number of publicly accessible pages containing information about a company. That can contribute to a broader online presence.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But distributing the same announcement across many domains does not mean every placement will carry the same SEO value.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Google's spam policies specifically address link spam and scaled content created primarily to manipulate search rankings. Google also says that links in paid or distributed content may need appropriate qualification when ranking credit is involved. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That makes it safer for agencies to sell distribution for what it actually is: a communications and publishing service.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It can complement SEO, but it should not be presented as a guaranteed shortcut to rankings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Can White-Label PR Distribution Help With AI Search?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;AI-powered search has created another reason for companies to care about the information available on the open web.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Search experiences increasingly combine information from multiple sources when answering questions about companies, products and current events.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That does not mean distributing a press release guarantees inclusion in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or another AI system.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is no reliable way for a PR provider to promise that outcome.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;What agencies can do is help clients maintain a consistent and useful information footprint: accurate company names, clear product descriptions, specific dates, original information and authoritative first-party pages.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;PR distribution can be one part of that broader strategy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Real Advantage for an Agency&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The most interesting part of the white-label model is not really the domain count.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It is the operational change.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of spending time building a publisher network, an agency can focus on what it already knows how to do: win clients, develop campaigns, produce content and manage communications.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The distribution infrastructure sits underneath that service.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero's agency page describes exactly this positioning, saying the platform can act as the backend publishing infrastructure while the agency controls client pricing, packaging and distribution scope. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For agencies that already have recurring demand for PR distribution, that can be a meaningful operational consideration.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is white-label PR distribution?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;White-label PR distribution allows an agency to offer distribution as part of its own service while using another company's infrastructure to handle the underlying publishing operation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does an agency need to build its own publisher network?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. An agency can use an existing distribution infrastructure provider instead of building and maintaining its own network of publishing domains.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;How many domains does Wirero currently advertise?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero currently describes its network as containing 1,000 independent domains organized across 10 industry-specific categories. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does Wirero support crypto agencies?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. Wirero's agency materials specifically identify crypto and forex marketing firms among its use cases, and its network includes a Blockchain &amp;amp; Cryptocurrency category. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can agencies set their own pricing?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero says partners control pricing to clients, packaging and distribution scope. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does Wirero offer RSS automation?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. Wirero lists RSS automation as an integration option for recurring publishing workflows. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does distribution guarantee SEO rankings?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. Distribution does not guarantee search rankings, Google News inclusion, Discover traffic or AI-search citations.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is distributed content the same as independent media coverage?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. A distributed announcement is not automatically the same as an independently reported news story. Agencies should make that distinction clear to clients.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Conclusion&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For a crypto marketing agency, adding PR distribution does not necessarily mean building a 1,000-site publisher network from scratch.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is another route: use existing distribution infrastructure and build the agency's own service around it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is the basic idea behind the white-label model.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Wirero is one example of the approach, offering agencies access to a multi-domain distribution network, industry categories, automation options and backend infrastructure. Its current materials specifically position the service for PR agencies, marketing agencies, crypto and forex firms, SEO agencies and other high-volume users. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Whether that model makes financial sense depends on the agency's client base, campaign volume, pricing and operating costs. But for agencies that repeatedly receive the same question — “Can you handle our PR distribution?” — having distribution infrastructure available in the background can turn that request into another service the agency can actually deliver.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The key is to sell it honestly. Distribution can expand publishing reach and simplify campaign operations. It should not be presented as guaranteed rankings, guaranteed traffic or guaranteed independent media coverage.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For agencies building long-term crypto marketing services in 2026, that distinction matters.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;/article&gt;

    <title>Grant Cardone Adds 350 BTC to Fort Lauderdale Real Estate Deal</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgu56XmAXJpR0CcraHkKsCKAsDZdTq1KA71cdKimlBOjm3MvHZ7XEnCv4rMZp4ZNRFHVfp8poukThZM0xC0DqfuR-C39aGdSLVbu9pZ76SLn-48PLEScvOY4DBx2JacBnBhg_lwVTBGgeZasDYwNMe8s2x4ODnvGZLl99KzibNZNnfsmT7UBshyphenhyphen8xlRQla2/s1672/grant-cardone-350-btc-fort-lauderdale-real-estate.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Grant Cardone Adds 350 Bitcoin to Fort Lauderdale Real Estate Deal" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgu56XmAXJpR0CcraHkKsCKAsDZdTq1KA71cdKimlBOjm3MvHZ7XEnCv4rMZp4ZNRFHVfp8poukThZM0xC0DqfuR-C39aGdSLVbu9pZ76SLn-48PLEScvOY4DBx2JacBnBhg_lwVTBGgeZasDYwNMe8s2x4ODnvGZLl99KzibNZNnfsmT7UBshyphenhyphen8xlRQla2/w400-h225/grant-cardone-350-btc-fort-lauderdale-real-estate.jpg.png" title="Grant Cardone 350 Bitcoin Fort Lauderdale real estate deal" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/b&gt; | &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Grant Cardone is taking his Bitcoin strategy deeper into the
real estate business.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The entrepreneur and real estate investor says &lt;b&gt;Cardone
Capital is adding 350 Bitcoin (BTC) to a Fort Lauderdale, Florida, real estate
deal&lt;/b&gt;, creating a structure that combines multifamily property exposure with
Bitcoin.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone announced the move on X, saying he had been awarded
a Fort Lauderdale property and was adding 350 BTC to the transaction.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone Capital is also promoting what it calls a &lt;b&gt;“Real
Estate Bitcoin Hybrid,”&lt;/b&gt; built around &lt;b&gt;350 units and 350 BTC&lt;/b&gt;. The idea
is straightforward: combine an income-producing real estate asset with exposure
to Bitcoin in a single investment strategy.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That makes the deal notable. Rather than simply holding
Bitcoin as a corporate treasury asset, Cardone is positioning BTC as part of a
broader real estate investment model.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A Different Kind of Real Estate Deal&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;At the center of the announcement is a Fort Lauderdale
property paired with 350 BTC.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone Capital's promotional materials describe the
opportunity as a &lt;b&gt;350-unit property combined with 350 BTC&lt;/b&gt;, with the
property presented as being in a prime location and approximately 30% below
replacement cost.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The approach is different from the traditional corporate
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/arthur-hayes-warns-ai-bubble-could.html"&gt;Bitcoin strategy&lt;/a&gt;, where a company buys BTC and holds it on its balance sheet.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;In Cardone's model, Bitcoin is being presented as another
component of the investment alongside the property itself.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The reasoning behind the structure is easy to understand.
Real estate can potentially generate rental income and appreciate over time,
while Bitcoin offers exposure to a liquid digital asset with a very different
risk and return profile.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Whether that combination ultimately works well for
investors, however, will depend on how both sides of the investment perform.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;How Much Is 350 BTC Worth?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The value of 350 BTC changes with the Bitcoin market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;One report valued the 350 BTC at approximately &lt;b&gt;$22.3
million&lt;/b&gt;, based on a Bitcoin price of about $63,671 on August 4, when the
transaction was reported.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Separately, social-media posts and other coverage have
referenced a figure of roughly &lt;b&gt;$26.9 million&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Neither figure should be treated as a fixed value for the
deal. Bitcoin trades around the clock, so the dollar value of 350 BTC can
change significantly within a short period.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For that reason, the &lt;b&gt;350 BTC figure is the more useful
way to describe the Bitcoin component&lt;/b&gt; of the transaction, while dollar
estimates should be tied to a specific Bitcoin price and date.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why the Structure Stands Out&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The most interesting part of Cardone's move isn't simply the
number of Bitcoin involved. It is how the cryptocurrency is being positioned.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A conventional Bitcoin treasury strategy involves buying BTC
and holding it as a reserve asset.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone's approach attempts to put two very different assets
into the same investment structure:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Real estate + Bitcoin.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The property can potentially provide rental income, while
Bitcoin offers exposure to price appreciation but also introduces substantially
higher volatility.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That combination could produce a different risk profile from
owning either asset independently.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If the property performs well and Bitcoin appreciates,
investors could potentially benefit from both sides of the strategy. If Bitcoin
suffers a major decline, however, the cryptocurrency component could lose
substantial value even if the underlying property continues generating rental
income.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone Capital Is Building a Broader Bitcoin Strategy&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Fort Lauderdale deal appears to fit into a larger
Bitcoin strategy at Cardone Capital.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Recent reports have said the firm had accumulated more than &lt;b&gt;2,800
BTC&lt;/b&gt;, while its real estate portfolio had grown to more than 15,000 units
and assets under management had exceeded $5.4 billion.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Those figures put the Fort Lauderdale transaction into a
broader context.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone has increasingly talked about Bitcoin alongside his
traditional real estate business rather than treating cryptocurrency as a
completely separate investment.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone Capital's own materials also promote the &lt;b&gt;Real
Estate &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/addton-dao-inside-ton-ecosystem-with.html"&gt;Bitcoin Hybrid&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/b&gt;, showing that the combination of property and BTC is
being incorporated into its investment offering.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For investors familiar with Cardone's real estate business,
that makes the strategy particularly interesting.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Instead of asking investors to choose between traditional
property exposure and Bitcoin, the hybrid model attempts to combine both.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Real Estate Side Still Matters&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin may be the headline-grabbing part of the
transaction, but the underlying property remains central to the strategy.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Multifamily real estate is influenced by factors such as
rents, occupancy rates, financing costs, operating expenses and property
valuations.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin works very differently.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;BTC does not generate rental income, and its market price
can move sharply in either direction. A strong Bitcoin market can boost the
value of the cryptocurrency allocation, but a major downturn can have the
opposite effect.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The hybrid strategy therefore does not remove investment
risk. Instead, it combines two assets whose returns are driven by very
different factors.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That distinction is important for investors evaluating the
concept.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why Bitcoin Investors Are Paying Attention&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin adoption has expanded beyond individual traders in
recent years, with companies, investment firms and asset managers exploring
different ways to gain exposure to the asset.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone's strategy adds another possibility: &lt;b&gt;using
Bitcoin as part of a real estate investment structure.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That could appeal to investors who already understand
property investing but also want exposure to Bitcoin.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;However, the headline numbers do not tell the entire story.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Anyone considering an investment structure like this would
need to understand how the BTC is held, who controls the assets, how gains and
losses are accounted for, what fees apply, how the property is financed and
what happens to the Bitcoin allocation during a major market downturn.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Those details can have a significant impact on the overall
risk of the investment.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Dollar Value Will Keep Changing&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The different dollar estimates attached to the 350 BTC
figure highlight one of the challenges of reporting cryptocurrency
transactions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;At one Bitcoin price, 350 BTC might be worth around $22
million. At a higher price, the same 350 BTC could be worth considerably more.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That is why CoinAINews is treating &lt;b&gt;350 BTC as the primary
transaction figure&lt;/b&gt; rather than presenting a single dollar valuation as
permanent.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The approximately $22.3 million estimate reflects the
Bitcoin price used when the transaction was reported, while the later $26.9
million figure reflects a different market valuation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Neither changes the underlying fact that the announced
Bitcoin allocation is &lt;b&gt;350 BTC&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Could the Model Spread to Other Real Estate Deals?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The bigger question is whether Cardone's approach becomes
more common.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Real estate has traditionally been viewed as a relatively
established alternative asset, while Bitcoin represents a newer and
considerably more volatile form of investment.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Combining the two could attract investors who want exposure
to both markets without treating them as completely separate portfolios.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But the strategy will ultimately have to be judged on
performance.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A hybrid structure may look particularly attractive during a
strong Bitcoin market. The test comes when BTC falls sharply while property
values, financing costs or operating expenses are moving in the opposite
direction.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That is where investors will get a better sense of how well
the two assets actually work together.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Fort Lauderdale transaction will be worth watching as
Cardone Capital develops its Bitcoin-and-real-estate strategy.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The company's promotional materials currently highlight a &lt;b&gt;350-unit,
350-BTC hybrid&lt;/b&gt;, suggesting that Bitcoin is becoming an intentional part of
its investment approach rather than simply an occasional purchase.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For Bitcoin investors, the deal provides another example of
BTC being incorporated into traditional alternative-asset strategies.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For real estate investors, it raises a different question:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Can Bitcoin become a meaningful component of
income-producing property investments?&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone appears to believe there is an opportunity to
combine the two.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Whether the strategy produces attractive risk-adjusted
returns will depend on the performance of both the property and Bitcoin over
time.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Grant Cardone has announced that &lt;b&gt;350 BTC is being added
to a Fort Lauderdale real estate deal&lt;/b&gt;, linking Bitcoin exposure with a
multifamily property investment.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone Capital is promoting a &lt;b&gt;350-unit, 350-BTC Real
Estate Bitcoin Hybrid&lt;/b&gt;, making the transaction part of a broader strategy
that brings cryptocurrency and real estate together.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The 350 BTC was previously valued at around &lt;b&gt;$22.3 million&lt;/b&gt;
based on Bitcoin's price at the time of the announcement, while other coverage
has cited a figure closer to $26.9 million. Because BTC trades continuously,
those dollar values can change quickly.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The more important story is the structure itself.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cardone is attempting to combine &lt;b&gt;Bitcoin and real estate
within the same investment strategy&lt;/b&gt;, creating a model that could attract
attention from investors in both markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Whether the approach delivers better returns or
diversification than holding the assets separately remains an open question.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For now, the Fort Lauderdale deal represents an interesting
development in the growing overlap between &lt;b&gt;Bitcoin and traditional
alternative investments&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;ZEC is the network's native asset, used for transfers and transaction fees.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What is the Valour Zcash ETP?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The Valour Zcash ETP is an exchange-traded product designed to provide exposure to Zcash (ZEC) through traditional brokerage and exchange infrastructure.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What is the management fee?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The stated management fee is 1.9%.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What is Zcash?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency launched in 2016. Its technology uses zero-knowledge proofs, including zk-SNARKs, to support privacy-preserving transactions.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Why is the launch significant?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;It adds another listed investment product providing access to ZEC and expands the range of digital assets available through Valour's ETP platform.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Bottom line:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; Valour's Zcash ETP gives investors a traditional exchange-traded route to ZEC exposure without requiring them to directly hold the cryptocurrency. The Spotlight listing adds another regulated market vehicle for accessing Zcash, while Valour's broader ETP expansion highlights the continued development of traditional investment products linked to digital assets.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</content>
