&lt;h2&gt;Why Did the Attackers Return 3,400 BTC?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The events following the exploit have made the case unusual.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The attackers contacted Blockstream through messages embedded in Bitcoin transactions and identified themselves as white hats. They indicated that most of the Bitcoin could be returned once the vulnerability had been fixed and the affected network infrastructure had been updated.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;After the necessary software changes were made, exactly 3,400 BTC was transferred back to the Liquid Federation wallet. Cointelegraph reported that the returned coins were worth roughly $270 million at the time. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the recovery stopped short of a full return.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Approximately 598 BTC remained outstanding, leaving Blockstream and Liquid with the difficult task of recovering the remaining funds while dealing with the attackers' demands.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The White-Hat Claim Is Now Being Questioned&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Calling the actors “white hats” has become increasingly controversial.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A traditional white-hat security researcher typically identifies a vulnerability, reports it to the affected organization and gives the organization an opportunity to fix the problem. In this case, the actors first removed a huge amount of &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/arya-ag-tokenized-grain-receipts-avalanche.html"&gt;Bitcoin &lt;/a&gt;from the network before negotiating its return.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That difference has led some industry figures to question whether the incident should be described as responsible security research.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Cointelegraph reported that Ledger Chief Technology Officer Charles Guillemet questioned the white-hat characterization, arguing that keeping a large portion of the funds while seeking compensation could look more like extortion than conventional white-hat activity. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For that reason, CoinAINews is using terms such as &lt;strong&gt;“actors,” “attackers” and “purported white hats”&lt;/strong&gt; rather than presenting the white-hat claim as an established fact.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Real Vulnerability Was Not Bitcoin's Core Blockchain&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One of the most important points to understand about the Liquid incident is that &lt;strong&gt;Bitcoin itself was not hacked&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The affected system was Liquid, a Bitcoin sidechain and settlement network built around Bitcoin. Liquid uses Bitcoin held by its Federation to support assets issued on the sidechain, including L-BTC.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to reporting from Liquid and SideSwap, the key involved in the withdrawal was not compromised. SideSwap said the L-BTC involved in the transaction originated from a bug in &lt;strong&gt;Elements&lt;/strong&gt;, the open-source software underpinning Liquid. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is an important distinction for Bitcoin users. The incident demonstrates a vulnerability in infrastructure built around Bitcoin, not a failure of Bitcoin's base-layer consensus or cryptographic security.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Liquid Exploit Matters for the Wider Crypto Industry&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The incident highlights a problem that extends far beyond Liquid.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Modern crypto networks increasingly rely on layers of software that connect blockchains, bridges, exchanges, custodians, sidechains and settlement systems. A weakness in one of those layers can potentially create enormous financial consequences even when the underlying blockchain continues operating normally.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Liquid incident is a particularly clear example.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The attackers did not need to break Bitcoin's consensus rules. Instead, the exploit affected the infrastructure responsible for handling assets and withdrawals around a Bitcoin sidechain.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For developers, custodians and infrastructure providers, that creates an important lesson: protecting private keys is only one part of blockchain security. The software that validates balances, authorizes transactions and processes withdrawals can be just as critical.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens to the Remaining 598 BTC?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The fate of the remaining Bitcoin is now the biggest unresolved question surrounding the incident.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Blockstream has rejected the demand for payment and is focused on recovering the outstanding funds rather than treating them as a negotiated bounty.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Because Bitcoin transactions are publicly recorded, investigators can monitor the addresses holding the remaining coins and track any subsequent movement. That does not automatically reveal the identity of the people controlling those addresses, but it can provide investigators with a permanent transaction trail.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The longer the 598 BTC remains onchain, the more attention it is likely to receive from blockchain analytics firms, exchanges and law enforcement agencies monitoring the funds.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Liquid Has Already Recovered Most of the Funds&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Despite the unresolved dispute, the return of 3,400 BTC significantly changed the situation from the first hours of the attack.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At the beginning of the incident, almost the entire Bitcoin balance of the Federation wallet had been withdrawn. The return of 3,400 BTC restored most of the Bitcoin backing associated with Liquid's system.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Cointelegraph reported that the network had deployed updated software and was preparing for a coordinated restart after the affected infrastructure was patched. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That recovery, however, does not erase the security questions raised by the exploit.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Liquid and the wider Bitcoin infrastructure community will still need to understand exactly how the vulnerability was triggered, why the transaction controls did not prevent the withdrawal and what safeguards can stop a similar incident from happening again.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Could the Liquid Hack Change Crypto Security Practices?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It could.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The case presents an uncomfortable question for the industry: how should companies respond when a security researcher crosses the line between vulnerability discovery and unauthorized asset removal?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If companies pay large rewards after attackers take control of funds, that could create incentives for future exploits. On the other hand, refusing to negotiate can make it harder to recover assets in incidents where attackers are willing to return part of what they took.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Liquid case therefore sits somewhere between a conventional hack, a vulnerability disclosure dispute and an attempted negotiation over cryptocurrency.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Its final outcome may influence how blockchain companies structure bug-bounty programs, emergency response plans and communication channels with security researchers.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Liquid Hack FAQs&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;How much Bitcoin was taken from Liquid?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Approximately 4,000 BTC was withdrawn from Liquid's Federation wallet. Reuters reported the value at around $320 million at the time of the incident. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;How much Bitcoin was returned?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Exactly 3,400 BTC was returned to the Liquid Federation wallet after the affected infrastructure was patched. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;How much Bitcoin is still outstanding?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Approximately 598 BTC remains outstanding, according to reporting following the partial recovery. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Did hackers really call themselves white hats?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. The actors described themselves as white hats in onchain communications. However, that characterization has been disputed, and it should not be treated as an independently established fact. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Was Bitcoin itself hacked?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. The incident affected the Liquid Bitcoin sidechain and related infrastructure. Reporting has focused on a software vulnerability rather than a compromise of Bitcoin's underlying blockchain. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is the 10% demand?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The actors involved in the incident sought a 10% payment in connection with the return of the remaining funds. Blockstream rejected the idea of paying for the return of the outstanding Bitcoin.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Liquid Network exploit has moved from an enormous Bitcoin withdrawal to a complicated recovery battle.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Roughly 4,000 BTC was initially taken, around 3,400 BTC has since been returned, and approximately 598 BTC remains outstanding.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The most controversial part of the story is no longer simply how the exploit happened. It is what should happen when people who take advantage of a vulnerability later return most of the funds while keeping a substantial amount and seeking compensation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/arya-ag-tokenized-grain-receipts-avalanche.html"&gt;Blockstream &lt;/a&gt;has made its position clear: it does not intend to treat the remaining Bitcoin as a paid security bounty.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For the crypto industry, the Liquid incident is a reminder that security failures do not always require a blockchain itself to be broken. Sidechains, bridges, settlement systems and the software connecting them can create their own critical attack surfaces.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Until the remaining Bitcoin is recovered and the full technical cause of the exploit is understood, the Liquid incident will remain one of the most closely watched crypto security stories of September 2026.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>How to Start With Crypto in 2026: A Beginner's Guide</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjC06ITNte_ichAIwiqa4ekomkaVxc5Nzf_OqDdCD0XHtFQUSgK6_YwIXkIhTpHre4Ko9TLzLE3GusuLH1gHNj_inIRUX8Cys23LLA7U5Bp8Ke0n_gBki48GjEYfh2BdtSqIe4YmGbAEJ68V08pOQjDMEWrv9yKSpXG8MIWyM_C7wPTZJKT6nKQ_NY98DeE/s1200/coinainews-crypto-beginner-guide-1200x675.webp" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="How to start with cryptocurrency in 2026 showing Bitcoin, Ethereum, crypto wallet and blockchain security" border="0" data-original-height="675" data-original-width="1200" height="180" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjC06ITNte_ichAIwiqa4ekomkaVxc5Nzf_OqDdCD0XHtFQUSgK6_YwIXkIhTpHre4Ko9TLzLE3GusuLH1gHNj_inIRUX8Cys23LLA7U5Bp8Ke0n_gBki48GjEYfh2BdtSqIe4YmGbAEJ68V08pOQjDMEWrv9yKSpXG8MIWyM_C7wPTZJKT6nKQ_NY98DeE/w320-h180/coinainews-crypto-beginner-guide-1200x675.webp" title="How to Start With Crypto in 2026: Beginner's Guide" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;em&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/em&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;"So, I've heard so many things about crypto. How do I actually start?"&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It is a reasonable question. Bitcoin, Ethereum, wallets, exchanges, DeFi, NFTs, gas fees and private keys can make crypto feel much more complicated than it needs to be.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The good news is that beginners do not need to understand every part of blockchain technology before getting started. What matters first is understanding what you are buying, choosing a reputable platform, protecting your account and avoiding common mistakes.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This guide walks through the basics of getting started with crypto in 2026, from choosing an exchange to securing a wallet and understanding the risks.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Step 1: Understand What Crypto Actually Is&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Before you buy anything, you need to know what you're buying.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto assets are not all the same. Bitcoin is widely followed as a digital asset and is increasingly viewed by some investors as a potential store of value. Ethereum is the native asset of a blockchain network used for smart contracts and decentralized applications. Other tokens can have different purposes, including governance, utility or access to specific blockchain ecosystems.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The technology behind many crypto assets is &lt;strong&gt;blockchain&lt;/strong&gt; — a distributed digital ledger that records transactions across a network.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why Do People Buy Crypto?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;For investment:&lt;/strong&gt; Some investors buy crypto because they believe its value could increase over time, although prices can also fall sharply.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;For financial access:&lt;/strong&gt; In countries dealing with high inflation or capital restrictions, some people use dollar-linked stablecoins as an alternative way to hold or transfer digital value.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;For technology:&lt;/strong&gt; Blockchain technology is being explored across areas such as payments, financial services, supply chains and digital identity.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Step 2: Decide Your Goal and Strategy&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Before making your first purchase, think about what you actually want to accomplish.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What's Your Investment Horizon?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Long-term:&lt;/strong&gt; Bitcoin and Ethereum are among the most established and widely followed crypto assets, but they remain volatile.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Medium-term:&lt;/strong&gt; Some investors research Layer-1 networks such as Solana and Avalanche, although these assets can carry substantially higher risk.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Short-term/speculative:&lt;/strong&gt; Meme coins and smaller tokens can experience extreme price movements. Beginners should understand the possibility of significant losses before considering them.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;How Much Should You Invest?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;There is no universal percentage that is appropriate for every crypto investor. The right amount depends on your financial situation, risk tolerance, investment objectives and time horizon.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Only use money you can afford to lose. Never borrow money to buy cryptocurrency and never use money needed for rent, essential bills or emergency expenses.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;One approach some long-term investors use is &lt;strong&gt;Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA)&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Instead of investing $1,000 in one transaction, an investor might spread the same amount across several smaller purchases, such as $100 per week for 10 weeks.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;DCA can reduce the pressure of trying to predict the perfect entry point, but it does &lt;strong&gt;not&lt;/strong&gt; guarantee profits or protect against losses.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Step 3: Choose a Crypto Exchange&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A crypto exchange is a platform where users can buy, sell or trade digital assets. Beginners should compare security features, fees, supported assets and availability in their country before choosing one.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="margin: 20px 0px; overflow-x: auto;"&gt;
&lt;table style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;thead&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px; text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Exchange&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px; text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Commonly Considered For&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/thead&gt;
&lt;tbody&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Important:&lt;/strong&gt; Exchange availability, products and regulatory status vary by country. Always check whether a platform is legally available in your jurisdiction before opening an account.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What to Expect From an Exchange&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;KYC:&lt;/strong&gt; Many regulated platforms require identity verification before allowing users to trade.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Fees:&lt;/strong&gt; Compare trading, deposit and withdrawal fees before choosing a platform.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Security:&lt;/strong&gt; Use a strong, unique password and enable multi-factor authentication whenever possible.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Withdrawal controls:&lt;/strong&gt; Understand how withdrawals work before depositing a significant amount.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Step 4: Secure Your Crypto&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;blockquote&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;"Not your keys, not your coins."&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/blockquote&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto security is one of the most important subjects for beginners to understand.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If funds remain on an exchange, the user is relying on that platform to safeguard the assets and process withdrawals. Self-custody gives the user direct control over private keys, but it also means the user becomes responsible for protecting those keys.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;There is no universal &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/how-to-start-with-crypto-in-2026.html"&gt;answer &lt;/a&gt;about which storage method is best. The right choice depends on how much is being held, how frequently it is used and how comfortable the user is with self-custody.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Types of Crypto Wallets&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;div style="margin: 20px 0px; overflow-x: auto;"&gt;
&lt;table style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;thead&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;

&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px; text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Examples&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px; text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Common Use&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/thead&gt;
&lt;tbody&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;

&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Cold Wallet&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Ledger, Trezor&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Long-term storage with private keys kept offline&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Your &lt;strong&gt;seed phrase&lt;/strong&gt; is extremely sensitive. It can be used to restore a wallet and, in many cases, gain control over its funds.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Never share your seed phrase or private key with anyone.&lt;/strong&gt; Legitimate exchange employees, wallet companies and support agents should not ask you to provide it.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Step 5: Avoid Beginner Crypto Scams&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto transactions can be difficult or impossible to reverse once funds have been sent. That makes scam prevention especially important.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="margin: 20px 0px; overflow-x: auto;"&gt;
&lt;table style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;thead&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px; text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Scam Type&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px; text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;How to Avoid It&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/th&gt;

&lt;tr&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Do not click unexpected links. Open the official website directly.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Fake Giveaways&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Never send crypto first because someone promises to send more back.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Guaranteed Returns&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Treat guaranteed-profit claims as a major warning sign.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Fake Apps&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Download wallets and exchange applications only from trusted official sources.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pro Tip:&lt;/strong&gt; Always check the website address carefully. Scammers can create domains that look similar to legitimate companies.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Before making your first trade or transfer, run through this quick checklist.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;/tr&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Taxes: What You Need to Know&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto tax treatment varies significantly between countries. Depending on where you live, selling, swapping, spending or earning crypto can create a tax obligation.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Always check the rules that apply in your jurisdiction before making taxable transactions.&lt;/strong&gt; Keep detailed records of your transactions, including dates, amounts, values and the assets involved.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For tax information, use official government sources or speak with a qualified tax professional who understands cryptocurrency.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What is the safest way for a beginner to start with crypto in 2026?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Start by learning the basics, choose a reputable &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/trump-leaves-door-open-for-bigger-us.html"&gt;platform &lt;/a&gt;that operates legally in your jurisdiction, enable strong account security and only invest money you can afford to lose. For long-term holdings, self-custody can be considered if you understand how to protect private keys.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;How much money should I invest in crypto as a beginner?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;There is no one-size-fits-all amount. Your allocation should reflect your financial situation, risk tolerance and investment goals. Starting small can help a beginner learn how exchanges, wallets and transactions work without taking excessive risk.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Which cryptocurrency should I buy first?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin and Ethereum are among the most established and widely followed crypto assets. However, both can experience substantial price declines. Beginners should research an asset before purchasing it rather than choosing one solely because of its popularity.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Is crypto safe for beginners?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto carries significant market and security risks. Beginners can reduce some avoidable risks by using strong passwords, enabling multi-factor authentication, checking website addresses and never sharing private keys or seed phrases.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What is Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA)?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;DCA means investing a fixed amount at regular intervals instead of investing the entire amount at once. It can reduce the pressure of trying to time the market, but it does not guarantee profits or eliminate investment risk.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Can I lose all my money in crypto?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Yes. Individual cryptocurrencies can lose substantial value, and some tokens can become nearly worthless. Only invest money you can afford to lose and understand the risks before making a purchase.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What is a seed phrase?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A seed phrase is a sequence of words used by many crypto wallets as a backup for recovering wallet access. Anyone who obtains the seed phrase may be able to control the associated funds. Never share it with anyone.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Do I have to pay tax on crypto?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Tax rules vary by country. Depending on the jurisdiction and transaction, selling, swapping, spending or earning cryptocurrency may result in tax obligations. Check the current rules in your country and maintain accurate transaction records.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Starting with crypto in 2026 does not require a finance degree or advanced knowledge of blockchain development. It requires patience, basic knowledge and good security habits.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Understand&lt;/strong&gt; what you're buying.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Plan&lt;/strong&gt; your goal, budget and risk level.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Buy&lt;/strong&gt; through a reputable platform available in your country.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Secure&lt;/strong&gt; your crypto and protect your private keys.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Avoid&lt;/strong&gt; scams, emotional trading and unrealistic promises.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto can offer new opportunities, but it also carries significant risks. The smartest first step is not buying a coin — it is learning how the system works and understanding what could go wrong.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This article is for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice. Cryptocurrency markets are volatile, and past performance does not guarantee future results. Always conduct your own research and consider consulting a qualified financial professional before making investment decisions.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Hunter Biden’s $LAPTOP Memecoin Crashes 86.5% in 30 Minutes After Launch</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;
  &lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhCEhUXKjzp9NtP6kxGPUOf3pudVgzcP0s0BwReEqtZiZT4fYZI6mStIeqap-mzo5O359f2pwOxhdJO5q25UNzXdAuACj2OSvSiB36BOuszLnTRnyQn-cnFpFUusR-NUwaS_mjlUL54Oey-iWlUDvFB_1oavgkf1FZMFLpGzeqi_zu0Gf3N3sDWwH1q8A0H/s1672/hunter-biden-laptop-memecoin-crash-86-5-percent.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Hunter Biden’s $LAPTOP memecoin crashes 86.5% shortly after launch" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhCEhUXKjzp9NtP6kxGPUOf3pudVgzcP0s0BwReEqtZiZT4fYZI6mStIeqap-mzo5O359f2pwOxhdJO5q25UNzXdAuACj2OSvSiB36BOuszLnTRnyQn-cnFpFUusR-NUwaS_mjlUL54Oey-iWlUDvFB_1oavgkf1FZMFLpGzeqi_zu0Gf3N3sDWwH1q8A0H/w640-h360/hunter-biden-laptop-memecoin-crash-86-5-percent.jpg.png" title="Hunter Biden’s $LAPTOP Memecoin Crashes 86.5%" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;
  September 9, 2026&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Hunter Biden’s newly launched &lt;strong&gt;$LAPTOP memecoin&lt;/strong&gt; experienced a brutal first trading session, with market data reported by Traders Union showing the token falling approximately &lt;strong&gt;86.5% within 30 minutes&lt;/strong&gt; of its debut.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The token reportedly dropped from around &lt;strong&gt;$199.50 to $26.88&lt;/strong&gt; during that initial period, while trading volume exceeded &lt;strong&gt;$2.5 million&lt;/strong&gt;. The sharp move highlights just how quickly political meme coins can move once trading begins.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;$LAPTOP is particularly notable because it is tied directly to one of the most politically charged stories involving Hunter Biden: the laptop controversy that emerged during the 2020 U.S. presidential election. The token was launched on &lt;strong&gt;Base&lt;/strong&gt;, the Ethereum layer-2 network associated with Coinbase.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;div style="margin: 20px 0px; overflow-x: auto; width: 100%;"&gt;

  &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Is Hunter Biden’s $LAPTOP Memecoin?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;$LAPTOP is a political-themed meme &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/blog-post.html"&gt;cryptocurrency associated&lt;/a&gt; with Hunter Biden, the son of former U.S. President Joe Biden.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The name references the laptop that became the subject of intense political controversy after it was reported that Hunter Biden had left a computer at a Delaware repair shop in 2019. The story became a major issue during the 2020 presidential campaign and generated years of political debate.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Rather than avoiding that history, the $LAPTOP project uses the controversy as its central theme.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Hunter Biden publicly teased the token before launch, including an X post featuring media coverage of the laptop story. Multiple outlets reported that the token would launch on Base with a total supply of one billion tokens. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;$LAPTOP Falls 86.5% Shortly After Trading Begins&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The biggest story surrounding the launch was not the political symbolism. It was the speed of the price collapse.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;According to a market report published after the launch, $LAPTOP dropped approximately &lt;strong&gt;86.5%&lt;/strong&gt; within its first 30 minutes of trading, moving from roughly &lt;strong&gt;$199.50 to $26.88&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The same report said the token had already generated more than &lt;strong&gt;$2.5 million in trading volume&lt;/strong&gt;, showing that substantial speculative activity arrived despite the project's extremely short trading history. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A move of that size does not automatically establish that the project was a scam or a rug pull. A newly launched meme token can experience enormous price swings because liquidity is initially limited and traders compete to buy or sell during the opening minutes.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That distinction matters. &lt;strong&gt;A crash is evidence of extreme volatility; it is not, by itself, proof of fraud.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why Did the Price Move So Violently?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;There are several structural reasons why a newly launched meme coin can experience a dramatic price move.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;1. Very Early Liquidity&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;New tokens often begin trading with much less liquidity than established cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin or Ethereum. When large orders enter a thin market, prices can move rapidly.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;2. Speculative Launch Trading&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Some traders buy new meme coins immediately after launch hoping to capture an early price spike. Others sell as soon as momentum weakens.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That creates a market where buying and selling pressure can change within seconds rather than hours.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;3. Political Attention&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;$LAPTOP arrived with an unusually recognizable political name. That gives the token a built-in news cycle and social-media audience, but attention does not necessarily translate into sustainable demand.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;4. Meme Coin Economics&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Meme coins are generally driven more by community interest, branding, speculation and social momentum than by traditional cash flows or business fundamentals.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That makes their prices particularly sensitive to changes in sentiment.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;How Is the $LAPTOP Supply Distributed?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Reports before launch said the project planned a total supply of &lt;strong&gt;1 billion $LAPTOP tokens&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Approximately &lt;strong&gt;30%&lt;/strong&gt; was allocated to Hunter Biden and the project's founders. Those tokens were reported to be locked for an initial period and then subject to a longer vesting schedule.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Another &lt;strong&gt;20%&lt;/strong&gt; was designated for distributions involving people who lost money on Donald Trump's $TRUMP meme coin as well as subscribers connected to Hunter Biden's media channels.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The project also described a mechanism under which as much as &lt;strong&gt;30% of the supply could be burned&lt;/strong&gt; depending on whether specified political and market-related events occur.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If those conditions are not met, reporting indicated that the relevant tokens could instead be directed toward charitable purposes.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The remaining allocation was described as supporting liquidity, charity and the administrative, legal and compliance costs associated with the project. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why the Trump $TRUMP Connection Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;One of the more unusual aspects of $LAPTOP is its relationship with traders who lost money on Donald Trump's &lt;strong&gt;$TRUMP&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/defi-development-corp-raises-11m-with.html"&gt;meme coin&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Reporting before the launch said a portion of the $LAPTOP supply would be distributed to wallets associated with people who suffered losses from $TRUMP.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That makes the token more than a simple celebrity meme coin. Its marketing strategy directly references the political and crypto ecosystem surrounding Trump-era meme coins.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It also gives the project an obvious narrative: a meme coin associated with Hunter Biden attempting to attract attention from traders who previously participated in Trump's crypto venture.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;$LAPTOP Is Not the Same as an Investment in Hunter Biden&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;One important distinction for readers is that buying $LAPTOP does not represent ownership in Hunter Biden, a company controlled by him, or a traditional &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/strategy-skips-bitcoin-buy-as-strc.html"&gt;financial asset&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It is a cryptocurrency token whose value depends on market trading and demand.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;There is also no basis for assuming that a politically famous name guarantees long-term value. The initial 86.5% decline demonstrates the opposite: attention can produce enormous trading activity while still being accompanied by equally enormous downside.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Is the $LAPTOP Crash a Rug Pull?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Not based on the price decline alone.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The term “rug pull” generally implies that insiders or developers have deliberately extracted liquidity or otherwise abandoned a token in a way that leaves investors with losses.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A sharp price fall can happen for many reasons, including profit-taking, thin liquidity, panic selling or a collapse in speculative demand.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;At the time of this report, the available evidence confirms the severe early price decline, but the decline itself should not be presented as proof that Hunter Biden or the project's founders conducted a rug pull.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why Political Meme Coins Keep Attracting Attention&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Political meme coins have become a recurring part of the crypto market because they combine two powerful internet-native forces: politics and speculation.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Donald Trump and Melania Trump previously launched their own meme coins, and other political figures or personalities have also experimented with crypto assets.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;These tokens can generate enormous attention because the underlying brand is already familiar to millions of people.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But familiarity is not the same thing as utility.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is one of the most important lessons from the $LAPTOP launch. A recognizable name can create liquidity and trading interest, but it cannot guarantee that buyers will continue supporting the token once the initial excitement fades.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What the $LAPTOP Crash Means for Meme Coin Traders&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The first lesson is simple: &lt;strong&gt;launch-day price action can be extremely misleading.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A token can rise dramatically within minutes and still collapse shortly afterward. The reverse is also possible, but neither direction tells investors what the long-term value of the project will be.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The second lesson is liquidity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Traders looking at a new token should pay attention not only to the displayed market capitalization but also to actual liquidity, trading volume, holder distribution and the concentration of tokens among large wallets.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The third lesson is supply structure.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Large allocations controlled by founders or insiders can create additional market risks, even when those tokens are subject to lockups or vesting schedules.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Could $LAPTOP Recover?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It is too early to make a reliable prediction.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A meme coin can recover after a sharp decline if a large community forms around it and trading activity remains strong. It can also continue falling if attention disappears.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For $LAPTOP, the market will ultimately determine whether the Hunter Biden connection creates lasting demand or simply produces a short-lived news cycle.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;There is no credible basis for assigning a future price target solely from the token's launch performance.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Bigger Story: Politics Is Becoming Part of Crypto's Speculation Economy&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The $LAPTOP launch is another example of how political identity and cryptocurrency speculation are becoming increasingly intertwined.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Unlike traditional political fundraising, a meme coin can trade continuously on blockchain-based markets and attract participants from around the world.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That creates a strange financial environment where political symbolism can become a tradable asset.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But the 86.5% opening collapse also demonstrates the other side of that model. Political attention can bring buyers into a market quickly, but it can disappear just as quickly.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What is Hunter Biden's $LAPTOP coin?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;$LAPTOP is a political-themed meme cryptocurrency associated with Hunter Biden and named after the laptop controversy that became prominent during the 2020 U.S. election.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;How much did $LAPTOP crash?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;One market report published after the launch reported an approximately &lt;strong&gt;86.5% decline within 30 minutes&lt;/strong&gt;, from around $199.50 to $26.88. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What blockchain is $LAPTOP on?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;The token launched on &lt;strong&gt;Base&lt;/strong&gt;, the Ethereum layer-2 network associated with Coinbase. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What is the total supply of $LAPTOP?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;Pre-launch reporting said the token has a total supply of &lt;strong&gt;1 billion tokens&lt;/strong&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Is $LAPTOP a rug pull?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;The reported price crash alone does not establish that the project is a rug pull. A detailed assessment would require evidence about liquidity withdrawals, insider transactions, token ownership and other on-chain activity.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Should investors buy $LAPTOP after the crash?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;A large price decline does not automatically make a meme coin undervalued. $LAPTOP remains a highly speculative asset, and traders should independently evaluate liquidity, token distribution, wallet concentration and project disclosures before taking any position.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Hunter Biden's &lt;strong&gt;$LAPTOP memecoin&lt;/strong&gt; has already delivered one of the most dramatic launches of the political-token cycle, with reported market data showing an &lt;strong&gt;86.5% collapse within roughly 30 minutes&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The episode is less about whether a politically famous meme coin can attract attention—it clearly can—and more about what happens after that attention arrives.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For now, $LAPTOP's debut is a reminder that &lt;strong&gt;viral branding, political controversy and real market value are three very different things&lt;/strong&gt;. The token's next phase will depend on whether trading activity and community interest survive after the initial launch frenzy.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Disclaimer:&lt;/strong&gt; This article is for informational purposes only and is not investment advice. Meme coins can be extremely volatile, and readers should conduct their own research before buying or selling any digital asset.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Bitcoin Faces a $80K Supply Wall as Long-Term Holders Sell 539K BTC</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg8eweV4Xk6MKLLVj83GOKbXlovgk41kJlMKo9Rtnycx9sfiYYc0SSudJhyphenhyphen3weGdIsmaxtpQTkRteUb7Hn1pUY98-pVrQnPtWiRpbq0_7r-fVGEjFL57pOsDbabY9x6oPV7tbzPmg2290h0E75GkTSyY6IOFKIHnHq96X72VpesZAppczZdcoS0a_VPY7N0/s1248/bitcoin-80k-supply-wall-long-term-holders-selling.jpg.jpg" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Bitcoin facing a heavy supply wall as long-term holders sell BTC near $80,000" border="0" data-original-height="832" data-original-width="1248" height="427" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg8eweV4Xk6MKLLVj83GOKbXlovgk41kJlMKo9Rtnycx9sfiYYc0SSudJhyphenhyphen3weGdIsmaxtpQTkRteUb7Hn1pUY98-pVrQnPtWiRpbq0_7r-fVGEjFL57pOsDbabY9x6oPV7tbzPmg2290h0E75GkTSyY6IOFKIHnHq96X72VpesZAppczZdcoS0a_VPY7N0/w640-h427/bitcoin-80k-supply-wall-long-term-holders-selling.jpg.jpg" title="Bitcoin Faces a $80K Supply Wall as Long-Term Holders Sell" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;
&lt;strong&gt;September 12, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin is running into a familiar problem at one of the market's most closely watched levels: &lt;strong&gt;there is a lot of Bitcoin available for sale.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to a September 12 market update from CoinMarketCap citing CryptoQuant data, long-term Bitcoin holders have sold approximately &lt;strong&gt;539,000 BTC in the $77,000-$80,000 price zone this year&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That selling has created what market participants are describing as a heavy &lt;strong&gt;supply wall&lt;/strong&gt; around the area, potentially making it harder for Bitcoin to establish a sustained move above $80,000.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the number needs context.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It does not mean 539,000 BTC was dumped onto exchanges in a single transaction or that Bitcoin is automatically headed for a major crash. Instead, the data points to a broader shift in the behavior of long-term holders as Bitcoin trades around a level where many older investors have an opportunity to realize gains.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The real question for the market is much simpler:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Can new buyers absorb the Bitcoin being sold by long-term holders?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why $80,000 Matters for Bitcoin&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The $80,000 area has become an important psychological and market level for Bitcoin.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When an asset approaches a major round number, investors who bought much lower can have a natural incentive to take some profit. If enough holders make that decision at roughly the same time, the available supply can increase precisely when new buyers need to provide stronger demand.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That appears to be the issue Bitcoin is facing now.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The market can continue higher even while long-term holders sell. Selling by itself is not necessarily bearish.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;What matters is whether buyers are strong enough to absorb it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If demand absorbs the available supply, the resistance can eventually disappear. If demand weakens while selling continues, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ai-made-millions-in-crypto-who-pays-tax.html"&gt;Bitcoin&lt;/a&gt; can struggle to make further progress.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Does the 539K BTC Figure Actually Tell Us?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The figure of approximately 539,000 BTC comes from the market update published by CoinMarketCap, which attributed the data to CryptoQuant.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It should therefore be understood as an &lt;strong&gt;on-chain market-data observation&lt;/strong&gt;, rather than as evidence that exactly 539,000 BTC was sold directly into exchange order books.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction matters.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin on-chain data can reveal changes in the behavior of different holder cohorts, but a change in the status of coins does not necessarily tell us exactly when, where or how every coin was sold.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;CryptoQuant describes its platform as providing on-chain and off-chain market data, including holder cohorts, address labels, exchange information and other blockchain metrics used to analyze &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ai-with-wallet-can-it-spend-your-crypto.html"&gt;cryptocurrency markets&lt;/a&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;So the more useful interpretation is that a significant amount of Bitcoin associated with long-term holders has moved through a distribution phase around the $77,000-$80,000 area.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Long-Term Holders Selling Is Important&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Long-term Bitcoin holders occupy an unusual position in the market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Many accumulated BTC at prices far below today's levels. When Bitcoin rallies substantially, those investors have something that newer buyers do not have: &lt;strong&gt;large unrealized gains and a long history of holding through volatility.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Some may decide to sell a portion of their holdings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That does not necessarily mean they have become bearish on Bitcoin.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;An investor can remain bullish on Bitcoin while taking partial profits after a major price increase.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For the market, however, the result is still additional supply.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;And when that supply appears near the same price zone, it can create resistance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;A Supply Wall Is Not an Unbreakable Ceiling&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The phrase “supply wall” can sound more dramatic than it actually is.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It does not mean Bitcoin cannot cross $80,000.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It means buyers may need to provide enough demand to absorb the selling pressure concentrated around that area.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Think of it as a tug-of-war.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Long-term holders are releasing coins.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;New buyers are attempting to absorb them.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If buyers win, the price can move through the resistance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If sellers continue to overwhelm demand, Bitcoin may remain below the level or retreat toward lower areas where buyers are more willing to step in.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Bitcoin Can Rise Even While Holders Sell&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is one of the most important concepts for understanding the current setup.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin does not need every existing holder to stop selling before its price can rise.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It only needs sufficient demand to absorb the coins being offered for sale.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Imagine that long-term holders decide to sell 10,000 BTC.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If buyers are willing to purchase 10,000 BTC at increasingly higher prices, the market can continue rising.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But if buyers are only willing to purchase 5,000 BTC at the current price, sellers may need to accept lower prices to find the remaining demand.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is why &lt;strong&gt;supply and demand matter more than the headline selling number alone.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The $77K-$80K Range Could Become a Key Battlefield&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The range highlighted in the CoinMarketCap update is important because it sits directly below the $80,000 psychological threshold.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If Bitcoin repeatedly approaches the upper end of the range and encounters selling, traders may begin treating the area as significant resistance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;On the other hand, if BTC can absorb the available supply and establish sustained trading above $80,000, the interpretation could change quickly.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The same sellers who are creating resistance today may eventually run out of coins they want to sell at those prices.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Once supply becomes less aggressive, buyers may have an easier path toward higher levels.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Bitcoin Traders Should Watch Next&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The 539K BTC figure is only one part of the picture. Traders and investors should watch how the market behaves around the supply zone itself.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bitcoin's reaction near $80,000:&lt;/strong&gt; repeated rejection would suggest that sellers remain active.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Trading volume:&lt;/strong&gt; stronger buying volume near resistance could indicate that the market is absorbing supply.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Exchange flows:&lt;/strong&gt; changes in BTC moving to and from exchanges can provide additional clues, although a transfer to an exchange does not prove an immediate sale.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Long-term-holder behavior:&lt;/strong&gt; continued distribution would suggest that older holders are still taking profits.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Whale activity:&lt;/strong&gt; renewed accumulation by large holders could help offset selling from other cohorts.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Price acceptance above $80,000:&lt;/strong&gt; sustained trading above the level would be more meaningful than a brief intraday move.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Would a Break Above $80K Change?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A decisive move above $80,000 would not automatically invalidate the on-chain data.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead, it could show that the market has successfully absorbed the supply.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That would be an important signal because resistance created by profit-taking is only effective while enough sellers remain willing to offer coins at that level.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If demand consistently exceeds that supply, Bitcoin can move higher even though long-term holders continue selling.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In that situation, the 539K BTC figure would become evidence of strong distribution that the market successfully absorbed rather than proof that sellers controlled the trend.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What If Bitcoin Keeps Failing at $80K?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The opposite scenario would deserve attention.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If Bitcoin repeatedly approaches $80,000 but cannot establish support above it, the market may be signaling that demand is not yet strong enough to absorb the available supply.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That could lead to a longer period of sideways trading.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It could also increase the probability of a deeper correction if sellers become more aggressive and buyers step back.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Still, a rejection at $80,000 alone would not prove that a new Bitcoin bear market has begun.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Markets can spend weeks or months consolidating below resistance before eventually breaking higher.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Is This a Bitcoin Whale Dump?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Not necessarily.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;“Long-term holder” and “whale” describe different characteristics.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A long-term holder classification generally relates to how long coins have been held, while a whale description usually relates to the size of a holder's position.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means a long-term holder does not automatically have to be a whale.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Using the terms interchangeably can make on-chain data sound more dramatic than it is.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The more accurate description is that &lt;strong&gt;long-term-holder supply is being distributed into the market around an important price zone.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why This Matters Beyond One Bitcoin Price Level&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The bigger story is about the changing ownership of Bitcoin.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Every major market cycle involves coins moving between different groups of investors.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Older holders may sell into strength. New investors may accumulate. Traders may move coins between exchanges and private wallets. Institutions may enter or reduce exposure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Over time, those movements change who controls the available supply.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is why on-chain analysis can be useful.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of looking only at the &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/can-ai-autonomously-own-and-manage.html"&gt;Bitcoin price chart&lt;/a&gt;, investors can also examine what different groups of holders are doing with their coins.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Real Question: Who Is Absorbing the 539K BTC?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This may ultimately be more important than the headline number itself.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If long-term holders have distributed roughly 539,000 BTC in the highlighted price zone, the next question is where that supply has gone.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Has it been absorbed by new investors?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Are larger holders accumulating?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Is institutional demand strong enough to keep the market moving?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Or is demand weakening while older holders continue to distribute?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Those answers will help determine whether the $77,000-$80,000 region becomes a temporary pause or a much more important resistance zone.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bitcoin's Next Move May Come Down to Supply Absorption&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The current setup is not as simple as “long-term holders are selling, therefore Bitcoin must fall.”&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That conclusion would ignore the other side of the market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Every seller needs a buyer.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The more important question is whether buyers are strong enough to absorb the available Bitcoin without demanding significantly lower prices.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is the real test facing BTC around $80,000.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;CoinMarketCap's latest market update, citing CryptoQuant data, says long-term Bitcoin holders have sold approximately &lt;strong&gt;539,000 BTC in the $77,000-$80,000 zone this year&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The selling has created a substantial supply area as Bitcoin struggles to establish a sustained move above $80,000.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the figure should not be interpreted as a guaranteed prediction of a crash.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bitcoin can still break above $80,000 if fresh demand is strong enough to absorb the distribution.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For now, the market is caught between two forces: long-term holders taking profits and buyers attempting to absorb their supply.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The next major clue may therefore come not from how much Bitcoin is being sold, but from &lt;strong&gt;how aggressively the market is willing to buy it.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Disclosure: This article is based on a CoinMarketCap market update citing CryptoQuant data. The 539,000 BTC figure is attributed to that report and is not presented as an independently verified CoinAINews calculation. This article is for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial or investment advice.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Solana's SGP-0002 Vote: Faster Disinflation Could Reshape SOL's Future</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEifooGbM9CcwRWvjVBL6rHHVZ7UbatopDs2ad0LjAlpWl288sMqMsr4hOwqvBGMOGbrCgRZ1VvJMT7KqEAriHspjiXqQ1Be-WGLNLtMdX_fT7PnJiRajHvzZpZxTyIJcSISRq9GsSirm8k4F5NHTbtwOveFoa06c4gk6JtmRigYmrkFOnvXS1UNsHsKuBFd/s1672/solana-sgp-0002-faster-disinflation-2026.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Solana SGP-0002 vote on faster disinflation and lower SOL issuance" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEifooGbM9CcwRWvjVBL6rHHVZ7UbatopDs2ad0LjAlpWl288sMqMsr4hOwqvBGMOGbrCgRZ1VvJMT7KqEAriHspjiXqQ1Be-WGLNLtMdX_fT7PnJiRajHvzZpZxTyIJcSISRq9GsSirm8k4F5NHTbtwOveFoa06c4gk6JtmRigYmrkFOnvXS1UNsHsKuBFd/w400-h225/solana-sgp-0002-faster-disinflation-2026.jpg.png" title="Solana SGP-0002 Vote: Faster Disinflation and Lower SOL Issuance" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff |&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Solana is facing one of its first major tests of stake-weighted governance, with a proposal that could accelerate the network's path toward its long-term inflation target.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Validators and stakers began voting on &lt;strong&gt;SGP-0002&lt;/strong&gt; on August 23. The proposal would double Solana's annual disinflation rate from &lt;strong&gt;15% to 30%&lt;/strong&gt;, allowing the network to reach its existing &lt;strong&gt;1.5% inflation floor earlier&lt;/strong&gt;. Under the proposal's modeling, the floor could be reached around &lt;strong&gt;2029 instead of 2032&lt;/strong&gt;, reducing projected future issuance by approximately &lt;strong&gt;18.9 million SOL&lt;/strong&gt; over six years.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At current SOL prices used in the proposal's analysis, the difference represents roughly &lt;strong&gt;$1.5 billion&lt;/strong&gt; in future emissions, although the dollar value will change with SOL's market price.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Numbers&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;table&gt;
  &lt;thead&gt;
    &lt;tr&gt;
      &lt;th&gt;Metric&lt;/th&gt;
      &lt;th&gt;Current 15% Disinflation&lt;/th&gt;
      &lt;th&gt;Proposed 30% Disinflation&lt;/th&gt;
    &lt;/tr&gt;
  &lt;/thead&gt;
  &lt;tbody&gt;
    &lt;tr&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;Inflation after 1 year&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;~3.24%&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;~2.86%&lt;/td&gt;
    &lt;/tr&gt;
    &lt;tr&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;1.5% inflation floor&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;Early 2032&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;Early 2029&lt;/td&gt;
    &lt;/tr&gt;
    &lt;tr&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;Six-year projected supply&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;727.4M SOL&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;708.5M SOL&lt;/td&gt;
    &lt;/tr&gt;
    &lt;tr&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;Difference&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;—&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;~18.9M SOL&lt;/td&gt;
    &lt;/tr&gt;
  &lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Source: SGP-0002 / SIMD-0550 modeling&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The catch? Because the proposal would reduce new SOL issuance, the modeled nominal staking yield would also decline, although actual validator and staker returns can vary depending on staking participation, commissions, MEV and other revenue sources.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal's modeling estimates that, assuming a 68% staking participation rate, staking yield could fall from about &lt;strong&gt;5.84% to 4.34% after one year&lt;/strong&gt;, roughly &lt;strong&gt;3.00% after two years&lt;/strong&gt;, and about &lt;strong&gt;2.25% after three years&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The proposal's modeling also points to tighter validator economics. Under its assumptions, the estimated number of unprofitable validators could rise from roughly &lt;strong&gt;290 at baseline to about 320 by year three&lt;/strong&gt;, depending on operating costs and MEV income.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;So here's the tension: &lt;strong&gt;holders benefit from less dilution, while stakers and validators face pressure on rewards.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Institutional Pushback&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This proposal has already drawn opposition from at least one major player.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Solana Company&lt;/strong&gt;, a Nasdaq-listed firm, said it would vote &lt;strong&gt;against&lt;/strong&gt; SGP-0002. The company's argument is that changing the economic rules during the first governance cycle could create &lt;strong&gt;uncertainty for institutional planning&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;blockquote&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;"In our conversations with institutions, the level of issuance is rarely cited as an obstacle; more commonly, it's uncertainty over whether the network's economics can be relied on over a multi-year horizon."&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;cite&gt;— Joseph Chee, CEO, Solana Company&lt;/cite&gt;
&lt;/blockquote&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Staking was also a major component of Solana Company's Q2 revenue, contributing approximately &lt;strong&gt;$2.5 million&lt;/strong&gt; of its $2.526 million quarterly revenue. Lower staking yields could therefore directly affect the company's economics.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Solana's First Major Stake-Weighted Governance Test&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The vote is also an important early test of Solana's new &lt;strong&gt;stake-weighted governance&lt;/strong&gt; system. Under the governance framework, at least &lt;strong&gt;one-third of eligible staked SOL&lt;/strong&gt; must participate, while &lt;strong&gt;two-thirds of participating stake&lt;/strong&gt; must support the proposal for it to pass.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The vote follows the failed &lt;strong&gt;SIMD-228&lt;/strong&gt; debate in 2025. That proposal sought to make Solana's inflation rate more responsive to staking participation. It got &lt;strong&gt;61.4% support&lt;/strong&gt; but fell short of the &lt;strong&gt;two-thirds threshold&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This time, the stakes are different. SGP-0002 is more targeted: it doesn't change the 1.5% floor, just the speed of getting there.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The SGP-0002 vote is taking place during Solana's current governance &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/bitcoin-in-2011-how-300k-could-move-btc.html"&gt;window&lt;/a&gt; in late August. According to current reporting, the voting window is open until &lt;strong&gt;August 26 at 15:30 UTC&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;SGP-0002 isn't a policy change that happens overnight. If approved, the proposal would still require implementation through &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/term-labs-governance-exploit-drains.html"&gt;Solana's&lt;/a&gt; software-development and feature-gating process before the new schedule takes effect. But the vote itself is a signal.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;For long-term SOL holders:&lt;/strong&gt; Faster disinflation could mean less future dilution.&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;For stakers and validators:&lt;/strong&gt; Lower issuance could put pressure on staking rewards and validator economics.&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;For the broader ecosystem:&lt;/strong&gt; The vote represents an important test of Solana's ability to make difficult economic decisions through stake-weighted governance.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The outcome could influence Solana's inflation schedule and token economics for years to come.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;
