    <title>Can the Same BTC Address Appear Twice? The Real Answer</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh3uw0eNeX2xManYUeXhGZe6E_yweotgpZ33-6ZDEu_LTLiKI7EYhjwIY01frWOVct7lJ6Oisc9dAQ13HnOfA-d2b8HSUGtYmcQ7aul7cSlPPCKRkuouz9IhqxzCqagNYikCIAK_ZMFDYjmw15yMBsxjoFD3aORSjYTXAYrnCKeekHErTFj4ddyHx2Sdd4q/s1733/same-bitcoin-address-generated-twice-btc-2026.webp%20(2).png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Can the same Bitcoin address appear twice? BTC address reuse and wallet recovery" border="0" data-original-height="908" data-original-width="1733" height="336" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh3uw0eNeX2xManYUeXhGZe6E_yweotgpZ33-6ZDEu_LTLiKI7EYhjwIY01frWOVct7lJ6Oisc9dAQ13HnOfA-d2b8HSUGtYmcQ7aul7cSlPPCKRkuouz9IhqxzCqagNYikCIAK_ZMFDYjmw15yMBsxjoFD3aORSjYTXAYrnCKeekHErTFj4ddyHx2Sdd4q/w640-h336/same-bitcoin-address-generated-twice-btc-2026.webp%20(2).png" title="Can the Same Bitcoin Address Appear Twice?" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;By CoinAINews Editorial Team&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin addresses look like random strings of letters and numbers, so it is natural to wonder: &lt;strong&gt;Can the same Bitcoin address appear twice?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The short answer is &lt;strong&gt;yes&lt;/strong&gt; — but there is an important distinction.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The same Bitcoin address can appear again because a wallet derives it from the same underlying key material, because an old address is reused, or because the same wallet has been restored on another device. That is very different from two completely independent wallets randomly generating an identical address.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Understanding that difference also explains why modern Bitcoin wallets usually give users a new receiving address and why repeatedly using one address can reduce financial privacy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Can the Same Bitcoin Address Be Generated Twice?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. The same Bitcoin address can appear more than once.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Modern Bitcoin wallets commonly use hierarchical deterministic, or &lt;strong&gt;HD&lt;/strong&gt;, wallet structures. These wallets derive a sequence of keys and addresses from underlying wallet seed material using deterministic rules.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;As a result, restoring the same wallet with the same recovery material and compatible derivation structure can reproduce addresses that were generated previously.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is not a cryptographic accident. It is one of the reasons deterministic wallets are useful.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin Core's documentation explains that HD wallets use deterministic key derivation, allowing addresses to be derived from the wallet's HD seed when restoring the wallet. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Three Different Things People Mean by “The Same Address Twice”&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This question becomes much easier once three situations are separated.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;1. The Same Wallet Derives the Same Address&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A deterministic wallet can recreate previously derived addresses from its underlying seed and derivation structure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For example, if a compatible wallet is restored from the same recovery seed, it can derive the same sequence of addresses again.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is expected behavior, not a collision.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin Core notes that HD wallets use deterministic key derivation, unlike older non-HD wallets whose keys were not generated from one deterministic seed. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;2. An Existing Address Is Reused&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is probably the simplest explanation when someone sees the same Bitcoin address associated with multiple transactions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A Bitcoin address does not automatically expire after receiving one payment. If you continue using an address that you control, another person can generally send BTC to it again.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.org explains that modern &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/forgot-your-btc-password-heres-honest.html"&gt;wallets &lt;/a&gt;normally generate a new address for each payment, but previously generated addresses remain valid and funds sent to older addresses can still belong to the wallet. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;3. Two Independent Wallets Accidentally Produce the Same Address&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is the scenario that sounds most mysterious.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Two completely independent wallets could theoretically produce the same address because cryptographic systems cannot make the mathematical possibility of every collision literally zero.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But with properly generated cryptographic keys, an accidental collision is extraordinarily unlikely.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;So if the same address appears in two wallets, you should first look for a more ordinary explanation: the same seed was restored, the same private key was imported, wallet data was copied, or the address was intentionally reused.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Same Seed Can Reproduce the Same Address&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Think of an HD wallet as a deterministic tree rather than a bag of unrelated addresses.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The wallet starts with underlying seed material and derives keys according to defined paths and indexes. If the same starting material and compatible rules are used again, the same branch of that tree can be reconstructed.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is why a wallet recovery phrase can restore access to multiple addresses rather than requiring the user to back up every receiving address individually.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin Core's current wallet documentation describes this deterministic recovery model and notes that HD wallets were introduced to avoid the recovery problems associated with older non-HD wallets. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Can Two People Have the Same Bitcoin Address?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It depends on what “have” means.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If two people have access to the same private key or the same wallet recovery material, they may both be able to control funds associated with the corresponding address.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But that is not the same as two unrelated people independently generating the same address by chance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The important security distinction is that the &lt;strong&gt;Bitcoin address is public&lt;/strong&gt;, while the private key or recovery material that authorizes spending must remain secret.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Someone can know your receiving address without automatically gaining the ability to spend the Bitcoin controlled by it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Do Bitcoin Wallets Keep Giving You New Addresses?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If your wallet shows a different receiving address after you receive Bitcoin, that is generally intentional.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Modern wallets commonly generate fresh addresses because Bitcoin transactions are publicly recorded. Using a different address for different payments makes it harder for outside observers to connect all of your activity to one public identifier.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.org specifically recommends using a new address for each payment received because reusing the same address can make it easier for others to link transactions together. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That does not mean your previous addresses have suddenly stopped working.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It simply means your wallet has created another receiving address for future payments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Is Reusing the Same Bitcoin Address Safe?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;From a basic transaction perspective, an address can often be reused. The bigger concern is &lt;strong&gt;privacy&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin transactions are publicly visible on the blockchain. When the same address repeatedly receives payments, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/openai-calls-for-global-ai-standards-as.html"&gt;blockchain&lt;/a&gt; observers can more easily associate those payments with one another.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.org therefore recommends using a new address each time you receive a new payment. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.com gives similar guidance, explaining that address reuse can make it easier for third parties to track activity and estimate information about funds associated with an address. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;So the practical question is not simply whether address reuse “works.” It does. The question is whether you want all of those payments to be more easily connected.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What About Bitcoin Donation Addresses?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is an important exception to the usual privacy advice.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Some websites, charities, open-source projects and public figures intentionally publish a Bitcoin address so anyone can send donations to it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In that situation, having a stable public address can be useful because donors need a reliable destination.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.org specifically notes public donations as a situation where publishing an address can be intentional, although it also warns that transactions involving a public address can reveal information about the associated activity. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;So a public donation address is not necessarily a mistake. It is a deliberate trade-off between convenience, transparency and privacy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What About Exchange Deposit Addresses?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Exchange deposit addresses are a little different from a self-custody wallet.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When you deposit Bitcoin to an exchange, the exchange controls the wallet infrastructure behind the deposit system. The exchange may assign you a specific deposit address, rotate addresses, use different wallet systems, or manage deposits internally after the transaction arrives.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means you should not assume that an exchange deposit address behaves exactly like the receiving addresses in your personal hardware or software wallet.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The safest approach is to use the &lt;strong&gt;current deposit address shown by the exchange for the specific asset and account&lt;/strong&gt; rather than relying on an old address simply because it worked previously.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Exchange users should also verify the network and asset before sending. Sending BTC to an incorrect network or unsupported destination can create a separate recovery problem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Can an Old Bitcoin Address Still Receive BTC?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In many wallet systems, yes.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.org states that previously generated addresses remain valid and that funds sent to older addresses can still belong to the wallet. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.com's wallet documentation similarly says previously generated addresses can remain available for receiving payments. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, wallet software differs in how it manages and displays old addresses. If you are restoring a wallet or recovering funds, the wallet's derivation structure and address-discovery behavior can matter.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What If the Same Address Appears on a Blockchain Explorer?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is nothing unusual about this.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/bernstein-sees-prediction-markets.html"&gt;blockchain explorer &lt;/a&gt;can show one Bitcoin address connected with multiple transactions because the address may have received funds more than once or participated in several transactions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The explorer is not showing that Bitcoin somehow created two identical addresses. It is simply displaying the transaction history associated with that public address.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For example, an address could receive BTC from one person today, receive another payment several weeks later and eventually spend some of its balance. All of those transactions can remain visible on the public blockchain.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Does a New Bitcoin Address Mean a New Wallet?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;No.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is one of the most common misunderstandings about Bitcoin wallets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A single HD wallet can control many Bitcoin addresses. Generating a new receiving address does not necessarily create a completely new wallet.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead, the wallet can derive additional addresses from its underlying wallet structure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is why a person can have dozens, hundreds or potentially far more addresses associated with one wallet while still managing them through one wallet application.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Can Generating the Same Address Break Bitcoin?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The appearance of the same address does not mean Bitcoin's cryptography has failed.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is a fundamental difference between:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Deterministic derivation:&lt;/strong&gt; the same wallet material produces the same address again.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Address reuse:&lt;/strong&gt; an existing address is deliberately used for another payment.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cryptographic collision:&lt;/strong&gt; independent key-generation processes unexpectedly produce the same relevant address representation.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The first two are normal wallet or user behavior. The third is theoretically possible but extraordinarily unlikely when secure cryptographic key generation is used.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Address Reuse Can Reveal More Than You Think&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin's blockchain is public and permanent.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If you repeatedly receive Bitcoin at one address, someone examining the blockchain can potentially connect those transactions together. Depending on what other information is available, this can reveal patterns about payments and balances associated with that address.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.org's privacy guidance recommends fresh addresses for payments and explains that using multiple addresses can make it harder to associate all of a user's transactions together. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This does not make a fresh address an invisibility tool. Blockchain privacy is more complicated than simply changing addresses. But avoiding unnecessary address reuse is one of the basic privacy practices recommended by Bitcoin documentation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Should You Do in Practice?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For ordinary self-custody users, the practical approach is fairly simple:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Use the fresh receiving address generated by your wallet when practical.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Do not assume an old address has become invalid just because the wallet generated a new one.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Never share your private key or recovery phrase merely because someone asks for your Bitcoin address.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;For public donations, understand that a permanent public address can make activity easier to associate.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;For exchanges, use the current deposit address displayed by the exchange and verify the asset and network before sending.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;If you restore a wallet, make sure you are using the correct recovery material and compatible derivation/account structure.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can the exact same Bitcoin address be generated twice?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. The same address can be reproduced through deterministic wallet derivation, or an existing address can simply be reused.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can two random Bitcoin wallets generate the same address?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It is theoretically possible for independent cryptographic processes to collide, but with proper key generation the probability is extraordinarily small. The same address appearing in two wallets is much more likely to have another explanation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does a new Bitcoin address mean I have a new wallet?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No. One HD wallet can control many addresses derived from its underlying wallet seed and derivation structure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can I reuse my old Bitcoin address?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In many cases, yes. However, repeated reuse can reduce privacy because transactions associated with the same public address are easier to connect.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is it okay to use one Bitcoin address for donations?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It can be a deliberate choice when public transparency and convenience are more important than maximum privacy. A public donation address can make related transactions easier to associate.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Should I reuse an old exchange deposit address?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Do not assume an old exchange deposit address is always the correct destination. Use the current deposit instructions provided by the exchange for the specific asset and account.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can someone steal my Bitcoin just by knowing my address?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Knowing a Bitcoin receiving address does not by itself reveal the private key required to authorize a spend. However, the address and its blockchain history are public information.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Why does my Bitcoin wallet keep changing my receiving address?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Most modern wallets do this intentionally to improve privacy. Bitcoin.org recommends fresh addresses for received payments because address reuse makes it easier to link transactions. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What happens when I restore my Bitcoin wallet?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A compatible HD wallet can derive addresses from the same underlying wallet seed again. If the expected addresses do not appear, the wallet's derivation path, account structure or recovery process may need to be checked.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Yes, the same Bitcoin address can appear twice — but that does not mean Bitcoin randomly created a duplicate address.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The most common explanations are deterministic wallet recovery, the same key material being used in multiple wallet instances, or simple address reuse.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Two completely independent wallets accidentally producing the same address is a very different scenario and is extraordinarily unlikely with proper cryptographic key generation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For everyday users, the bigger issue is usually privacy. Modern wallets generally provide fresh receiving addresses because using a different address for different payments makes blockchain activity harder to connect. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The easiest way to remember it is this: &lt;strong&gt;new address does not mean new wallet, old address does not automatically mean invalid, and seeing the same address twice does not automatically mean a cryptographic collision.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin addresses are designed to be shared for receiving payments. The information that must remain secret is the private key or recovery material that controls the funds.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjbfcrg_YkQe1RkuMq6uVnqqSuRowB2c3A3al37GcZ108Og2PSbVI7OkenL-Qo2vT3ll0I2yiw8_GF32PYAd5pMES9sbVZZDysyP1gQfHmcQWKz8CaQS_y9DTnc0gsyuEu3NcprTmN8Wvje4gE4DkeugNzCXwTP4kdEDAzm0J_ZUSKn5IwKKvOVZwn2mmGK/s1672/poland-crypto-bill-veto-parliament-2026.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Poland parliament crypto bill veto leaves cryptocurrency regulation uncertain" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjbfcrg_YkQe1RkuMq6uVnqqSuRowB2c3A3al37GcZ108Og2PSbVI7OkenL-Qo2vT3ll0I2yiw8_GF32PYAd5pMES9sbVZZDysyP1gQfHmcQWKz8CaQS_y9DTnc0gsyuEu3NcprTmN8Wvje4gE4DkeugNzCXwTP4kdEDAzm0J_ZUSKn5IwKKvOVZwn2mmGK/w640-h360/poland-crypto-bill-veto-parliament-2026.jpg.png" title="Poland Crypto Bill Stalls After Presidential Veto" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large; font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large; font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;
September 5, 2026&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Poland’s attempt to establish a new regulatory framework for
the cryptocurrency market has hit another roadblock after parliament failed to
secure enough votes to override President Karol Nawrocki’s veto of a
crypto-assets bill.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The Sejm, Poland’s lower house of parliament, voted on
September 4 on whether to overturn the presidential veto. Lawmakers voted 241
in favor of the override, 198 against and three abstained. However, 266 votes
were required, leaving the motion 25 votes short of the threshold.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The result means the bill remains blocked in its current
form and leaves Poland’s domestic crypto regulatory framework facing further
uncertainty as the country continues to work within the European Union’s
broader Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regime.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The dispute also highlights a wider policy debate over how
Poland should regulate digital assets while balancing consumer protection,
financial-crime controls and the competitiveness of its cryptocurrency
industry.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h2 style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The Vote That Keeps Poland’s Crypto Rules in Limbo&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The September 4 vote was an attempt by parliament to
overturn President Nawrocki’s veto of the crypto-assets legislation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The final result was:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;table border="0" cellpadding="0" class="MsoNormalTable"&gt;
 &lt;thead&gt;
  &lt;tr&gt;

  &lt;td style="border: solid windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: solid windowtext .5pt; padding: .75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Shortfall&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="border: solid windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: solid windowtext .5pt; padding: .75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt;"&gt;

  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;With only 241 lawmakers supporting the override, the
required majority was not reached.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;That means the president’s veto remains effective and the
legislation cannot become law in its current form.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Importantly, the failed override does not mean
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/bis-researchers-test-xrp-ledger-official-statistics.html"&gt;cryptocurrency&lt;/a&gt; has been banned in Poland. Crypto assets and related
businesses remain part of the country’s financial and regulatory landscape. The
immediate issue is that this particular national crypto legislation has been
stopped following the presidential veto.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;For crypto companies operating in Poland, however, the
result creates another period of uncertainty over what additional domestic
rules could eventually be introduced alongside European regulations.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;What Was Poland Trying to Change?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The legislation was designed to strengthen Poland’s
regulatory framework for crypto-assets and give the Polish Financial
Supervision Authority, known as KNF, stronger supervisory powers over the
sector.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;One of the main objectives was to bring Poland’s domestic
framework more closely into line with the European Union’s Markets in
Crypto-Assets Regulation, commonly known as MiCA.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;MiCA provides a common regulatory framework for crypto-asset
issuers and service providers across the European Union. Its broader objectives
include improving consumer protection, strengthening market integrity and
creating clearer rules for companies operating in the digital-asset industry.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Poland’s proposed legislation was therefore not simply about
creating rules for cryptocurrencies from scratch. It was also about
establishing how the country would implement and supplement the European
framework through its own national regulatory system.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;That distinction has become central to the political debate.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;How the Bill Reached the President&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The legislation had already passed several important stages
before reaching President Nawrocki.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;On May 15, 2026, Poland’s Sejm approved the crypto-assets
bill by 241 votes to 200, with no abstentions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The Senate subsequently adopted its position without
amendments. The legislation was then sent to the president on May 22.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;President Karol Nawrocki vetoed the bill on June 11.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Supporters of the legislation subsequently sought to
overturn the veto, leading to the September 4 vote in the Sejm.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The attempt ultimately failed because parliament could not
reach the required 266 votes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Why Did President Nawrocki Reject the Bill?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;President Nawrocki has argued that the proposed legislation
would impose excessive regulatory pressure on Poland’s cryptocurrency industry.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;One of his central concerns is that overly restrictive
regulation could make Poland less attractive for crypto businesses and
potentially encourage companies to move their operations or activities to other
jurisdictions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;From the president’s perspective, regulation should protect
consumers and address financial risks without creating unnecessary barriers for
legitimate companies.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Nawrocki has also indicated support for an alternative
legislative approach.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;His proposal seeks to combine regulatory oversight with
stronger measures related to consumer protection, fraud prevention and
financial crime while addressing concerns about excessive regulation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;This makes the disagreement more complicated than a simple
argument between regulation and deregulation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Both sides recognize that the &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/south-korea-tokenize-stocks-bonds-funds-2027.html"&gt;cryptocurrency industry&lt;/a&gt;
requires oversight. The main disagreement concerns how much regulation is
appropriate, what powers regulators should receive and how those rules could
affect Poland’s competitiveness.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The Government Wants Stronger Oversight&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Prime Minister Donald Tusk and supporters of the legislation
have taken a different position.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The government has argued that stronger regulatory oversight
is necessary to protect consumers and address risks associated with the
cryptocurrency market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Tusk urged lawmakers to override the presidential veto ahead
of the vote and pointed to concerns involving illicit finance and the need for
effective regulatory supervision.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The government’s position is that regulators need sufficient
authority to respond when problems emerge in the digital-asset sector.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;For policymakers, the challenge is therefore to create a
system that can address fraud, financial crime and consumer risks while still
allowing legitimate cryptocurrency businesses to operate.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Why Zondacrypto Became Part of the Debate&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The political discussion has also been influenced by
concerns surrounding cryptocurrency businesses operating in Poland, including
the situation involving Zondacrypto.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Government officials have referred to the investigation
involving the cryptocurrency company as part of the broader argument for
stronger regulatory oversight.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;However, it is important not to overstate the connection.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The existence of an investigation does not establish that
the proposed crypto legislation would have prevented the issues involved.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Instead, the case has become part of the political debate
over whether Polish authorities have sufficient powers and tools to supervise
cryptocurrency companies and respond to potential problems.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;That distinction matters because regulation cannot
automatically guarantee that financial misconduct or operational failures will
never occur.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;What the Failed Vote Does — and Does Not — Mean&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The immediate consequence of the failed vote is
straightforward: the crypto-assets bill remains blocked after President
Nawrocki’s veto.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;But the result should not be interpreted as a ban on
cryptocurrency in Poland.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;It also does not mean that Poland is outside Europe’s crypto
regulatory framework.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;MiCA remains an important part of the regulatory environment
for crypto-asset businesses operating across the European Union.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The unresolved question is how Poland will build its own
domestic framework around that European system.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;That could include decisions about licensing, supervision,
enforcement powers and consumer protections.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;For businesses, the uncertainty lies in what additional
national requirements Poland could introduce and when those rules might take
shape.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-large;"&gt;Why Crypto Companies Are Watching Closely&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Regulatory uncertainty can have significant consequences for
cryptocurrency companies.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Businesses operating in the sector often need to make
long-term decisions about licensing, compliance systems, employees, banking
relationships, technology infrastructure and where they establish their
operations.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Clear regulations can make those decisions easier because
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/small-crypto-transactions-are-draining.html"&gt;companies know&lt;/a&gt; what requirements they need to meet.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Uncertainty, on the other hand, can make it more difficult
to plan investments and expansion.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;For international crypto companies, Poland’s situation is
also relevant because businesses increasingly compare regulatory environments
across European jurisdictions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;If Poland adopts a framework viewed as excessively
restrictive, companies could potentially consider other markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;If the country creates a clear and predictable system that
effectively works alongside MiCA, it could provide greater certainty for
businesses while strengthening consumer protections.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;MiCA Adds Another Layer to Poland’s Crypto Debate&lt;/span&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Poland’s regulatory debate cannot be separated from the
European Union’s MiCA framework.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;MiCA was introduced to create more consistent rules for
crypto-assets and crypto-asset service providers across the EU.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;For companies operating in multiple European markets,
harmonized regulation can reduce the complexity of dealing with substantially
different national systems.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;However, national governments still have important
responsibilities in implementing and enforcing the broader regulatory
framework.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;That creates a difficult balance for Poland.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The country needs to ensure that its domestic rules work
with European requirements while also determining how much additional oversight
should be provided to national authorities.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The failed veto override shows that lawmakers and the
president have not yet reached agreement on that balance.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Could Poland Introduce Another Crypto Bill?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Yes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The failed attempt to override the veto does not end the
legislative debate over cryptocurrency regulation in Poland.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;President Nawrocki has already indicated support for an
alternative approach, meaning another proposal could eventually be considered.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;A future bill could attempt to address some of the concerns
raised by the president while retaining stronger consumer-protection and
financial-crime provisions favored by the government.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The exact form and timing of any replacement legislation
remain uncertain.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;For now, the existing bill is blocked, and policymakers must
determine whether they can reach a compromise or whether a substantially
different proposal will be required.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Poland’s government and parliament now face the task of
determining how to move forward with crypto regulation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The next phase is likely to focus on several competing
priorities:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0in;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Stronger
     regulatory supervision &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Consumer
     protection &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Fraud
     prevention &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Financial-crime
     controls &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Compliance
     with the EU’s MiCA framework &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Maintaining
     Poland’s attractiveness to legitimate crypto businesses &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The outcome could determine how Poland positions itself
within Europe’s increasingly regulated digital-asset market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;For crypto companies, the most important factor will be
clarity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Businesses can generally adapt to regulation when
requirements are clearly defined and predictable. The greater challenge is
operating in an environment where the rules remain politically contested and
their future direction is uncertain.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Key Facts&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;table border="1" cellpadding="0" class="MsoNormalTable" style="border: solid windowtext 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: solid windowtext .5pt; mso-border-insideh: .5pt solid windowtext; mso-border-insidev: .5pt solid windowtext; mso-cellspacing: 1.5pt; mso-yfti-tbllook: 1184;"&gt;

  &lt;p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;National crypto-asset

  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Did Poland ban cryptocurrency after the parliamentary
vote?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;No.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The failed vote means parliament did not obtain enough
support to override President Karol Nawrocki’s veto of the crypto-assets bill.
It does not constitute a cryptocurrency ban in Poland.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;How many votes were needed to override the veto?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The Sejm needed 266 votes to override the presidential veto.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The motion received 241 votes in favor, leaving it 25 votes
short.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;What was the final vote?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The final tally was 241 votes in favor of overriding the
veto, 198 against and three abstentions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Why did President Nawrocki veto the crypto bill?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Nawrocki argued that the legislation could impose excessive
regulation on the cryptocurrency industry and potentially make Poland less
attractive to crypto businesses.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;He has supported an alternative approach that also
emphasizes consumer protection, fraud prevention and financial-crime controls.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Why did the Polish government support the bill?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The government argued that stronger regulatory supervision
was needed to protect consumers and address risks involving illicit finance and
the rapidly developing cryptocurrency sector.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;What is MiCA?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;MiCA stands for the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation. It
is the European Union’s regulatory framework for crypto-assets and related
service providers.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Does the failed vote mean Poland has no crypto
regulations?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;No.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The failed vote concerns this particular national
crypto-assets bill. Poland remains subject to the broader European regulatory
environment, including applicable MiCA requirements.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;Could Poland pass another crypto bill?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Yes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The failed veto override does not prevent lawmakers from
pursuing another legislative proposal. President Nawrocki has also indicated
support for an alternative regulatory approach.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: normal;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-large;"&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;Poland’s attempt to advance a new crypto-assets regulatory
framework has stalled again after parliament failed to override President Karol
Nawrocki’s veto.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The 241 votes supporting the override were not enough to
reach the required 266, leaving the legislation blocked.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The result does not mean cryptocurrency has been banned in
Poland. Instead, it leaves the country facing another period of uncertainty
over how its domestic crypto rules should evolve alongside the European Union’s
MiCA framework.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The political disagreement is ultimately about finding the
right balance.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;The government wants stronger supervision and protections
against financial risks, while President Nawrocki has warned that excessive
regulation could push crypto businesses away from Poland.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;With the current bill now blocked, attention will shift
toward whether lawmakers can negotiate a compromise or develop a new proposal.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium; font-weight: normal;"&gt;For Poland’s cryptocurrency industry, the next chapter will
be closely watched—not only because of the rules themselves, but because the
country’s eventual approach could influence how attractive its market remains
to crypto businesses operating across Europe.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;

    <title>Next Coin to Pump? Traders Are Watching These Crypto Signals</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiCS2MFiKRGbJNpjyX_HZZhmhHiQjORoHBlGE9k8WLfXMAjBqF2ZgRsM2HHkBoZSeAaTkM0xW9u-kas-hHNYU5WpUq69d6SgokdUA__A_pMIWTHMDiQkoR41IoaI3FgGAsDagdSVoVgeqzACY5D0t4rgJGKqM1UM25yNm_M16i6Z3AoWfSmiclEHMJEKtE2/s1672/next-coin-to-pump-altcoin-crypto-market-momentum.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Crypto traders watching altcoin momentum for the next potential breakout" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiCS2MFiKRGbJNpjyX_HZZhmhHiQjORoHBlGE9k8WLfXMAjBqF2ZgRsM2HHkBoZSeAaTkM0xW9u-kas-hHNYU5WpUq69d6SgokdUA__A_pMIWTHMDiQkoR41IoaI3FgGAsDagdSVoVgeqzACY5D0t4rgJGKqM1UM25yNm_M16i6Z3AoWfSmiclEHMJEKtE2/w400-h225/next-coin-to-pump-altcoin-crypto-market-momentum.jpg.png" title="Next Coin to Pump? Crypto Traders Watch Altcoin Momentum" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/b&gt; | &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The crypto market is asking a familiar question again: &lt;b&gt;which
coin could be next to pump?&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;CoinMarketCap recently put that question directly to its
audience on X, triggering another round of speculation among crypto traders
looking for the next big mover.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;There is, of course, no simple answer.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto markets can change direction within hours, and the
token showing the strongest momentum today is not necessarily the one that
leads the market tomorrow. Instead of trying to name a guaranteed winner,
traders are increasingly watching &lt;b&gt;volume, liquidity, market narratives and
the strength of individual tokens relative to the broader market&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That could be more useful than simply chasing the biggest
green candle.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why Traders Are Searching for the Next Big Mover&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto rallies often move in stages.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin usually attracts the first wave of attention. When
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/grant-cardone-adds-350-btc-to-fort.html"&gt;BTC stabilizes&lt;/a&gt; or starts moving higher, traders often begin looking further
down the market-cap rankings for assets that could potentially deliver larger
percentage gains.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That can lead to capital rotating into large-cap altcoins,
sector-specific tokens and eventually smaller, more speculative projects.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Meme coins are one example.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;AI-related cryptocurrencies are another.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;DeFi, infrastructure and newer blockchain ecosystems can
also suddenly become market favorites when traders decide that a particular
narrative has room to run.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Recent CoinMarketCap coverage has highlighted how quickly
individual tokens can outperform or reverse, with PUMP showing momentum while
other meme and altcoin names experienced very different price action.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The bigger takeaway is that crypto momentum can shift
quickly.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Biggest Green Candle Isn't Always the Best Signal&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A token jumping 30% in a day will naturally attract
attention.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But price alone does not explain why the move is happening.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A rally supported by rising spot volume, improving liquidity
and a clear catalyst is very different from a short-lived move in a thinly
traded token.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That's why traders searching for the next potential breakout
often watch several signals together.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The key ones include:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Rising
     trading volume&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Stronger
     market liquidity&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Increasing
     exchange activity&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Improving
     on-chain activity&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Growing
     social interest&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A
     clear project-specific catalyst&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Continued
     relative strength against the broader market&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;None of these guarantees a rally.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But when several appear together, they can provide a better
picture of whether a move has genuine participation behind it.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Meme Coins Could Remain on Traders' Radar&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Meme coins are usually among the first sectors traders watch
when speculative appetite returns.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Their appeal is straightforward. A relatively small amount
of additional buying can sometimes produce large percentage moves, particularly
in tokens with strong communities and active trading markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But the same characteristic makes them risky.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;CoinMarketCap's recent coverage has shown both sides of the
trade. PUMP has attracted attention around revenue, buybacks, technical
momentum and social activity, while other meme-related assets have struggled or
reversed after earlier rallies.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That means traders should be careful about treating a sudden
meme-coin rally as proof that a broader meme season has arrived.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A few tokens moving sharply does not automatically mean the
entire sector is entering a sustained uptrend.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;AI Tokens Are Another Narrative to Watch&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Artificial intelligence remains one of the major themes
connecting traditional technology markets with crypto.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;AI-related tokens can benefit when traders rotate into
narrative-driven assets, particularly when individual projects have visible
development activity, growing ecosystems or new catalysts.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But simply having “AI” in a project's marketing is not
enough.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Traders may want to look at actual network usage, developer
activity, liquidity, partnerships and token economics before assuming that a
project can maintain momentum.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The distinction is important because narrative-driven
rallies can be extremely fast — and equally fast to reverse.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Liquidity Could Be the Real Clue&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If there is one factor that can help explain why certain
&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/arthur-hayes-warns-ai-bubble-could.html"&gt;cryptocurrencies&lt;/a&gt; suddenly outperform, it is liquidity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;When traders become more comfortable taking risk, capital
can move progressively further down the risk curve.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A simplified version of that process looks like this:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Bitcoin strengthens → large-cap altcoins gain attention →
sector leaders outperform → smaller tokens attract speculation&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It does not happen every time, but the pattern is familiar
across crypto markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This is why watching Bitcoin remains important even when the
goal is to identify an altcoin opportunity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If BTC suddenly falls sharply, many speculative altcoin
setups can disappear just as quickly.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Could Make a Coin Stand Out?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Rather than asking which coin will definitely pump, traders
can ask a more practical question:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Which tokens are showing signs that demand is increasing
before the move becomes obvious?&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Several characteristics can help answer that.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;1. Rising Volume&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A sustained increase in volume alongside price strength is
generally more meaningful than a price move occurring with very little trading
activity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Volume shows that more market participants are involved.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;2. A Real Catalyst&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A protocol upgrade, major partnership, exchange listing,
product launch, governance change or other identifiable development can give
traders a reason to reassess a token.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A rally without an obvious catalyst deserves additional
caution.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;3. Improving Liquidity&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Liquidity determines how easily traders can enter and exit
positions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A token can rise rapidly in a thin market, but that also
means it can fall just as quickly when buyers disappear.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;4. Relative Strength&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A token that continues outperforming its sector while the
broader market is moving sideways can be worth monitoring.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Relative strength can sometimes reveal where traders are
concentrating capital.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;5. Sustainable Attention&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Social-media activity can be a powerful short-term catalyst
in crypto.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;However, social attention becomes more meaningful when it is
accompanied by actual trading volume, liquidity and user activity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Don't Confuse a Pump With a Trend&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This is perhaps the most important point.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A &lt;b&gt;pump&lt;/b&gt; can last minutes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A &lt;b&gt;trend&lt;/b&gt; can last weeks or months.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;They are not the same thing.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A token that suddenly jumps 50% could simply be experiencing
a speculative burst. Another token may move more slowly but continue making
higher highs while trading activity and liquidity improve.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The second setup can be more interesting from a trend
perspective.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That doesn't mean it is guaranteed to succeed.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It simply means the move has more evidence behind it.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Market May Rotate Before the Crowd Notices&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto narratives can change surprisingly quickly.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;One week traders may focus on meme coins. The next week
attention can move toward AI, DeFi or a particular blockchain ecosystem.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This makes the “next coin to pump” question difficult to
answer in advance.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The token that eventually becomes the market leader may not
be the one making the biggest move today.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It could be an asset that is quietly building volume,
attracting users and gaining relative strength before broader market attention
arrives.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That is why traders often build watchlists rather than
relying on a single prediction.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Traders Should Watch Now&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A useful watchlist can focus on a combination of measurable
signals rather than hype.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Look for tokens showing:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Price strength + rising volume + improving liquidity + a
credible catalyst.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;When those factors appear together, a token may deserve
closer attention.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Still, none of them eliminates risk.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto remains highly volatile, and even a technically
strong setup can fail if market-wide risk appetite suddenly changes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Recent CoinMarketCap market coverage is a good reminder of
that dynamic: some assets have rallied sharply while others have experienced
fast reversals or broader deleveraging.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;So, Which Coin Is Next?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;There is no reliable way to identify the next major
cryptocurrency winner before the move happens.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Anyone claiming to know with certainty which coin will be
the next 10x or 100x performer is making a prediction, not stating a fact.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The more useful approach is to identify &lt;b&gt;where momentum,
liquidity and genuine market interest are beginning to converge&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Meme coins could benefit if speculative appetite expands.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;AI tokens could attract attention if the AI narrative
strengthens.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Large-cap altcoins could lead if Bitcoin establishes a
stronger trend.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;And completely different sectors could take over if the
market narrative changes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The market decides which one wins.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;CoinMarketCap's &lt;b&gt;“Next coin to pump?”&lt;/b&gt; question
captures one of crypto trading's most persistent habits: investors are always
looking for the next major mover.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But there is no guaranteed answer.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Instead of chasing whichever token has already made the
biggest move, traders can watch &lt;b&gt;volume, liquidity, relative strength,
catalysts and sector rotation&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Recent market activity shows why that approach matters. Some
tokens have attracted strong momentum, while others have quickly reversed after
speculative rallies.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The next big opportunity may therefore not be the coin that
is already pumping.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It could be the one quietly gaining &lt;b&gt;volume, liquidity and
attention before the wider market notices&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For now, that is the signal worth watching.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;CoinAINews provides independent coverage of
cryptocurrency, technology, finance and digital-asset markets. This article is
for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
