    <title>Crypto Regulation Could Reverse Without Congress, Miller Whitehouse-Levine Warns</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh0iWb3mpGJ-vXi9zdwLyG4IyfPRSk-DX8Uyo8VbVhwY_3a3xKSj6ld7SZyxX6di5p5bZfm_rFwqDj9cToFnNKS6bSuLT4ardtlt2d2yEcolRJyx_97_a5oAN_X54H83_YvzDZkToeBou0pOcpgnsfc50Cky-6zGDhG8pf1EmxYaEy91k0aBgypWueZ7KKT/s1672/crypto-regulation-miller-whitehouse-levine-congress.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="U.S. Capitol surrounded by blockchain elements representing uncertainty over future crypto regulation" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="180" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh0iWb3mpGJ-vXi9zdwLyG4IyfPRSk-DX8Uyo8VbVhwY_3a3xKSj6ld7SZyxX6di5p5bZfm_rFwqDj9cToFnNKS6bSuLT4ardtlt2d2yEcolRJyx_97_a5oAN_X54H83_YvzDZkToeBou0pOcpgnsfc50Cky-6zGDhG8pf1EmxYaEy91k0aBgypWueZ7KKT/w320-h180/crypto-regulation-miller-whitehouse-levine-congress.jpg.png" title="U.S. Capitol surrounded by blockchain elements representing uncertainty over future crypto regulation" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The U.S. crypto industry has made significant regulatory
gains over the past year, but those gains may prove difficult to preserve
without legislation from Congress.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That's the warning coming from Miller Whitehouse-Levine, CEO
of the Solana Policy Institute. His concern is that while federal agencies can
deliver regulatory progress, those rules may be less durable than legislation
passed by &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/which-smart-contract-standards-are.html"&gt;Congress&lt;/a&gt;—and a future administration could potentially reverse or
modify them.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Core Problem: Agencies Can't Offer Permanence&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Whitehouse-Levine's warning comes as sweeping U.S. crypto
legislation remains stalled in Congress, leaving federal agencies to fill the
void. The industry-backed CLARITY Act, which aims to define whether crypto
tokens should be regulated as securities or commodities, remains stalled in
Congress, leaving its path forward uncertain.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That impasse has put the onus on the Trump administration's
crypto-friendly regulators, particularly the Securities and Exchange Commission
and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The SEC has been working on
proposed exemptions that could ease securities requirements for certain crypto
offerings, while the CFTC is moving ahead with discussions on additional
cryptocurrency regulation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;"The agencies ... seemingly are ready to act, given
that Congress has been unwilling or unable to do so," Whitehouse-Levine
told Reuters.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But here's the catch: regulations introduced by federal
agencies could face court challenges or be reversed by future administrations.
The shift in regulatory priorities between administrations shows how quickly
federal crypto policy can change.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;And that's exactly what Whitehouse-Levine is worried about.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The "Gensler 2.0" Fear&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Whitehouse-Levine's broader concern is that the industry's
recent regulatory progress remains vulnerable without durable legislation. That
concern was echoed by crypto executives who warned that a future administration
could create a "Gensler 2.0" scenario.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The concern reflects how quickly U.S. &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/openai-president-greg-brockman-warns.html"&gt;crypto policy&lt;/a&gt; can
change under a new administration. Under former President Joe Biden, SEC Chair
Gary Gensler sued dozens of crypto companies, including Coinbase, Binance, and
Ripple, arguing that many digital assets qualified as securities and should
have been registered with the agency. Gensler famously described the crypto
market as "rife with fraud, scams and abuse," comparing it to
"the Wild West."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Some executives even fear that a future administration could
install crypto hawks like Gensler once again.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Josh Riezman, chief legal and strategy officer at crypto
trading firm GSR, put it bluntly:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;"But then the next administration, depending on how
that shakes out, we can be looking very much like a potentially Gensler 2.0
type scenario."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Progress That Could Be Undone&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The industry has seen significant gains under the current
administration. SEC Chair Paul Atkins, appointed in April 2025, has moved away
from the enforcement-first approach of his predecessor. The SEC has stepped
back from several major enforcement cases involving crypto companies, including
Coinbase, Binance and Ripple. It has issued formal guidance on token
classification through a joint memorandum with the CFTC.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The GENIUS Act, which provides regulatory clarity for
stablecoins, became law in July 2025. But without broader market-structure
legislation, the industry's regulatory gains remain vulnerable to future policy
changes.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Whitehouse-Levine has repeatedly emphasized that these gains
are fragile. Without permanent legislation, regulatory policy can shift with
every new administration.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Deeper Concern: Legal Ambiguity as a Weapon&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Whitehouse-Levine's anxiety goes beyond who sits in the SEC
chair. The deeper problem, as he sees it, is that "crypto better than any
other industry unfortunately understands how legal ambiguities or
interpretations can be weaponized against an industry."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Even if the industry secures its biggest legislative wins,
the old legal frameworks—the Securities Act of 1933, the Securities Exchange
Act of 1934, and the Commodity Exchange Act of 1936—are still on the books. A
future administration hostile to crypto could simply reinterpret these laws in
ways that once again make it impossible for the industry to operate.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Whitehouse-Levine, who previously worked at the DeFi
Education Fund, has consistently argued for a clear regulatory distinction
between centralized exchanges and decentralized finance software. Under a
Gensler-like approach, however, this distinction would likely disappear,
subjecting DeFi projects to the same burdens as centralized exchanges.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Political Reality&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The path forward isn't straightforward. While many Democrats
support creating a regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies, they generally
favor tougher safeguards against money laundering, fraud, and conflicts of
interest than Republican lawmakers. Potential Democratic gains in the November
midterm elections could give lawmakers greater power to scrutinize SEC and CFTC
rulemaking efforts.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Meanwhile, traditional Wall Street firms that strongly
oppose some SEC and CFTC crypto policies could also complicate implementation.
The CME Group sued the CFTC in June over its decision to approve perpetual
crypto futures, while industry groups have urged the SEC to place tighter
limits on blockchain-based stock trading plans.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Happens Next&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For the crypto industry, the immediate question is whether
regulators can provide meaningful relief while Congress remains deadlocked. The
SEC and CFTC can move ahead with rules and exemptions, but those measures
remain more exposed to litigation and future policy changes than a statute
passed by Congress.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Reuters reported that the agencies are preparing to fill the
gap left by stalled legislation, making the next phase of U.S. crypto policy
increasingly dependent on regulators rather than lawmakers.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That does not mean the industry's recent progress is
meaningless. It means the durability of that progress remains uncertain. If
Congress eventually passes comprehensive market-structure legislation, it could
establish rules that are harder for a future administration to reverse.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The central issue facing U.S. crypto regulation is no longer
simply whether the industry will receive friendlier rules. It is whether those
rules will survive a change in political leadership.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Miller Whitehouse-Levine's warning highlights the weakness
of relying too heavily on administrative policy. The SEC and CFTC can provide
meaningful regulatory relief, but congressional legislation would give the
industry a more durable legal foundation. Reuters' latest reporting shows that
agencies are already moving to fill the gap created by stalled legislation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For crypto companies, investors and developers, that
distinction matters. Regulatory momentum can change quickly. A permanent
statutory framework would make that change far less disruptive.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</content>

border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-style: none; border-width: medium; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; height: 1px; margin: 32px 0px;" /&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Space Network has signed a $50 million binding pre-order agreement for its Freeport satellite network services with HQ Company International Holdings, Inc. to deliver decentralized satellite communications infrastructure across the Philippines .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The official signing ceremony was held at the SKY 31 Convention in Seoul, attended by key executives from both organizations, including Tae Lim Oh, CEO of Space Network, and Yongsoo Samuel Cho, CEO of HQ Company .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;As the grandson-in-law of the 12th President of the Philippines, Fidel V. Ramos, Mr. Cho has lived in the Philippines for many years, leading cross-border investments and infrastructure enterprises while fostering economic and cultural exchanges between South Korea and the Philippines .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;"The Philippines has more than 7,000 islands, and reaching all of them has always been the hardest part of building telecom infrastructure here," said Yongsoo Samuel Cho, CEO of HQ Company. "Freeport gives us a satellite network we can build our own services on, designed around what Philippine customers actually need. We're excited to get started" .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What Is Freeport?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Freeport is the core of Space Network: the LEO satellite network Space Network builds, launches and operates as the foundation for an open, global connectivity network. Space Network currently operates four LEO satellites and plans to grow the Freeport constellation to approximately 230 by 2029, when commercial services begin .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The name comes from trade. A freeport is a zone where goods move under lighter rules, and any trader can use the port without owning it. Freeport brings that idea to connectivity. Telecom operators like HQ Company buy capacity in the regions they serve and run their own services on top of it, without building a constellation of their own. Independently owned satellites and ground stations can also join the network, carry each other's traffic and get paid for it automatically, so every operator that joins adds coverage and capacity the next one can use .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Freeport delivers two kinds of service. In space, satellites link to each other by laser, forming a secure optical network that carries data long distances without touching the public internet. On the ground, Ka-band links deliver private connectivity to businesses and governments anywhere on Earth, from remote mines and rigs to national networks .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Every Freeport node runs the same in-house software stack:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;ul style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px; padding-left: 18px;"&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;SOLAR (routing):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; lets the sender choose the path its traffic takes through the network, so control over routing stays with the customer&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;LUMEN (settlement):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; each hop signs for the data it actually delivered and is paid through on-chain contracts, so operators who have never met can carry each other's traffic without invoices or intermediaries&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;PHOTON (payment):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; private payments powered by zero-knowledge cryptography, keeping payment details confidential&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li style="margin-top: 6px;"&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="margin-bottom: 0px; margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px !important;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;SPONTE:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; Space Network's universal satellite operating system, which lets spacecraft from any manufacturer join the network&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;To accelerate Freeport's development, Space Network recently appointed Jinmin Chung as VP of Engineering. Chung is a former Executive Vice President at Samsung Electronics, where he headed the Software Innovation Center at Samsung Research and led the telephony, network and connectivity frameworks for the Tizen platform .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;The Partnership&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Under the $50 million partnership, Space Network will supply the Freeport network access, technical hardware, proprietary software stack and ongoing engineering support. HQ Company will lead local commercial operations, including sales, customer acquisition, spectrum authorizations and regional service execution across the Philippines .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The agreement follows Space Network's $100 million deal with Vietnam's DETI Technology, signed in June 2026, and brings its total commercial pre-orders to $150 million .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;This local operator-centric expansion aligns directly with the vision of Spacecoin, a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/cboe-and-s-dow-jones-extend-1-trillion.html"&gt;blockchain &lt;/a&gt;project combining LEO satellite hardware with Web3 technology to build an open, decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN). The agreement is a concrete commercial deployment of Spacecoin's global connectivity vision in the Philippine telecommunications market .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;"Samuel's team knows this market in a way we currently don't yet, and that's exactly how Freeport is meant to work," said Tae Lim Oh, CEO of Space Network. "We build the network, and local partners run the service in the markets they know best. The Philippines is the second country to commit this year, and it won't be the last" .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What Is Spacecoin?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Spacecoin is a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/secs-new-stance-on-token-buybacks-could.html"&gt;Web3 project&lt;/a&gt; combining blockchain protocols with low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite technology to build an open, decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN). By expanding connectivity options in underserved regions, Spacecoin aims to provide universal, borderless and reliable internet access .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Space Network is the neutral layer that lets independently owned satellites, ground stations, and terminals in orbit and on the ground carry each other's traffic — and get paid for it — without anyone's permission. To keep it permissionless, Space Network uses permissionless currency, Spacecoin. Satellites within the Space Network price their relay services in Spacecoin. Users pay satellites in Spacecoin to transmit their data. If Space Network used a currency gated by anyone, it could not stay neutral. If it used another currency not optimized for space telecommunications, Space Network could not optimize its performance. Hence why Spacecoin is being built .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;About HQ Company&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;HQ Company International Holdings, Inc. is an infrastructure company in the Philippines specializing in solar energy and renewable infrastructure. Dedicated to advancing underserved markets in the Philippines, HQ Company is building and deploying sustainable energy and satellite communication networks across the nation. Led by CEO Yongsoo Samuel Cho, HQ Company draws on extensive local networks and cross-border &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/tether-freezes-nearly-550-million-in.html"&gt;investment &lt;/a&gt;expertise to drive large-scale infrastructure projects .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What did Space Network and HQ Company sign?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;A $50 million binding pre-order agreement for Freeport satellite communication services in the Philippines .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What is Freeport?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;A decentralized satellite internet network that allows local operators to lease capacity without launching their own satellites. It operates 4 LEO satellites today and plans to expand to approximately 230 by 2029 .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;How does this connect to Spacecoin?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Space Network is the infrastructure company behind Spacecoin, a DePIN project that uses the SPACE token to fund and coordinate the satellite network. Satellites price their relay services in Spacecoin .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What was the Vietnam deal?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;A $100 million MOU with DETI Technology signed in June 2026, targeting Vietnamese telecom operators with a three-year exclusivity period .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;What's next?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Space Network plans to expand to approximately 230 satellites by 2029, with the Philippines and Vietnam serving as early commercial markets. The company says the Philippines is the second country to commit this year, "and it won't be the last" .&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600;"&gt;Bottom line:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class="" style="color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"&gt; Space Network's Philippines deal brings its total pre-orders to $150 million and marks another step toward commercializing its Freeport satellite network. The company is targeting emerging markets where traditional broadband infrastructure falls short. But the hard parts — spectrum licensing, service rollout, and actual revenue — are still ahead.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"&gt;head.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</content>

    <title>XRP Ledger 3.3.0 Proposes Confidential Transfers for $530M in Tokenized Assets</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg0bG-VwK3ZgWyauMK73sz9B3bNzhUdgYmuh5wmxZMxDoANy0Pl4niDJJgTpEbXfIOZFulj6s1viRE8XzwKMWG40lz460YYeu1JAXbumOMtJpG1_6IRtwIJ_3t1lhc6dpRLyDDOyWDo5HwKAXrIdXeMDWe6pNq5-d09v3qa8_bjBlKBRFE1LUINN4LIx3LX/s1536/xrp%20ledger.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="XRPL 3.3.0 proposes Confidential Transfers for 530 million tokenized assets on XRP Ledger" border="0" data-original-height="1024" data-original-width="1536" height="213" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg0bG-VwK3ZgWyauMK73sz9B3bNzhUdgYmuh5wmxZMxDoANy0Pl4niDJJgTpEbXfIOZFulj6s1viRE8XzwKMWG40lz460YYeu1JAXbumOMtJpG1_6IRtwIJ_3t1lhc6dpRLyDDOyWDo5HwKAXrIdXeMDWe6pNq5-d09v3qa8_bjBlKBRFE1LUINN4LIx3LX/w320-h213/xrp%20ledger.png" title="XRPL 3.3.0 Proposes Confidential Transfers for $530M Tokenized Assets | CoinaiNews" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Aug 10, 2026&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;– The XRP Ledger has taken another
step toward expanding its role in institutional finance. The upcoming XRPL
3.3.0 upgrade proposes a "Confidential Transfers" feature that would
let institutions encrypt token balances and payment amounts for tokenized
assets while keeping accounts and token types visible on the public ledger.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The timing matters. More than&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;$1.38 billion&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;in
tokenized real-world assets already sit on the XRPL, including positions from
RLUSD, Ondo, VERT Capital, Archax, and Société Générale. Selected issuers
tracked by&amp;nbsp;&lt;a href="https://rwa.xyz/" target="_blank"&gt;RWA.xyz&lt;/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;include:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" class="MsoNormalTable" style="border-collapse: collapse; mso-yfti-tbllook: 1184; width: 744px;"&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The figures above represent selected issuers and therefore
do not account for the full $1.38 billion tracked total. Excluding RLUSD, more
than $530 million in tracked tokenized assets remain on XRPL, although only
eligible MPT-based assets could use the proposed privacy feature.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;How Confidential Transfers Work — Without Breaking the
Ledger&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The feature targets Multi-Purpose Tokens (MPTs), the token
format Ripple has been pitching for funds, bonds, and other financial
instruments. Under the proposal, individual balances and payment amounts on
MPTs can be encrypted while accounts and token types remain visible to all.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The technical approach:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;The proposal uses
cryptographic techniques — EC-ElGamal encryption and zero-knowledge proofs — to
verify that transaction amounts balance correctly without being able to read
those amounts. An institution could transfer assets without publishing the size
of every position and payment to the public. Accounts and token types stay
visible — only the numbers are hidden.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Under the current proposal, the feature is&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;opt-in&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;and
covers only direct MPT payments between accounts. It does not apply to trades
on XRPL's built-in decentralized exchange, escrow arrangements, or checks.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Why this matters for institutions:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Public
balances can expose trading positions, which many regulated firms cannot
accept. The feature keeps the token type and account addresses on the public
record for oversight while hiding sensitive position data from competitors and
the broader market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;$1.38 Billion Already on Chain — And Growing&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The ledger already has institutional users for the feature
to serve. Ripple has been working to grow that number through 2026. In February
2026,&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Aviva Investors&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;and Ripple announced a collaboration to
explore tokenizing traditional fund structures on the XRP Ledger.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The Confidential Transfers feature would make it easier for
institutions like Aviva or Ondo to manage assets on a public ledger without
exposing sensitive position data that could tip off competitors or create
market-moving information.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Five Proposed Amendments Await Validator Approval&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Confidential Transfers is one of several amendments being
developed for the XRPL. According to XRPL Operations, the update includes
support for proposed amendments aimed at institutional adoption and network
efficiency:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Confidential
     Transfer&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;– Keeps MPT balances and transfers private through
     encryption&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Batch&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;–
     Lets users combine up to eight transactions into a single operation,
     making complex payments and trustless swaps easier&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Sponsor&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;–
     Allows a third party to cover transaction fees and reserve requirements
     for another user&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Permission
     Delegation&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;– Lets wallet owners grant limited permissions for
     specific transactions without sharing full account control&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Dynamic
     MPT&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;– Allows token issuers to update certain properties of
     Multi-Purpose Tokens after creation&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;However, none of these amendments are active yet.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;XRPL
amendments require at least&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;80% support from trusted validators&lt;/b&gt;,
held continuously for&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;two weeks&lt;/b&gt;, before they activate. For now, the
amendment remains under development, with validator approval required before
activation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What This Means for XRP and Tokenization&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The Confidential Transfers proposal represents a bet on
institutional adoption. If approved, the feature would remove a key barrier
that currently makes it difficult for large financial institutions to manage
assets on a public distributed ledger.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The real test:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Whether Aviva, Ondo, or another
institution already issuing assets on XRPL actually chooses to hide balances
and transfer sizes rather than leave them public. That adoption — not the code
— will determine whether Confidential Transfers is a feature or a turning
point.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;For now, the amendment remains under development, with
validator approval required before activation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>New Crypto Token and Coin Launches — August 2026</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

  &lt;h1&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhVNZtKBAnUNXxid_d5HTBFNpNjlmA0aj5Wi5DhXxPKptkdwhaOD-Y6cdI6WhzCxYdStnye3TIwZ9FB3Gyej0-V8i2a_0EsnklqhehSMmyPZtqUZG6qDYPWd5iJjy9pclhqBti4G2lpfMyO8RoW6KH17vQowZYduW2nM7EY7ojCpSijJiDCVfY0W5-uHY1o/s1672/New%20Crypto%20Token%20and%20Coin%20Launches.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="180" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhVNZtKBAnUNXxid_d5HTBFNpNjlmA0aj5Wi5DhXxPKptkdwhaOD-Y6cdI6WhzCxYdStnye3TIwZ9FB3Gyej0-V8i2a_0EsnklqhehSMmyPZtqUZG6qDYPWd5iJjy9pclhqBti4G2lpfMyO8RoW6KH17vQowZYduW2nM7EY7ojCpSijJiDCVfY0W5-uHY1o/s320/New%20Crypto%20Token%20and%20Coin%20Launches.png" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;strong style="font-size: large;"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong style="font-size: large;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: large;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;August 2026 has brought a steady stream of new token launches and listings. Here's a factual overview of some of the notable projects attracting attention across the crypto market.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;SwarmBase (SWARM) — Live on Multiple Exchanges&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Launched: August 19, 2026&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;SwarmBase ($SWARM) is now trading on Bitget, KuCoin, MEXC, and PancakeSwap.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What It Is:&lt;/strong&gt; SwarmBase is an AI infrastructure platform built on BNB Chain for creating and coordinating autonomous AI agent swarms.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Key Details&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Total Supply:&lt;/strong&gt; 1 billion SWARM, fixed&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Community Allocation:&lt;/strong&gt; 20% of total supply, with 10% unlocked at TGE and 10% linearly vested&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Funding:&lt;/strong&gt; Approximately $7 million raised from Castrum Capital, M2M Capital, Notch Ventures, and Becker Ventures&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Deflationary Mechanism:&lt;/strong&gt; 20% of platform fees are burned permanently&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Team/Strategic Partners:&lt;/strong&gt; 30% allocation with a 12-month cliff lock&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Exchange Listings&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;KuCoin:&lt;/strong&gt; Trading began August 19, 2026, at 10:00 UTC&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bitget:&lt;/strong&gt; Trading began August 19, 2026, at 10:00 UTC&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Withdrawals:&lt;/strong&gt; Available from August 20, 2026, on Bitget&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Linera (LNRA) — "Next Hyperliquid" Aspiration&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Token Sale Announced: August 20, 2026&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Linera, founded by former Libra (Meta) team members, has announced an upcoming LNRA token sale and positioned itself as aiming to become the "next Hyperliquid."&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What They're Building:&lt;/strong&gt; Linera is developing a consumer-focused blockchain that includes a real-time PvP prediction market available through its platform.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Core product:&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;a href="https://app.linera.xyz/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Linera Originals&lt;/a&gt; is designed around prediction markets that can open, operate, and settle within a short time frame.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Key Features&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Microchains Parallel Architecture:&lt;/strong&gt; Supports thousands of smaller markets running simultaneously&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Finality Under 1 Second:&lt;/strong&gt; Blocks are designed for sub-second finality&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Linera Originals:&lt;/strong&gt; Prediction markets designed to open, operate, and settle within one minute&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pure PvP Mode:&lt;/strong&gt; No house or external market makers&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Small Team:&lt;/strong&gt; Approximately five core members&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Access:&lt;/strong&gt; Users who earn in-app badges through product participation will receive priority access to a dedicated allocation pool for the LNRA sale.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Status:&lt;/strong&gt; Full sale details, including size, pricing, and allocation, have not yet been published and are expected in a separate announcement.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Flop Labs (FLOP) — Arthur Hayes' Return&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Status: Airdrop Planned Q4 2026, Genesis Block Targeted Q1 2027&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Arthur Hayes, co-founder of &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/solmate-adds-1000-sol-confirms-ai-push.html"&gt;BitMEX&lt;/a&gt;, has announced his return to the crypto industry through Flop Labs.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What It Is:&lt;/strong&gt; Flop Labs is proposing a network where AI agents can use FLOP to pay for computing power, inference services, and storage. GPU providers would supply resources, while validators would confirm service delivery.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Key Commitments&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;No Presale&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;No Venture-Capital Allocation&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Fair Launch:&lt;/strong&gt; The project has described the planned distribution as a "100% fair launch"&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Timeline&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Q4 2026:&lt;/strong&gt; FLOP airdrop planned&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Q1 2027:&lt;/strong&gt; Flop Network genesis block targeted&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Important Note:&lt;/strong&gt; Flop Labs has not yet published a token allocation schedule, airdrop rules, a claim process, or complete technical documentation explaining how FLOP will function before genesis.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The planned token distribution would therefore occur before the network supporting its intended utility is live. Investors and users should treat the project as early-stage and verify official documentation as it becomes available.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;ATA Chain (ATAX) — Coinstore Listing&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Listing: August 21, 2026&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;ATA Chain's native token, ATAX, is scheduled for a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/banks-rotating-into-ethereum-3x-faster.html"&gt;Coinstore &lt;/a&gt;listing as part of its initial exchange rollout.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What It Is:&lt;/strong&gt; ATA Chain describes itself as an AI-linked blockchain ecosystem built around ATA-C Wallet, digital identity tools, and tokenized gold and silver products.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Schedule (UTC+8)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Deposits:&lt;/strong&gt; August 20, 2026, 12:00&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Trading:&lt;/strong&gt; August 20, 2026, 16:00&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Withdrawals:&lt;/strong&gt; August 21, 2026, 17:00&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Trading Start Times by Region&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Singapore:&lt;/strong&gt; 4:00 PM&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Istanbul:&lt;/strong&gt; 11:00 AM&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;

  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What to Watch Next&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;These four projects are at very different stages. SwarmBase is already trading across multiple venues, while Linera is moving toward its token sale. Flop Labs remains in an early development phase, and ATA Chain is preparing for its scheduled exchange listing.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For anyone following new crypto launches, the important distinction is between a token that is already trading and a project that is still preparing its network or distribution. Launch dates, token allocations, exchange schedules, and technical plans can change, so checking the latest official announcements before making any decision remains important.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Says AGI Has Arrived After OpenAI GPT-6 Astra Launch</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjG_NIfxMjbbAeSFGt1KieJxPiVMlZZPnOHI08yA-oj2KGTCWQl-f5zhIIL3lIup_Dui-ComO7YO-FCw8RNWcgaUQs0wMH4Hh7ViudidtJ5cVe5nmj0li4xT1CuHbs3ltrmw5LBF-4GFa1I_62TFVpfiH_VOnoh3HDwV8n_z_YjJg1RowgMc_tGGD-olUQA/s1672/jensen-huang-gpt-6-astra-agi-nvidia.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang discusses AGI after OpenAI GPT-6 Astra launch" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjG_NIfxMjbbAeSFGt1KieJxPiVMlZZPnOHI08yA-oj2KGTCWQl-f5zhIIL3lIup_Dui-ComO7YO-FCw8RNWcgaUQs0wMH4Hh7ViudidtJ5cVe5nmj0li4xT1CuHbs3ltrmw5LBF-4GFa1I_62TFVpfiH_VOnoh3HDwV8n_z_YjJg1RowgMc_tGGD-olUQA/w640-h360/jensen-huang-gpt-6-astra-agi-nvidia.jpg.png" title="Jensen Huang Says AGI Has Arrived After GPT-6 Astra Launch" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;
&lt;strong&gt;September 7, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Nvidia CEO &lt;strong&gt;Jensen Huang&lt;/strong&gt; has declared that &lt;strong&gt;“AGI has arrived”&lt;/strong&gt; following OpenAI's launch of GPT-6 Astra, putting the latest AI model at the center of a renewed debate over whether artificial general intelligence has finally become a reality.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Huang made the statement while congratulating the OpenAI team and highlighting the enormous computing infrastructure behind Astra. According to Huang, the model was trained on more than &lt;strong&gt;100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72 systems&lt;/strong&gt;. He also said another &lt;strong&gt;400,000 NVIDIA GPUs&lt;/strong&gt; are coming online. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI has presented GPT-6 Astra as a major leap in AI capability, particularly in computer use, software engineering, cybersecurity, science and professional work. But whether the model should formally be called AGI remains a matter of debate because there is no universally accepted technical definition or test for AGI. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="margin: 20px 0px; overflow-x: auto; width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;table style="border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 700px; width: 100%;"&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Jensen Huang Actually Said&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Huang's statement was direct. In a post congratulating OpenAI, he pointed to the rapid progression from ChatGPT to o1 and then GPT-6 Astra and said that &lt;strong&gt;“AGI has arrived.”&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;He also highlighted the scale of the infrastructure used to train Astra, saying the model was trained on more than 100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72 systems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Huang's post further said that another 400,000 Nvidia GPUs are coming online, suggesting that the computing infrastructure supporting frontier AI models is set to expand substantially. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The wording is important: &lt;strong&gt;Huang is making the AGI declaration&lt;/strong&gt;. It should not be presented as proof that the entire AI industry has officially agreed that AGI has been achieved.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;GPT-6 Astra Is Behind the New AGI Debate&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/why-is-my-bitcoin-transaction-still.html"&gt;OpenAI&lt;/a&gt; introduced GPT-6 Astra as its newest flagship model and described it as a major advance in AI capabilities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The model is designed to work beyond traditional chatbot interactions. Its capabilities include operating computers, browsing software environments, writing code, performing research and handling complex professional workflows.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That broader ability is one reason the AGI discussion has intensified. The defining idea behind AGI is not simply that an AI system can answer difficult questions. It is that the system can generalize across a wide range of intellectual tasks rather than being restricted to one narrow function.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Astra's ability to combine reasoning with computer interaction therefore makes it a particularly important milestone in the current AI race.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;More Than 100,000 NVIDIA Systems Were Used&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The computing scale behind Astra is another major part of the story.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Huang said the model was trained using more than &lt;strong&gt;100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72 systems&lt;/strong&gt;. The systems are designed to connect large numbers of GPUs through high-bandwidth networking for demanding AI workloads. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For the AI industry, the figure illustrates how frontier model development is becoming increasingly dependent on massive amounts of specialized computing infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Training increasingly capable models requires not only GPUs, but also high-speed interconnects, networking, memory, data centers and large amounts of electricity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That makes the development of frontier AI closely connected to the broader expansion of AI infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;OpenAI Has Not Simply Declared the AGI Debate Over&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is an important distinction between Huang's statement and OpenAI's official position.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI President &lt;strong&gt;Greg Brockman&lt;/strong&gt; has described Astra's arrival as potentially marking the beginning of the AGI era, but the company has not provided a universally accepted &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/can-you-recover-crypto-sent-to-the-wrong-network.html"&gt;technical&lt;/a&gt; certification saying that AGI has definitively been achieved.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Brockman has also acknowledged that AGI is difficult to define precisely and has suggested that people may ultimately judge whether the milestone has been reached based on what the system can actually accomplish. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This leaves an important question open: &lt;strong&gt;is GPT-6 Astra actually AGI, or is it an exceptionally capable AI system that is moving toward AGI?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why There Is No Simple AGI Test&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;AGI does not have one universally accepted benchmark comparable to a traditional exam.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Different researchers use different criteria. Some focus on human-level performance across a broad range of intellectual tasks. Others emphasize autonomy, adaptability, reasoning, learning and the ability to complete economically valuable work.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means two researchers can look at exactly the same AI model and reach different conclusions about whether it qualifies as AGI.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is why Huang's statement is significant as an industry signal, but it should still be treated as a &lt;strong&gt;claim rather than an independently settled scientific fact&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Astra's Computer-Use Capabilities Could Be the Bigger Story&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One of the most consequential developments surrounding Astra is its ability to interact with computers and software.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Traditional AI assistants generally respond to instructions by generating text, code or other content. More advanced agentic systems can take additional steps: opening applications, navigating websites, working with files, executing code and completing multi-stage tasks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If these systems become sufficiently reliable, the economic impact could extend well beyond the chatbot market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Companies could potentially use AI agents for software development, research, data analysis, administration, customer service and other knowledge-intensive workflows.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That possibility is a major reason the industry is increasingly discussing AI in terms of &lt;strong&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/capital-b-buys-376-bitcoin-for-253.html"&gt;AI workers&lt;/a&gt; and agents&lt;/strong&gt; rather than only AI assistants.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Cybersecurity Raises a Different Set of Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Greater AI capability also creates new safety challenges.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;OpenAI has highlighted Astra's cybersecurity capabilities, including its ability to identify vulnerabilities under controlled testing conditions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That capability can be useful for defensive security research, but the same underlying skills could potentially be misused.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;As AI systems become better at writing code, analyzing software and discovering vulnerabilities, companies developing these models face a difficult balance between providing useful capabilities and preventing harmful use.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is one reason the question of whether a model is “AGI” cannot be separated from questions about reliability, monitoring and deployment safeguards.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why This Is Also a Big Moment for Nvidia&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Huang's comments underline Nvidia's central role in the current AI infrastructure race.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Frontier models require enormous computing capacity, and Nvidia's Grace Blackwell platforms are designed specifically for large-scale AI workloads.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The reported scale of Astra's training demonstrates the relationship between model capability and computing infrastructure: as companies attempt to build more capable AI systems, they are also building larger and more sophisticated data-center environments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Huang's announcement that another 400,000 Nvidia GPUs are coming online points to the next phase of that infrastructure expansion.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In other words, the AGI debate is happening alongside an enormous race to build the computing capacity needed for future AI models.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Does “AGI Has Arrived” Mean Human-Level AI Is Solved?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Not necessarily.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Even highly capable AI models can have limitations. They may make incorrect assumptions, fail unexpectedly, struggle with unfamiliar situations or require human oversight for important decisions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The term AGI is also broader than performance on individual benchmarks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A model can achieve extraordinary results in coding, mathematics or computer-use tests without necessarily demonstrating every characteristic that researchers associate with general intelligence.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For that reason, the most defensible interpretation of Huang's statement is that he believes the latest generation of AI has crossed an important capability threshold.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Whether that threshold should officially be called AGI will remain part of the wider scientific and industry debate.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The AI Industry Is Moving Toward Longer Autonomous Tasks&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Astra launch reflects a broader shift taking place across frontier AI.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Models are increasingly being designed to handle tasks that take longer than a single question-and-answer exchange.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of simply answering “How do I build this?”, an AI agent can potentially research the problem, write code, test the result, identify errors and continue working until it reaches an objective.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That transition from &lt;strong&gt;answer generation to task execution&lt;/strong&gt; could prove more economically important than any individual benchmark.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If reliability improves enough, businesses could begin assigning AI systems entire workflows rather than individual steps.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The real test for Astra will take place outside the launch announcement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Developers and businesses will ultimately judge the system based on how reliably it performs real-world tasks, how much human supervision it needs and whether its capabilities remain consistent over long periods.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Several developments will therefore be worth watching:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How quickly GPT-6 Astra expands into consumer and enterprise workflows.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Whether AI agents can reliably complete longer multi-step tasks.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How developers use Astra's computer-use and coding capabilities.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How OpenAI handles the model's cybersecurity capabilities.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Whether competing AI labs produce systems with similar agentic capabilities.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How quickly additional Nvidia computing infrastructure comes online.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Whether researchers eventually agree on a clearer definition of AGI.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Did Jensen Huang say AGI has arrived?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Yes. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said &lt;strong&gt;“AGI has arrived”&lt;/strong&gt; after OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch. The statement reflects Huang's assessment of the latest AI capabilities. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is GPT-6 Astra?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's latest flagship AI model, designed for advanced reasoning, computer use, software engineering, cybersecurity, scientific work and professional tasks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;How many Nvidia GPUs were used to train GPT-6 Astra?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Jensen Huang said Astra was trained on more than &lt;strong&gt;100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72 systems&lt;/strong&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Has OpenAI officially proved that Astra is AGI?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;No universally accepted technical test exists for AGI. OpenAI has described Astra as a major step toward or into the AGI era, while the broader question of whether it qualifies as AGI remains debated. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Why does the Astra launch matter for Nvidia?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Astra highlights the enormous computing infrastructure required for frontier AI. Nvidia supplies the GPUs and networking systems used to build many of these large AI computing environments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What does AGI mean?&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Artificial general intelligence generally refers to an AI system capable of performing a broad range of intellectual tasks rather than being limited to a narrow application. However, researchers and companies use different definitions, so there is no single universally accepted threshold.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Jensen Huang's declaration that &lt;strong&gt;“AGI has arrived”&lt;/strong&gt; has added a powerful new claim to the debate surrounding OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The underlying development is significant regardless of what label ultimately wins the argument. Astra represents a new generation of AI systems built to reason, use computers, write software and perform complex tasks across multiple domains.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The model's reported training scale—more than &lt;strong&gt;100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72 systems&lt;/strong&gt;—also shows how much computing power is now being deployed at the frontier of AI.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Whether GPT-6 Astra should officially be called AGI will remain contested. But the direction of the technology is becoming increasingly clear: AI systems are moving from simply generating answers toward &lt;strong&gt;performing complex work&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;
