&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(119, 119, 119); padding: 10px;"&gt;Shows where the funds were actually sent.&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Can Coinbase Reverse Bitcoin Sent to Another Coinbase User?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is where the on-chain and off-chain distinction becomes particularly important.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Coinbase says an on-chain send goes to an external blockchain address and is irreversible. An off-chain send can be made to another Coinbase user using supported identifying information such as an email address, phone number or username. &lt;a href="https://help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/trading-and-funding/cryptocurrency-trading-pairs/steps-to-send-crypto" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Coinbase Help&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Coinbase also says that if crypto is sent to an email address linked to a Coinbase account, the funds are considered claimed. If the recipient does not have a Coinbase account and does not claim the crypto within the applicable period described by Coinbase, the funds can be returned. For a pending eligible payment, Coinbase says a user can try to cancel it. &lt;a href="https://help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/trading-and-funding/sending-or-receiving-cryptocurrency/i-sent-funds-to-the-wrong-address-how-do-i-get-them-back" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Coinbase — Crypto sent to the wrong address&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is fundamentally different from asking the Bitcoin blockchain to reverse a confirmed BTC transaction.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For a deeper explanation, see our related guide: &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/can-coinbase-reverse-bitcoin-sent-to-another-coinbase-user/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Can Coinbase Reverse Bitcoin Sent to Another Coinbase User?&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Can't Bitcoin Simply Reverse a Wrong Transaction?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin is designed to operate without a central institution that can arbitrarily modify the ledger.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Once a transaction is confirmed, changing it would require a different transaction history rather than a simple "undo" command.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This finality is useful for merchants and financial applications because Bitcoin payments do not come with the same chargeback mechanism found in traditional card payments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The same feature that prevents unauthorized reversals also means that users must take responsibility for verifying payment details before sending.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How to Avoid Sending Bitcoin to the Wrong Address&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Prevention is much easier than recovery.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Copy the full receiving address carefully.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Use the wallet's QR-code scanning feature when appropriate.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Check the entire address rather than relying only on the first and last few characters.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Confirm that the network is correct.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;For a large transfer, consider sending a small test transaction first.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Keep the recipient's payment request and destination details until the transfer is confirmed.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Never rush a transaction because someone claims the payment is urgent.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin.org recommends careful verification because Bitcoin payments are irreversible. Coinbase likewise recommends checking addresses and using a small test transaction before sending a significant amount. &lt;a href="https://bitcoin.org/en/you-need-to-know" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Bitcoin.org&lt;/a&gt; | &lt;a href="https://help.coinbase.com/en/exchange/crypto-transfers/sent-to-wrong-address" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Coinbase Help&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What About RBF? Can It Reverse a Wrong Address?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Replace-by-Fee, or RBF, should not be confused with a refund mechanism.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;RBF can allow certain unconfirmed Bitcoin transactions to be replaced with another transaction under the applicable rules. It is primarily a fee-management mechanism for transactions that have not yet been confirmed.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It does not provide a normal way to take a confirmed payment back from a recipient.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Therefore, if you sent BTC to the wrong address and the transaction is already confirmed, RBF is not a solution for reversing it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What If the Transaction Has Zero Confirmations?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Zero confirmations means the transaction has not yet been included in a confirmed block.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is different from saying the payment can definitely be cancelled.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The exact options depend on the wallet and transaction configuration. Some Bitcoin wallets support transaction replacement mechanisms, while custodial services may have their own controls.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the transaction is still unconfirmed, check your wallet's available options before taking any action. Do not create another transaction blindly, because doing so can make the situation more confusing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can a Bitcoin transaction be reversed after sending to the wrong address?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Generally no if it is a confirmed on-chain transaction. Bitcoin.org says confirmed Bitcoin transactions can only be refunded by the recipient. &lt;a href="https://bitcoin.org/en/faq" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Bitcoin.org FAQ&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can Coinbase reverse Bitcoin sent to the wrong address?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Coinbase says on-chain sends are irreversible and it cannot retrieve funds sent to an incorrect address. Recovery may depend on the recipient or, in certain off-chain situations, the status of the transfer. &lt;a href="https://help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/trading-and-funding/cryptocurrency-trading-pairs/steps-to-send-crypto" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Coinbase Help&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What happens if I send Bitcoin to someone else's wallet by mistake?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;If the transaction is confirmed, you normally need the recipient's cooperation. The Bitcoin network itself will not reverse the payment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What happens if I send Bitcoin to an address nobody owns?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;If the address is valid but nobody controls the corresponding private key, the Bitcoin can become permanently inaccessible.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can an unconfirmed Bitcoin transaction be cancelled?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Not automatically. Some wallets may provide replacement or cancellation-related options before confirmation, but availability depends on the transaction and wallet.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is sending Bitcoin to the wrong network the same as sending it to the wrong address?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;No. They are different problems. Wrong-network recovery depends on the asset, destination service and network involved, and recovery is not guaranteed.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Should I give my seed phrase to a crypto recovery service?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;No. A legitimate support representative should not need your recovery phrase or private key to investigate a transaction. Anyone asking for these credentials should be treated as a potential scam.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;A confirmed Bitcoin transaction sent to the wrong on-chain address generally cannot be reversed.&lt;/strong&gt; The Bitcoin network does not provide a central chargeback system, and the sender cannot simply cancel a confirmed payment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The situation can be different when the transfer was handled off-chain by a custodial platform. Coinbase, for example, distinguishes blockchain transactions from off-chain transfers between Coinbase users, and some pending off-chain payments may have platform-specific cancellation or return options. &lt;a href="https://help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/trading-and-funding/cryptocurrency-trading-pairs/steps-to-send-crypto" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"&gt;Coinbase Help&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If you have made a mistake, the first step is to identify whether the transfer was &lt;strong&gt;on-chain or off-chain&lt;/strong&gt;, check its status, locate the transaction ID if one exists, and contact the recipient or receiving platform through an official channel.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Most importantly, never give your seed phrase or private key to someone promising to recover your Bitcoin. In crypto, preventing a mistaken transfer is usually far easier than recovering one.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Bitcoin Critic Nouriel Roubini Backs USAFi as Tokenized Asset Nears Launch</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgE4CXlkQ3Ywk3Ep9QcuuhNF062r96I4HJgLUo-kc-X4EbjbutOkDdx0XVh38Ybxi6Q9khrhHHDMnwZDGLBzlZEPPlFSc2fGhj5siO5rhubhJbdR-xISlgs8hIqo59nkMC7xmwaiwd6Yk2IB6dwoVi5R-gn79FCrTfp1tEJTquNTeK6pGVtDNJwI86UH6LI/s1536/economist%20Nouriel%20Roubini.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Nouriel Roubini backs USAFi tokenized asset Atlas America Fund planned VARA launch Q3 2026" border="0" data-original-height="1024" data-original-width="1536" height="213" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgE4CXlkQ3Ywk3Ep9QcuuhNF062r96I4HJgLUo-kc-X4EbjbutOkDdx0XVh38Ybxi6Q9khrhHHDMnwZDGLBzlZEPPlFSc2fGhj5siO5rhubhJbdR-xISlgs8hIqo59nkMC7xmwaiwd6Yk2IB6dwoVi5R-gn79FCrTfp1tEJTquNTeK6pGVtDNJwI86UH6LI/w320-h213/economist%20Nouriel%20Roubini.png" title="Bitcoin Critic Nouriel Roubini Backs USAFi Tokenized Asset Near Launch | CoinaiNews" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Aug 10, 2026&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;– Nouriel Roubini spent years
sharply criticizing Bitcoin and the broader cryptocurrency market, dismissing
decentralized finance as a speculative playground, and warning that crypto had
no real assets behind it.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Now he's backing a planned tokenized investment product.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The economist known as "Dr. Doom" for predicting
the 2008 financial crisis has co-authored a whitepaper for&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;USAFi&lt;/b&gt;, a
digital token backed by the Atlas America Fund — a Nasdaq-listed ETF associated
with Atlas Capital Team, where Roubini serves as chief economist.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The token is planned for issuance under Dubai's Virtual
Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) framework in the third quarter of 2026, with
Securitize — the platform behind BlackRock's BUIDL fund — providing the
tokenization infrastructure.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Why Roubini Shifted His Position&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Roubini built much of his public profile on attacking
crypto. He called Bitcoin a "self-fulfilling bubble" and argued that
most digital assets had no intrinsic value. His whitepaper statement framed the
project as a break from that record.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"We are living through the most dangerous period for
savers in a generation. Trade wars, the threat of conflict in the world's
critical shipping lanes, sanctions, and persistent inflation all quietly erode
the value of what people have put away. For years I argued that most digital
assets offered no protection from this, because they had no real assets behind
them. What Atlas has built is different."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;—&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Nouriel Roubini&lt;/b&gt;, Co-Founder, Atlas Capital
Team&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The distinction is the underlying assets. USAFi is backed by
the Atlas America Fund (USAF), an actively managed ETF registered with the SEC
and listed on Nasdaq, with reserve assets custodied at Bank of New York. The
fund holds U.S. Treasuries, gold, real estate investment trusts, and food and
strategic commodities.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The fund's performance:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Atlas said that, as of
June 22, USAF had returned 11.11% since inception 19 months ago, with
annualized volatility of 5.47% and a Sharpe ratio of 0.55.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What USAFi Actually Does&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Atlas is pitching USAFi as a "Technodollar" — a
new class of digital reserve asset positioned apart from stablecoins.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;i&gt;"The dollar has taken two forms in modern history,
and it is now taking a third. There was the Gold Dollar, backed by the promise
to swap dollars for gold. Then the Petrodollar, backed by the world's need to
buy oil in dollars. We call what comes next the Technodollar: a digital dollar
reserve backed not by a single commodity but by a broad claim on America's most
productive companies in the industries AI is now transforming."&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;—&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Reza Bundy&lt;/b&gt;, CEO, Atlas Capital Team&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Key features:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Permissionless
     ERC-20 token&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— trades with 24/7 accessibility&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;SEC-registered
     ETF backing&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— about $17 million in assets under management at the
     time of the announcement&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Planned
     VARA issuance&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— targeted for Dubai's Asset Referenced Virtual
     Asset framework&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;AI-managed
     portfolio&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— Atlas describes its infrastructure as
     "agentic," with AI running the portfolio day to day within
     investment committee rules&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Roubini's Shift Toward Tokenization&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The planned launch is the latest example of tokenization, a
sector that has grown past&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;$30 billion in non-stablecoin assets&lt;/b&gt;,
according to&amp;nbsp;&lt;a href="https://rwa.xyz/" target="_blank"&gt;rwa.xyz&lt;/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;data.
Major firms including BlackRock, Franklin Templeton, and Apollo have already
launched tokenized products.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;But Roubini's involvement is different.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;After years of arguing that crypto had no real assets behind
it, he is now backing a project that uses blockchain to represent real assets.
After warning that digital assets offered no protection from inflation or
geopolitical stress, he is now pitching a token designed exactly for that
purpose.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;For the tokenization industry, Roubini's involvement
represents another example of established financial figures moving toward
blockchain-based representations of traditional assets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What This Means for Crypto&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The development shows that even a longtime Bitcoin and
crypto critic is now participating in a blockchain-based tokenization project.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The USAFi token isn't Bitcoin. It doesn't compete with
Bitcoin. But it represents a fundamental shift in how even the most skeptical
traditional financiers view blockchain technology: not as a replacement for the
financial system, but as an upgrade to its infrastructure.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;HYPE: The $35.2M Weekly Figure Is Not the Whole Story&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Hyperliquid's HYPE token appears second on CoinMarketCap's August 31–September 6 list, with an estimated &lt;strong&gt;$35.2 million&lt;/strong&gt; unlock representing approximately &lt;strong&gt;0.17% of circulating supply&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, investors should distinguish that figure from a much larger HYPE event that occurred on &lt;strong&gt;August 29, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Broader &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/strategy-is-back-saylors-company-buys.html"&gt;token&lt;/a&gt;-unlock tracking data estimated the August 29 event at approximately &lt;strong&gt;$1.2 billion&lt;/strong&gt;, involving roughly &lt;strong&gt;14.18 million HYPE tokens&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The event represented around &lt;strong&gt;1.4% of HYPE's total supply&lt;/strong&gt;, with reported allocation data showing approximately &lt;strong&gt;46.6% going to insiders&lt;/strong&gt; and &lt;strong&gt;46.3% to the community&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That does not mean $1.2 billion worth of HYPE was automatically sold into the market. The figure represents the estimated market value of tokens becoming unlocked under the relevant distribution schedule.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="background: rgb(247, 247, 247); border-left: 4px solid rgb(85, 85, 85); margin: 22px 0px; padding: 14px 18px;"&gt;
&lt;p style="margin: 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #04ff00;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key distinction:&lt;/strong&gt; The approximately $1.2 billion HYPE unlock occurred on August 29 and is a separate event from CoinMarketCap's $35.2 million HYPE figure in its August 31–September 6 weekly list.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bitway Leads the CMC Weekly List&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitway (BTW) has the largest estimated unlock on CoinMarketCap's highlighted list at &lt;strong&gt;$41.5 million&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The release represents approximately &lt;strong&gt;3.75% of circulating supply&lt;/strong&gt;, which makes the percentage particularly important when assessing potential market impact.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitway's tokenomics also provide additional context. The project's allocation structure includes a &lt;strong&gt;5% liquidity allocation that is fully unlocked&lt;/strong&gt;, while approximately &lt;strong&gt;16.33% allocated to backers is locked for 12 months&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is a good example of why investors should look beyond the headline dollar value and examine how a project's token supply is structured.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Sui Unlock Includes Early Contributors, Community and Mysten Labs&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Sui ranks third on the CoinMarketCap list with an estimated &lt;strong&gt;$15.9 million&lt;/strong&gt; unlock, equivalent to approximately &lt;strong&gt;0.54% of circulating supply&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The reported distribution involves approximately &lt;strong&gt;13.53 million SUI tokens&lt;/strong&gt; divided among several recipient groups.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(217, 217, 217); padding: 12px; text-align: right;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;13.53M SUI&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The recipient breakdown can matter because different groups may have different reasons for holding, using or selling their tokens.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Ethena and Other Tokens on the List&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Ethena (ENA) ranks fourth with an estimated &lt;strong&gt;$14.4 million&lt;/strong&gt; unlock, representing approximately &lt;strong&gt;0.97% of circulating supply&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Kite is listed at approximately &lt;strong&gt;$7.3 million&lt;/strong&gt;, while EigenCloud and Falcon Finance are each listed at approximately &lt;strong&gt;$7 million&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;UnifAI Network has a smaller estimated dollar value of &lt;strong&gt;$4.8 million&lt;/strong&gt;, but its listed unlock represents approximately &lt;strong&gt;4.96% of circulating supply&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Quack AI and Berachain round out the 10-token list with estimated unlock values of approximately &lt;strong&gt;$2.6 million&lt;/strong&gt; and &lt;strong&gt;$2.3 million&lt;/strong&gt;, respectively.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Unlock Percentage Can Matter More Than Dollar Value&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A $40 million unlock may sound enormous, but its &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/russias-sberbank-plans-to-accept-ether.html"&gt;market&lt;/a&gt; impact depends heavily on the size of the existing circulating supply and available liquidity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For example, an unlock equal to 0.2% of circulating supply can have a very different effect from an unlock equal to 5% of circulating supply.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is why traders often watch both the &lt;strong&gt;estimated dollar value&lt;/strong&gt; and the &lt;strong&gt;percentage of circulating supply&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Token Unlock Does Not Mean Automatic Selling&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This distinction is critical.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When tokens become unlocked, recipients gain access to them according to the project's vesting or distribution rules. They can then decide how to use those tokens.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Hold the tokens&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Stake them&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Use them within the ecosystem&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Provide liquidity&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Transfer them to another wallet&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Deposit them on an exchange&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Sell some or all of them&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Even a transfer to an exchange does not necessarily prove that a sale has already occurred.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The eventual market impact depends on actual recipient behavior, market liquidity, demand and broader market conditions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Traders Should Watch This Week&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;1. Large Wallet Transfers&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Transfers from wallets associated with investors, foundations, treasuries or other major token holders can attract market attention. However, wallet movement by itself is not proof of selling.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;2. Exchange Deposits&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Large deposits of newly unlocked tokens to exchanges may increase speculation about potential selling pressure. Traders should still avoid treating an exchange deposit as confirmation of a completed sale.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;3. Trading Volume&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Trading activity around an unlock can reveal whether the market is actively repricing the additional supply or simply absorbing it without significant disruption.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;4. Market Liquidity&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A highly liquid token market may absorb additional supply more easily than a thinly traded market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;5. Future Unlocks&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One unlock rarely tells the entire tokenomics story. Investors should also check whether larger releases are scheduled for the following weeks or months.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Different Token Unlock Trackers Can Disagree&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Investors may notice different figures or event lists when comparing CoinMarketCap with other token-unlock tracking services.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That does not necessarily mean one source is wrong. Platforms can use different methodologies for calculating circulating supply, token value, vesting categories and event timing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Some trackers may also include events that another service does not classify in the same way.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For significant supply events, investors should therefore compare third-party data with the project's own tokenomics documentation whenever possible.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bigger Picture for Crypto Markets&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Token unlocks are ultimately about supply and demand.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When additional tokens become available, the potential supply of an asset &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/japan-fsa-seeks-tax-filing-exemption.html"&gt;increases&lt;/a&gt;. But that does not automatically translate into a price decline.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If demand grows faster than the newly available supply, the market can absorb the additional tokens. If demand is weak and recipients sell aggressively, the impact can be more noticeable.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is why token unlock calendars are best viewed as &lt;strong&gt;market-risk monitoring tools&lt;/strong&gt; rather than guaranteed buy or sell signals.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What This Week's Calendar Really Means&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;CoinMarketCap's August 31–September 6 list highlights several supply events, with Bitway leading at &lt;strong&gt;$41.5 million&lt;/strong&gt;, followed by Hyperliquid at &lt;strong&gt;$35.2 million&lt;/strong&gt; and Sui at &lt;strong&gt;$15.9 million&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But HYPE requires special attention because the &lt;strong&gt;August 29 event estimated at approximately $1.2 billion&lt;/strong&gt; was a separate and substantially larger unlock.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The distinction matters because combining those figures would give readers the wrong impression about what CoinMarketCap's weekly list actually represents.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For investors, the better approach is to ask five simple questions:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How large is the unlock relative to circulating supply?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Who is receiving the tokens?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Are recipients historically long-term holders or active sellers?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How much liquidity is available?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Are additional large unlocks coming soon?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This week's token-unlock schedule contains several events worth watching, but the numbers need context.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitway has the largest estimated unlock on CoinMarketCap's highlighted list at &lt;strong&gt;$41.5 million&lt;/strong&gt;. Hyperliquid follows at &lt;strong&gt;$35.2 million&lt;/strong&gt;, while Sui is listed at &lt;strong&gt;$15.9 million&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At the same time, the separate &lt;strong&gt;August 29 HYPE unlock estimated at around $1.2 billion&lt;/strong&gt; shows why investors should look beyond a single weekly calendar when assessing token supply.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The central lesson is straightforward: &lt;strong&gt;an unlock is not the same thing as a sell-off.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Newly unlocked tokens can be held, staked, used, transferred or sold. The actual market effect depends on what recipients do, how much liquidity exists and how strong demand is at the time.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For crypto investors, understanding those factors is far more useful than simply reacting to the biggest dollar figure on an unlock calendar.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;hr /&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Editorial note:&lt;/strong&gt; CoinMarketCap figures cited in this article refer to its August 31–September 6 weekly token-unlock update. The approximately $1.2 billion HYPE event refers separately to the August 29, 2026 unlock and is included for broader market context. Unlock values are estimates and can change as token prices move. Different data providers may report different figures because of methodology, timing, vesting classifications and circulating-supply calculations.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>ECB Launches Pontes to Settle Tokenized Assets in Central Bank Money</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjd2VOmSYmte3Svia9my_Z3X3b6gR6pNsvKA9FzyR6w_BgJeVsA9uDxefvu01Z5OsboMWwQWyW_3s5F8wnQ_6pPYRmYKYjn3U5Iuk1vxnCFWESkiMLffGR8yh24Mvbga5gDJVii3RD1VlinMX6m986nIuQCvMgERSW7EKYqhRkV8eeIVhMIq3raWq0auXqF/s1734/ecb-pontes-tokenized-assets-central-bank-money.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="ECB Pontes platform for settling tokenized assets in central bank money" border="0" data-original-height="907" data-original-width="1734" height="334" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjd2VOmSYmte3Svia9my_Z3X3b6gR6pNsvKA9FzyR6w_BgJeVsA9uDxefvu01Z5OsboMWwQWyW_3s5F8wnQ_6pPYRmYKYjn3U5Iuk1vxnCFWESkiMLffGR8yh24Mvbga5gDJVii3RD1VlinMX6m986nIuQCvMgERSW7EKYqhRkV8eeIVhMIq3raWq0auXqF/w640-h334/ecb-pontes-tokenized-assets-central-bank-money.webp.png" title="ECB Pontes Tokenized Asset Settlement" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The European Central Bank has launched Pontes, a new settlement solution designed to let banks and other eligible financial institutions settle wholesale transactions in tokenized assets using central bank money.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The September 21 launch marks a significant step in the Eurosystem's broader effort to connect distributed ledger technology (DLT)-based financial markets with existing central bank payment infrastructure. Rather than requiring institutions to rely exclusively on private settlement assets such as stablecoins, Pontes connects market DLT platforms with the Eurosystem's TARGET Services so that the cash leg of eligible transactions can be settled in central bank money.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB says Pontes is the first initiative under its strategic programme to make central bank money suitable for a tokenized financial future, while further development of the ecosystem is expected to continue through 2028. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Is ECB Pontes?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Pontes is a Eurosystem distributed ledger technology solution that acts as a bridge between market-operated DLT platforms and the Eurosystem's TARGET Services.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In practical terms, tokenized assets such as bonds, securities and other financial instruments can exist on distributed ledgers, while the associated payment can be settled using central bank money.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is important because &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/rex-tuttle-assx-2x-etf-strive-bitcoin-treasury.html"&gt;tokenization &lt;/a&gt;changes how financial assets can be issued, traded and settled. Instead of maintaining separate systems for different stages of a transaction, DLT can potentially combine issuance, trading, settlement, custody and servicing into a more integrated digital process.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB says tokenization could make financial markets more efficient by allowing multiple parts of an asset's lifecycle to be combined and by enabling automation through smart contracts. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Central Bank Money Matters for Tokenized Markets&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The central issue Pontes addresses is the settlement asset used when a tokenized financial asset changes hands.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In traditional financial markets, central bank money provides a settlement asset that carries very low credit and settlement risk. In tokenized markets, however, transactions can take place on distributed ledgers that are separate from conventional central bank payment infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Private settlement instruments, including &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/visa-memecoin-card-rewards-crossmint-robinhood-wallet.html"&gt;stablecoins &lt;/a&gt;and tokenized bank deposits, can potentially bridge that gap. Pontes provides another option by connecting DLT-based transactions to central bank money.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB has previously argued that access to a risk-free settlement asset is important for the wider adoption of DLT in financial markets. Its 2024 exploratory work helped establish the basis for Pontes. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Pontes Does Not Mean Stablecoins Are Disappearing&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The launch should not be interpreted as the ECB eliminating stablecoins from tokenized finance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead, Pontes creates a central-bank-money settlement route for eligible wholesale transactions. The ECB has itself described an environment in which tokenized central bank money can exist alongside private settlement assets such as stablecoins and tokenized deposits.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means institutions could ultimately have multiple settlement options depending on the type of transaction, market infrastructure and regulatory framework involved.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The distinction is particularly important for crypto and blockchain markets because stablecoins remain widely used for transferring value across digital-asset networks. Pontes addresses a different part of the financial infrastructure: wholesale settlement of tokenized assets through the Eurosystem's central bank money framework.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Who Can Use Pontes?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Pontes is initially aimed at wholesale financial markets rather than ordinary consumers.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB said an initial group of market participants and DLT operators had completed onboarding and was ready to use the service. The participants listed by the ECB include &lt;strong&gt;Deutsche Bank, Santander, Société Générale, the European Investment Bank, Deka Bank, DZ Bank and other European financial institutions&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The initial group also includes DLT operators such as &lt;strong&gt;Clearstream, Axiology, Cashlink and SWIAT&lt;/strong&gt;. The ECB said additional participants are expected to connect in the coming months. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This makes Pontes primarily an institutional financial-market infrastructure project rather than a consumer-facing crypto payment service.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How Pontes Connects Blockchain and TARGET Services&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The core design of Pontes is based on linking market DLT platforms with &lt;strong&gt;TARGET Services&lt;/strong&gt;, the Eurosystem's existing payment infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This connection allows tokenized financial transactions recorded on participating DLT platforms to access central bank money settlement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The objective is not to replace every existing financial-market system with a single blockchain. Instead, Pontes provides an interoperability layer that allows distributed-ledger-based markets to connect with established Eurosystem settlement infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This approach could become important as banks, securities firms and market infrastructures experiment with tokenized bonds, equities and other financial instruments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Pontes Launches Now, While 2028 Is the Bigger Roadmap&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One detail is particularly important when describing the timeline.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pontes has already launched.&lt;/strong&gt; The initial service went live on September 21, 2026.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, the ECB is treating the launch as the beginning of a gradual development process. The central bank says additional features and longer operating hours will be introduced over time, with &lt;strong&gt;full implementation expected by 2028&lt;/strong&gt;. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB's longer-term &lt;strong&gt;Appia&lt;/strong&gt; programme is also working toward a blueprint for an integrated European tokenized financial ecosystem by 2028.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Therefore, 2028 should be viewed as an important milestone for the broader Eurosystem tokenization strategy rather than the date when Pontes first becomes operational.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;ECB Plans to Invest in Tokenized Securities&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Pontes launch comes alongside another significant development from the ECB.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The central bank has started preparatory work to invest a small portion of its own funds in tokenized securities. The initial focus will be on euro-denominated securities issued by euro-area public-sector entities and European supranational institutions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB says the purpose is to gain practical experience as an investor and build institutional expertise around DLT and tokenized financial markets. &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/coinbase-and-robinhood-could-benefit-as.html"&gt;Transactions associated&lt;/a&gt; with these investments are expected to be settled through Pontes. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This does not mean the ECB is investing its monetary-policy portfolio in cryptocurrencies. The initiative concerns a small portion of the ECB's own funds and focuses initially on tokenized securities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Tokenization Could Change in Financial Markets&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Tokenization involves representing assets in digital-token form, generally using distributed ledger technology.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For financial institutions, one potential advantage is the ability to automate processes that currently involve multiple intermediaries and separate systems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A tokenized bond, for example, could potentially combine issuance, trading, settlement and other lifecycle functions through interconnected digital infrastructure. Smart contracts could also automate certain conditions and actions associated with financial instruments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, these are potential efficiency gains rather than guaranteed outcomes. Adoption depends on regulation, interoperability, market liquidity, cybersecurity, operational resilience and whether financial institutions find the new infrastructure commercially useful.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Pontes and the Future of Tokenized Bonds and Securities&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One of the areas most likely to benefit from institutional tokenization infrastructure is the market for digital versions of traditional securities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Banks and financial-market infrastructures around the world have been experimenting with tokenized bonds, funds and other assets. The challenge has been connecting those digital markets to reliable settlement infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Pontes provides a Eurosystem-backed mechanism for the cash side of eligible wholesale transactions, potentially making it easier for institutions to develop DLT-based financial products without separating the asset ledger from conventional settlement money.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB's approach also gives European financial institutions a framework for experimenting with tokenized markets while retaining central bank money as an anchor for settlement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Pontes vs. Stablecoin Settlement&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The next stage will involve expanding Pontes' capabilities and bringing additional market participants onto the system.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB says enhanced features and longer operating hours will be introduced gradually. The broader Appia programme will meanwhile examine how a more integrated European tokenized financial ecosystem could operate, with a blueprint targeted for 2028. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The development could put Europe at the center of institutional experimentation with tokenized securities, while giving banks access to central bank money for the settlement leg of eligible DLT transactions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;Technology&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;Distributed ledger technology&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;Connected infrastructure&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;Eurosystem TARGET Services&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;Initial users&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;Banks, financial institutions and &lt;br /&gt;DLT operators&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;Full implementation target&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 8px;"&gt;2028&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The ECB's launch of Pontes gives Europe's tokenized financial markets a direct connection to central bank money settlement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The significance is broader than simply launching another blockchain platform. Pontes is designed to connect emerging DLT-based financial markets with the Eurosystem's existing payment infrastructure, allowing eligible wholesale tokenized transactions to settle using central bank money.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The initial system is already live, while additional features, longer operating hours and broader development are planned over the coming years. The ECB expects full implementation of Pontes by 2028, alongside its wider Appia work on the future architecture of Europe's tokenized financial ecosystem. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For banks and financial-market infrastructures, the development could provide another foundation for building tokenized securities markets in Europe. For the broader crypto and blockchain industry, it also shows how distributed-ledger technology is increasingly being incorporated into traditional financial-market infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Updated September 22, 2026. This article is based on ECB announcements and current reporting available at publication time.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Kalshi CEO Says NBA Prediction-Market Deal Could Arrive “Really Soon”</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;h1&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh8r0sJRB2UTJSBQseVAHeExrIV3v_4JQsc6M2he15Dtonatt4YBF5eS4kmkVTp8lYVnIv9i6SBsEezTXTY1jYtBiDtXimDG3-tQ7Jtl-SQETFHL9naZEIG3pkVDJ7vz0JLc-eYFEO2khvl_OlgIPZ8tQRJ0v0H87i1CYJOiM3gAaI4n4QM1vQfoEHdJjkn/s1672/kalshi-nba-prediction-market-deal-tarek-mansour.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour discusses a potential NBA prediction-market deal" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh8r0sJRB2UTJSBQseVAHeExrIV3v_4JQsc6M2he15Dtonatt4YBF5eS4kmkVTp8lYVnIv9i6SBsEezTXTY1jYtBiDtXimDG3-tQ7Jtl-SQETFHL9naZEIG3pkVDJ7vz0JLc-eYFEO2khvl_OlgIPZ8tQRJ0v0H87i1CYJOiM3gAaI4n4QM1vQfoEHdJjkn/w640-h360/kalshi-nba-prediction-market-deal-tarek-mansour.jpg.png" title="Kalshi NBA Prediction Market Deal" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;
September 7, 2026&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A potential partnership between the &lt;strong&gt;NBA and prediction-market platforms&lt;/strong&gt; could be getting closer.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Kalshi CEO &lt;strong&gt;Tarek Mansour&lt;/strong&gt; told RotoWire that a deal involving &lt;strong&gt;data, market integrity and marketing&lt;/strong&gt; between the NBA and prediction markets could arrive “really soon.” His comments come as the NBA reportedly moves closer to formalizing relationships with prediction-market companies ahead of the 2026-27 season. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, there is an important distinction: &lt;strong&gt;the NBA has not publicly announced a finalized Kalshi partnership matching those terms.&lt;/strong&gt; The current reporting points to negotiations and an expected framework rather than a completed deal.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Did Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour Say?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Mansour discussed the future of prediction markets and their relationship with major U.S. sports leagues during an interview with RotoWire.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When discussing the NBA and other major leagues, he indicated that developments could come very soon. The areas highlighted include three elements that could become important to any eventual agreement:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Data:&lt;/strong&gt; access to official sports information used by prediction markets.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Integrity:&lt;/strong&gt; cooperation aimed at identifying and addressing suspicious activity.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Marketing:&lt;/strong&gt; commercial and promotional relationships between prediction-market companies and sports organizations.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;RotoWire's reporting separately indicated that the NBA is close to finalizing a framework related to prediction-market access to league data and integrity systems. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Is the NBA Already Partnering With Kalshi?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Not officially, based on the information currently available.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction is important because the CoinMarketCap post refers to a potential deal that could arrive soon, rather than announcing that an NBA-Kalshi agreement has already been signed.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Front Office Sports has reported that the NBA is expected to announce deals with multiple prediction-market companies as the 2026-27 season approaches. Another industry report said the league wants to finalize partnerships before the new season begins. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means the eventual arrangement may involve more than one prediction-market operator rather than being exclusive to &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ripple-ceo-brad-garlinghouse-says.html"&gt;Kalshi&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Does NBA Data Matter?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Prediction markets depend on reliable information to determine the outcome of event contracts.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For basketball-related markets, that can include official game results, player statistics, schedules and other league information used to settle contracts.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;An official data relationship can give &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/china-unveils-45-billion-bank-and.html"&gt;market &lt;/a&gt;operators a clearly defined source of information while giving the league greater visibility into how its data is being used.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For the NBA, the relationship could also provide a formal channel for monitoring prediction-market activity involving its games.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Integrity Could Be the Bigger Issue&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The potential partnership is not simply about selling access to NBA statistics.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Market integrity is one of the biggest issues surrounding sports prediction markets.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Sports leagues have an obvious interest in detecting activity that could indicate manipulation, insider information or other behavior that threatens the integrity of competitions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The NBA has already discussed prediction-market oversight with U.S. regulators. Earlier this year, NBA Commissioner Adam Silver said the league had been talking with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission about an integrity framework for basketball-related prediction-market trading. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That history helps explain why an eventual commercial arrangement could include an integrity component rather than being limited to marketing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Prediction Markets Are Expanding Across Sports&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The NBA is considering these relationships at a time when prediction-market companies are rapidly expanding their presence in professional sports.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Kalshi recently became the &lt;strong&gt;official prediction-market partner of the U.S. Open&lt;/strong&gt;, giving the company another major sports relationship. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Other prediction-market platforms have also been pursuing sports partnerships, while individual professional teams have begun exploring commercial relationships with the industry.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The trend suggests that prediction markets are moving beyond being purely online trading platforms and are increasingly seeking direct relationships with the leagues whose events underpin their markets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the NBA Deal Could Be Important for Kalshi&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;An NBA partnership would be strategically significant for Kalshi because basketball is one of the largest sports audiences in the United States.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A formal relationship could potentially give Kalshi access to official league data, stronger integrity cooperation and additional marketing opportunities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It could also help prediction markets present themselves as a more established part of the sports ecosystem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the commercial upside comes with regulatory risk.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Kalshi Is Still Facing a Major Regulatory Fight&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The timing of the potential NBA partnership is especially significant because Kalshi is fighting a broader legal battle over sports prediction markets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Kalshi argues that its event contracts fall under federal commodities regulation. Several states and regulators have challenged that position, arguing that sports-related prediction contracts can function like gambling and should be subject to state-level rules.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The legal conflict intensified after the Ninth Circuit ruled against Kalshi in a case involving Nevada regulators. At the same time, a separate federal appeals court had previously sided with Kalshi in litigation involving New Jersey, creating a significant split over regulatory authority. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;New Jersey has now asked the U.S. Supreme Court to consider whether states have authority to regulate sports prediction markets such as Kalshi. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means any major sports partnership will develop alongside an unresolved regulatory debate.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Would an NBA Deal Mean Prediction Markets Are Legal Everywhere?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;No.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A commercial agreement between the NBA and a prediction-market company would not automatically settle the legal question over whether sports event contracts are regulated as financial products or gambling.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The legal classification of prediction markets remains under debate, and the outcome of ongoing court cases could have implications for how these products operate across the United States.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In other words, an NBA partnership could be commercially important without resolving the industry's regulatory uncertainty.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Could the NBA Work With Multiple Prediction Markets?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is a possibility supported by current reporting.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Front Office Sports reported that the NBA is expected to announce deals with &lt;strong&gt;multiple prediction markets&lt;/strong&gt;, rather than necessarily selecting one exclusive platform. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If that happens, companies such as Kalshi and other prediction-market operators could potentially compete for relationships with the league under a common framework.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The final structure, however, will depend on what the NBA officially announces.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Should Investors and Traders Watch Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The most important development will be an official announcement from the NBA or the prediction-market companies involved.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Three details will be particularly important:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Which prediction markets are included?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What data and integrity rights will they receive?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Will the agreements include marketing or sponsorship rights?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The answers could determine how significant the NBA's entry into formal prediction-market partnerships ultimately becomes.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What This Means for the Prediction-Market Industry&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the NBA finalizes agreements with prediction-&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/polands-crypto-bill-veto-survives-after.html"&gt;market operators&lt;/a&gt;, it would represent another major step in the industry's push into mainstream sports.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For prediction-market companies, partnerships with major leagues can provide credibility, data access and new customer-acquisition opportunities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For sports leagues, the appeal is more complicated. Prediction markets can create another form of fan engagement and a new commercial channel, but leagues also have to consider integrity, consumer protection and regulatory concerns.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That balance is likely to shape the NBA's eventual approach.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour says a prediction-market agreement involving the NBA could arrive &lt;strong&gt;“really soon.”&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Current reporting supports the idea that NBA negotiations are advanced and that the league could announce prediction-market partnerships before the 2026-27 season begins. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But there is still an important line between &lt;strong&gt;“close to a deal” and “deal officially signed.”&lt;/strong&gt; As of September 7, 2026, the NBA has not publicly confirmed a finalized Kalshi partnership covering data, integrity and marketing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If an agreement is announced, it could become one of the most important developments yet for the growing U.S. prediction-market industry.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is Kalshi officially partnering with the NBA?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;There is no publicly confirmed finalized NBA-Kalshi partnership matching the reported data, integrity and marketing framework as of September 7, 2026. Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour has said a development could arrive very soon.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What did Tarek Mansour say about the NBA?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Mansour told RotoWire that a deal involving data, integrity and marketing between the NBA and prediction markets could arrive “really soon.”&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;When could the NBA announce prediction-market deals?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Recent reports indicate that the NBA is expected to finalize or announce prediction-market partnerships before the 2026-27 NBA season gets underway. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What would an NBA prediction-market deal include?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;The potential framework could include official data access, integrity cooperation and marketing or commercial rights.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Does the NBA deal resolve Kalshi's legal problems?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;No. Kalshi continues to face legal challenges over whether sports prediction contracts fall under federal commodities regulation or state gambling laws. New Jersey has also asked the U.S. Supreme Court to review the issue. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Could the NBA partner with more than one prediction-market company?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Yes. Current reporting indicates the NBA could announce relationships with multiple prediction-market companies rather than necessarily choosing a single exclusive operator. &lt;/p&gt;

    <title>CLARITY Act Could Slip to 2030 as Senate Vote Nears</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;
  &lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVjb5TB3yJcxYz-dvFRqj0Ou0A8XWcrQLlwAAA3IKIfY9joY8M_UeUU9MLtTaVzpa6_Sjrfl1W47tFHHBoS27KNYmztHXUtTOyoAlYYx42oek3Bx6Q5reYaOzez28qdfCNYh7DkgfdqDRLhYBseccyb9Qlts2H1lVtNXF3DkYRp8989JmSUnnUG__vIiAD/s1672/clarity-act-cynthia-lummis-2030-crypto-regulation.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Senator Cynthia Lummis warns the CLARITY Act could be delayed until 2030" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVjb5TB3yJcxYz-dvFRqj0Ou0A8XWcrQLlwAAA3IKIfY9joY8M_UeUU9MLtTaVzpa6_Sjrfl1W47tFHHBoS27KNYmztHXUtTOyoAlYYx42oek3Bx6Q5reYaOzez28qdfCNYh7DkgfdqDRLhYBseccyb9Qlts2H1lVtNXF3DkYRp8989JmSUnnUG__vIiAD/w640-h360/clarity-act-cynthia-lummis-2030-crypto-regulation.jpg.png" title="Cynthia Lummis Warns CLARITY Act Could Slip to 2030" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;WASHINGTON — The U.S. Senate is heading toward a crucial test for the CLARITY Act, with Senator Cynthia Lummis warning that failure to pass comprehensive crypto market-structure legislation during the current Congress could push the next major opportunity as far out as 2030.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The warning comes as lawmakers prepare for a key Senate procedural vote on the &lt;strong&gt;Digital Asset Market Clarity Act&lt;/strong&gt;, formally designated as H.R. 3633. The legislation is intended to establish clearer rules for digital assets and define the regulatory responsibilities of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But there is an important distinction behind the 2030 headline: &lt;strong&gt;2030 is not a statutory deadline written into the CLARITY Act.&lt;/strong&gt; It is Lummis' assessment of how long the industry could have to wait for another serious legislative opportunity if Congress fails to reach a deal now.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The Senate's next major test is scheduled for &lt;strong&gt;September 15, 2026&lt;/strong&gt;. That vote is a procedural cloture test, not final passage of the bill.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why 2030 Has Become Part of the CLARITY Act Debate&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Lummis, a Republican senator from Wyoming and one of Congress' leading advocates for digital-asset legislation, has been pushing for a comprehensive market-structure framework for years.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;In July, after releasing updated CLARITY Act text, Lummis said the coming weeks were likely the last real chance in years to get the legislation right. She also called for continued negotiations with Democratic lawmakers to produce a version capable of becoming law. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Her latest warning takes that argument further. If Congress cannot complete the legislation during the current window, political priorities could shift after the midterm elections, congressional control could change and lawmakers may have to restart negotiations over the structure of U.S. crypto regulation.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is the reasoning behind the &lt;strong&gt;2030 scenario&lt;/strong&gt;. It is a political forecast rather than a guaranteed timetable.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;September 15 Is a Critical Test — But Not Final Passage&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The Senate is preparing for a major procedural vote on September 15.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For the CLARITY Act to move forward, supporters face the Senate's familiar &lt;strong&gt;60-vote cloture threshold&lt;/strong&gt;. A successful cloture vote would allow the Senate to advance debate and consideration of the legislation.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It would not, however, mean that the CLARITY Act has passed Congress or become U.S. law.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The distinction matters because several additional steps would remain after the procedural vote, including Senate consideration, final Senate passage and agreement with the House before legislation could reach the president.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Recent reporting shows the stakes are high. &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/defi-development-corp-raises-11m-with.html"&gt;Crypto advocacy&lt;/a&gt; groups and banking organizations have intensified lobbying efforts ahead of the September vote, while lawmakers remain divided over issues including consumer protection, anti-money-laundering safeguards and the potential impact of digital assets on traditional banking. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Is the CLARITY Act?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The &lt;strong&gt;Digital Asset Market Clarity Act&lt;/strong&gt; is a proposed federal market-structure law designed to create clearer rules for digital assets in the United States.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;One of its central goals is to establish a more defined division of regulatory authority between the SEC and CFTC.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That issue has been at the center of the U.S. crypto debate for years. Digital-asset companies have repeatedly argued that uncertainty over whether a particular &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/strategy-skips-bitcoin-buy-as-strc.html"&gt;token &lt;/a&gt;or activity falls under securities or commodities rules makes it difficult to build and operate products in the United States.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The CLARITY Act attempts to replace some of that uncertainty with statutory definitions, registration requirements and clearer regulatory responsibilities.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Bill Has Already Cleared the Senate Banking Committee&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The CLARITY Act is not starting from scratch.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;In May, the legislation passed the Senate Banking Committee by a &lt;strong&gt;15-9 bipartisan vote&lt;/strong&gt;, an important step that moved it closer to consideration by the full Senate. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Lummis subsequently released updated text in July that incorporated work from the Senate Banking and Agriculture committees.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The updated proposal shows that lawmakers have already spent substantial time negotiating the legislation. The challenge now is turning that committee-level agreement into enough support on the Senate floor.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why the Senate Floor Could Be Harder&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Committee votes and floor votes are very different political tests.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The Banking Committee was able to produce a bipartisan 15-9 result. But moving a major financial-market bill through the full Senate requires broader agreement, particularly because of the 60-vote cloture threshold.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That means Republican supporters cannot simply rely on their own party's votes.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Democratic senators have raised concerns over several provisions and have sought changes to strengthen consumer protections and other safeguards. Some Republicans have also expressed concerns about aspects of the legislation.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The result is a negotiation in which even relatively small provisions could become important to the final vote count.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Banking Industry Concerns Add Another Layer&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The fight is not limited to crypto companies and lawmakers.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Traditional banking organizations have also become increasingly involved in the debate because some provisions could affect how digital-asset companies compete with banks for customers, deposits and financial services.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Reuters reported that banking and crypto interests have stepped up lobbying ahead of the September 15 vote, making the CLARITY Act one of the most closely watched financial-policy battles of the current congressional session. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For crypto advocates, the bill represents a chance to establish clearer rules and reduce regulatory uncertainty. For critics, the priority is ensuring that new &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/cronos-recovers-1112m-after-tectonic.html"&gt;digital-asset&lt;/a&gt; rules do not create loopholes or weaken protections already applied to traditional financial markets.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Happens If the September Vote Fails?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A failed procedural vote would not permanently kill the CLARITY Act.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Congress could theoretically revisit the legislation later, renegotiate provisions or introduce another version. A future Congress could also create an entirely different market-structure framework.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;However, the political environment could look very different after the 2026 midterm elections.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;New lawmakers could arrive. Committee leadership could change. Congressional priorities could shift. And lawmakers who currently support the bill could have less influence over the legislative process.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is why Lummis is describing the current period as such an important window.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Could the CLARITY Act Really Be Delayed Until 2030?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Potentially, but there is no guarantee that 2030 will be the next legislative opportunity.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The 2030 figure should be understood as Lummis' warning about the consequences of losing the current congressional window.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Congress could introduce a new crypto market-structure bill earlier. Lawmakers could reach a different bipartisan agreement in 2027, 2028 or 2029. Political circumstances can change quickly.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;But passing a comprehensive market-structure law requires agreement across committees, both chambers of Congress and ultimately the White House. If negotiations collapse now, rebuilding that coalition could take years.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is the real significance of the 2030 warning.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What the CLARITY Act Could Change for Crypto&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If enacted, the legislation could provide a clearer federal framework for a broad range of digital-asset businesses.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That could include cryptocurrency exchanges, token issuers, digital-asset intermediaries, blockchain companies and other businesses whose activities currently sit in areas of regulatory uncertainty.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;A clearer framework could also make it easier for companies and investors to determine whether a particular digital asset falls under SEC or CFTC oversight and what registration or compliance obligations may apply.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Supporters argue that greater certainty could encourage investment and innovation in the United States instead of pushing companies toward jurisdictions with clearer regulatory frameworks.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;CLARITY Act vs. Current Crypto Regulation&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The United States is not waiting for the CLARITY Act to have crypto regulation at all.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Existing securities, commodities, banking, anti-money-laundering and stablecoin rules already apply to different parts of the digital-asset market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The unresolved question is the broader market structure: which regulator should oversee which digital assets and activities, how intermediaries should register and what rules should govern the market as a whole.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is the gap the CLARITY Act is attempting to address.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why the Outcome Matters to Crypto Investors&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For investors, regulatory clarity can matter even when it does not directly change the price of Bitcoin or another cryptocurrency.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Clearer rules can influence whether exchanges list certain assets, whether financial institutions offer crypto products, how token issuers structure projects and where blockchain companies choose to operate.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;It can also affect the willingness of traditional financial institutions to enter the digital-asset market.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;That is why the September vote is being closely watched across the crypto industry.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The CLARITY Act Timeline&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;div style="margin: 20px 0px; overflow-x: auto; width: 100%;"&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What Investors Should Watch Before September 15&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The headline vote is only one part of the story.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Investors should watch for changes to the bill's text, statements from senators who have not committed to supporting cloture and signs that negotiators are closing the remaining gaps.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The final vote count will matter more than public endorsements because the bill needs enough senators to clear the procedural threshold.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Another important factor is timing. With the midterm elections approaching, lawmakers have a shrinking number of legislative days in which they can resolve the remaining disputes.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What is the CLARITY Act?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;The CLARITY Act, formally the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, is proposed U.S. legislation designed to establish a clearer regulatory framework for digital assets and define responsibilities between the SEC and CFTC.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Why does Cynthia Lummis mention 2030?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;Lummis is warning that if Congress fails to pass comprehensive crypto market-structure legislation during the current congressional window, the next meaningful opportunity could be pushed as far out as 2030. This is a political assessment, not a legal deadline.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;When is the next major CLARITY Act vote?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;The Senate is scheduled for a key procedural/cloture test on September 15, 2026. The vote is intended to determine whether the legislation can advance; it is not final passage.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Does a successful September 15 vote make the CLARITY Act law?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;No. A successful cloture vote would allow the Senate to move forward with consideration. The bill would still need further Senate action and House approval before it could reach the president.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Has the CLARITY Act passed a Senate committee?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;Yes. The Senate Banking Committee approved the legislation by a 15-9 vote in May 2026. &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Why is the CLARITY Act important for crypto?&lt;/h3&gt;
  &lt;p&gt;The bill could create clearer federal rules for digital assets and provide a more defined division of responsibilities between the SEC and CFTC. Supporters believe that regulatory certainty could encourage crypto investment and development in the United States.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The CLARITY Act has reached a point where political timing may be almost as important as the legislation itself.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;Senator Cynthia Lummis' &lt;strong&gt;2030 warning&lt;/strong&gt; should not be read as a law that automatically postpones the bill. Instead, it highlights what supporters believe could happen if Congress loses the current opportunity to establish a comprehensive crypto market-structure framework.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;The September 15 Senate vote is therefore important, but it is not the finish line. Even if lawmakers clear the procedural hurdle, substantial work would remain before the legislation could become law.&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;For the U.S. crypto industry, the central question is now straightforward: &lt;strong&gt;Can lawmakers find enough bipartisan support to move the CLARITY Act forward before the 2026 legislative window closes?&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;If they do, the United States could take a major step toward defining the regulatory rules for digital assets. If they do not, Lummis' warning suggests the industry could be waiting much longer for another comprehensive attempt.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Pump.fun App Temporarily Unavailable on Apple’s US and India App Stores</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhf8ja-6h99X6QMpaQY6ahOBlyPZQR9hyphenhyphenuNTbEp_mG7qFJgDcW_0QDNqjESvpIFmQnP0zeO453C21A_fD_hsXhEZu03zj6LlKRFCmIe01h0X4LAJj03clzB5N-qQ2zhQgSdLyovbOw0uw-i1dabdz69gsyY7BrAvivv62LQCc3f5QbpZ3nPOqWffP24rPAt/s1672/pumpfun-app-apple-us-india-app-store.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Pump.fun mobile app temporarily unavailable on Apple App Store in the US and India" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhf8ja-6h99X6QMpaQY6ahOBlyPZQR9hyphenhyphenuNTbEp_mG7qFJgDcW_0QDNqjESvpIFmQnP0zeO453C21A_fD_hsXhEZu03zj6LlKRFCmIe01h0X4LAJj03clzB5N-qQ2zhQgSdLyovbOw0uw-i1dabdz69gsyY7BrAvivv62LQCc3f5QbpZ3nPOqWffP24rPAt/w640-h360/pumpfun-app-apple-us-india-app-store.jpg.png" title="Pump.fun App Temporarily Unavailable on Apple App Store" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pump.fun’s mobile app is temporarily unavailable for new downloads from Apple’s App Store in the United States and India, according to a latest update from the Pump.fun mobile team.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The development affects users who are trying to install the Pump.fun app for the first time on iPhone or iPad in the two markets. People who already have the app installed are reportedly unaffected and can continue using it as usual.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The app also remains available to Android users through Google Play, meaning the current issue is not a complete shutdown of Pump.fun’s mobile service.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happened to the Pump.fun App?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Pump.fun’s mobile team said the application is temporarily unavailable to download from the &lt;strong&gt;U.S. and India iOS App Stores&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The update specifically refers to new downloads. Existing users who already have the application installed can continue using it normally, while new users on Android can download the application through Google Play. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The timing of the restriction has attracted attention because Pump.fun is one of the best-known platforms for launching and trading memecoins on Solana. Its official website continues to promote the mobile experience and describes the platform as a place to discover and trade internet trends and tokens. &lt;/p&gt;
