      &lt;/tr&gt;
    &lt;/tbody&gt;
  &lt;/table&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Bergamot Compatibility Could Matter for Firefox&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    There is another technical detail that deserves attention: &lt;strong&gt;Bergamot&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    QVAC's translation stack supports Bergamot as an inference engine. Bergamot is associated with the offline translation technology used in Mozilla's Firefox translation ecosystem.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    That compatibility is important because it means QVAC's local translation architecture is not completely isolated from an existing browser-based offline translation ecosystem.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    QVAC's technical documentation lists both its own local inference stack and Bergamot as translation options. Developers can load supported neural machine translation models and perform translation locally through the QVAC SDK.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    This does &lt;strong&gt;not&lt;/strong&gt; mean that Tether has announced a new official Firefox integration for every TranslatePsy model. It means that the underlying QVAC translation stack supports the Bergamot inference technology, which creates an interesting path for developers already working with that ecosystem.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;QVAC SDK Launched Earlier in 2026&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The translation release is easier to understand when viewed alongside Tether's earlier QVAC work.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    In April 2026, Tether launched the &lt;strong&gt;QVAC SDK&lt;/strong&gt;, an open-source, cross-platform software development kit intended to provide a common interface for local AI capabilities.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The SDK brings together technologies including llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, Bergamot, Stable Diffusion and ONNX Runtime through a unified architecture.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    QVAC's documentation describes the system as a way to build local and peer-to-peer AI applications, allowing models to perform inference directly on devices rather than relying exclusively on cloud infrastructure.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    TranslatePsy is therefore not an isolated experiment. It is another example of the local-first AI strategy Tether has been developing through QVAC.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Healthcare Could Become a Major Use Case&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Language barriers can become particularly serious when the information being communicated involves healthcare.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether says TranslatePsy-AfriSLM could work alongside &lt;strong&gt;QVAC MedPsy&lt;/strong&gt;, its smaller medical-focused AI model, to make health information more accessible in local languages.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The concept is straightforward: a medical information system could potentially operate locally on a device and use translation technology to communicate information in a user's preferred language.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    However, translation AI should not be treated as a replacement for qualified medical professionals. Errors in medical terminology or context can have serious consequences.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The strongest potential use case is therefore likely to involve AI-assisted communication with appropriate human oversight rather than fully autonomous medical decision-making.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Education, Agriculture and Humanitarian Work&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Healthcare is only one possible application.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Education could benefit from local-language translation as well. A large amount of digital educational material is produced in a relatively small number of dominant languages. Translation into more African languages could make some of that material easier to access.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Agriculture is another potential area. Information about weather, crops, pests, farming methods and safety procedures is useful only if people can understand it.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Humanitarian organizations could also potentially use offline translation in areas where internet infrastructure is damaged or unavailable.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The common factor is connectivity. An &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/elon-musk-says-ai-could-add-20-trillion.html"&gt;AI model&lt;/a&gt; that can operate locally does not have to stop working simply because the internet connection disappears.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What About the Nine European Languages?&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether's release also includes &lt;strong&gt;TranslatePsy-EuroNano&lt;/strong&gt;, a compact translation family designed for nine European languages.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether says TranslatePsy-Nano is designed for a browser-scale footprint, with the Nano family covering nine European and eight African languages.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The company has emphasized reducing the amount of storage required to deploy translation models locally.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether's research reports that one European-language deployment can require roughly &lt;strong&gt;36 MB&lt;/strong&gt; of storage, compared with approximately 633 MB for an equivalent Firefox offline translation configuration in the company's comparison.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    That represents roughly a &lt;strong&gt;94% reduction in storage requirements&lt;/strong&gt;, according to Tether's benchmark.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Again, these figures are based on Tether's own testing and configuration. Actual storage requirements can vary depending on the model, language pair and software environment.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Why Smaller AI Models Are Becoming More Important&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The AI industry has spent years competing to build larger models with more parameters and greater computing requirements.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    But another trend is developing at the same time: &lt;strong&gt;AI is moving closer to the device.&lt;/strong&gt;
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Smartphones, laptops and other consumer hardware are becoming capable of running increasingly sophisticated models locally.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Local AI can offer several advantages:
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;ul&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Less dependence on an internet connection&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Potentially better privacy for sensitive information&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Lower cloud infrastructure requirements&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Faster responses when network latency is significant&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;More opportunities for AI use in remote locations&lt;/li&gt;
    &lt;li&gt;Greater control for developers and users&lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The trade-off is that local models generally have fewer resources than the largest cloud systems. Developers therefore have to balance model size, accuracy, speed, storage and battery consumption.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Tether's Approach Is Different From Simply Building a Bigger Model&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    TranslatePsy illustrates a broader change in how AI performance can be measured.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Instead of asking only how large a model is, developers can ask whether the model solves a particular problem efficiently on hardware that people already own.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Translation is a good example because it is a specialized task. A translation model does not necessarily need the broad reasoning abilities of a general-purpose AI assistant.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    If a smaller specialized model can produce high-quality translations while using dramatically less memory and computing power, it can become easier to deploy at scale.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    That is particularly relevant for low-resource languages, where the primary challenge may not be building the world's largest model but creating a model that understands the language well enough to be genuinely useful.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Open Source Could Help the Project Expand&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Another important part of the release is its open-source nature.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether says the TranslatePsy-AfriSLM models, inference code and related data-processing resources are being made available so researchers and developers can experiment with the technology.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The AfriSLM models are available in three sizes—0.8B, 2B and 4B parameters—with quantized versions available for smaller deployments.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    This gives developers more flexibility. A powerful laptop may be able to use a larger model, while a smartphone or low-resource device could use a smaller quantized version.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The open-source approach also leaves room for developers to build applications Tether itself may not have anticipated, including education tools, local-language assistants and offline communication software.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;What This Means for the Future of AI&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether's translation project highlights a part of the AI industry that is sometimes overshadowed by the race for ever-larger models.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The next stage of AI may not be defined only by bigger data centers and more powerful chips. It may also be defined by smaller models that can run locally and solve specific problems efficiently.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    For Africa, that could have particular importance because language support remains one of the biggest barriers to digital inclusion.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    UNESCO has highlighted how many African languages remain poorly represented online. Tether's approach does not solve that problem by itself, but it offers another technical path: train specialized models for those languages and make them small enough to run on devices people already own.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether's latest AI release is more significant than a simple multilingual translation announcement.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    It combines &lt;strong&gt;open-source models, offline processing, small parameter counts, local inference and support for historically underserved languages&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    TranslatePsy-AfriSLM supports 19 African languages, while the broader TranslatePsy-Nano family covers nine European and eight African languages.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether's reported benchmarks suggest that relatively small models can compete with much larger systems in specialized translation tasks. The company also reports major reductions in training-data volume and storage requirements, as well as fast local inference on laptop and smartphone hardware.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    But the most important test will happen outside benchmark tables.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    If students, healthcare workers, farmers, researchers and field teams can reliably use these models on ordinary devices without an internet connection, the technology could become a practical tool for digital inclusion.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The broader lesson is simple: &lt;strong&gt;the future of AI may not only be about making models bigger. It may also be about making them smaller, faster, more private and available in more people's own languages.&lt;/strong&gt;
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

  &lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What did Tether AI Research release?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether AI Research released open-source TranslatePsy translation models designed to run locally on smartphones, laptops and other edge devices.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;How many African languages does TranslatePsy-AfriSLM support?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    TranslatePsy-AfriSLM supports 19 African languages, including Hausa, Swahili, Yoruba, Igbo, Zulu, Somali, Oromo and others.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Can Tether's translation models work offline?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Yes. Tether says the TranslatePsy models are designed to process translations locally without requiring an internet connection.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What is TranslatePsy-Nano?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    TranslatePsy-Nano is Tether's compact translation family covering nine European and eight African languages, with an emphasis on a browser-scale footprint and local deployment.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What is Bergamot?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Bergamot is an inference technology used in offline neural machine translation. QVAC's translation documentation supports Bergamot as one of its translation inference engines, connecting the QVAC stack with technology used in the Firefox offline translation ecosystem.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;How fast is Tether's offline translation technology?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Tether's published benchmark reports approximately 46 milliseconds per sentence for a Bergamot setup on a Linux laptop. A Pixel 10 Pro XL test reported 26.1 milliseconds per sentence in batch mode. Actual performance will vary by device and configuration.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;What is the QVAC SDK?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The QVAC SDK is Tether's open-source, cross-platform development framework for local and peer-to-peer AI applications. It was launched in April 2026 and supports multiple AI capabilities, including translation.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Why is offline AI important?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    Offline AI can continue working where internet connectivity is unreliable. It can also reduce the need to send sensitive information to remote cloud servers.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Are Tether's benchmark results independently verified?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    No independent verification is implied by Tether's announcement. The benchmark figures discussed in this article are identified as company-reported results. Independent testing and real-world deployments will provide additional evidence about the models' performance.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h3&gt;Is Tether's AI project connected to USDT?&lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p&gt;
    The translation project comes from Tether AI Research and its QVAC initiative. It is part of Tether's broader technology strategy and is separate from the core operation of the USDT stablecoin.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr /&gt;

    <title>Alibaba's Wan 3.0 Turns PDFs and PPTs Into 30-Second AI Videos — Here's How Much It Costs</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;!--Alibaba Wan 3.0 Article - CoinAINews--&gt;
&lt;div style="line-height: 1.8; margin: 0px auto; max-width: 820px; padding: 20px;"&gt;

  &lt;h1 style="line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhfbp912K6GuGHJjPQC5Ar1PlbSHsYRv7I93u3iEriIJIUqD8QKaHrj8rshgopvipSiJTlU7Gcg7lmjl6rCwenjrrCIAhv744AL3OL_KU8yJTNc1fhg-yHR5nvUcC6pnfMl6LcOYOuhgU3OpZb0irIaC3pVtGPYQth9Yi1hXZifXkHUtHqccZoVcv9sJQVW/s1672/alibaba-wan-3-ai-video-generator-pdf-ppt-30-second-video.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Alibaba Wan 3.0 AI video generator turning PDF and PowerPoint files into 30-second videos" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhfbp912K6GuGHJjPQC5Ar1PlbSHsYRv7I93u3iEriIJIUqD8QKaHrj8rshgopvipSiJTlU7Gcg7lmjl6rCwenjrrCIAhv744AL3OL_KU8yJTNc1fhg-yHR5nvUcC6pnfMl6LcOYOuhgU3OpZb0irIaC3pVtGPYQth9Yi1hXZifXkHUtHqccZoVcv9sJQVW/w400-h225/alibaba-wan-3-ai-video-generator-pdf-ppt-30-second-video.jpg.png" title="Alibaba Wan 3.0 AI Video Generator" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: 17px;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h1 style="line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: 17px;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff |&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;h1 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 12px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: 17px;"&gt;Alibaba has officially launched &lt;/span&gt;&lt;strong style="font-size: 17px;"&gt;Wan 3.0&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: 17px;"&gt;, its latest AI video generation model — and it can turn your PowerPoints and PDFs into 30-second videos.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The model can generate up to &lt;strong&gt;30 seconds of video in a single generation&lt;/strong&gt;, with output reaching &lt;strong&gt;1080p resolution&lt;/strong&gt;. But the longer video length is only part of the story. Wan 3.0 is also built to work with different types of reference material, including documents, presentations, images, audio and video.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That puts Alibaba's latest model in an interesting position. It is not being pitched only as a tool for making cinematic clips from text prompts. It is also aimed at people who already have information sitting inside reports, presentations and other business documents and want to turn that material into video.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    And at &lt;strong&gt;$6 for a 30-second 1080p generation&lt;/strong&gt;, the pricing is likely to attract plenty of attention.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    What Wan 3.0 Can Actually Do
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;h3 style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 19px;"&gt;
    30-Second Video Generation
  &lt;/h3&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    One of the clearest upgrades in Wan 3.0 is its ability to generate up to &lt;strong&gt;30 seconds of video in a single generation&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That gives creators more space to build a complete sequence without automatically breaking an idea into several shorter clips.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Alibaba says Wan 3.0 supports native 30-second generation and can produce output at &lt;strong&gt;480p, 720p and 1080p&lt;/strong&gt; resolutions.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The longer generation window could be useful for advertising, short-form storytelling, product demonstrations and other content where a few seconds simply isn't enough to communicate the full idea.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    But there is an important distinction here: a longer generation does not automatically mean a better video. Consistency, movement, scene transitions and instruction following still determine whether the final clip is actually useful.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    PDFs and PPTs Are Where It Gets Interesting
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    This is probably the feature that will get businesses paying the closest attention.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 can use &lt;strong&gt;documents, presentations, spreadsheets and other structured information&lt;/strong&gt; as part of its video-generation workflow.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Businesses already produce enormous amounts of content in the form of presentations, reports, spreadsheets, training materials and marketing documents. &lt;strong&gt;Wan 3.0 is designed to turn that static information into video.&lt;/strong&gt;
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Imagine a company preparing a 20-slide product presentation.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Normally, converting that presentation into a video could mean writing a separate script, selecting visuals, recording narration and sending everything through an editing workflow.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    A document-aware &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/thailand-moves-closer-to-spot-bitcoin.html"&gt;AI system&lt;/a&gt; can potentially reduce some of those steps by using the original material as the foundation for the video.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That doesn't mean you can upload any random PDF and instantly get a finished Hollywood-style production. Human review will still matter, especially when the source material contains complicated information, branding requirements or important factual details.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Still, the workflow is significant.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The AI isn't simply generating something from a blank prompt. It is using information that already exists.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Multiple Reference Inputs
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 also takes a broader multimodal approach to video creation.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Users can provide different reference assets to help guide the generation process. These can include images, videos and audio alongside other forms of input.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That matters when a creator needs more control over what appears in the final video.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    For example, instead of describing a character entirely through text, a reference image can help establish the character's appearance. Additional visual or audio references can then be used to guide other parts of the scene.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The goal is to make the model less dependent on pure text prompting and more useful for workflows where creators already have source material.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Editing and Video Extension
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 is not limited to creating a new video from scratch.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Alibaba also positions the model for &lt;strong&gt;video editing and extension&lt;/strong&gt;, allowing users to work with existing footage and make changes through instructions.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That can be useful for creators who don't want to regenerate an entire clip just because one part needs to change.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Video generation is increasingly moving in this direction. Instead of treating AI as a one-click generator, companies are trying to turn it into a complete production assistant that can generate, modify and extend content.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 is part of that shift.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    How Much Does Wan 3.0 Cost?
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    This is where Alibaba's model gets particularly interesting.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Alibaba Cloud's current pricing lists Wan 3.0 at different rates depending on resolution:
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"&gt;&lt;!--Pricing Table--&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
  &lt;div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; margin: 20px 0px 30px; overflow-x: auto;"&gt;
    &lt;table style="background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 16px; min-width: 600px; width: 100%;"&gt;
      &lt;thead&gt;
        &lt;tr style="background: rgb(26, 26, 46);"&gt;
          &lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 14px; text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Resolution&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/th&gt;

          &lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); padding: 13px;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;$6.00&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
        &lt;/tr&gt;
      &lt;/tbody&gt;
    &lt;/table&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    At the highest listed resolution, a &lt;strong&gt;30-second 1080p video costs approximately $6&lt;/strong&gt; based on the published per-second rate.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That doesn't necessarily make Wan 3.0 the cheapest option in every possible workflow, because real production costs can also depend on retries, editing, additional assets and platform usage.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Still, the headline number is straightforward: &lt;strong&gt;30 seconds of 1080p generation for about $6.&lt;/strong&gt;
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    For businesses producing large amounts of short-form content, that pricing could become an important part of the decision.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Alibaba's AI Push Comes at the Same Time
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The Wan 3.0 launch comes shortly after Alibaba announced an &lt;strong&gt;HK$80 billion, or roughly $10.2 billion, Hong Kong share placement&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Reuters reported that Alibaba plans to use the proceeds to support its broader AI development, including investment in &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/india-plans-first-tokenized-corporate.html"&gt;AI infrastructure&lt;/a&gt;, chips and models.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The timing is notable because Alibaba has been aggressively expanding its AI ambitions while facing the enormous infrastructure costs that come with running increasingly capable models.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 therefore isn't an isolated product launch.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    It fits into Alibaba's wider strategy of building an &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/sam-altman-warns-ais-biggest-risks.html"&gt;AI ecosystem&lt;/a&gt; that covers models, cloud computing and applications.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The company already has its Qwen family of large language models, while Wan gives it a stronger position in the increasingly competitive AI video market.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Why Document-to-Video Could Matter
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The biggest opportunity may not be filmmakers at all.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Businesses already produce enormous amounts of content in the form of presentations, reports, spreadsheets, training materials and marketing documents. &lt;strong&gt;Wan 3.0 is designed to turn that static information into video.&lt;/strong&gt;
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That could open up a much larger market than traditional AI video generation.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Think about internal training.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    A company might have a lengthy employee handbook or a presentation explaining a new process. Turning that information into a short video could make it easier for employees to consume.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The same idea works for marketing teams.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    A product presentation could potentially become a promotional video. A travel company could turn destination information into visual content. An education provider could transform learning material into short explanatory clips.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The possibilities are broad because the source material already exists.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The challenge is making sure the AI understands that material correctly.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    A visually impressive video isn't much use if it changes numbers, misunderstands a product specification or leaves out an important part of the original information.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That's why human review is likely to remain an important part of the workflow.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 vs. the Competition
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Alibaba isn't entering an empty market.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Google, OpenAI and several specialist AI companies are developing increasingly sophisticated video-generation systems. The technology is improving quickly, and new models can make comparisons outdated within months — sometimes weeks.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0's strongest selling points appear to be its combination of &lt;strong&gt;longer generation, multimodal inputs, document-based workflows and relatively low listed pricing&lt;/strong&gt;.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    But price isn't everything.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Users will ultimately care about the quality of the output, consistency between scenes, how accurately the model follows instructions and how much editing is required before a video is ready for publication.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Independent testing will be important here.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 is still relatively new, so broad third-party comparisons with competing models remain limited. Alibaba's own performance and capability claims should therefore be viewed as company-reported until more independent evaluations become available.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    Availability
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 is available through Alibaba's AI platforms, including &lt;strong&gt;Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and Qwen Cloud&lt;/strong&gt;, with access and individual features depending on the service and region.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Alibaba has also been expanding the model's availability for different creative and commercial use cases.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    That could eventually put the technology in front of a much wider audience than developers experimenting with AI video generation.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    For businesses, the more interesting question may be whether Wan 3.0 can fit into existing workflows rather than simply whether it can generate impressive clips.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    What Comes Next
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    AI video generation is gradually moving away from the simple idea of entering a sentence and receiving a video.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The next stage is likely to involve models that understand &lt;strong&gt;documents, images, presentations, audio, existing footage and other business information&lt;/strong&gt; and then use all of it to build content.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 is clearly moving in that direction.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The model's document capabilities could prove especially useful if Alibaba can make the process reliable enough for professional use.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    But reliability is the part that will take time to judge.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    A business needs more than an impressive demo. It needs consistent results, accurate information, predictable costs and enough control to make the final output match its requirements.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;h2 style="border-left: 4px solid rgb(247, 147, 26); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; margin-top: 35px; padding-left: 12px;"&gt;
    The Bottom Line
  &lt;/h2&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Alibaba's Wan 3.0 is more than a straightforward upgrade to an AI video generator.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    It can generate &lt;strong&gt;up to 30 seconds of video&lt;/strong&gt;, supports output up to &lt;strong&gt;1080p&lt;/strong&gt;, works with multiple forms of reference material and is designed to bring documents and presentations into the video-generation process.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    The pricing is another major attraction. At the listed &lt;strong&gt;$0.20 per second for 1080p&lt;/strong&gt;, a 30-second video works out to roughly &lt;strong&gt;$6&lt;/strong&gt; before any additional usage or production costs.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    Whether Wan 3.0 can match the very best competing models on overall quality remains an open question. Independent testing and wider real-world use will tell that story.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px;"&gt;
    But Alibaba may be aiming at something bigger than another AI video demo.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600;"&gt;
    Wan 3.0 could be more about changing how businesses turn information into content — and less about generating another impressive AI demo.
  &lt;/p&gt;

  &lt;hr style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: 0px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; height: 1px; margin: 35px 0px 20px;" /&gt;

  &lt;p style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;"&gt;
    &lt;strong&gt;Disclaimer:&lt;/strong&gt; This article is for informational purposes only. AI models, pricing and availability can change, so users should verify current specifications and costs before relying on them.
  &lt;/p&gt;

color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-weight: 600;"&gt;Aug 8, 2026&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt; – SanDisk Corp. reported a staggering 175% year-over-year revenue increase to $20.25 billion for fiscal 2026, fueled by an explosive 437% surge in data-center sales as the company cements its position as a critical player in the AI infrastructure boom.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The flash-memory giant's fourth-quarter results blew past Wall Street estimates, with revenue hitting $8.97 billion – a 51% sequential jump that topped consensus forecasts of $8.42 billion. Earnings per share came in at $39.25, exceeding the average analyst estimate of $34.59 by nearly $5.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;"We closed fiscal 2026 with a leading technology portfolio, established datacenter as a key growth pillar, and deepened our customer partnerships," said David Goeckeler, chief executive officer of SanDisk, in a statement.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2 style="background-color: white; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-language-override: normal; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-size-adjust: none; font-size: 22px; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: 32px; margin: 32px 0px 16px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Data Center Now Represents 38% of Portfolio&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Data-center revenue reached $2.98 billion in the fourth quarter alone, up 103% from the previous quarter. The segment now accounts for 38% of SanDisk's total business, compared with just 12% a year earlier.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Executives attributed roughly one-third of the growth to higher shipment volumes, with stronger pricing accounting for the remaining two-thirds – a dynamic that reflects tight supply conditions in the AI-driven memory market.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Goeckeler described AI inference workloads as "memory-centric and storage-intensive," positioning SanDisk's NAND flash products as essential components in the expanding artificial intelligence value chain.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Gross margins expanded dramatically to 84.6% in Q4, up from 26.4% in the same period last year. The company swung to GAAP net income of $6.90 billion, compared with a loss of $23 million in the prior-year quarter.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2 style="background-color: white; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-language-override: normal; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-size-adjust: none; font-size: 22px; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: 32px; margin: 32px 0px 16px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Long-Term Contracts Secure Nearly $94 Billion in Revenue&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The company has signed eight long-term supply agreements with customers, carrying a combined floor value of approximately $93.9 billion. These contracts cover more than 50% of shipments for fiscal 2027 and about two-thirds for fiscal 2028 – up from just one-third coverage three months earlier.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The weighted average contract term exceeds four years, with some agreements extending to five years. Pricing mechanisms incorporate a mix of fixed and floating elements, tailored to individual customer requirements.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The enhanced contract coverage signals a structural shift in the memory industry. According to Goldman Sachs analysts, suppliers have gained negotiating leverage across longer durations, broader coverage, and more favorable pricing structures – a trend exemplified by SanDisk's latest agreements.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2 style="background-color: white; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-language-override: normal; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-size-adjust: none; font-size: 22px; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: 32px; margin: 32px 0px 16px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Consumer Weakness, Mixed Guidance Weigh on Shares&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Despite the blockbuster results, SanDisk shares fell between 4% and 10% in after-hours trading, as investors focused on guidance that fell short of the most optimistic projections.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The company forecast first-quarter 2027 revenue of $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion, compared with highest Street estimates of approximately $12.3 billion. The cautious outlook underscores lingering weakness in consumer products, where revenue declined 32% year-over-year to $556 million amid sluggish PC and smartphone demand.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The stock's decline follows a staggering 3,000% rally over the past year, leaving little room for disappointment. Both SanDisk and Western Digital now trade roughly 50% below their all-time highs, suggesting potential profit rotation among institutional investors.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h2 style="background-color: white; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-feature-settings: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-language-override: normal; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-size-adjust: none; font-size: 22px; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; line-height: 32px; margin: 32px 0px 16px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;&lt;span style="color: #01ffff;"&gt;Market Implications&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The divergent performance between SanDisk's data-center and consumer segments illustrates the widening gap between AI-driven enterprise spending and consumer electronics demand. As hyper-scalers and cloud providers continue to expand AI infrastructure, memory suppliers are capturing an increasingly large share of the value chain.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;Yet the market's muted response to record results highlights the elevated expectations embedded in semiconductor stocks. Investors are now pricing in near-perfect execution, leaving limited margin for error.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;span class=""&gt;The cryptocurrency market is closely watching these developments. With Bitcoin holding above $64,000 and gold surging over 7% in recent sessions, some analysts are observing a potential rotation away from AI names into alternative assets – a trend that could benefit digital assets if sustained.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;hr style="background: none 0% 0% / auto repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-style: none; border-width: medium; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; height: 1px; margin: 32px 0px;" /&gt;&lt;p class="ds-markdown-paragraph" style="background-color: white; color: #0f1115; font-family: quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot;Segoe UI&amp;quot;, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, &amp;quot;Open Sans&amp;quot;, &amp;quot;Helvetica Neue&amp;quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 16px 0px;"&gt;&lt;em&gt;CoinaiNews.COM provides independent market analysis and coverage of cryptocurrency, technology, and financial markets.     <title>China Unveils $45 Billion Bank and Insurer Recapitalization</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;article&gt;

&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh4y0Fn4lSp0XV7FQRbS28QEs5RfhOhMBU-4wIccvxz14kXD8N1qoJnOVoIKKo2c1BmQHnqibO2ikSyT5mt1eV5ICEvhj5UPoRZvXVz6tsu_Kp7c5kR1ew1m8Lfvdja6XOob9dm9DxtPyoD_UAHzNUvwE8SvjlrTVZ8BN-wkFRPf2j9G8o-sVsLScUKlimk/s1672/china-45-billion-bank-insurer-recapitalization.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="China announces $45 billion recapitalization for major banks and insurers" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh4y0Fn4lSp0XV7FQRbS28QEs5RfhOhMBU-4wIccvxz14kXD8N1qoJnOVoIKKo2c1BmQHnqibO2ikSyT5mt1eV5ICEvhj5UPoRZvXVz6tsu_Kp7c5kR1ew1m8Lfvdja6XOob9dm9DxtPyoD_UAHzNUvwE8SvjlrTVZ8BN-wkFRPf2j9G8o-sVsLScUKlimk/w640-h360/china-45-billion-bank-insurer-recapitalization.jpg.png" title="China $45 Billion Bank and Insurer Recapitalization" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;
September 7, 2026&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;China is moving to strengthen some of its biggest banks and insurers with a &lt;strong&gt;300 billion yuan ($45 billion) capital injection&lt;/strong&gt; funded through special government bonds, in one of the country’s largest financial-sector recapitalization efforts in nearly two decades.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The move is part of a broader package involving eight major financial institutions. Including additional capital raised from other state-linked shareholders, the institutions are seeking to raise up to &lt;strong&gt;360 billion yuan, or about $54 billion&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest step comes as Chinese lenders face weaker lending margins and slower credit demand, while Beijing continues to look for ways to support economic growth and strengthen the resilience of the financial system. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;China’s $45 Billion Injection Explained&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The headline figure of 300 billion yuan refers to capital that China’s Ministry of Finance plans to provide through special government bonds.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The money will be used to recapitalize major state-owned financial institutions, strengthening their capital positions and giving them greater capacity to support lending and absorb potential losses.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, the overall operation is larger than the government’s 300 billion yuan contribution. Announcements from the participating institutions indicate that the combined fundraising could reach &lt;strong&gt;360 billion yuan&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div style="margin: 20px 0px; overflow-x: auto; width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;table style="border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 680px; width: 100%;"&gt;
&lt;thead&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;Figure&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;Approx. USD&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;th style="border: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); padding: 10px; text-align: left;"&gt;What It Represents&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;

&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); padding: 10px;"&gt;300 billion yuan&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); padding: 10px;"&gt;$45 billion&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); padding: 10px;"&gt;Ministry of Finance capital support&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td style="border: 1px solid rgb(204, 204, 204); padding: 10px;"&gt;360 billion yuan&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Which Chinese Banks and Insurers Are Receiving Capital?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The recapitalization covers several major state-owned &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/polands-crypto-bill-veto-survives-after.html"&gt;financial institutions&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Agricultural Bank of China&lt;/strong&gt; plans to raise up to 160 billion yuan through a private placement, while &lt;strong&gt;Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)&lt;/strong&gt; is targeting up to 100 billion yuan.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The &lt;strong&gt;Export-Import Bank of China&lt;/strong&gt; is set to receive 30 billion yuan in capital support.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;On the insurance side, &lt;strong&gt;China Life Insurance&lt;/strong&gt; is receiving 35 billion yuan, while &lt;strong&gt;China Taiping Insurance Group&lt;/strong&gt; is set to receive 7 billion yuan. The &lt;strong&gt;People’s Insurance Company of China&lt;/strong&gt; plans to raise up to 15 billion yuan through a private placement.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;China Reinsurance and China Export &amp;amp; &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/why-is-my-bitcoin-transaction-still.html"&gt;Credit&lt;/a&gt; Insurance are also included in the broader capital-raising program. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Is Beijing Recapitalizing Its Banks?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The main objective is to strengthen the financial system while giving major lenders more room to support the wider economy.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Chinese banks have been operating in an environment of declining net interest margins. Lower margins make it harder for lenders to build capital simply through retained earnings.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At the same time, demand for new loans has weakened. Reuters reported that China’s loan growth fell to a record-low pace in July, highlighting the difficulty policymakers face in encouraging credit expansion through traditional monetary channels alone. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Additional capital can help banks maintain stronger balance sheets while continuing to lend to businesses and households.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;China’s Banks Still Have Capital Buffers&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The recapitalization should not automatically be interpreted as evidence that China’s largest banks are on the verge of collapse.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Data cited in recent reporting showed that Chinese banks had an average capital adequacy ratio of &lt;strong&gt;15.26%&lt;/strong&gt; and an average core Tier 1 capital ratio of &lt;strong&gt;10.72%&lt;/strong&gt; as of June.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead, the current strategy is better understood as a pre-emptive effort to strengthen capital buffers, support lending capacity and prepare major institutions for increasingly demanding regulatory requirements. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Insurers Are Part of the Plan&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The inclusion of major insurers is another important part of the latest package.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;China’s insurers have faced pressure from the prolonged low-interest-rate environment, which can make it harder to generate attractive investment returns while meeting obligations to policyholders.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Additional capital can strengthen insurers’ solvency positions and potentially give them more flexibility to make long-term investments.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reuters reported that analysts expect the insurer &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/can-you-recover-crypto-sent-to-the-wrong-network.html"&gt;capital&lt;/a&gt; injections to ease capital constraints and potentially increase insurers’ ability to invest long-term funds in the stock market. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;China Wants More Financial Firepower&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The recapitalization is part of a broader effort by Beijing to use the financial system to support economic activity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Rather than relying only on interest-rate cuts or other forms of monetary easing, the government can strengthen the balance sheets of institutions that provide credit and manage large pools of capital.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That approach could become particularly important if businesses and households remain cautious about borrowing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A stronger capital base gives banks more capacity to absorb losses and continue financing sectors that policymakers consider important to economic growth.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How This Could Affect Chinese Markets&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The immediate objective is financial stability rather than a direct stock-market stimulus. But the recapitalization could still have consequences for Chinese equities.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Insurers with stronger capital positions may have greater capacity to deploy funds into long-term investments, including equities. Reuters reported that analysts see the insurer recapitalization as potentially easing constraints on stock-market investment. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For banks, stronger capital ratios could also improve their ability to absorb losses and maintain lending.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That said, additional capital alone cannot guarantee stronger economic growth. If businesses and consumers remain reluctant to borrow, banks may still struggle to turn additional balance-sheet capacity into substantially higher loan demand.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;China’s Larger Financial Strategy&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest move follows earlier efforts to strengthen the capital base of China’s largest state-owned banks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Beijing has been gradually replenishing capital at major state lenders as it prepares them for tougher international capital requirements and seeks to keep the financial system resilient.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The new package expands that strategy to include major insurers alongside banks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That broader approach reflects the increasingly important role insurers play in China’s financial markets, particularly as policymakers encourage institutions to provide longer-term investment capital.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Is China’s $45 Billion Injection a Bailout?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The term “bailout” can be misleading if it suggests that the institutions involved are failing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The available information points instead to a &lt;strong&gt;government-led recapitalization&lt;/strong&gt; designed to strengthen balance sheets, support lending capacity and improve financial resilience.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;China’s largest banks continue to report substantial capital buffers. The policy is therefore more accurately described as a capital-strengthening operation rather than a conventional emergency rescue.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Happens Next?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The key question will be whether the additional capital translates into stronger credit growth and greater economic activity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Beijing is trying to address several problems at once: weaker lending margins, slower credit demand, financial-sector risks and the need to maintain support for economic growth.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If banks use the additional capital to expand productive lending, the move could provide broader support to businesses and investment. If demand for credit remains weak, however, the effect on the real economy may be more limited.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For insurers, the focus will be on whether stronger capital positions allow them to increase long-term investment while maintaining financial stability.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Key Takeaways&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;China’s Ministry of Finance plans to provide &lt;strong&gt;300 billion yuan, roughly $45 billion&lt;/strong&gt;, through special government bonds.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The recapitalization targets major state-owned banks and insurers.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The participating institutions could raise up to &lt;strong&gt;360 billion yuan, or about $54 billion&lt;/strong&gt;, when other shareholder contributions are included.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Agricultural Bank of China and ICBC are among the largest bank recipients.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;China Life Insurance and China Taiping are among the insurers receiving additional capital.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The goal is to strengthen capital buffers, support lending and improve financial resilience.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The move comes as Chinese banks face weak lending demand and pressure on net interest margins.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;The recapitalization does not by itself mean China’s largest banks are failing.&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;How much money is China injecting into its banks and insurers?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;China’s Ministry of Finance plans to provide 300 billion yuan, approximately $45 billion, through special government bonds. The participating institutions are expected to raise up to 360 billion yuan in total when other shareholder contributions are included.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Why is China recapitalizing its banks?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;The main goals are to strengthen bank capital, support lending capacity, improve financial resilience and help the financial system support economic growth.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Which Chinese banks are included?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Agricultural Bank of China, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and Export-Import Bank of China are among the institutions included in the latest recapitalization program.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Which Chinese insurers are receiving capital?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;China Life Insurance, China Taiping Insurance Group and People’s Insurance Company of China are among the major insurers included in the package.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is China rescuing failing banks?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;The available information describes the operation as a recapitalization designed to strengthen financial institutions. It should not automatically be interpreted as an emergency bailout of failing banks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Could the capital injection boost Chinese stocks?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Potentially. Stronger insurer capital positions could provide greater capacity for long-term investments, including equities. However, the recapitalization does not guarantee a sustained stock-market rally.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Will the move increase lending in China?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;It is intended to give banks greater capacity to support lending. The actual impact will depend partly on whether businesses and households are willing to borrow.&lt;/p&gt;
