   &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
   &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Token&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
   &lt;/td&gt;
   &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
   &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Function&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
   &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;/thead&gt;
 &lt;tbody&gt;&lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 1;"&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;DOLO&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Native ERC-20 token; liquidity, transfers and ecosystem
  utility&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 2;"&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;veDOLO&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Governance and voting power&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 3; mso-yfti-lastrow: yes;"&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;oDOLO&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Liquidity-provider rewards used with DOLO to obtain
  discounted veDOLO&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This separation means the governance token and the utility
token aren't the same thing, which is different from many other DeFi projects.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;How Dolomite Works&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;At its core, Dolomite is a lending, borrowing and trading
protocol. Here's the basic flow:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol start="1" style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="1"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;You
     deposit cryptoassets as collateral&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;You
     can borrow stablecoins against that collateral&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;While
     your assets are deposited, they can still earn yield through the
     protocol's integration with other DeFi platforms&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The protocol uses Chainlink oracles to ensure fair pricing
and includes a 5% liquidation penalty to manage risk.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Makes It Different?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The main differentiator is asset diversity. While Aave and
Compound primarily support major assets like ETH, USDC, and DAI, Dolomite
supports over 1,000 different assets. This gives users more flexibility but
also comes with higher risk, as less-liquid assets can be more volatile.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The World Liberty Financial Connection&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Dolomite gained additional attention when its co-founder,
Corey Caplan, was named an advisor to World Liberty Financial (WLFI) in
September 2024. This created a strategic bridge between the two projects. The
connection also brought WLFI-related assets into Dolomite's ecosystem,
expanding the relationship between the two projects.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The connection increased attention around Dolomite,
particularly as World Liberty Financial later used the protocol for lending and
collateral activity.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;DOL on Avalanche: A Different Project&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It's important to note that&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;DOL also exists as a
token on the Avalanche network&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;through a project called&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;Dolana&lt;/b&gt;.
This is a completely different project with different tokenomics.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Key differences:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" class="MsoNormalTable" style="border-collapse: collapse; mso-yfti-tbllook: 1184; width: 744px;"&gt;
 &lt;thead&gt;
  &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-firstrow: yes; mso-yfti-irow: 0;"&gt;
   &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
   &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Feature&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
   &lt;/td&gt;
   &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
   &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Dolomite (DOLO)&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
   &lt;/td&gt;
   &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
   &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Dolana (DOL)&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
   &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;/thead&gt;

  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Blockchain&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Arbitrum, Ethereum, Mantle, Berachain&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Avalanche&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 2;"&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Purpose&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;DeFi lending protocol&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Hyper-deflationary, hyper-reward token&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 3;"&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tokenomics&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Governance + utility token&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;2.5% of every transaction burned&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 4; mso-yfti-lastrow: yes;"&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Mechanism&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Interest and fees&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;Staking rewards from transaction burns&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: x-small;"&gt;If you're looking at a DOL token on Avalanche, that's likely
Dolana, not Dolomite.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Security and Risks&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;No DeFi protocol is without risk, and Dolomite has had
its challenges.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;In March 2024, a vulnerability in Dolomite's old Ethereum
contracts, which had been deployed years earlier and discontinued, was
exploited. Approximately&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;$1.8 million&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;was taken from 187
victims. Dolomite's own post-mortem says the vulnerable old system dated to
2019 and had been shut down in 2020; the incident affected users who still had
old approvals.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Other risks to consider:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l3 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The
     protocol is still relatively small compared to established players&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l3 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Support
     for over 1,000 assets means some may have low liquidity&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l3 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The
     governance mechanism requires active participation to be effective&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Should You Buy DOLO?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This isn't financial advice — it's context.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/what-is-slippage-in-crypto-trading-and.html"&gt;Dolomite &lt;/a&gt;offers a genuinely different approach to DeFi by
focusing on asset diversity and capital efficiency. The integration with World
Liberty Financial and a reported $3.4 million in total funding, with Coinbase
Ventures among its investors, suggest institutional interest.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;However, the project's smaller size, security history, and
competitive landscape (Aave, Compound, and others) mean it's not without risk.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;If you're considering DOLO:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ol start="1" style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="1"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo4; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Understand
     that it's a governance and utility token, not a stablecoin&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo4; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Be
     aware of the difference between DOLO on Arbitrum/Ethereum and DOL on
     Avalanche&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo4; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Check
     the current TVL and trading volume to assess activity&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l0 level1 lfo4; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Remember
     that DeFi protocols can have smart contract risks&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ol&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Dolomite (DOLO) is a DeFi lending protocol that stands out
for its support of over 1,000 assets and its focus on capital efficiency. It
has a three-token model, a connection to World Liberty Financial, and a history
that includes both growth and a security incident.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;As with any crypto project, do your own research. Understand
the tokenomics, the team, and the risks before making any decisions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>10 of the Weirdest Things Ever Tokenized on Blockchain</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhIK8w4IYCDC-1JsDGlBrG2aie4aQir8fiZIiZZbAKvs13nmqCe2TSkS_NlFWtO9x36X67XrPUjvP04UaIuABzLeT74RiUu9FJZUPfblf5CPCxOY4FMd18Wqf81Prt_hJL9mLzxynm_sl6YyLpuf7r6oj2vHFhy2CDN6Y4dTz5PGHoqp8g0B4Pv7XleGG3D/s1376/88.png" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="10 weirdest things ever tokenized on blockchain including Disaster Girl NFT banana Jack Dorsey tweet uranium and music royalties" border="0" data-original-height="768" data-original-width="1376" height="179" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhIK8w4IYCDC-1JsDGlBrG2aie4aQir8fiZIiZZbAKvs13nmqCe2TSkS_NlFWtO9x36X67XrPUjvP04UaIuABzLeT74RiUu9FJZUPfblf5CPCxOY4FMd18Wqf81Prt_hJL9mLzxynm_sl6YyLpuf7r6oj2vHFhy2CDN6Y4dTz5PGHoqp8g0B4Pv7XleGG3D/w320-h179/88.png" title="Collage of strangest blockchain tokenizations featuring Disaster Girl meme duct-taped banana Jack Dorsey tweet NFT and uranium token" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Aug 8, 2026 – Blockchain tokenization has evolved far beyond
cryptocurrencies and stablecoins. While financial giants like BlackRock and
JPMorgan are busy tokenizing Treasury bills and money market funds, the crypto
community has taken the technology in some unexpected directions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;The tokenized real-world asset market has exploded from $8.8
billion to nearly $30 billion over the past year. But alongside serious
institutional adoption, a parallel universe of bizarre tokenization has emerged
— from bodily functions to livestock to duct-taped bananas.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Here are 10 of the weirdest things that have been tokenized
on blockchain:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h4 style="text-align: left;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;1. "Disaster Girl" Meme&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/h4&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: In April 2021, Zoë Roth — the girl in the
famous "Disaster Girl" meme — sold a non-fungible token of the
original photograph for 180 ETH. At the time of sale, this was valued at
approximately $473,000 to $500,000.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Key details: Roth retained the copyright and arranged a 10%
royalty on any future sales. The 21-year-old University of North Carolina
student used proceeds to pay off student loans and donate to charity. Her
father Dave took the original photo in 2005 during a controlled burn.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Who Said What:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"The sale shows us that we do have some sort of
control, some sort of agency in the whole process." – Zoë Roth, speaking
to The News &amp;amp; Observer&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"There's only one person who has the bragging rights to
it." – David Yermack, NYU Finance Professor, describing blockchain
technology as a "revolution in accounting"&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"I think anytime you can find a collector — no matter
what price — who respects the art behind it and is going to cherish it, that's
a successful sale." – Ben Lashes, manager of meme stars including
"Disaster Girl," "Grumpy Cat," and "Nyan Cat"&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Source: BBC News, New York Times, CoinMarketCap&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;2. A Duct-Taped Banana (The "Comedian" Artwork)&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: The physical artwork "Comedian" by
Italian artist Maurizio Cattelan — a banana duct-taped to a wall — debuted at
the 2019 Art Basel show in Miami Beach and sold for $120,000. In November 2024,
crypto entrepreneur **Justin Sun** purchased the artwork for **$6.2 million**
at a Sotheby's auction, more than quadrupling its $1.5 million estimate.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;The twist: Sun fulfilled a promise to eat the banana at a
Hong Kong press conference, describing the act as "becoming a part of the
artwork's history".&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Important nuance: The buyer purchased the certificate of
authenticity and instructions on how to replace the banana when it rots — not
the fruit itself, which is regularly replaced.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Who Said What:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"This is not just an artwork; it represents a cultural
phenomenon that bridges the worlds of art, memes, and the cryptocurrency
community." – Justin Sun, founder of TRON, after acquiring the piece&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"In the coming days, I will personally eat the banana
as part of this unique artistic experience, honoring its place in both art
history and popular culture." – Justin Sun&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"How do you value what, for me at least, is one of the
most brilliant ideas in the history of conceptual art?" – David Galperin,
Sotheby's Head of Contemporary Art, Americas&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Source: Sotheby's official release, Daily Mail, Ocula
Magazine&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;3. Jack Dorsey's First Tweet&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: An NFT of Jack Dorsey's first tweet —
"just setting up my twttr" — sold for $2,915,835.47 (1,630.5825601
ETH) during the 2021 NFT boom. The buyer was Iranian-born crypto entrepreneur
Sina Estavi, CEO of Bridge Oracle.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Key details: Dorsey pledged to convert proceeds to bitcoin
and donate to GiveDirectly's Africa Response charity. The sale was handled on
Valuables by Cent, with 95% of proceeds going to Dorsey and 5% to the platform.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;The twist: When Estavi attempted to resell it in April 2022
with an asking price of $48 million, the highest recorded bid dropped
dramatically, highlighting how cultural novelty doesn't always translate into
durable returns.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Who Said What:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"This is not just a tweet! I think years later people
will realize the true value of this tweet, like the Mona Lisa painting." –
Sina Estavi, buyer of Dorsey's first tweet NFT&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"It was bought using the cryptocurrency Ether, for
1630.5825601 ETH, which was worth $2,915,835.47 at the time of sale." –
Cameron Hejazi, CEO and co-founder of Cent (Valuables platform)&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Source: Reuters, BBC News&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;4. Tokenized Uranium&amp;nbsp;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: Metals.io, a Tezos-ecosystem real-world-asset
platform, has tokenized physical uranium, along with other technology-flavored
commodities. The flagship uranium token, xU3O8, represents physical yellowcake
held in custody and traded 24/7.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Scale: The platform launched with tokenized uranium (xU3O8),
gold (VNXAU), and a strategic metals basket token (RARE) covering hafnium,
rhenium, indium, neodymium oxide, and praseodymium oxide — all critical to AI
and advanced technologies.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Who Said What:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"Commodities are super interesting because the
regulatory status of spot commodities in most countries is much more amendable
to work on a blockchain than it is for securities." – Arthur Breitman,
Tezos co-founder, speaking at TezDev 2026&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"Base metals I think are really interesting. So things
like cobalt, cadmium, some precious metals as well. Copper, lithium, all of
that. There's an interesting play here." – Arthur Breitman&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"Now that it's tokenized on Etherlink, on top of that
perhaps when there's more liquidity you can imagine perps which is a nice
innovation from the DeFi world." – Arthur Breitman, on the uranium token&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"There's an opportunity to create something that
doesn't exist as opposed to trying to replace other systems." – Arthur
Breitman&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Source: CoinMarketCap Community (crypto.news), Bitget News&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;5. Tokenized Music Royalties (3LAU)&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: Musicians have embraced tokenization to sell
streaming royalties directly to fans. In 2021, electronic musician 3LAU (Justin
Blau) sold his "Ultraviolet" album as an NFT collection for
approximately $11.7 million, with buyers receiving a share of streaming
royalties.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;How it works: The tokens represent fractional ownership of
future royalty payments from streaming platforms. 3LAU subsequently founded
Royal.io, which raised $16 million** in seed funding and **$55 million in
Series A, with artists like Nas, Diplo, and The Chainsmokers using the
platform.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Who Said What:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"3LAU's Ultraviolet NFT auction grossed about $11.7
million. Founded Royal.io: a platform where fans buy limited digital assets
that include shares of streaming royalties." – Jeroen Vaelen, Web3 Music
Industry analyst on LinkedIn&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Source: LinkedIn (Jeroen Vaelen), YouTube Music Podcast&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;6. Tokenized Cows in Brazil&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: A dairy farm in Paraná, southern Brazil, used
ten dairy cows as collateral for a 100,000 Brazilian real loan (approximately
$19,400) on the B3 stock exchange. This marked the first livestock collateral
formally registered on Brazil's main stock exchange .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;How it works: Each cow wears an AI-powered smart collar from
Cowmed that tracks health, behavior, rumination, and location in real time. The
raw data is converted into an encrypted digital identifier directly linked to
the credit agreement .&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"We take the cow, which is a real and tangible asset,
and transform it into a digital asset backed by a unique code monitored in real
time." – Thiago Martins, Cowmed representative, speaking to CNN
Brasil&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;The bigger picture: Cowmed currently monitors approximately
100,000 dairy cows from over 1,000 farms, with a herd valued at over R$2
billion (approximately $395 million). An estimated 20% of network members are
interested in this model, potentially unlocking R$400 million (about $77.6
million) in new credit .&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Important nuance: While widely described as "tokenized
cows," the transaction uses a traditional Brazilian credit instrument
(CPR-F) and encrypted digital identities — no public blockchain token is
actually traded&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;7. A Year's Worth of Farts&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: During the pandemic, filmmaker Alex
Ramírez-Mallis recorded his own bodily functions and minted each sound as a
non-fungible token. He sold the pieces for 0.05 ETH apiece (around $85 at the
time).&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Why it matters: The experiment demonstrated that
tokenization can package almost any measurable event into a transferable
digital unit. The real question for investors and users is what that unit means
legally and economically once the novelty fades.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;8. A Perfume Formula&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: German beauty studio Look Labs launched Cyber
Eau de Parfum in April 2021, linking the scent formula to an NFT . Each buyer
received a physical bottle and a digital token containing the encoded recipe .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;How it works: The fragrance was developed with a master
perfumer in Grasse, France, and recorded using near-infrared spectroscopy . The
scent blends juniper, lemon, bergamot, pine needle, iris, sandalwood, cedar,
and amber .&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"Look Labs translates the scent of Cyber Eau de Parfum
into an NFT artwork making it the world's first digital fragrance." –
Jordan Katzarov, Look Labs founder&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"Potentially if we have a machine that can convert back
those molecular reflections, we can recreate the scent back or, we can have an
AI algorithm that can 'decode' the scent and reproduce it in the near
future." – Jordan Katzarov, to Dezeen&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;9. Racehorses&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: Tokenization can break thoroughbred racehorse
ownership into digital shares, allowing investors to buy partial stakes and
participate in prize earnings, breeding income, or future resale proceeds .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Scale: Platforms like Tokinvest and Part Of Dream (POD) are
building regulated marketplaces for racehorse tokenization. In September 2025,
Tokinvest sold out its first tokenized racehorse project, raising US$3.2
million and earning the first full multi-asset license from Dubai's Virtual
Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) .&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"Our mission is simple and ambitious: make investing in
real-world assets as easy as buying a product on Amazon." – Scott Thiel,
CEO of Tokinvest&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"Investing in racehorses has traditionally been the
preserve of the super wealthy and elite. Tokinvest has developed a new way to
invest in racehorses that massively brings down the cost and ease." –
Scott Thiel, to Inc. Arabia&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;The challenge: Placing an item on a blockchain doesn't
automatically make it more liquid or valuable if the legal rights, transfer
processes, and market structure remain the same.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;10. Whisky Casks&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;What happened: Tokenization platforms like DigiCask enable
fractional ownership of premium whisky casks on the blockchain, unlocking new
opportunities for alternative investment .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;How it works: Investors can buy whole units or fractional
stakes in aging Scotch whisky while the physical inventory sits in bonded
warehouses. The token simplifies how ownership is divided and administered,
though investors still depend on the performance of the underlying market and
storage arrangements .&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;"DigiCask is a whisky tokenization platform that
unlocks new opportunities for investors searching for alternative investments
by enabling fractional ownership of premium whisky casks on the blockchain and
offering transparency and accessibility." – DigiCask project
description&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Honorable Mentions&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;Tokenized fish-backed debt: A Chilean fish processing
company attempted to structure a tokenized debt instrument with returns based
on fish sales. The deal ultimately failed due to unresolved reporting and audit
requirements.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;Burned art NFTs: Some creators have tokenized artwork they
subsequently destroyed, creating value through scarcity and performance art.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The Serious Side of Weird&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;While these examples range from absurd to genuinely bizarre,
they highlight a crucial point: tokenization is fundamentally flexible. The
same technology that tokenizes bodily functions can also tokenize uranium,
whisky casks, and livestock for agricultural lending.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;The serious takeaway from experiments like Brazil's
tokenized cows is that building enforceability, verification, and legal clarity
is the hard part — not the tokenization itself. As the Tezos-backed metals
platform demonstrates, tokenization is now moving into commodities critical to
the AI revolution.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;The tokenized RWA market has tripled in size over the past
year, and institutions are moving from pilots to production. As Larry Fink, CEO
of BlackRock, has argued, eventually every asset could be tokenized. Whether
that includes farts, cows, or both, the crypto industry is determined to find
out.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

independent market analysis and coverage of cryptocurrency, technology, and
financial markets. The information presented does not constitute financial
advice.&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>THORChain 3.20 Brings Monero and Zcash Closer to Native Cross-Chain Liquidity</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiDJ8MJ-iGNZneA2I-uGQQR0N77ZpS_V1HsKzP79oxoaKzIJgkdM5LMhAn5UMq7KQIvnFrSJxTyr7sZ7o1owoFTY8DRy6jL58WvbB1iAysBHY1upwNQ3mTAbc98XYyt1nFe08UuAtiTPHhBbVuvmy5j6QCrbtJW2D6BXmRBC6hFpp5A0xt2tNoHflfwu_-k/s1672/thorchain-3-20-monero-zcash-cross-chain-liquidity.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="THORChain 3.20 moves Monero and Zcash closer to native cross-chain liquidity" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiDJ8MJ-iGNZneA2I-uGQQR0N77ZpS_V1HsKzP79oxoaKzIJgkdM5LMhAn5UMq7KQIvnFrSJxTyr7sZ7o1owoFTY8DRy6jL58WvbB1iAysBHY1upwNQ3mTAbc98XYyt1nFe08UuAtiTPHhBbVuvmy5j6QCrbtJW2D6BXmRBC6hFpp5A0xt2tNoHflfwu_-k/w400-h225/thorchain-3-20-monero-zcash-cross-chain-liquidity.jpg.png" title="THORChain 3.20, Monero and Zcash Cross-Chain Liquidity" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: small;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff |&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain has released v3.20 — a major upgrade that moves Monero and Zcash significantly closer to native cross-chain swaps.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The update brings a series of changes to THORChain's cross-chain infrastructure, including major work related to &lt;strong&gt;Monero (XMR)&lt;/strong&gt; and &lt;strong&gt;Zcash (ZEC)&lt;/strong&gt;, two privacy-focused cryptocurrencies that have historically been harder to connect with the wider crypto market.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is an important distinction, however. The v3.20 release does &lt;strong&gt;not&lt;/strong&gt; mean that unrestricted XMR and ZEC trading is suddenly available across every THORChain interface. Instead, the upgrade lays important technical groundwork for those integrations, with Monero moving through a progressive activation process and Zcash positioned as the next integration.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That makes the upgrade significant — but for a slightly different reason than a simple “privacy coins are now live” headline might suggest.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What THORChain 3.20 Actually Changes&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain is built around a relatively simple idea: users should be able to swap native assets across different blockchains without converting them into wrapped versions or handing their funds to a centralized exchange.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin and Ethereum are already part of that model. Supporting privacy-focused networks is considerably more complicated because their transaction systems and cryptographic designs work differently.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/monad-developers-propose-upgradeable.html"&gt;THORChain&lt;/a&gt;'s release information, v3.20 includes fixes and security improvements covering areas such as &lt;strong&gt;Monero key generation, FROST signing, vault rotation, transaction observation and recovery&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Those changes are particularly important for the network's plans around XMR. Before a cross-chain integration can become broadly usable, the underlying infrastructure needs to reliably generate keys, authorize transactions, monitor activity and recover from potential failures.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Monero Is Getting Closer — But the Rollout Is Progressive&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is the part that needs the most careful explanation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain says Monero is moving toward activation, but the rollout is expected to happen progressively as the network tests and monitors the integration.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means users should not interpret the v3.20 release as confirmation that every THORChain wallet or interface can already execute unrestricted XMR swaps.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead, the upgrade represents a substantial step toward making that functionality possible.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Why Monero Is Technically Difficult&lt;/h3&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Monero uses privacy-preserving transaction technology that makes transaction observation and recovery more complicated than on transparent blockchains.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain has highlighted the use of &lt;strong&gt;FROST threshold signing&lt;/strong&gt; as part of its Monero integration. Version 3.20 includes improvements designed to deal with issues such as key generation, missing key shares and Monero transaction data.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In practical terms, this is much more than simply adding XMR to a list of supported assets.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The network needs to make sure the underlying signing and transaction infrastructure works reliably before users can depend on it for meaningful liquidity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Zcash Is Next in Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Zcash is also moving forward, although it is at a different stage from Monero.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain's v3.20 update includes changes to its Zcash client to recognize the network's &lt;strong&gt;NU6.3 “Ironwood” upgrade&lt;/strong&gt;. The release also brings THORChain's Zcash testing environment into compatibility with the relevant Zebra version.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain describes Zcash as the &lt;strong&gt;next chain integration&lt;/strong&gt; in its current pipeline.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;So it would be premature to describe v3.20 as an instant, fully activated ZEC trading launch. The more accurate description is that the protocol is preparing the infrastructure needed for the integration.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Privacy Coins Need Better Liquidity Access&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The broader problem THORChain is trying to address is fairly straightforward.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Privacy coins have often had fewer options for moving into and out of the wider crypto market. Monero, in particular, has faced restrictions and delistings on some centralized exchanges, making access to liquidity more complicated for some users.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A native cross-chain route could change that.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of converting XMR into a wrapped representation or depositing it with a centralized exchange, users could eventually have another way to move between native &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/monad-developers-propose-upgradeable.html"&gt;XMR&lt;/a&gt; and other supported cryptocurrencies through THORChain's infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That would give privacy-coin holders another route into the broader market while maintaining a self-custodial model.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the actual usefulness of that route will ultimately depend on how much liquidity becomes available and how widely wallets and aggregators support it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;THORChain Is Doing More Than Adding Privacy Coins&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The privacy-coin work is only one part of v3.20.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The upgrade is one of THORChain's broader infrastructure releases, with changes covering liquidity, stablecoin swaps, supported chains and network operations.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;table&gt;
&lt;thead&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;th&gt;Feature&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;th&gt;What v3.20 Changes&lt;/th&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/thead&gt;
&lt;tbody&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Monero (XMR)&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td&gt;Major infrastructure and security improvements ahead of progressive activation.&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Zcash (ZEC)&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td&gt;Updated client and network compatibility work ahead of integration.&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stable Reserve&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td&gt;Experimental mechanism for stablecoin liquidity and eligible stablecoin swaps.&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Protocol-Owned Liquidity&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td&gt;New controls for deploying protocol capital into liquidity.&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;BNB, Base and Solana&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;

&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;tr&gt;
&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Network Security&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;td&gt;Additional improvements to node, vault and transaction handling.&lt;/td&gt;
&lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;
&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Stable Reserve Could Be One of the More Interesting Changes&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Another feature worth watching is THORChain's new &lt;strong&gt;Stable Reserve&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The mechanism is designed to allow eligible stablecoins to be swapped against protocol-owned stablecoin inventory instead of always relying on THORChain's traditional liquidity structure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;When sufficient inventory is available, eligible stablecoin-to-&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/x-trade-buttons-are-coming-soon-says.html"&gt;stablecoin&lt;/a&gt; swaps can potentially execute at &lt;strong&gt;1:1 with no liquidity fee and no slippage&lt;/strong&gt;, although network transaction costs can still apply.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is an important caveat: the Stable Reserve is experimental and was introduced &lt;strong&gt;disabled by default&lt;/strong&gt; while testing continues.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the mechanism proves reliable, it could eventually give wallets, exchanges and aggregators another reason to route stablecoin transactions through THORChain.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Protocol-Owned Liquidity Gets a Bigger Role&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Version 3.20 also expands THORChain's approach to &lt;strong&gt;Protocol-Owned Liquidity (POL)&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The basic concept is that the protocol itself can direct part of its resources toward liquidity rather than depending entirely on external liquidity providers.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest changes introduce governance controls around how system income can be allocated to POL and which pools can receive protocol-owned liquidity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That could become increasingly important as THORChain attempts to grow trading activity across more networks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Deeper liquidity generally means better execution for larger swaps, while protocol-owned liquidity can potentially make the network less dependent on short-term liquidity incentives.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;BNB, Base and Solana Are Also Returning&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Version 3.20 is not only about new integrations.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The release also prepares the infrastructure for &lt;strong&gt;BNB, Base and Solana trading to resume progressively&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That matters because THORChain has gone through a period in which security and infrastructure issues affected parts of its network operations.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The latest release includes additional improvements to nodes, vaults and transaction handling as the protocol continues strengthening its infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why the Upgrade Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain's long-term proposition is different from simply creating another decentralized exchange.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The protocol is attempting to connect assets that normally live inside separate blockchain ecosystems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Bitcoin operates on Bitcoin. Ether operates on Ethereum. Monero has its own privacy-focused network, while Zcash uses its own architecture.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Moving value between these systems without relying on centralized intermediaries is technically difficult.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That is why the progress around XMR and ZEC is important.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If THORChain can eventually provide reliable native liquidity between privacy-focused assets and major cryptocurrencies, it could connect two parts of the crypto market that have often remained relatively separate.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;But There Is Still Work to Do&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It would be easy to look at the v3.20 announcement and conclude that THORChain has already solved the privacy-coin liquidity problem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That's premature.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Monero's rollout is progressive. Zcash remains an upcoming integration. The Stable Reserve is experimental and disabled by default, while actual liquidity levels will determine how useful the new integrations become.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Technical support is only the first step.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A successful cross-chain market also needs reliable infrastructure, sufficient liquidity, competitive execution and wallet or aggregator support. Those pieces take time to develop.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Users Should Watch Next&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For XMR and ZEC holders, the next important milestone isn't simply another protocol version number.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It's &lt;strong&gt;actual activation and usable liquidity&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Once the integrations progress further, users will want to know:&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Which wallets support the swaps?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Which assets can be traded directly against XMR and ZEC?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How deep is the available liquidity?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;What fees apply?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How reliable are transaction confirmations?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How quickly do swaps settle?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Are there temporary limits during the rollout?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Those practical details will determine whether THORChain's privacy-coin integration becomes a meaningful trading route or remains primarily an interesting piece of infrastructure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bigger Picture for Privacy Coins&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Privacy-focused cryptocurrencies have always faced a difficult trade-off.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;They offer technology designed to provide greater transaction privacy, but those same characteristics can make integration with conventional financial and crypto infrastructure more complicated.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Centralized exchanges can restrict or remove support. Wrapped representations introduce another layer of complexity. Cross-chain protocols, meanwhile, have historically faced technical challenges when connecting privacy-focused networks.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain's work on XMR and ZEC shows that decentralized infrastructure is still trying to solve that problem.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If the integrations eventually reach full production maturity, privacy-coin holders could have another way to access broader crypto liquidity without depending entirely on centralized exchanges or wrapped representations.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;THORChain v3.20 is a major infrastructure upgrade, but it is not accurate to describe it as a fully live Monero and Zcash trading launch just yet.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The release moves &lt;strong&gt;Monero significantly closer to activation&lt;/strong&gt;, with major work on FROST signing, key generation, transaction observation and recovery. Zcash is also progressing, with updated client and network compatibility work preparing it for integration.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At the same time, THORChain is preparing to bring back support for BNB, Base and Solana, introducing its experimental Stable Reserve and expanding its Protocol-Owned Liquidity system.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For privacy-coin users, the potential payoff is straightforward: a future route between &lt;strong&gt;native XMR or ZEC and major crypto assets without relying entirely on centralized exchanges or wrapped representations&lt;/strong&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the real test starts now.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;THORChain has built more of the infrastructure. The next question is whether the network can turn that infrastructure into &lt;strong&gt;deep, reliable, and genuinely usable privacy-coin liquidity — and whether privacy-coin holders will finally have a self-custodial route into the broader market.&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;This article is for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice. Cryptocurrency markets and decentralized protocols involve significant risks. Readers should verify current protocol status, supported assets, liquidity and fees before using any crypto service.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Nvidia in Talks to Invest Up to $10 Billion in Anthropic IPO as AI Firm Targets $2 Trillion Valuation</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhmn-Uj-0F3KdSYN3RUpW43pOLLntTnNBC-RKRmpQGPMJ_U84Zq7PUoXy5jyzR9j9aA-m1jzdZ2JIXd9p-FJlUD-brqfu7SklNxDABxUtGrOSMxbY9YNY8t2Sr2cWdThyDWVlMoaG8JsA8ALxgTQtN9HTkmx8MYfg1aEVhVk6XSJ8q0o7-aFTAc1_Lom6KZ/s1672/nvidia-anthropic-10-billion-ipo-investment.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Nvidia and Anthropic potential $10 billion AI investment and IPO" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="360" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhmn-Uj-0F3KdSYN3RUpW43pOLLntTnNBC-RKRmpQGPMJ_U84Zq7PUoXy5jyzR9j9aA-m1jzdZ2JIXd9p-FJlUD-brqfu7SklNxDABxUtGrOSMxbY9YNY8t2Sr2cWdThyDWVlMoaG8JsA8ALxgTQtN9HTkmx8MYfg1aEVhVk6XSJ8q0o7-aFTAc1_Lom6KZ/w640-h360/nvidia-anthropic-10-billion-ipo-investment.jpg.png" title="Nvidia Anthropic Potential $10 Billion IPO Investment" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nvidia is reportedly in talks to become a major anchor investor in Anthropic’s potential initial public offering (IPO), with the chipmaker considering an investment of up to $10 billion.&lt;/strong&gt; According to a Reuters report, Anthropic could seek to raise as much as $100 billion in the offering, potentially giving the artificial intelligence company a valuation of around $2 trillion.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The discussions highlight how quickly the financial scale of leading AI companies is expanding. If completed on the reported terms, Anthropic’s IPO could become one of the largest public offerings ever and would give Nvidia an even deeper financial relationship with one of the most important users of its AI chips.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, the reported investment is &lt;strong&gt;not yet a finalized transaction&lt;/strong&gt;. Reuters reported that the discussions remain ongoing and could change. Anthropic has not publicly confirmed the IPO terms, while Nvidia had not immediately responded to Reuters’ request for comment. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Nvidia Could Become an Anchor Investor in Anthropic’s IPO&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reuters reported on September 11 that Anthropic is discussing bringing Nvidia into its planned IPO as an anchor investor. People familiar with the discussions said Nvidia is considering investing as much as $10 billion.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;An anchor investor typically commits to purchasing a significant portion of shares around an IPO, providing an early signal of institutional confidence. For a company seeking to raise tens of billions of dollars, having a major technology company such as Nvidia involved could help strengthen investor interest.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The potential investment is particularly notable because Nvidia and Anthropic already have significant commercial ties. Anthropic depends heavily on advanced computing infrastructure to train and operate its Claude AI models, while Nvidia remains one of the industry's leading suppliers of AI accelerators.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Anthropic Could Target a $100 Billion IPO&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The reported size of Anthropic’s potential offering is what makes the story especially significant.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to Reuters, Anthropic is seeking to raise &lt;strong&gt;as much as $100 billion&lt;/strong&gt;, potentially valuing the company at approximately &lt;strong&gt;$2 trillion&lt;/strong&gt;. Those figures are not final and could change as the company moves closer to an eventual listing.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A $100 billion capital raise would represent an extraordinary milestone for the U.S. IPO market and would place Anthropic among the most valuable publicly traded technology companies if the reported valuation were achieved.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The potential listing also comes at a time when investors are closely watching whether the enormous capital requirements of frontier &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/singapore-exchange-targets-us.html"&gt;AI companies&lt;/a&gt; can translate into sustainable revenue and profits.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Anthropic’s Valuation Has Risen Rapidly&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Anthropic’s potential IPO valuation would represent a major increase from its most recent private-market valuation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reuters reported that Anthropic raised $65 billion in May at a post-money valuation of approximately $965 billion. The company’s annualized revenue run rate had subsequently climbed above $65 billion by the end of July, compared with roughly $9 billion at the end of 2025. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That rapid revenue growth is one reason investors are paying close attention to the company’s IPO plans. Anthropic has also reportedly projected revenue of roughly $190 billion to $200 billion in 2028, although future projections are inherently uncertain and should not be treated as guaranteed results.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Nvidia’s Potential Investment Matters&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Nvidia's possible participation would be more than a simple financial investment. It could strengthen a relationship between a leading &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ai-crashed-market-whos-liable.html"&gt;AI model developer&lt;/a&gt; and one of the world's most important suppliers of AI computing hardware.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Training and operating advanced AI models requires enormous amounts of computing power. Nvidia’s GPUs have become a critical part of the infrastructure supporting many major AI companies, including Anthropic.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reuters also reported that Anthropic has been working to diversify its computing suppliers. The company has relationships with major technology firms including Amazon and Google, while also exploring custom hardware to gain greater control over its computing costs. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means Nvidia has a strategic interest in maintaining a strong relationship with Anthropic even as the AI company expands its infrastructure options.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Anthropic Is Expanding Its Computing Infrastructure&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Anthropic's AI models require substantial computing capacity, particularly as demand for its Claude products grows.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The company has agreements involving several major technology providers. Reuters reported that Anthropic has committed to purchasing significant computing capacity through Microsoft Azure powered by Nvidia chips, while Amazon and Google are also important infrastructure partners.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In April, Anthropic said it would commit more than $100 billion over a decade to Amazon Web Services and use more than one million Amazon Trainium2 chips. The company has also agreed with Google and Broadcom to expand access to additional TPU capacity. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This infrastructure race explains why the relationship between AI model developers and semiconductor companies has become increasingly important to investors.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Could Anthropic’s IPO Become the Largest in History?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If Anthropic ultimately raises close to the reported $100 billion target, the IPO could become one of the largest public offerings ever.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The U.S. IPO market has already experienced a strong year. Reuters reported that U.S. IPOs excluding special-purpose acquisition companies had raised about $137 billion through the end of August, according to Dealogic. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Anthropic’s potential listing would therefore arrive during a period when investors are already showing strong appetite for large technology offerings. At the same time, the enormous valuation being discussed means the IPO could become an important test of how much investors are willing to pay for rapidly growing AI businesses.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Anthropic IPO Plans Are Still Subject to Change&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Investors should be careful not to treat the reported $2 trillion valuation or $100 billion fundraising target as final.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The Reuters report is based on people familiar with confidential discussions, and those discussions could change before Anthropic files final IPO documents. The size of the offering, valuation, timing and Nvidia’s potential investment could all be different when the transaction becomes official.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Anthropic has also not publicly confirmed the reported IPO structure.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That distinction is important because the current story is about &lt;strong&gt;potential IPO plans and ongoing negotiations&lt;/strong&gt;, rather than a completed $10 billion Nvidia investment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What the Nvidia-Anthropic Deal Could Mean for AI Investors&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;If Nvidia ultimately participates with a multibillion-dollar commitment, the investment could be interpreted as a strong vote of confidence in Anthropic and the broader market for frontier AI.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It could also demonstrate how closely linked the &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/should-ai-learn-crypto-risk-nobodys.html"&gt;AI ecosystem&lt;/a&gt; has become. AI model developers need increasingly powerful computing infrastructure, while chipmakers depend on continued demand from those developers to justify enormous investments in next-generation hardware.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Nvidia, an investment in Anthropic could potentially provide exposure to the growth of one of the industry's major AI labs while strengthening a commercial relationship with a large customer.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For Anthropic, securing Nvidia as an anchor investor could provide additional credibility as it prepares for what could be a landmark public-market debut.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nvidia is reportedly considering investing up to $10 billion in Anthropic’s potential IPO, while Anthropic is seeking to raise as much as $100 billion at a valuation of around $2 trillion, according to Reuters.&lt;/strong&gt; &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The potential transaction would further connect two major parts of the AI economy: the companies developing frontier AI models and the semiconductor companies supplying the computing power required to run them.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But for now, the key word is &lt;strong&gt;“potential.”&lt;/strong&gt; The Nvidia investment has not been finalized, and Anthropic’s reported fundraising target and valuation remain subject to change.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;As Anthropic moves toward a possible public listing, investors will be watching three things closely: the company's final IPO valuation, the amount it ultimately raises, and whether Nvidia formally commits to becoming an anchor investor.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Source: Reuters reporting based on people familiar with the discussions. The reported investment and IPO terms remain subject to change.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
</content>

    <title>Germany Extends EU Lead With 79 MiCA-Authorized Crypto Providers as Banks Join In</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgnmJOg8kO5dDwjsIMdwtjYbvL2590tRw1D3dn0835tTVZfCLkIvNsIx6ixWVTQvqNDE1OYcNL0DIAgvYTQy1MJIRKRinPjX3jDhNgR1wexdT_VLk6cSrZqHCympyE7R5TXud5OW66lQz7oyZ2h7nVVm1k9c3SS0SoFsBQuEWitvicI1FbTEgdPkXZR0U6_/s1672/germany-mica-crypto-providers-banks.jpg.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Illustration of Germany leading Europe’s regulated crypto market as traditional banks enter the MiCA framework." border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgnmJOg8kO5dDwjsIMdwtjYbvL2590tRw1D3dn0835tTVZfCLkIvNsIx6ixWVTQvqNDE1OYcNL0DIAgvYTQy1MJIRKRinPjX3jDhNgR1wexdT_VLk6cSrZqHCympyE7R5TXud5OW66lQz7oyZ2h7nVVm1k9c3SS0SoFsBQuEWitvicI1FbTEgdPkXZR0U6_/w400-h225/germany-mica-crypto-providers-banks.jpg.png" title="Germany Leads EU in MiCA-Authorized Crypto Providers" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;By CoinAINews Staff | &lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany has solidified its position as the European Union’s
leading hub for regulated crypto services, with &lt;b&gt;six cooperative banks
joining the MiCA-authorized list&lt;/b&gt; and pushing the country’s total to 79
licensed crypto-asset service providers.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The latest figures come from an update to the European
Securities and Markets Authority’s (ESMA) MiCA register. The update brought
Germany’s total to &lt;b&gt;79 authorized crypto-asset service providers (CASPs)&lt;/b&gt;,
putting it ahead of other major European crypto markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The development is particularly significant because the
latest additions include traditional financial institutions rather than only
crypto-native companies. It suggests that regulated digital-asset services are
increasingly becoming part of the conventional European banking landscape.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany Extends Its MiCA Lead&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany’s total increased after six cooperative banks
received authorization under the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets
Regulation, commonly known as MiCA.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The six newly added institutions are &lt;b&gt;Raiffeisenbank
Aidlingen, Ihre Volksbank, VR-Bank Mittelfranken Mitte, Volksbank Euskirchen,
VR Bank Ried-Überwald and Volksbank Backnang&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Their inclusion gives Germany &lt;b&gt;79 authorized CASPs&lt;/b&gt;,
according to the latest register data.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The growing number of regulated providers puts Germany at
the forefront of Europe’s formal crypto economy and reinforces its position as
an important &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/michael-saylor-calls-bitcoins-most.html"&gt;market&lt;/a&gt; for digital-asset businesses.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What MiCA Authorization Means&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;MiCA is the European Union’s regulatory framework for
crypto-assets. It establishes common rules for crypto-asset issuers and service
providers across the bloc.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The framework covers areas including authorization and
supervision of crypto-asset service providers, consumer and investor
protection, transparency requirements and measures addressing market abuse.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Rules governing CASP authorization and ongoing supervision
became applicable from &lt;b&gt;December 30, 2024&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For companies operating under the framework, authorization
provides a regulated foundation for offering covered crypto services within the
European market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;MiCA also creates a more harmonized regulatory environment
than the fragmented national approaches that existed across Europe before the
framework came into effect.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Six Banks Join the Crypto Economy&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The arrival of &lt;b&gt;six German cooperative banks in the latest
register update is particularly notable — it signals that traditional banking
is moving into crypto.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For years, European crypto adoption was largely associated
with exchanges, fintech companies and specialist digital-asset businesses. The
growing participation of established banks shows that regulated &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/solanas-sgp-0002-vote-faster.html"&gt;crypto services&lt;/a&gt;
are increasingly being incorporated into traditional financial institutions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Depending on their individual authorization, banks can
potentially offer permitted crypto-related services such as custody and
execution.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That could make cryptocurrency services more accessible to
customers who prefer dealing with established financial institutions instead of
dedicated crypto platforms.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why Germany Matters&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany already had one of Europe’s more developed
regulatory environments for digital assets before MiCA became fully applicable.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The country’s financial regulator, BaFin, has played an
important role in supervising crypto-related businesses, while MiCA provides
the broader EU framework.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany’s growing number of authorized providers therefore
gives the country a substantial presence within Europe’s regulated
digital-asset industry.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;However, a MiCA authorization does not eliminate the risks
associated with cryptocurrency. Regulation establishes requirements and
supervisory structures, but digital assets remain subject to significant
market, operational and investment risks.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Europe’s Crypto Market Is Becoming More Institutional&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany’s latest additions point to a wider change taking
place across Europe.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;As MiCA becomes more established, crypto businesses are
increasingly operating within a common regulatory framework designed to provide
consistent standards across EU markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The growing participation of banks could encourage
additional institutional adoption, particularly among financial companies that
previously faced uncertainty about how crypto-related activities would fit
within national regulatory systems.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany’s latest six additions are therefore important
beyond the country itself. They show that traditional financial institutions
are beginning to use Europe’s regulatory framework as a pathway into the
digital-asset market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Regulation Could Reshape Competition&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany’s lead could also affect competition among European
financial centers.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A large number of authorized providers can make a market
more attractive to crypto companies, financial institutions and infrastructure
providers. A larger regulated ecosystem can create opportunities for exchanges,
custody businesses, payment providers and other companies supporting digital
assets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But authorization numbers alone will not determine which
country becomes Europe’s dominant crypto hub.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Tax policy, banking access, institutional demand, regulatory
supervision, technology infrastructure and the ability to serve customers
across the EU will also influence the competition.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bigger Picture&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The latest MiCA developments show that Europe’s
cryptocurrency market is moving further toward a regulated and institutional
model.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany’s &lt;b&gt;79 authorized CASPs&lt;/b&gt; put it at the top of
the EU rankings, while the addition of six cooperative banks demonstrates that
traditional financial institutions are increasingly participating in the
sector.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The development also reflects one of MiCA’s central
objectives: creating a common regulatory framework that gives crypto businesses
clearer rules for operating across the European market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For crypto companies, that can mean greater regulatory
clarity. For financial institutions, it creates a formal route into digital
assets. And for consumers, it provides a more clearly defined environment in
which to evaluate crypto service providers.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Germany has extended its lead in Europe’s regulated crypto
market, reaching &lt;b&gt;79 MiCA-authorized crypto-asset service providers&lt;/b&gt; after
six cooperative banks joined the latest register update.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The most important part of the development may not be the
number itself. It is the fact that traditional financial institutions are
increasingly becoming part of Europe’s regulated crypto ecosystem.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;As MiCA continues to reshape the continent’s digital-asset
industry, Germany’s growing lead could make it an increasingly important center
for regulated crypto services.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;It is the growing connection between traditional European
banking and the regulated crypto economy — a shift that could define the next
phase of digital-asset adoption.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

not constitute investment advice. Cryptocurrency markets are volatile, and
readers should conduct their own research before making financial decisions.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
