    <title>Bitwise CEO Hunter Horsley Says Crypto Brings People Together Across Backgrounds</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjlgol8-nOWi6XPYBIn9Scy1cQRKPSdFopyYYuvbmw5oMSiIGp6xuYQ-gPrRjOPEbt5Eo3J-OKT4ESEueevgN4NxkAw6n3Am-aS7rwFaHqw56cNoamilzB00cq3KnZrQ8TlV4OV8hyphenhyphen6MAt7ukHjuvs9tGkTjG-ZnYfK1Fexo2yqgU-W46J1iHl6RxcfJy4i/s1672/hunter-horsley-crypto-community-diverse-backgrounds.jpg%20(2).png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Hunter Horsley discusses crypto bringing people from different backgrounds together" border="0" data-original-height="941" data-original-width="1672" height="225" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjlgol8-nOWi6XPYBIn9Scy1cQRKPSdFopyYYuvbmw5oMSiIGp6xuYQ-gPrRjOPEbt5Eo3J-OKT4ESEueevgN4NxkAw6n3Am-aS7rwFaHqw56cNoamilzB00cq3KnZrQ8TlV4OV8hyphenhyphen6MAt7ukHjuvs9tGkTjG-ZnYfK1Fexo2yqgU-W46J1iHl6RxcfJy4i/w400-h225/hunter-horsley-crypto-community-diverse-backgrounds.jpg%20(2).png" title="Hunter Horsley on Crypto Bringing Different Backgrounds Together" width="400" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;By CoinAINews Staff | &lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitwise CEO Hunter Horsley says one of crypto's most
interesting features has little to do with token prices.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;According to a recent comment shared by Horsley, the
crypto industry brings together people from very different backgrounds who
nevertheless share a common ambition: building a better financial and
technological future.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The observation comes at a time when the &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/super-micro-probe-finds-no-evidence.html?m=1"&gt;crypto market&lt;/a&gt;
has grown far beyond its early group of developers and enthusiasts.
Institutional investors, technology entrepreneurs, traditional finance
professionals and retail users now occupy the same ecosystem.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For Horsley, that diversity is part of what makes crypto
different.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto's Unusual Mix of People&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto has always attracted people who might not normally
find themselves in the same financial community.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Developers can debate protocols with economists.
Entrepreneurs can interact directly with investors. Traditional asset managers
can sit alongside long-time Bitcoin users.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That mix can sometimes produce disagreements, but
Horsley's point is that disagreement itself can be productive.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A recent report covering his comments said Horsley
highlighted how people with different backgrounds and credentials are coming
into crypto while sharing a common objective of improving the future. The same
report noted his emphasis on open discussion and disagreement within the
community.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That is a noticeably different message from the usual
crypto conversation, which tends to focus heavily on Bitcoin prices, ETF flows,
market cycles and short-term speculation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why Diversity Matters in Crypto&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The crypto industry is no longer a small technology
experiment.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin has become an investment asset, while blockchain
networks are increasingly being explored for payments, financial infrastructure
and tokenized assets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That expansion has brought people from many different
professional backgrounds into the industry.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Some arrive through technology.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Others come through finance.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Some are interested in monetary policy and Bitcoin, while
others focus on stablecoins, decentralized applications or on-chain financial
markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The result is an ecosystem where disagreements are almost
unavoidable.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Horsley's argument suggests that this may actually be a
strength.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Different perspectives can challenge assumptions that
might otherwise go unquestioned.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Hunter Horsley's Role in the Crypto Industry&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Horsley is the co-founder and CEO of Bitwise Asset
Management, a crypto-focused investment firm that provides investment products
and research around digital assets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitwise's own website identifies Horsley as CEO and a
board director and describes the company's mission as expanding access to
crypto.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;His background is also somewhat different from that of
many early crypto executives.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Before co-founding Bitwise, Horsley worked in product
roles at Facebook and Instagram. His experience in consumer technology helped
shape his approach to making crypto investment products easier for traditional
investors to access.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That perspective has become particularly relevant as
crypto has moved closer to mainstream financial markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;From Crypto Enthusiasts to Institutions&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The makeup of the crypto industry has changed
significantly over the past several years.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin was initially associated largely with individual
users, developers and a relatively small group of technology enthusiasts.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Today, the ecosystem includes asset managers, financial
advisers, banks, hedge funds, family offices and other institutional investors.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The arrival of spot Bitcoin ETFs in the United States
accelerated that transition.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitwise was among the firms that launched a U.S. spot
Bitcoin ETF, giving investors a traditional exchange-traded vehicle for gaining
exposure to Bitcoin.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Horsley has previously argued that crypto needed
investment products that fit the way traditional investors already access
markets.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That shift has helped connect two groups that
historically operated in very different financial worlds.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto Is Still Full of Disagreement&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Despite the industry's growth, crypto remains far from
unified.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;There are major disagreements over everything from
Bitcoin's role as money to the future of Ethereum, &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/next-coin-to-pump-traders-are-watching.html"&gt;stablecoins&lt;/a&gt; and
decentralized finance.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Even within Bitcoin itself, investors can disagree
sharply about monetary policy, scaling, custody and regulation.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That makes Horsley's comments about open discussion
particularly relevant.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A market where participants come from different
backgrounds will naturally contain conflicting opinions.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The important question is whether those disagreements
lead to better ideas rather than simply more division.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bigger Idea Behind Horsley's Comment&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Horsley's latest remarks were not a new Bitcoin price
prediction or a call for investors to buy a particular cryptocurrency.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Instead, they focused on the people participating in the
industry.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That distinction matters.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto coverage often revolves around price targets,
market forecasts and institutional flows. But the long-term development of the
industry also depends on whether developers, investors, entrepreneurs and users
can continue working together despite having very different views.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That may be one of the reasons the industry continues to
attract people from outside its traditional base.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why This Could Matter for Crypto's Next Phase&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;As crypto becomes more integrated with traditional
finance, the industry's diversity could become increasingly important.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Institutional investors bring experience with portfolio
construction and risk management.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Technology developers bring expertise in software and
infrastructure.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Entrepreneurs experiment with new applications.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Retail users often provide the earliest demand for new
products and services.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Each group sees crypto through a different lens.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Combining those perspectives can create friction, but it
can also produce ideas that would be difficult to develop inside a single
professional community.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitwise and the Broader Push for Crypto Adoption&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitwise has positioned itself around making digital
assets more accessible to traditional investors.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The firm's current materials emphasize expanding access
to crypto and serving wealth-management professionals, family offices and
institutional clients.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That strategy reflects a broader transformation in the
market.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto is no longer operating entirely outside
traditional finance.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Instead, the two worlds are increasingly overlapping.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitcoin ETFs are one example.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Stablecoins are another.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Tokenization and on-chain financial products could become
another major bridge between the two systems.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;As these markets develop, people with different
professional backgrounds will likely continue entering the industry.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What Horsley's Message Means for Investors&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;There is no immediate trading signal in Horsley's
comment.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;He was not announcing a new Bitcoin target or predicting
a specific market move.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Instead, his observation points toward something more
fundamental: crypto has become a broad enough industry to attract people with
very different experiences and motivations.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For investors, that can be important because innovation
rarely comes from one type of participant alone.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A developer may identify a technical opportunity that a
traditional investor misses.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A financial professional may spot a risk that a developer
overlooks.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;A user may highlight a problem that neither group
initially considered.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That interaction is part of how emerging financial
technology develops.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Bitwise CEO Hunter Horsley says crypto brings together
people from different backgrounds who share a common ambition of improving the
future.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;His comments highlight a side of the cryptocurrency
industry that is often overlooked during periods of intense market volatility.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto is no longer made up of a single type of investor
or developer.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;It includes technology professionals, traditional finance
experts, entrepreneurs, institutions and individual users — often with very
different opinions about where the industry should go next.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;That diversity can create plenty of disagreement.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But if Horsley's broader point holds, the ability to
debate those differences while working toward common goals could ultimately
become one of crypto's biggest strengths.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;i&gt;CoinAINews provides independent coverage of
cryptocurrency, technology, finance and digital-asset markets. This article is
for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>China’s New AI Side Hustle: People Are Licensing Their Faces for Digital Content</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;h1&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhjQK_6oVRSW_Pz802KMuOv5KqtI6Psuz9NqgpJxCVthUnpSYChQ1vVKOKv5izPAjgtgesBb2Zr9cXnwJClFipG2RflqDSHL1nM9LE6OcmXYWIHmBkClqkgI3Obdgl7RjtIyF_7pN4R4BrFkxVBZT9MDb0xRXi7Y3azHsifJ_U23QMd4V5aeTuhiT_oOByu/s1734/china-ai-face-licensing-digital-likeness.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;img alt="People in China licensing their faces for AI-generated dramas, ads and digital content" border="0" data-original-height="907" data-original-width="1734" height="334" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhjQK_6oVRSW_Pz802KMuOv5KqtI6Psuz9NqgpJxCVthUnpSYChQ1vVKOKv5izPAjgtgesBb2Zr9cXnwJClFipG2RflqDSHL1nM9LE6OcmXYWIHmBkClqkgI3Obdgl7RjtIyF_7pN4R4BrFkxVBZT9MDb0xRXi7Y3azHsifJ_U23QMd4V5aeTuhiT_oOByu/w640-h334/china-ai-face-licensing-digital-likeness.webp.png" title="China AI Face Licensing: Turning Digital Likeness Into Income" width="640" /&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;China’s AI boom is creating a surprising new way for ordinary people to make money: licensing their faces for use in AI-generated videos, advertisements, games and digital dramas.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h1&gt;

&lt;p&gt;You do not necessarily need to become an actor, influencer or model. In a growing market for digital likenesses, your face itself can become something that content producers pay to use.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Recent reports from China describe platforms where people can register their faces, complete identity verification and offer licensing rights to producers looking for realistic human appearances for AI-generated content. Reported fees range from relatively small payments to deals worth as much as 99,999 yuan, or roughly ₹14 lakh, depending on the platform and licensing terms. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But there is an important distinction: the highest reported figure represents an upper-end listing or deal value, not what the average person is earning. Actual payments can vary significantly depending on how the face can be used, for how long and in how many productions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What Is Face Licensing in AI?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Face licensing is relatively straightforward in concept.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A person provides photographs or other facial data to a platform and agrees to specific terms governing how their likeness can be used. After verification, the person's face can appear in a catalogue that content producers can search when creating &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/sent-btc-to-wrong-address-what-happens.html"&gt;AI-generated characters.&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of hiring someone for an entire filming session, an AI production company may license the person's likeness and use it as source material for a digital character.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Platforms can allow producers to search for faces according to characteristics such as age, gender and appearance. Some catalogues also categorize faces according to the type of role they might fit, such as an everyday character, a rugged appearance or a more conventional model look. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The concept is similar to licensing stock photography, except the asset being licensed is much more personal: a person's recognizable appearance.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;How Much Money Can Someone Make From Their Face?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This is where the story becomes particularly interesting.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Reports cited by Indian and international publications say emerging Chinese face-licensing platforms have advertised or facilitated payments ranging from tens of yuan to much larger amounts. One reported upper-end figure is 99,999 yuan, approximately ₹14 lakh. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;However, that number should not be interpreted as a typical payout.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Rest of World reported that some platforms were paying people between about $15 and $700 to license their likenesses for AI-generated content. On ActID, for example, reported fees for &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/ai-crypto-will-humans-become-obsolete.html"&gt;AI drama projects&lt;/a&gt; ranged from 99 yuan to 500 yuan per episode, with the platform taking a 10% commission. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One example highlighted in recent reporting involved a Chinese bank employee whose face was licensed seven times by an advertising company over three days. The person reportedly received about 2,500 yuan, or roughly $370, for those uses. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;So the real earning potential depends on the contract, rather than simply uploading a face and automatically receiving a large payment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Why Do AI Companies Need Real Human Faces?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;AI can generate completely artificial people, so why would producers pay for real faces?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;One reason is realism.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;AI-generated characters can sometimes look repetitive or unnatural. Real human faces provide more variety and can help producers create characters that appear less generic.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;There is also a practical production advantage. An AI drama does not necessarily require the person behind the face to spend hours on a film set. The producer can license the likeness and use it as source material for a digital character.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That changes the economics of digital entertainment.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Instead of paying an actor for every physical appearance, a production may pay for defined digital usage rights. The person can potentially continue working or living normally while their licensed likeness appears in &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/09/openai-makes-progress-on-another.html"&gt;AI-generated content.&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;China Is Building a Market for Digital Actors&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The emergence of these platforms is closely connected to China's rapidly expanding AI-generated entertainment industry.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Rest of World reported that more than 95% of the microdramas released in China during the first three months of 2026 used AI somewhere in their production process. The publication also reported that ActID had registered around 800 users after launching in March, with roughly 300 agreeing to license their images. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Two AI drama productions had reportedly licensed around 10 faces through the platform at the time of that report.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;This suggests that face licensing is still an emerging market rather than a mature industry where millions of people are routinely earning large amounts.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;From Private Industry Deals to Public Platforms&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The idea of paying for a person's likeness is not completely new.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;What is changing is how easily these transactions can be organized.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;According to reporting from China, face-related deals were previously handled largely through private groups connected to the film and television industry. Increasingly, specialized platforms are bringing the process into a more structured marketplace where people can register their likeness and producers can search for suitable faces. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That could make digital likeness licensing accessible to people who would never have considered themselves professional actors or models.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Can People Choose How Their Face Is Used?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In principle, that is one of the major selling points of the new model.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Platforms can allow users to define permitted uses, duration and other licensing conditions. A person may be able to decide whether their face can appear in advertisements, games, short dramas or other types of digital content. Some platforms also allow users to set prices based on the requested usage. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That creates a crucial difference between authorized face licensing and unauthorized AI face generation.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In the first model, the person agrees to defined usage terms. In the second, someone can reproduce a person's identity without permission.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Biggest Problem: Once Your Face Is Digital, Who Controls It?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The money may sound attractive, but licensing a face is fundamentally different from selling an ordinary photograph.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A photograph can be removed from one website. A digital likeness can potentially be copied, modified, trained into other systems or used in new contexts.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That creates difficult questions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul&gt;
&lt;li&gt;How long does the license remain valid?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Can the producer use the face in future AI models?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Can the license be transferred to another company?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;What happens if the face appears in content the person dislikes?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;Can the person revoke permission later?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;li&gt;What happens to stored biometric information?&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p&gt;These questions are becoming more important as AI-generated video becomes cheaper and easier to produce.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;China Is Also Tightening Rules Around AI Faces&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The rise of face licensing comes at the same time as Chinese authorities are addressing unauthorized AI replicas.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;In September 2026, China's Supreme People's Court issued guidance concerning disputes involving artificial intelligence. The guidance states that, except where otherwise provided by law, using AI to process a person's name or likeness without consent to create and use a recognizable virtual digital representation can infringe personality rights. It also addresses unauthorized voice cloning and AI-generated content that harms a person's reputation. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;China's regulatory framework is therefore developing alongside the commercial market: people can potentially license their likeness, while unauthorized reproduction remains subject to legal restrictions.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Earlier in 2026, China's cyberspace regulator also published a draft framework for digital virtual human information services. The proposal emphasized individual consent when sensitive personal information is used for modeling or generating digital identities and called for protection of rights such as likeness, reputation, privacy and personal information. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Is This the Future of the Creator Economy?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;It could become one part of it.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The internet already turned photographs, videos, voices and personal brands into monetizable assets. Generative AI is expanding that idea by making a person's visual identity usable in entirely new ways.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;A person who once earned money by appearing in a commercial might now license a digital version of their appearance. An extra who never became famous could potentially have their face used in multiple AI productions without physically appearing on set.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;At the same time, the economics remain uncertain.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;AI can generate synthetic faces at very low cost, meaning producers may not always need real people. Real faces could be most valuable when a production wants realism, diversity, recognizable features or specific character types.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;That means face licensing is unlikely to turn every smartphone user into a high-paid digital actor.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Could Your Face Become a Digital Asset?&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;The more important development may not be the reported ₹14 lakh figure. It is the idea that human likeness itself is becoming something that can be catalogued, licensed and commercially used by AI systems.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For years, people have treated their photographs as personal content. Generative AI is pushing the conversation further: what happens when the face itself becomes a reusable digital asset?&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;China's emerging market offers one possible answer. People can voluntarily license their likenesses, producers can obtain permission to use them, and platforms can act as intermediaries.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the model also highlights the importance of reading licensing agreements carefully. A short-term payment may not be worth it if a contract grants broad, long-lasting rights that are difficult to revoke.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;What This Means for Ordinary Internet Users&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;You do not need to participate in a face-licensing platform to be affected by this trend.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;AI tools can already create realistic images, videos and face swaps. As these technologies improve, the difference between an ordinary photograph and commercially useful biometric information becomes increasingly important.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For anyone considering licensing their face, the key questions are not simply “How much will I earn?” but also “Who gets the rights?”, “For how long?”, “For what purposes?” and “What happens to my data after the agreement ends?”&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;Those questions could become just as important as the payment itself.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;Frequently Asked Questions&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can people in China really make money by licensing their faces to AI companies?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Yes. Recent reporting describes Chinese platforms that connect people willing to license their likenesses with producers creating AI-generated dramas, advertisements and games. Payments vary widely depending on the agreement and usage rights. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;What is the highest reported amount for an AI face license?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Recent reports cite an upper-end figure of 99,999 yuan, approximately ₹14 lakh. This should not be treated as an average earning or guaranteed payment. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Why would an AI company pay for a real person's face?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Real faces can provide greater visual variety and realism for AI-generated characters. Producers can also license specific likenesses for defined projects instead of hiring someone for a traditional physical shoot. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Can people decide where their face is used?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Some face-licensing platforms allow users to set conditions covering permitted content, duration and other usage rights. The exact protections depend on the individual platform and contract. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is using someone's face with AI without permission legal in China?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;China's Supreme People's Court issued September 2026 guidance stating that unauthorized AI processing of a person's likeness to create and use a recognizable digital representation can infringe personality rights, subject to applicable legal exceptions. &lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h3&gt;Is face licensing the same as selling your identity permanently?&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Not necessarily. A license can be limited by time, purpose, platform or number of productions. However, the exact legal effect depends on the contract, which is why the scope of rights matters.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;h2&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;/h2&gt;

&lt;p&gt;China's emerging AI face-licensing market shows how quickly artificial intelligence is changing the value of personal identity.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;For some people, a face that was once simply part of their identity can now become a licensed digital asset used in AI dramas, advertisements and games. Reported payments range from modest per-use fees to a headline-grabbing upper end of nearly ₹14 lakh.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;But the bigger story is not simply about making money from a face. It is about ownership, consent and control in an era when AI can reproduce human appearances at scale.&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;As digital characters become a larger part of entertainment, advertising and online media, the question may soon shift from &lt;strong&gt;“Can AI copy your face?”&lt;/strong&gt; to &lt;strong&gt;“Who has the legal right to use it, and for how long?”&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Sources:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

    <title>Are There Legit Crypto Recovery Companies? The Honest Answer</title>
    <content type='html'>&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEizjtJZbmBJpm_7DZ_RoJHy7wZezFqqcGK7tf0kk0qT-Z6IoCbHuJOycPKYw7bFRmmUQn5-bkW03bL1_MGEVeV_XVnjpCvNPkPbvjKM5Zf2EfRxq9ogfHMzDe74BaJCUtKY4k6eQnZ52YnG1G7UJm-KXgJW-qaISuOr7KrW6ysNWcM-TSaLtP_vL3-T6eop/s1536/legit-crypto-recovery-companies-scam-warning.webp.png" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;img alt="Legitimate crypto recovery companies and cryptocurrency recovery scam warning illustration" border="0" data-original-height="1024" data-original-width="1536" height="213" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEizjtJZbmBJpm_7DZ_RoJHy7wZezFqqcGK7tf0kk0qT-Z6IoCbHuJOycPKYw7bFRmmUQn5-bkW03bL1_MGEVeV_XVnjpCvNPkPbvjKM5Zf2EfRxq9ogfHMzDe74BaJCUtKY4k6eQnZ52YnG1G7UJm-KXgJW-qaISuOr7KrW6ysNWcM-TSaLtP_vL3-T6eop/w320-h213/legit-crypto-recovery-companies-scam-warning.webp.png" title="Are There Legit Crypto Recovery Companies? The Honest Answer" width="320" /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;br /&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If you've lost crypto to a scam, a forgotten password, or a
corrupted wallet file, you've probably asked yourself this question at least
once: are there actually legitimate recovery companies, or is the whole
industry just a second scam waiting to happen?&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Quick answer:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Legitimate crypto recovery
services do exist, but no legitimate company can guarantee that stolen
cryptocurrency will be recovered. Technical wallet-access recovery is different
from investigating stolen funds, and victims should be extremely cautious of
unsolicited recovery offers and upfront-payment demands.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The recovery industry has a serious scam problem, with
fraudsters frequently impersonating legitimate companies, law firms and
government agencies. Scammers copy logos, clone websites, and promise the world
for an upfront fee.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;This guide cuts through the noise — so you know what
actually works, who to trust, and how to avoid getting scammed twice.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why Crypto Recovery Is Still Difficult&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Before we talk about who can help, let's set expectations.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Crypto recovery remains uncommon, particularly in cases
involving stolen funds that have already moved through multiple wallets,
exchanges or jurisdictions. According to Global Ledger's 2025 analysis,
approximately 6.52% of stolen funds, worth about $263.23 million, were returned
across the 255 incidents it tracked .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center received 181,565
cryptocurrency fraud complaints totaling more than $11 billion in losses in
2025 — a 22% increase from 2024, according to the FBI IC3 2025 report . The FBI
has issued multiple public service announcements specifically warning about
fake crypto recovery services .&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Why? Because recovery is genuinely difficult. Criminal fund
movements often cross multiple blockchains, use mixing services, and operate
across jurisdictions. There is no "undo" button on a blockchain
transaction.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;But "difficult" is not the same as
"impossible." And legitimate services do exist.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Types of Recovery Assistance&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The crypto recovery industry is not one thing. Different
types of organizations handle different parts of the recovery process.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Type 1: Law Enforcement-Initiated Recoveries&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Law-enforcement-led cases can offer recovery options that
private firms cannot provide on their own, because authorities may have access
to legal processes that can support asset freezes or seizures.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The FBI encourages victims to report cryptocurrency fraud as
soon as possible because rapid reporting can help support efforts to recover
lost funds.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Type 2: Public-Private Partnerships&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;These are coalitions that embed law enforcement into the
asset recovery process. Private sector intelligence combines with law
enforcement's legal power to seize funds. When these partnerships work, they
can produce results that neither side could achieve alone.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Type 3: Experienced Private Investigative Firms&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Some experienced firms work with lawyers, law enforcement
agencies, exchanges or other relevant parties when appropriate. These companies
generally cannot seize funds themselves. Their role may include tracing
transactions, identifying relevant services or counterparties, and preparing
investigative material that can support legal or law-enforcement action.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Examples of firms operating in this area include:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Recoveris (Switzerland):&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;A vendor-neutral
blockchain investigation firm built by law enforcement and legal professionals.
The company says it is a member of ICC FraudNet, a global recovery framework
that connects asset recovery lawyers across 81 countries . Recoveris says its
team includes former law enforcement specialists and that it can prepare
investigative reports to support legal proceedings.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Crypto Legal (UK/US):&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;A blockchain forensics and
legal services firm with lawyers registered by the Solicitors Regulation
Authority. Team members hold certifications like Cryptocurrency Tracing
Certified Examiner (CTCE), according to the company.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Important note:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Mentioning a &lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/p2p-vs-bank-transfers-which-crypto.html"&gt;company &lt;/a&gt;in this
article does not constitute an endorsement or a guarantee that its services
will recover funds. Readers should independently verify a firm's registration,
credentials, fee structure and references before engaging it.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Type 4: Technical Wallet Access Recovery — Often More
Realistic&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If you forgot your wallet password, lost part of your seed
phrase, or have a corrupted wallet file, this is where recovery is most
realistic. These are&amp;nbsp;&lt;b&gt;&lt;a href="https://www.coinainews.com/2026/08/how-ai-is-making-blockchain-fraud.html"&gt;technical problems&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;— not legal battles.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Crypto Recovers&lt;/b&gt;, a Netherlands-based company founded
in 2019, says it restored access to more than $2.5 million in inaccessible
cryptocurrency assets in 2025 . The company reported that its largest single
recovery was approximately $1.5 million.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The company specializes in wallets like Ledger, Trezor,
MetaMask, and even deprecated wallets like Jaxx Liberty and MultiBit.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;How it works:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Users provide whatever information
they have — password hints, partial seed phrases, wallet files — and the
company uses custom software and high-performance computing to brute-force the
missing pieces. Success depends on the accuracy of the information provided.
According to Crypto Recovers, the standard commission for successful recovery
is 20%, with flexibility for high-value cases . The company says it does not
handle scam-related cases directly, but has built a network of trusted partners
who specialize in scam investigations and law enforcement support.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Type 5: Inexperienced Private Firms&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Smaller firms that may have access to paid tools but lack
relationships with law enforcement or exchanges. They often produce incomplete
or inaccurate reports.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Type 6: Scammers&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;These are pure frauds. They contact victims unsolicited,
often already knowing details of their previous loss, and demand upfront fees.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;When Recovery Actually Makes Sense&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Different types of losses call for different types of help.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;1. Technical Wallet Access Losses&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If you have partial information about your wallet — a
forgotten password, a partial seed phrase, a corrupted wallet file — technical
recovery is realistic. Companies like Crypto Recovers exist specifically for
this purpose.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;2. Scam Theft and Fraud Investigations&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;If your crypto was stolen in a scam, you need an
investigative firm — not a "recovery" firm that promises magic.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;What legitimate investigators actually do:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Trace
     funds across wallets, bridges, mixers, and exchanges&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Identify
     wallet clusters and exchange flows&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Prepare
     reports that can support legal proceedings&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Coordinate
     with law enforcement and exchanges&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Support
     legal action through subpoenas and preservation orders&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The critical distinction:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Private investigators
generally cannot seize funds themselves; meaningful recovery may ultimately
require cooperation from law enforcement, exchanges, courts, or other relevant
authorities.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;3. Institutional and Cross-Border Recovery&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;For larger claims involving multiple jurisdictions,
securities law, and corporate structures, specialist firms coordinate legal,
regulatory, and technical expertise across markets. They assess not just where
the money went, but where capital was raised, which regulatory regimes are
engaged, and whether the record supports recovery action.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-family: &amp;quot;Segoe UI Emoji&amp;quot;,sans-serif; mso-bidi-font-family: &amp;quot;Segoe UI Emoji&amp;quot;;"&gt;💀&lt;/span&gt; The Red Flags: How to
Spot a Recovery Scam&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The FBI has issued repeated warnings about crypto recovery
scams. Here's how they operate:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Step 1: Finding Victims.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Scammers actively
source contact lists of people who have reported crypto losses — through
forums, social media, complaint boards, and darknet data. Someone who has
posted about losing money is a "qualified lead."&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Step 2: Impersonating a Credible Brand.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;They
copy logos, domains, and documentation of real blockchain analytics companies.
Fake domains look almost identical to real ones. The FBI warns that criminals
are using AI-generated videos featuring senior FBI officials and cloned voices
to impersonate government agencies.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Step 3: The Ask.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;They demand an upfront fee —
"legal costs," "verification deposits," or "insurance
bonds." Once the payment is made, they disappear. Sometimes they request
additional payments before vanishing completely.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;The key warning signs:&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" class="MsoNormalTable" style="border-collapse: collapse; mso-yfti-tbllook: 1184; width: 744px;"&gt;

   &lt;/td&gt;
   &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12.0pt 7.5pt 12.0pt;"&gt;

   &lt;/td&gt;

  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;They contact you first&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12.0pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;An unsolicited recovery offer is a major warning sign.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 2;"&gt;

  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;They demand upfront payment&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12.0pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Be especially cautious when payment is requested before
  meaningful investigative work.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;

  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;They guarantee results&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12.0pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;No legitimate service can guarantee that stolen
  cryptocurrency will be recovered.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
 &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 4;"&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 12.0pt 7.5pt 0cm;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;They ask for private keys&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12.0pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Never give your seed phrase or private key to a recovery
  service.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;

 &lt;tr style="mso-yfti-irow: 5; mso-yfti-lastrow: yes;"&gt;

  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;They pressure you to act fast&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
  &lt;td style="padding: 7.5pt 0cm 7.5pt 12.0pt;"&gt;
  &lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Urgency is a common tactic used in scams.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
  &lt;/td&gt;
 &lt;/tr&gt;
&lt;/tbody&gt;&lt;/table&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What to Do If You Need Help&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;1. Preserve everything.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Transaction hashes,
wallet addresses, screenshots, communications — save everything before you
contact anyone.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;2. Contact the exchange first.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;If you sent funds
through a centralized exchange, contact their compliance or fraud team
immediately. They can sometimes freeze accounts if you act quickly.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;3. File official reports.&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;Report to the FBI IC3,
local police, or your country's cybercrime authority. Official reports create a
record that can support freeze requests.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;4. Choose the right type of help.&lt;/b&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Technical
     wallet issue&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;(lost password, partial seed) → Look for a wallet
     recovery specialist like Crypto Recovers.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l2 level1 lfo2; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Scam
     theft&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;→ Look for an investigative firm with law enforcement
     relationships and legal credentials.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;5. Be wary of unsolicited recovery offers&lt;/b&gt;, especially
advertisements or messages making guaranteed recovery claims.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;b&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The Bottom Line&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Yes, legitimate crypto recovery services exist. But they
don't do what you might expect.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Legitimate recovery providers cannot guarantee that stolen
funds will be recovered. They should not guarantee that an upfront payment will
unlock or guarantee the recovery of stolen funds. Be especially cautious when a
company demands an upfront payment for verification, unlocking, insurance,
taxes or guaranteed recovery.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;What they actually do is:&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;ul style="margin-top: 0cm;" type="disc"&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l3 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Trace
     funds using blockchain analytics&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l3 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Prepare
     reports that can support legal proceedings&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l3 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Coordinate
     with law enforcement and exchanges&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
 &lt;li class="MsoNormal" style="mso-list: l3 level1 lfo3; tab-stops: list 36.0pt;"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;Support
     legal action&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;
&lt;/ul&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;The recovery industry has a serious impersonation problem.
Legitimate firms invest significant resources in monitoring and removing
fraudulent domains that copy their brands.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;p class="MsoNormal"&gt;&lt;span style="font-size: medium;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;Just remember:&lt;/b&gt;&amp;nbsp;recovery is rare, difficult, and
never guaranteed. Claims of guaranteed recovery should be treated as a major
warning sign.&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;div align="center" class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center;"&gt;

&lt;hr align="center" size="1" width="100%" /&gt;

guidance on your specific situation.&lt;/i&gt;&lt;o:p&gt;&lt;/o:p&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
